meaning: अत्र कृष्णाजिनस्यादानादि प्रागधिवर्तनात्कृत्वा दिव स्कम्भनिरसीति कृष्णाजिन उदीचीनकुम्बां श्म्यां निधाय धिषणासि पर्वत्येति शम्यायां दृषदमत्याधाय धिषणासि पार्वतेयीति दृषद्युपलामत्यादधाति
text_mt: Here, having performed the actions beginning with the taking of the black antelope skin up to the placing of [the mortar], having placed the yoke-peg with its point facing north on the black antelope skin with: 'You are the prop of heaven!', having placed the lower grinding-stone across the yoke-peg with: 'You are the rock, daughter of the mountain!', he places the upper grinding-stone on the lower grinding-stone with: 'You are the rock, daughter of the mountain!'

sanskrit_iast: aṃśava stha madhumanta iti taṇḍulān abhimantrya devasya tvety anudrutyāgnaye juṣṭam adhivapāmīti yathādevataṃ dṛṣadi taṇḍulān adhivapati trir yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham
meaning: अंशव स्थ मधुमन्त इति तण्डुलान् अभिमन्त्र्य देवस्य त्वेत्य् अनुद्रुत्याग्नये जुष्टम् अधिवपामीति यथादेवतं दृषदि तण्डुलान् अधिवपति त्रिर् यजुषा तूष्णीं चतुर्थम्
text_mt: Having consecrated the rice grains with: 'You are shoots full of sweetness!', and having recited: 'At the impulse of the divine...', he pours the rice grains onto the lower grinding-stone according to the deity with: 'I pour you out pleasing to Agni'—thrice with the formula, the fourth time silently.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāya tveti prācīmupalāṃ prohatyapānāya tveti pratīcīṃ vyānāya tveti madhyadeśe vyavadhārayati prāṇāya tvāpānāya tvā vyānāya tveti saṃtataṃ pinaṣṭi
meaning: प्राणाय त्वेति प्राचीमुपलां प्रोहत्यपानाय त्वेति प्रतीचीं व्यानाय त्वेति मध्यदेशे व्यवधारयति प्राणाय त्वापानाय त्वा व्यानाय त्वेति संततं पिनष्टि
text_mt: With: 'For the out-breath, thee!' he pushes the upper grinding-stone eastwards; with: 'For the in-breath, thee!' westwards; with: 'For the cross-breath, thee!' he holds it in the middle region; with: 'For out-breath thee! For in-breath thee! For cross-breath thee!' he grinds continuously.

sanskrit_iast: dīrghāmanu prasitimāyuṣe dhāmiti prācīmantato 'nuprohya devo vaḥ savitā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratigṛhṇātv iti kṛṣṇājine piṣṭāni praskandayitvādabdhena vaścakṣuṣāvekṣa ity avekṣyāsaṃvapantī piṃṣāṇūti kurutād iti saṃpreṣyati
meaning: दीर्घामनु प्रसितिमायुषे धामिति प्राचीमन्ततो ऽनुप्रोह्य देवो वः सविता हिरण्यपाणिः प्रतिगृह्णात्व् इति कृष्णाजिने पिष्टानि प्रस्कन्दयित्वादब्धेन वश्चक्षुषावेक्ष इत्य् अवेक्ष्यासंवपन्ती पिंषाणूति कुरुताद् इति संप्रेष्यति
text_mt: Having pushed [it] forth to the east at the end with: 'Along an extended course for life I set thee!', having poured out the flour onto the black antelope skin with: 'May the divine Savitṛ of golden hands receive you!', and having looked [at it] with: 'With an unblinking eye I look upon you,' he gives the ritual call: 'Grinding without spilling, make [it] fine!'

sanskrit_iast: api vā patny avahanti śūdrā pinaṣṭi
meaning: अपि वा पत्न्य् अवहन्ति शूद्रा पिनष्टि
text_mt: Or the wife pounds, and a Śūdra woman grinds.
He bakes the sacrificial offerings on the āhavanīya or on the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: dhṛṣṭir asi brahma yacchetyupaveṣamādāya rakṣasaḥ pāṇiṃ dahāhirasi budhniya ity abhimantrayāpāgne 'gnimāmādaṃ jahīti gārhapatyātpratyañcāvaṅgārau nirvartya niṣkravyādaṃ sedheti tayor anyataramuttaramaparamavāntaradeśaṃ nirasyā devayajaṃ vaheti dakṣiṇamavasthāpya dhruvamasīti tasminmadhyamaṃ puroḍāśakapālamupadadhāti
meaning: धृष्टिर् असि ब्रह्म यच्छेत्युपवेषमादाय रक्षसः पाणिं दहाहिरसि बुध्निय इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयापाग्ने ऽग्निमामादं जहीति गार्हपत्यात्प्रत्यञ्चावङ्गारौ निर्वर्त्य निष्क्रव्यादं सेधेति तयोर् अन्यतरमुत्तरमपरमवान्तरदेशं निरस्या देवयजं वहेति दक्षिणमवस्थाप्य ध्रुवमसीति तस्मिन्मध्यमं पुरोडाशकपालमुपदधाति
text_mt: Having taken the fire-stirrer with: 'You are the bold one; grant holy power!', having consecrated it with: 'Burn the hand of the Rakṣas! You are the serpent of the deep!', having turned away two burning coals westwards from the gārhapatya with: 'Drive away, O Agni, the raw-flesh-eating fire!', having discarded one of them towards the north-west intermediate direction with: 'Expel the flesh-eating one!', and having established the southern one with: 'Bring the sacrifice of the gods!', he places the central cake-potsherd upon it with: 'You are steadfast!'

sanskrit_iast: nirdagdhaṃ rakṣo nirdagdhā arātaya iti kapāle 'ṅgāramatyādhāya dhartramasīti pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ saṃspṛṣṭam /
meaning: निर्दग्धं रक्षो निर्दग्धा अरातय इति कपाले ऽङ्गारमत्याधाय धर्त्रमसीति पूर्वं द्वितीयं संस्पृष्टम् /
text_mt: Having put a burning coal on the potsherd with: 'Burnt is the Rakṣas, burnt are the enemies!', [he places] the second [potsherd] contiguous to the east with: 'You are the supporter!'
The third to the east with: 'You are the maintainer!'
To the south of the middle one with: 'You are the pile; sit in all directions!'
To the north of the middle one with: 'You are the enclosing pile; sit in all directions!'
The sixth with: 'You are the host of the Maruts!'
In this way he sets down the subsequent set of potsherds.

sanskrit_iast: api vā madhyamamupadhāya savyasya pāṇer aṅgulyābhinidhāya nirdagdhaṃ rakṣo nirdagdhā arātaya iti kapāle 'ṅgāramatyādhāya dhartramasīti tasmādaparaṃ dharuṇamasīti tasmātpūrvaṃ yathāyogam itarāṇi
meaning: अपि वा मध्यममुपधाय सव्यस्य पाणेर् अङ्गुल्याभिनिधाय निर्दग्धं रक्षो निर्दग्धा अरातय इति कपाले ऽङ्गारमत्याधाय धर्त्रमसीति तस्मादपरं धरुणमसीति तस्मात्पूर्वं यथायोगम् इतराणि
text_mt: Or having set down the middle one, having pressed it down with a finger of the left hand, having put a burning coal on the potsherd with: 'Burnt is the Rakṣas, burnt are the enemies!', [he places] to the west of it with: 'You are the supporter!', to the east of it with: 'You are the maintainer!', and the others according to their proper arrangement.
The Vājasaneyins prescribe the pressing down of each one with a finger and the rolling of a burning coal onto it.

sanskrit_iast: cita sthordhvācita ityūrdhvamaṣṭābhya upadadhāti tūṣṇīṃ vā
meaning: चित स्थोर्ध्वाचित इत्यूर्ध्वमष्टाभ्य उपदधाति तूष्णीं वा
text_mt: He sets down [potsherds] above the eight with: 'You are piled, piled upwards!', or silently.

sanskrit_iast: bhṛgūṇāmaṅgirasāṃ tapasā tapyadhvam iti vedena kapāleṣvaṅgārānadhyūhya madantīradhiśrayati
meaning: भृगूणामङ्गिरसां तपसा तप्यध्वम् इति वेदेन कपालेष्वङ्गारानध्यूह्य मदन्तीरधिश्रयति
text_mt: Having heaped burning coals onto the potsherds with the grass whisk with: 'Be heated by the heat of the Bhṛgus and the Aṅgirases!', he sets on the boiling waters.

sanskrit_iast: prakṣālitāyāṃ pātryāṃ niṣṭaptopavātāyāṃ pavitravatyāṃ piṣṭāni saṃvapati devasya tvetyanudrutyāgnaye juṣṭaṃ saṃvapāmīti yathādevataṃ triryajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham
meaning: प्रक्षालितायां पात्र्यां निष्टप्तोपवातायां पवित्रवत्यां पिष्टानि संवपति देवस्य त्वेत्यनुद्रुत्याग्नये जुष्टं संवपामीति यथादेवतं त्रिर्यजुषा तूष्णीं चतुर्थम्
text_mt: Into a washed vessel that has been heated over the fire, cooled by the wind, and provided with strainers, he pours the flour, having recited: 'At the impulse of the divine...', with: 'I pour [you] together, pleasing to Agni' according to the deity—thrice with the formula, the fourth time silently.
While pouring together, he restrains his speech; covering it, he releases it.
Having purified the flour like the sprinkling-waters, he kneads [it] with the praṇītā waters.

sanskrit_iast: anyā vā yajuṣotpūya yadi praṇītā nādhigacchet
meaning: अन्या वा यजुषोत्पूय यदि प्रणीता नाधिगच्छेत्
text_mt: Or having purified other [waters] with a formula, if he should not obtain the praṇītā waters.

sanskrit_iast: sruveṇa praṇītābhya ādāya vedenopayamya samāpo adbhiragmateti piṣṭeṣvānīyādbhiḥ pari prajātā iti taptābhir anupariplāvya janayatyai tvā saṃyaumīti saṃyutya makhasya śiro 'sīti piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā yathābhāgaṃ vyāvartethām iti vibhajya samau piṇḍau kṛtvā yathādevatamabhimṛśatīdamagnerityāgneyam /
meaning: स्रुवेण प्रणीताभ्य आदाय वेदेनोपयम्य समापो अद्भिरग्मतेति पिष्टेष्वानीयाद्भिः परि प्रजाता इति तप्ताभिर् अनुपरिप्लाव्य जनयत्यै त्वा संयौमीति संयुत्य मखस्य शिरो ऽसीति पिण्डं कृत्वा यथाभागं व्यावर्तेथाम् इति विभज्य समौ पिण्डौ कृत्वा यथादेवतमभिमृशतीदमग्नेरित्याग्नेयम् /
text_mt: Having taken [water] from the praṇītā waters with the dipping spoon, having supported it with the grass whisk, having poured it onto the flour with: 'The waters have come together with the waters!', having flooded it all around with heated waters with: 'Produced all around from the waters!', having kneaded it with: 'I knead thee for generating!', having made a lump with: 'Thou art the head of Makha!', having divided it with: 'Do ye two part according to your shares!', and having made two equal lumps, he touches them according to the deity: the one for Agni with: 'This is of Agni!'
The one for Agni and Soma with: 'This is of Agni and Soma!'

sanskrit_iast: idamahaṃ senāyā abhītvaryai mukhamapohāmīti vedena kapālebhyo 'ṅgārānapohya gharmo 'si viśvāyurityāgneyaṃ puroḍāśmaṣṭāsu kapāleṣv adhiśrayati
meaning: इदमहं सेनाया अभीत्वर्यै मुखमपोहामीति वेदेन कपालेभ्यो ऽङ्गारानपोह्य घर्मो ऽसि विश्वायुरित्याग्नेयं पुरोडाश्मष्टासु कपालेष्व् अधिश्रयति
text_mt: Having cleared the burning coals from the potsherds with the grass whisk with: 'Here do I push back the vanguard of the advancing army!', he sets down the sacrificial cake for Agni on the eight potsherds with: 'You are the boiling cauldron, full of life!'
In this way the rites from now on are performed in sequence.
He finishes each one by one with a rite of the same kind.
Those that are capable [of being done together] are performed once.

sanskrit_iast: uru prathasvoru te yajñapatiḥ prathatām iti puroḍāśaṃ prathayan sarvāṇi kapālānyabhiprathayati
meaning: उरु प्रथस्वोरु ते यज्ञपतिः प्रथताम् इति पुरोडाशं प्रथयन् सर्वाणि कपालान्यभिप्रथयति
text_mt: Spreading out the sacrificial cake with: 'Spread wide, may the lord of the sacrifice spread wide for thee!', he spreads it over all the potsherds.
He makes it not high, not shaped like an apūpa cake, in the shape as it were of a tortoise, of the size of a horse's hoof.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ na satrā pṛthuṃ karotīty eke
meaning: तं न सत्रा पृथुं करोतीत्य् एके
text_mt: Some say he does not make it completely flat.
With: 'Take on a skin!', he smoothens it with water, not letting it overflow.

sanskrit_iast: antaritaṃ rakṣo 'ntaritā arātaya iti sarvāṇi davīṃṣi triḥ paryagnikṛtvā devas tvā savitā śrapayatv ity ulmukaiḥ paritapati
meaning: अन्तरितं रक्षो ऽन्तरिता अरातय इति सर्वाणि दवींषि त्रिः पर्यग्निकृत्वा देवस् त्वा सविता श्रपयत्व् इत्य् उल्मुकैः परितपति
text_mt: Having carried fire thrice around all the sacrificial offerings with: 'Warded off is the Rakṣas, warded off are the enemies!', he heats [them] all around with firebrands with: 'May the divine Savitṛ bake thee!'

sanskrit_iast: agniste tanuvaṃ mātidhāgiti darbhairabhijvalayati jvālair vā
meaning: अग्निस्ते तनुवं मातिधागिति दर्भैरभिज्वलयति ज्वालैर् वा
text_mt: With: 'May Agni not scorch thy body!', he kindles [it] with darbha grasses or with flames.
He releases his speech with: 'Bake without burning!'
The āgnīdhra makes the sacrificial offerings well-cooked.

sanskrit_iast: saṃ brahmaṇā pṛcyasveti vedena puroḍāśesāṅgāraṃ bhasmādhyūhati
meaning: सं ब्रह्मणा पृच्यस्वेति वेदेन पुरोडाशेसाङ्गारं भस्माध्यूहति
text_mt: With: 'Be united with the prayer!', he heaps ash along with burning coals onto the sacrificial cake with the grass whisk.

sanskrit_iast: aṅguliprakṣālanaṃ pātrīnirṇejanaṃ colmukenābhitapya sphyenāntarvedi tisro lekhā likhati prācīrudīcīr vā
meaning: अङ्गुलिप्रक्षालनं पात्रीनिर्णेजनं चोल्मुकेनाभितप्य स्फ्येनान्तर्वेदि तिस्रो लेखा लिखति प्राचीरुदीचीर् वा
text_mt: Having heated the water for washing the fingers and the vessel-cleansing [water] with a firebrand, he draws three lines inside the altar ground with the wooden sword, eastward or northward.

sanskrit_iast: tāsv asaṃsyandayaṃstrirninayati pratyagapavargamekatāya svāhety etaiḥ pratimantram
meaning: तास्व् असंस्यन्दयंस्त्रिर्निनयति प्रत्यगपवर्गमेकताय स्वाहेत्य् एतैः प्रतिमन्त्रम्
text_mt: Into them, without letting [the streams] run together, he pours out thrice, ending in the west, with these respective formulas: 'To Ekata, svāhā!'
Or having poured [them] out, he should heat [them]; he should heat [them].

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasava iti sphyamāḍhāyendrasya bāhurasi dakṣiṇa ity abhimantrya haraste mā pratigāmiti darbheṇa saṃmṛjyāpareṇāhavanīyaṃ yajamānamātrīmaparimitāṃ vā prācīṃ vediṃ karoti
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इति स्फ्यमाढायेन्द्रस्य बाहुरसि दक्षिण इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य हरस्ते मा प्रतिगामिति दर्भेण संमृज्यापरेणाहवनीयं यजमानमात्रीमपरिमितां वा प्राचीं वेदिं करोति
text_mt: Having taken the wooden sword with: 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ...', having consecrated it with: 'You are the right arm of Indra!', having wiped it with darbha grass with: 'May thy heat not go against me!', he makes to the west of the āhavanīya an eastern altar ground of the measure of the sacrificer or unmeasured.
He makes it transverse in such a way that the sacrificial offerings placed [thereon] may fit.

sanskrit_iast: vedena vediṃ vividuḥ pṛthivīṃ sā paprathe pṛthivī pārthivāni /
meaning: वेदेन वेदिं विविदुः पृथिवीं सा पप्रथे पृथिवी पार्थिवानि /
text_mt: "With the veda they found the altar ground, the earth; she, the earth, spread out the earthly realms.

sanskrit_iast: garbhaṃ bibharti bhuvaneṣvantastato yajño jāyate viśvadāniriti purastātstambayajuṣo vedena vediṃ triḥ saṃmārṣṭyupariṣṭād vā
meaning: गर्भं बिभर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तस्ततो यज्ञो जायते विश्वदानिरिति पुरस्तात्स्तम्बयजुषो वेदेन वेदिं त्रिः संमार्ष्ट्युपरिष्टाद् वा
text_mt: She bears the embryo within the creatures; from her the sacrifice, bestowing everything, is born"—with this [formula] he wipes the altar ground three times with the veda before the stambayajus, or after it.
From the eastern half of the altar ground, at a place [divided into] three parts, he removes the stambayajus.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyai varmāsīti tatrodagagraṃ prāgagraṃ vā darbhaṃ nidhāya pṛthivi devayajanīti tasmin sphyena prahṛtyāpahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyā iti sphyena satṛṇān pāṃsūnapādāya vrajaṃ gaccha gosthānam iti harati /
meaning: पृथिव्यै वर्मासीति तत्रोदगग्रं प्रागग्रं वा दर्भं निधाय पृथिवि देवयजनीति तस्मिन् स्फ्येन प्रहृत्यापहतो ऽररुः पृथिव्या इति स्फ्येन सतृणान् पांसूनपादाय व्रजं गच्छ गोस्थानम् इति हरति /
text_mt: With "You are a shield for the earth," placing there a darbha blade with its tip pointing northward or eastward, and with "O earth, place of sacrifice to the gods," striking upon it with the wooden sword, and with "The enemy Araru is struck away from the earth," taking up the dust together with the grass with the wooden sword, he carries it away with "Go to the pen, the cow-stall!"

sanskrit_iast: varṣatu te dyaur iti vediṃ pratyavekṣate yajamānaṃ vā
meaning: वर्षतु ते द्यौर् इति वेदिं प्रत्यवेक्षते यजमानं वा
text_mt: With "May the sky rain upon you," he looks down at the altar ground, or at the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: badhāna deva savitar ity uttarataḥ purastād vitṛtīyadeśa udagdvipade 'parimite vā veder nivapati
meaning: बधान देव सवितर् इत्य् उत्तरतः पुरस्ताद् वितृतीयदेश उदग्द्विपदे ऽपरिमिते वा वेदेर् निवपति
text_mt: With "Bind [him], divine Savitṛ," he pours [the dust] down to the north [and] to the east [of the altar ground], at a third of the distance, two steps north of the altar ground, or an unmeasured [distance].

meaning: अररुस्ते दिवं मा स्कानिति न्युप्तमाग्नीध्रो ऽञ्जलिनाभिगृह्णाति
text_mt: With "May Araru not leap up to your sky!" the agnīdh catches what is poured down with his cupped hands.
Thus he removes [it] a second and a third time.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ caturthaṃ haran sarvaṃ darbhaśeṣaṃ harati
meaning: तूष्णीं चतुर्थं हरन् सर्वं दर्भशेषं हरति
text_mt: Removing [it] silently the fourth time, he takes away all the remaining darbha grass.

sanskrit_iast: apārarumadevayajanaṃ pṛthivyā iti dvitīye praharaṇo 'rarurdyāṃ mā paptaditi tṛtīye /
meaning: अपाररुमदेवयजनं पृथिव्या इति द्वितीये प्रहरणो ऽररुर्द्यां मा पप्तदिति तृतीये /
text_mt: With "Araru, not belonging to the place of sacrifice, [is struck away] from the earth" at the second striking; with "May Araru not fall to the sky!" at the third.

sanskrit_iast: apahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyai devayajanyā iti dvitīye 'pādāno 'pahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyā adevayajana iti tṛtīye
meaning: अपहतो ऽररुः पृथिव्यै देवयजन्या इति द्वितीये ऽपादानो ऽपहतो ऽररुः पृथिव्या अदेवयजन इति तृतीये
text_mt: With "Araru is struck away from the earth, the place of sacrifice to the gods" at the second taking up; with "Araru, not belonging to the place of sacrifice, is struck away from the earth" at the third.

sanskrit_iast: avabāḍhaṃ rakṣa iti dvitīye nivapana āgnīdhro 'bhigṛhṇāty avabāḍho 'ghaśaṃsa iti tṛtīye 'vabāḍhā yātudhānā iti caturthe
meaning: अवबाढं रक्ष इति द्वितीये निवपन आग्नीध्रो ऽभिगृह्णात्य् अवबाढो ऽघशंस इति तृतीये ऽवबाढा यातुधाना इति चतुर्थे
text_mt: With "Crushed down is the rakṣas!" at the second pouring out, the agnīdh catches [it]; with "Crushed down is the evil speaker!" at the third; with "Crushed down are the sorcerers!" at the fourth.

sanskrit_iast: drapsaste dyāṃ mā skāniti khaniṃ pratyavekṣya sphyena vediṃ parigṛhṇāti vasavastvā parigṛhṇantu gāyatreṇa chandaseti dakṣiṇato rudrā iti paścād ādityā ity uttarataḥ
meaning: द्रप्सस्ते द्यां मा स्कानिति खनिं प्रत्यवेक्ष्य स्फ्येन वेदिं परिगृह्णाति वसवस्त्वा परिगृह्णन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसेति दक्षिणतो रुद्रा इति पश्चाद् आदित्या इत्य् उत्तरतः
text_mt: With "May your drop not leap up to the sky," having looked at the excavation, he encloses the altar ground with the wooden sword: with "May the Vasus enclose you with the gāyatrī metre!" on the south, with "the Rudras" on the west, with "the Ādityas" on the north.

sanskrit_iast: apārarumadevayajanaṃ pṛthivyā adevayajano jahīti sphyenottamāṃ tvacamuddhanti
meaning: अपाररुमदेवयजनं पृथिव्या अदेवयजनो जहीति स्फ्येनोत्तमां त्वचमुद्धन्ति
text_mt: With "Araru, not belonging to the place of sacrifice, [is struck away] from the earth; slay what does not belong to the place of sacrifice!" he loosens the topmost skin [of earth] with the wooden sword.
The agnīdh pours what is loosened onto the rubbish heap three times.

sanskrit_iast: imāṃ narāḥ kṛṇuta vedimeta devebhyo juṣṭāmadityā upasthe /
meaning: इमां नराः कृणुत वेदिमेत देवेभ्यो जुष्टामदित्या उपस्थे /
text_mt: "Men, make this altar ground, come, agreeable to the gods, in the lap of Aditi!

sanskrit_iast: imāṃ devā ajuṣanta viśve rāyaspoṣā yajamānaṃ viśantv iti saṃpreṣyati
meaning: इमां देवा अजुषन्त विश्वे रायस्पोषा यजमानं विशन्त्व् इति संप्रेष्यति
text_mt: All the gods have been pleased with this; may abundance of wealth enter the sacrificer!"—with this he issues the ritual call.

sanskrit_iast: devasya savituḥ sava iti khanati dvyaṅgulāṃ tryaṅgulāṃ caturaṅgulāṃ yāvatpārṣṇyāḥ śuklaṃ tāvatīṃ pṛthamātrīṃ rathavartamamātrīṃ sītāmātrīṃ prādeśamātrīṃ vā purīṣavatīm
meaning: देवस्य सवितुः सव इति खनति द्व्यङ्गुलां त्र्यङ्गुलां चतुरङ्गुलां यावत्पार्ष्ण्याः शुक्लं तावतीं पृथमात्रीं रथवर्तममात्रीं सीतामात्रीं प्रादेशमात्रीं वा पुरीषवतीम्
text_mt: With "At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ," he digs two finger-breadths deep, three finger-breadths, four finger-breadths, as deep as the white of the heel, the breadth of a span, the breadth of a chariot-wheel rim, the breadth of a furrow, or the breadth of a span, abounding in loose earth.
He does not dig deeper than these measures.
[The altar ground should be] higher on the south, sloping toward the east, or sloping toward the northeast.
He raises the two eastern shoulders of the altar ground, and the two western hips.
It is narrower in the east, broader in the west, and more sunken in the middle.
Whatever root lies beyond [it], he cuts it off with the wooden sword, not with his fingernail.
Whatever loose earth is in excess, he pours it onto the rubbish heap.
For one desirous of cattle he should make [an altar ground] with imported loose earth.

sanskrit_iast: yat prāk khananāt tat kṛtvā yadāharettanmantreṇa khanet
meaning: यत् प्राक् खननात् तत् कृत्वा यदाहरेत्तन्मन्त्रेण खनेत्
text_mt: Having done what precedes the digging, whatever [loose earth] he brings, he should dig that with the formula.

sanskrit_iast: brahmannuttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigrahīṣyāmīti brahmāṇam āmantrya sphyena vediṃ parigṛhṇāty ṛtam asīti dakṣiṇataḥ /
meaning: ब्रह्मन्नुत्तरं परिग्राहं परिग्रहीष्यामीति ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य स्फ्येन वेदिं परिगृह्णात्य् ऋतम् असीति दक्षिणतः /
text_mt: "O Brahman, I shall make the second enclosing"—having thus addressed the Brahman, he encloses the altar ground with the wooden sword: with "You are truth" on the south,
with "You are the seat of truth" on the west,
with "You are the glory of truth" on the north.
Some teach the two enclosings in reverse order.

sanskrit_iast: dhā asi svadhā asīti pratīcīṃ vediṃ sphyena yoyupyate
meaning: धा असि स्वधा असीति प्रतीचीं वेदिं स्फ्येन योयुप्यते
text_mt: With "You are maintenance, you are self-sustained offering," he levels the altar ground westward with the wooden sword.

sanskrit_iast: udādāya pṛthivīṃ jīradānur iti vedim anuvīkṣate
meaning: उदादाय पृथिवीं जीरदानुर् इति वेदिम् अनुवीक्षते
text_mt: With "Lifting up the earth, abundant in gifts..." he looks along the altar ground.

sanskrit_iast: paścārdhe vedervitṛtīyadeśe sphyaṃ tiryañcaṃ stabdhvā saṃpreṣyati prokṣaṇīrāsādayedhmābarhirupasādaya sruvaṃ ca srucaś ca saṃmṛḍḍhi patnīṃ saṃnahyājyenodehīti
meaning: पश्चार्धे वेदेर्वितृतीयदेशे स्फ्यं तिर्यञ्चं स्तब्ध्वा संप्रेष्यति प्रोक्षणीरासादयेध्माबर्हिरुपसादय स्रुवं च स्रुचश् च संमृड्ढि पत्नीं संनह्याज्येनोदेहीति
text_mt: Having planted the wooden sword crosswise in the western half of the altar ground at a third of the distance, he issues the ritual call: "Place the waters of sprinkling, bring near the firewood and sacrificial grass, wipe the dipping ladle and the offering ladles, gird the wife, and come up with the clarified butter!"
Or rather, he should not utter the ritual call.

sanskrit_iast: prokṣaṇīrabhipūryodañcaṃ sphyamapohya dakṣiṇena sphyamasaṃspṛṣṭā upaninīya sphyasya vartmansādayatyṛtasadhastheti dveṣyaṃ manasā dhyāyan
meaning: प्रोक्षणीरभिपूर्योदञ्चं स्फ्यमपोह्य दक्षिणेन स्फ्यमसंस्पृष्टा उपनिनीय स्फ्यस्य वर्त्मन्सादयत्यृतसधस्थेति द्वेष्यं मनसा ध्यायन्
text_mt: Having filled the waters of sprinkling, having moved the wooden sword northward, having poured down [the waters] to the south of the wooden sword without touching [it], he places [them] in the track of the wooden sword with "O you who sit together in truth," meditating in his mind on the person he hates.

sanskrit_iast: śatabhṛṣṭir asi vānaspatyo dviṣato vadha iti purastāt pratyañcam utkare sphyamudasyati dveṣyaṃ manasā dhyāyan
meaning: शतभृष्टिर् असि वानस्पत्यो द्विषतो वध इति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चम् उत्करे स्फ्यमुदस्यति द्वेष्यं मनसा ध्यायन्
text_mt: With "You are a hundred-spiked weapon of wood, the slayer of the enemy," he casts the wooden sword onto the rubbish heap from east to west, meditating in his mind on the person he hates.
Without washing his hands, he does not remove the vessels.
Having washed his hands, he rinses the wooden sword, not touching the tip.
North of the āhavanīya he sets down the firewood and sacrificial grass with their tips pointing eastward—the firewood to the south, the sacrificial grass to the north.

sanskrit_iast: patnīsaṃnahanam eke pūrvaṃ samāmananti sruksaṃmārjanam eke
meaning: पत्नीसंनहनम् एके पूर्वं समामनन्ति स्रुक्संमार्जनम् एके
text_mt: Some teach the girding of the wife first; some, the wiping of the ladles.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtācīretāgnirvo hvayati devayajyāyā iti sruca ādāya pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ity āhavanīye gārhapatye vā pratitapyāniśitā stha sapatnakṣayaṇīrityabhimantrya vedāgrāṇi prativibhajyāprativibhajya vā taiḥ srucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi prācīrudīcīrvottānā dhārayamāṇaḥ
meaning: घृताचीरेताग्निर्वो ह्वयति देवयज्याया इति स्रुच आदाय प्रत्युष्टं रक्षः प्रत्युष्टा अरातय इत्य् आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये वा प्रतितप्यानिशिता स्थ सपत्नक्षयणीरित्यभिमन्त्र्य वेदाग्राणि प्रतिविभज्याप्रतिविभज्य वा तैः स्रुचः संमार्ष्टि प्राचीरुदीचीर्वोत्ताना धारयमाणः
text_mt: Taking the offering ladles with "O you anointed with ghee, come, Agni summons you to the worship of the gods," heating them over the āhavanīya or gārhapatya with "Burned is the rakṣas, burned are the adversaries," and blessing them with "You are unblunted, destructive of rivals," having separated or not separated the tips of the veda, he wipes the offering ladles with them, holding them turned upward toward the east or toward the north.
Some say: "Only the upabhṛt [held] toward the north."

sanskrit_iast: goṣṭhaṃ mā nirmṛkṣam iti sruvamagrairantarato 'bhyākāraṃ sarvato bilamabhisamāhāram /
meaning: गोष्ठं मा निर्मृक्षम् इति स्रुवमग्रैरन्तरतो ऽभ्याकारं सर्वतो बिलमभिसमाहारम् /
text_mt: With "May I not wipe away the cow-stall," [he wipes] the dipping ladle from inside outward with the tips, gathering all around the bowl,

sanskrit_iast: vācaṃ prāṇam iti juhūmagrairantarato 'bhyākāraṃ prācīṃ madhyair bāhyataḥ pratīcīm /
meaning: वाचं प्राणम् इति जुहूमग्रैरन्तरतो ऽभ्याकारं प्राचीं मध्यैर् बाह्यतः प्रतीचीम् /
text_mt: With "Speech, breath," [he wipes] the juhū, [holding it] eastward, from inside outward with the tips, and from outside westward with the middle parts,

sanskrit_iast: cakṣuḥ śrotram ityupabhṛtam udīcīmagrairantarato 'bhyākāraṃ pratīcīṃ madhyair bāhyataḥ prācīm /
meaning: चक्षुः श्रोत्रम् इत्युपभृतम् उदीचीमग्रैरन्तरतो ऽभ्याकारं प्रतीचीं मध्यैर् बाह्यतः प्राचीम् /
text_mt: With "Eye, hearing," [he wipes] the upabhṛt, [holding it] northward, from inside westward with the tips, and from outside eastward with the middle parts,

sanskrit_iast: prajāṃ yonim iti yathā sruvam evaṃ dhruvām
meaning: प्रजां योनिम् इति यथा स्रुवम् एवं ध्रुवाम्
text_mt: With "Offspring, womb," [he wipes] the dhruvā just like the dipping ladle.

sanskrit_iast: rūpaṃ varṇaṃ paśūnāṃ mā nirmṛkṣaṃ vāji tvā sapatnasāhaṃ saṃmārjmīti prāśitraharaṇaṃ tūṣṇīṃ vā
meaning: रूपं वर्णं पशूनां मा निर्मृक्षं वाजि त्वा सपत्नसाहं संमार्ज्मीति प्राशित्रहरणं तूष्णीं वा
text_mt: With "May I not wipe away the form, the colour of the cattle; vigorous one, conquering rivals, I wipe you," [he wipes] the vessel for the prāśitra portion, or silently.
He does not let the wiped [utensils] touch the unwiped.

sanskrit_iast: agnervastejiṣṭhena tejasā niṣṭapāmīti punaḥ pratitapya prokṣyāgreṇotkaraṃ darbheṣu sādayati jaghanena vā
meaning: अग्नेर्वस्तेजिष्ठेन तेजसा निष्टपामीति पुनः प्रतितप्य प्रोक्ष्याग्रेणोत्करं दर्भेषु सादयति जघनेन वा
text_mt: Having heated them again with "I scorch you with the most fiery blaze of Agni," and having sprinkled them, he places them on darbha blades in front of the rubbish heap, or behind [it].
Having touched the wipers of the ladles with water,

sanskrit_iast: divaḥ śilpamavatataṃ pṛthivyāḥ kakubhiḥ śritaṃ tena vayaṃ sahasravalśena sapatnaṃ nāśayāmasi svāhety agnau praharati yasmin pratitapaty utkare vā nyasyati
meaning: दिवः शिल्पमवततं पृथिव्याः ककुभिः श्रितं तेन वयं सहस्रवल्शेन सपत्नं नाशयामसि स्वाहेत्य् अग्नौ प्रहरति यस्मिन् प्रतितपत्य् उत्करे वा न्यस्यति
text_mt: he throws them into the fire at which he heats [the ladles] with "A work of art of heaven spread out, resting on the peaks of the earth; with that of a thousand branches we destroy the rival, svāhā!", or casts them on the rubbish heap.

sanskrit_iast: āśāsānā saumanasamityapareṇa gārhapatyamūrdhvajñumāsīnāṃ patnīṃ saṃnahyati tiṣṭhantīṃ vā
meaning: आशासाना सौमनसमित्यपरेण गार्हपत्यमूर्ध्वज्ञुमासीनां पत्नीं संनह्यति तिष्ठन्तीं वा
text_mt: With "Hoping for goodwill..." he girds the wife sitting west of the gārhapatya with her knees raised, or standing.

sanskrit_iast: mauñjena dāmnānyatarataḥ pāśena yoktreṇa vābhyantaraṃ vāsasaḥ
meaning: मौञ्जेन दाम्नान्यतरतः पाशेन योक्त्रेण वाभ्यन्तरं वाससः
text_mt: [He girds her] with a rope of muñja grass having a loop on one side, or with a yoke-strap, underneath her garment.
Some say he girds around it.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa nābhiṃ niṣṭarkyaṃ granthiṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ paryūhya dakṣiṇena nābhimavasthāpyopotthāyāgne gṛhapata upa mā hvayasveti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate
meaning: उत्तरेण नाभिं निष्टर्क्यं ग्रन्थिं कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं पर्यूह्य दक्षिणेन नाभिमवस्थाप्योपोत्थायाग्ने गृहपत उप मा ह्वयस्वेति गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते
text_mt: Having tied an untying knot north of the navel, having tucked [the ends] around clockwise, having placed [it] south of the navel, and having stood up nearby, she attends upon the gārhapatya with, "O Agni, lord of the house, invite me."

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ patnīrupa mā hvayadhvaṃ patni patnyeṣa te loko namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīriti devapatnīrupatiṣṭhate
meaning: देवानां पत्नीरुप मा ह्वयध्वं पत्नि पत्न्येष ते लोको नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीरिति देवपत्नीरुपतिष्ठते
text_mt: She attends upon the wives of the gods with, "O wives of the gods, invite me! O wife, O wife, this is your place. Homage be to you; do not injure me."

sanskrit_iast: tasmāddeśādapakramya suprajasastvā vayam iti dakṣiṇata udīcyupaviśati
meaning: तस्माद्देशादपक्रम्य सुप्रजसस्त्वा वयम् इति दक्षिणत उदीच्युपविशति
text_mt: Having stepped away from that place, she sits down to the south, facing north, with, "Having good offspring, we…"
"May I not be a widow, like Indrāṇī; may I have good sons, like Aditi.

sanskrit_iast: asthūri tvā gārhapatyopaniṣade suprajās tvāyeti japati
meaning: अस्थूरि त्वा गार्हपत्योपनिषदे सुप्रजास् त्वायेति जपति
text_mt: Not [riding in] a single-horse chariot [do I come] to you, O gārhapatya, for sitting near, seeking good offspring," she murmurs.

sanskrit_iast: yuktā me yajñamanvāsātā iti yajamānaḥ sampreṣyati
meaning: युक्ता मे यज्ञमन्वासाता इति यजमानः सम्प्रेष्यति
text_mt: "Both yoked, may you sit beside my sacrifice," the sacrificer gives the ritual call.
"He sacrifices with the New and Full Moon sacrifices rich in clarified butter," so it is known [from sacred tradition].

sanskrit_iast: pūṣā te bilaṃ viṣyatviti sarpirdhānasya bilamapāvartya dakṣiṇāgnāvājyaṃ vilāpyāditirasyacchidrapattretyājyasthālīmādāya mahīnāṃ payo 'syoṣadhīnāṃ rasatasya te 'kṣīyamāṇasya nirvapāmi devayajyāyā iti tasyāṃ pavitrāntarhitāyām ājyaṃ nirupyedaṃ viṣṇurvicakrama iti dakṣiṇāgnāvadhiśrityeṣe tveti dakṣiṇārdhe gārhapatyasyādhiśrityorje tvetyapādāya vedenopayamya patnyā upaharati
meaning: पूषा ते बिलं विष्यत्विति सर्पिर्धानस्य बिलमपावर्त्य दक्षिणाग्नावाज्यं विलाप्यादितिरस्यच्छिद्रपत्त्रेत्याज्यस्थालीमादाय महीनां पयो ऽस्योषधीनां रसतस्य ते ऽक्षीयमाणस्य निर्वपामि देवयज्याया इति तस्यां पवित्रान्तर्हितायाम् आज्यं निरुप्येदं विष्णुर्विचक्रम इति दक्षिणाग्नावधिश्रित्येषे त्वेति दक्षिणार्धे गार्हपत्यस्याधिश्रित्योर्जे त्वेत्यपादाय वेदेनोपयम्य पत्न्या उपहरति
text_mt: With, "May Pūṣan untie your mouth," having opened the mouth of the butter container, having melted the clarified butter over the southern fire, having taken the butter vessel with, "You are Aditi, of unbroken leaves," having ladled the clarified butter into it while covered by the strainers with, "You are the milk of the great ones, the sap of the plants; of you, inexhaustible, I ladle out for the worship of the gods," having set it on the southern fire with, "Viṣṇu strode through this," having set it on the southern half of the gārhapatya with, "For food, you," having removed it with, "For strength, you," and having held it underneath with the veda, he brings it near to the wife.

meaning: तत्सा निमील्य वीक्ष्यानुच्छूसन्त्यवेक्षते महीनां पयो ऽसीति
text_mt: Having closed and opened her eyes, not exhaling over it, she looks at it with, "You are the milk of the great ones."
With, "You are splendour," he sets it on the northern half of the gārhapatya.
In the absence of the wife, the setting on the gārhapatya beginning with [the formula] "splendour" is omitted.

meaning: तेजसे त्वेत्यपादाय तेजो ऽसि तेजो ऽनुप्रेहीति हरति /
text_mt: Having removed it with, "For splendour, you," he carries it with, "You are splendour; follow splendour."

sanskrit_iast: agniste tejo mā vinaidityāhavanīye 'dhiśrityāgner jihvāsīti sphyasya vartman sādayati
meaning: अग्निस्ते तेजो मा विनैदित्याहवनीये ऽधिश्रित्याग्नेर् जिह्वासीति स्फ्यस्य वर्त्मन् सादयति
text_mt: Having set it on the āhavanīya with, "May Agni's splendour not leave you," he places it on the track of the sphya with, "You are the tongue of Agni."

sanskrit_iast: ājyamasi satyamasīty adhvaryur yajamānaś ca nimīlya vīkṣyānucchūsantāvājyamavekṣete
meaning: आज्यमसि सत्यमसीत्य् अध्वर्युर् यजमानश् च निमील्य वीक्ष्यानुच्छूसन्तावाज्यमवेक्षेते
text_mt: With, "You are clarified butter, you are truth," the adhvaryu and the sacrificer, having closed and opened their eyes and not exhaling over it, gaze at the clarified butter.
Then he purifies it with the two strainers pointing north, repeatedly bringing them back.

sanskrit_iast: śukram asīti prathamaṃ jyotir asīti dvitīyaṃ tejo 'sīti tṛtīyam
meaning: शुक्रम् असीति प्रथमं ज्योतिर् असीति द्वितीयं तेजो ऽसीति तृतीयम्
text_mt: "You are bright," is the first; "You are light," is the second; "You are splendour," is the third.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvavadājyaliptābhyāṃ prokṣaṇīrutpūyāniṣkāsinā sruveṇa vedamupabhṛtaṃ kṛtvāntarvedyājyāni gṛhṇāti
meaning: पूर्ववदाज्यलिप्ताभ्यां प्रोक्षणीरुत्पूयानिष्कासिना स्रुवेण वेदमुपभृतं कृत्वान्तर्वेद्याज्यानि गृह्णाति
text_mt: Having purified the sprinkling water with the two [strainers] smeared with clarified butter as before, having held the veda underneath with the sruva without scraping, he takes portions of clarified butter inside the altar ground:

sanskrit_iast: samaṃbilaṃ dhārayamāṇo juhvāṃ madhyadeśa upabhṛti bhūmau pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ dhruvāyām
meaning: समंबिलं धारयमाणो जुह्वां मध्यदेश उपभृति भूमौ प्रतिष्ठितायां ध्रुवायाम्
text_mt: Holding the brim level: [into the sruva] at the middle region for the juhū, for the upabhṛt, and for the dhruvā resting on the ground.
Four [ladlings] into the juhū, eight into the upabhṛt, four into the dhruvā.
Or for one desiring cattle, five ladlings into the dhruvā, as in the archetype into the other two.
Ten ladlings into the upabhṛt, five ladlings into the other two, say some.
More into the juhū, less into the upabhṛt, the most into the dhruvā.

sanskrit_iast: śukraṃ tvā śukrāyām iti tribhiḥ pañcānāṃ tvā vātānām iti ca dvābhyāṃ juhvāṃ catuḥ pañcakṛtvo vā pratimantram
meaning: शुक्रं त्वा शुक्रायाम् इति त्रिभिः पञ्चानां त्वा वातानाम् इति च द्वाभ्यां जुह्वां चतुः पञ्चकृत्वो वा प्रतिमन्त्रम्
text_mt: With the three formulas, "You, the bright, into the bright…" and with the two, "You, of the five winds…," into the juhū four or five times, formula by formula.

sanskrit_iast: pañcānāṃ tvā diśāṃ pañcānāṃ tvā pañcajanānāṃ pañcānāṃ tvā salilānāṃ dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi paṇcānāṃ tvā pṛṣṭhānāṃ dhartrāy gṛhṇāmi dhāmāsi priyaṃ devānām anādhṛṣṭaṃ devayajanaṃ devavītaye tvā gṛhṇāmīti carostvā pañcabilasyeti ca pañcabhirupabhṛtyaṣṭakṛtvo daśakṛtvo vā pratimantram
meaning: पञ्चानां त्वा दिशां पञ्चानां त्वा पञ्चजनानां पञ्चानां त्वा सलिलानां धर्त्राय गृह्णामि पण्चानां त्वा पृष्ठानां धर्त्राय् गृह्णामि धामासि प्रियं देवानाम् अनाधृष्टं देवयजनं देववीतये त्वा गृह्णामीति चरोस्त्वा पञ्चबिलस्येति च पञ्चभिरुपभृत्यष्टकृत्वो दशकृत्वो वा प्रतिमन्त्रम्
text_mt: With the five formulas, "For the support of the five directions I take you, for the support of the five peoples I take you, for the support of the five waters I take you, for the support of the five surfaces I take you, you are the dear abode of the gods, the unassailed place of sacrifice, for the feast of the gods I take you," and with, "You, of the pot with five orifices…," into the upabhṛt eight or ten times, formula by formula.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣeṇa dhruvāyāṃ catuḥ pañcakṛtvo vā pratimantram
meaning: शेषेण ध्रुवायां चतुः पञ्चकृत्वो वा प्रतिमन्त्रम्
text_mt: With the remainder, into the dhruvā four or five times, formula by formula.
He does not place the portions of clarified butter on the rubbish heap.
They do not carry westwards what has been ladled inside the altar ground.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvavatprokṣaṇīrabhimantrya brahmāṇamāmantrya visrasyedhmaṃ kṛṣṇo 'syākhareṣṭha iti triḥ prokṣati /
meaning: पूर्ववत्प्रोक्षणीरभिमन्त्र्य ब्रह्माणमामन्त्र्य विस्रस्येध्मं कृष्णो ऽस्याखरेष्ठ इति त्रिः प्रोक्षति /
text_mt: Having consecrated the sprinkling waters as before, having addressed the brahman, and having untied the firewood, he sprinkles three times with, "You are black, dwelling in the cleft:"

sanskrit_iast: vedirasīti trir vediṃ barhirasīti trir barhiḥ /
meaning: वेदिरसीति त्रिर् वेदिं बर्हिरसीति त्रिर् बर्हिः /
text_mt: Three times the altar ground with, "You are the altar ground;" three times the sacrificial grass with, "You are the sacrificial grass."

sanskrit_iast: antarvedi purogranthi barhirāsādya dive tvetyagraṃ prokṣatyantarikṣāya tveti madhyaṃ pṛthivyai tveti mūlam
meaning: अन्तर्वेदि पुरोग्रन्थि बर्हिरासाद्य दिवे त्वेत्यग्रं प्रोक्षत्यन्तरिक्षाय त्वेति मध्यं पृथिव्यै त्वेति मूलम्
text_mt: Having placed inside the altar ground the sacrificial grass with its knot to the east, he sprinkles the tip with, "For the sky, you," the middle with, "For the intermediate space, you," the base with, "For the earth, you."
Having caused the ladle to touch the tips, he causes it to touch the bases.

sanskrit_iast: poṣāya tveti sahasrucā purastāt pratyañcaṃ granthiṃ pratyukṣya prokṣaṇīśeṣaṃ svadhā pitṛbhya iti dakṣiṇāyai śroṇerottarasyāḥ saṃtataṃ ninīya pūṣā te granthiṃ viṣyatviti granthiṃ visraṃsayati
meaning: पोषाय त्वेति सहस्रुचा पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चं ग्रन्थिं प्रत्युक्ष्य प्रोक्षणीशेषं स्वधा पितृभ्य इति दक्षिणायै श्रोणेरोत्तरस्याः संततं निनीय पूषा ते ग्रन्थिं विष्यत्विति ग्रन्थिं विस्रंसयति
text_mt: With, "For prosperity, you," having sprinkled back from east to west over the knot along with the ladle, having poured out the remainder of the sprinkling water continuously from the southern buttock to the northern with, "Svadhā to the fathers," he loosens the knot with, "May Pūṣan loosen your knot."
He pulls out westwards the tucked-in cord.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇo stūpo 'sīti karṣann ivāhavanīyaṃ prati prastaramapādatte nodyauti na prayauti na pratiyauti na vikṣipati na pramārṣṭi na pratimārṣṭi nānumārṣṭi
meaning: विष्णो स्तूपो ऽसीति कर्षन्न् इवाहवनीयं प्रति प्रस्तरमपादत्ते नोद्यौति न प्रयौति न प्रतियौति न विक्षिपति न प्रमार्ष्टि न प्रतिमार्ष्टि नानुमार्ष्टि
text_mt: With, "You are the topknot of Viṣṇu," as if dragging it towards the āhavanīya, he takes out the grass bunch; he does not lift it up high, does not push it forward, does not pull it back, does not toss it aside, does not wipe it across, does not wipe it against, does not wipe it after.
"May this out-breath and in-breath enter the sacrificer.
For they have become purifiers in the sacrifice, two strainers cleaning the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: yajamāne prāṇāpānau dadhāmīti tasmin pavitre apisṛjya prāṇāpānābhyāṃ tvā satanuṃ karomīti yajamānāya prayacchati /
meaning: यजमाने प्राणापानौ दधामीति तस्मिन् पवित्रे अपिसृज्य प्राणापानाभ्यां त्वा सतनुं करोमीति यजमानाय प्रयच्छति /
text_mt: I place the out-breath and the in-breath in the sacrificer"—having inserted the two strainers into it, he hands [it] over to the sacrificer with, "I make you embodied with out-breath and in-breath."
The brahman holds the grass bunch, or the sacrificer.
Having covered the altar ground with darbha grass blades, he strews the tying cord to the south, or diagonally.

sanskrit_iast: ūrṇāmradasaṃ tvā stṛṇāmīti barhiṣā vediṃ stṛṇāti bahulamanatidṛśyaṃ prāgapavargaṃ pratyagapavargaṃ vā tridhātu pañcadhātu vā
meaning: ऊर्णाम्रदसं त्वा स्तृणामीति बर्हिषा वेदिं स्तृणाति बहुलमनतिदृश्यं प्रागपवर्गं प्रत्यगपवर्गं वा त्रिधातु पञ्चधातु वा
text_mt: With, "I strew you, soft as wool," he strews the altar ground with sacrificial grass: thick, not translucent, ending to the east or ending to the west, in three layers or in five layers.
With the tips, he covers the bases.
At each layer he repeats the formula.

sanskrit_iast: prastarapāṇiḥ saṃspṛṣṭānparidhīnparidadhāti gandharvo 'si viśvāvasurityetaiḥ pratimantramudagagraṃ madhyamaṃ prāgagrāvitarau
meaning: प्रस्तरपाणिः संस्पृष्टान्परिधीन्परिदधाति गन्धर्वो ऽसि विश्वावसुरित्येतैः प्रतिमन्त्रमुदगग्रं मध्यमं प्रागग्रावितरौ
text_mt: With the grass bunch in his hand, he places the enclosing sticks touching one another, with the formulas, "You are the gandharva Viśvāvasu…," formula by formula: the middle one with its tip to the north, the other two with their tips to the east;
The southern one with its tip towards the āhavanīya, the northern one with its tip away.

sanskrit_iast: sūryastvā purastātpātv ity āhavanīyamabhimantryoparyāhavanīye prastaraṃ dhārayannagniṃ kalpayati
meaning: सूर्यस्त्वा पुरस्तात्पात्व् इत्य् आहवनीयमभिमन्त्र्योपर्याहवनीये प्रस्तरं धारयन्नग्निं कल्पयति
text_mt: Having addressed the āhavanīya with, "May Sūrya protect you from the east," holding the grass bunch above the āhavanīya, he arranges the fire.
"For the sake of the after-offerings, he pushes forward two burning embers eastward," so the Vājasaneyaka [states].
Having touched the middle enclosing stick, he places the two upright kindling sticks for the āghāra libation.

sanskrit_iast: vītihotraṃ tvā kava iti dakṣiṇāṃ samidasyāyuṣe tvetyuttarām
meaning: वीतिहोत्रं त्वा कव इति दक्षिणां समिदस्यायुषे त्वेत्युत्तराम्
text_mt: The southern one with, "You, the invoker of offerings, O wise one…;" the northern one with, "You are a kindling stick; for life, you."
He makes two equal darbha blades without inner sprouts into separators.

sanskrit_iast: viśo yantre stha ity antarvedyudagagre nidhāya vasūnāṃ rudrāṇām ādityānāṃ sadasi sīdeti tayoḥ prastaramatyādadhāti
meaning: विशो यन्त्रे स्थ इत्य् अन्तर्वेद्युदगग्रे निधाय वसूनां रुद्राणाम् आदित्यानां सदसि सीदेति तयोः प्रस्तरमत्यादधाति
text_mt: Having placed them inside the altar ground with their tips to the north with, "You two are the restrainers of the people," he places the grass bunch upon them with, "Sit in the seat of the Vasus, the Rudras, and the Ādityas."
The bases of the grass bunch are drawn back further than the bases of the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: juhūrasi ghṛtācītyetaiḥ pratimantramanūcīrasaṃspṛṣṭāḥ srucaḥ prastare sādayati
meaning: जुहूरसि घृताचीत्येतैः प्रतिमन्त्रमनूचीरसंस्पृष्टाः स्रुचः प्रस्तरे सादयति
text_mt: With the formulas, "You are the juhū, filled with clarified butter…," formula by formula, he places the ladles lengthwise, not touching one another, upon the grass bunch.
Or only the juhū upon the grass bunch.
He aligns the handle of the juhū level with the bases [of the grass bunch].
North of the juhū, the upabhṛt, drawn back somewhat further beneath the two separators.
North of the upabhṛt, the dhruvā, drawn back somewhat further above the two separators.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabho 'si śakvaro ghṛtācīnāṃ sūnuḥ priyeṇa nāmnā priye sadasi sīdeti dakṣiṇena juhūṃ sruvaṃ sādayaty uttareṇottareṇa vā dhruvām
meaning: ऋषभो ऽसि शक्वरो घृताचीनां सूनुः प्रियेण नाम्ना प्रिये सदसि सीदेति दक्षिणेन जुहूं स्रुवं सादयत्य् उत्तरेणोत्तरेण वा ध्रुवाम्
text_mt: With, "You are the bull, the powerful, the son of the butter-ladles; sit with your dear name in your dear seat," he places the sruva south of the juhū, or further and further north of the dhruvā.

sanskrit_iast: etā asadanniti sruvo 'bhimantrya viṣṇūni stha vaiṣṇavāni dhāmāni stha prājāpatyānītyājyāni kapālavatpuroḍāśādaṅgārānapohya sūrya jyotirvibhāhi mahata indriyāyety abhimantryāpyāyataṃ ghṛtayoniragnirhavyānumanyatām /
meaning: एता असदन्निति स्रुवो ऽभिमन्त्र्य विष्णूनि स्थ वैष्णवानि धामानि स्थ प्राजापत्यानीत्याज्यानि कपालवत्पुरोडाशादङ्गारानपोह्य सूर्य ज्योतिर्विभाहि महत इन्द्रियायेत्य् अभिमन्त्र्याप्यायतं घृतयोनिरग्निर्हव्यानुमन्यताम् /
text_mt: Having addressed the dipping-spoon with: 'These have sat down', [and] having addressed the clarified butter offerings with: 'You are of Viṣṇu, you are the abodes of Viṣṇu, you are of Prajāpati', [and] having pushed away the burning embers from the sacrificial cake [lying] on the potsherds, having addressed [it] with: 'O Sūrya, shine forth as light for great power; let it swell; Agni, whose source is ghee, shall approve the oblations;'

sanskrit_iast: khamaṅkṣva tvacamaṅkṣva surūpaṃ tvā vasuvidaṃ paśūnāṃ tejasāgnaye juṣṭam abhighārayāmīty āgneyaṃ puroḍāśam abhighārayati tūṣṇīm uttaram
meaning: खमङ्क्ष्व त्वचमङ्क्ष्व सुरूपं त्वा वसुविदं पशूनां तेजसाग्नये जुष्टम् अभिघारयामीत्य् आग्नेयं पुरोडाशम् अभिघारयति तूष्णीम् उत्तरम्
text_mt: with: 'Anoint the opening, anoint the crust; I besprinkle you, fair of form, finder of wealth, with the splendor of cattle, pleasing to Agni', he besprinkles the sacrificial cake for Agni; silently the subsequent one.

sanskrit_iast: yasta ātmā paśuṣu praviṣṭo devānāṃ viṣṭhāmanu yo vitasthe /
meaning: यस्त आत्मा पशुषु प्रविष्टो देवानां विष्ठामनु यो वितस्थे /
text_mt: 'That breath of yours which has entered into the cattle, which has expanded following the stations of the gods

sanskrit_iast: ātmanvānsoma ghṛtavānhi bhūtvā devāngaccha suvarvinda yajamānāya mahyamiti prātardoham
meaning: आत्मन्वान्सोम घृतवान्हि भूत्वा देवान्गच्छ सुवर्विन्द यजमानाय मह्यमिति प्रातर्दोहम्
text_mt: Becoming endowed with a self, O Soma, having ghee, go to the gods, find heaven for me, the sacrificer'—[with this verse he besprinkles] the morning milk.

sanskrit_iast: syonaṃ te sadanaṃ karomi ghṛtasya dhārayā suśevaṃ kalpayāmi ta iti pātryāmupastīryārdraḥ prathasnurbhuvanasya gopāḥ śṛta utsnāti janitā matīnāmityaparyāvartayanpuroḍāśamudvāsya
meaning: स्योनं ते सदनं करोमि घृतस्य धारया सुशेवं कल्पयामि त इति पात्र्यामुपस्तीर्यार्द्रः प्रथस्नुर्भुवनस्य गोपाः शृत उत्स्नाति जनिता मतीनामित्यपर्यावर्तयन्पुरोडाशमुद्वास्य
text_mt: Having spread an under-layer [of ghee] in the vessel with: 'I make a soft seat for you; with a stream of ghee I fashion it gentle for you', having removed the sacrificial cake without turning it over, with: 'Moist, expansive, guardian of the world, baked, rising up, progenitor of devotions,'

sanskrit_iast: devena bhasma pramṛjya tasmin sīdāmṛte pratitiṣṭha vrīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasyamāna iti pātryāṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: देवेन भस्म प्रमृज्य तस्मिन् सीदामृते प्रतितिष्ठ व्रीहीणां मेध सुमनस्यमान इति पात्र्यां प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: having wiped off the ash with the sacred bunch, he places it firmly in the vessel with: 'Sit in it; stand firm in immortality, O essence of rice, being well-disposed.'

sanskrit_iast: irā bhūtiḥ pṛthivyai raso motkramīditi sruveṇa kapālāni pratyajya devastvā savitā madhvānaktviti sruveṇa puroḍāśam anakti svaktamakūrmapṛṣantamaparivargamaṇikāṣam
meaning: इरा भूतिः पृथिव्यै रसो मोत्क्रमीदिति स्रुवेण कपालानि प्रत्यज्य देवस्त्वा सविता मध्वानक्त्विति स्रुवेण पुरोडाशम् अनक्ति स्वक्तमकूर्मपृषन्तमपरिवर्गमणिकाषम्
text_mt: Having re-anointed the potsherds with the dipping-spoon with: 'May food, prosperity, and the sap of the earth not depart', he anoints the sacrificial cake with the dipping-spoon with: 'May god Savitṛ anoint you with honey', thoroughly anointed, not with a tortoise-marked back, without missing any spot, without scraping [it thin].
Having anointed it on top, he anoints it underneath.
At the full moon he should set down the oblations with the Caturhotṛ formula, at the new moon with the Pañcahotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: priyeṇa namnā priyaṃ sada āsīdeti yadanyaddhavirdārśapūrṇamāsikebhyastadetenāsādayediti vijñāyate
meaning: प्रियेण नम्ना प्रियं सद आसीदेति यदन्यद्धविर्दार्शपूर्णमासिकेभ्यस्तदेतेनासादयेदिति विज्ञायते
text_mt: It is known [from the Brāhmaṇa]: 'With your dear name sit in your dear seat'—whatever oblation there is other than those of the New and Full Moon sacrifices, one should set down with this [mantra].
Behind the offering ladles, he sets down the two sacrificial cakes.

sanskrit_iast: api vā madhye vedyāḥ sāṃnāyyakumbhyau saṃdadhāti pūrvaṃ śṛtamaparaṃ dadhi /
meaning: अपि वा मध्ये वेद्याः सांनाय्यकुम्भ्यौ संदधाति पूर्वं शृतमपरं दधि /
text_mt: Or rather, in the middle of the altar ground he joins the two pots of sāṃnāyya: the hot milk in front, the sour curds behind;

sanskrit_iast: athaine vyudūhati dakṣiṇasyāṃ śroṇyāṃ śṛtamāsādayatyuttarasyāṃ dadhi
meaning: अथैने व्युदूहति दक्षिणस्यां श्रोण्यां शृतमासादयत्युत्तरस्यां दधि
text_mt: then he pushes them apart; he sets down the hot milk on the southern buttock, the sour curds on the northern.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ vedaḥ pṛthivīmanvavindadguhā satīṃ gahane gahvareṣu /
meaning: अयं वेदः पृथिवीमन्वविन्दद्गुहा सतीं गहने गह्वरेषु /
text_mt: 'This sacred grass bunch found the earth, which was in hiding, in the deep places, in the hollows;

sanskrit_iast: sa vindatu yajamānāya lokamacchidraṃ yajñaṃ bhūrikarmā karotv ity agreṇottareṇa vā dhruvāṃ vedaṃ nidhāya vedyantānparistīrya hotṛṣadanaṃ kalpayitvā sāmidhenībhyaḥ pratipadyate
meaning: स विन्दतु यजमानाय लोकमच्छिद्रं यज्ञं भूरिकर्मा करोत्व् इत्य् अग्रेणोत्तरेण वा ध्रुवां वेदं निधाय वेद्यन्तान्परिस्तीर्य होतृषदनं कल्पयित्वा सामिधेनीभ्यः प्रतिपद्यते
text_mt: May it find a realm for the sacrificer; may it of abundant deeds make the sacrifice flawless'—having placed the grass broom in front of or to the north of the dhruvā ladle, having strewn the borders of the altar ground, having prepared the hotṛ's seat, he proceeds to the sāmidhenī verses.
He issues the call: 'Recite for Agni being kindled', or: 'Recite for [him] being kindled.'
[The hotṛ] recites fifteen sāmidhenī verses.
At each praṇava he puts a piece of firewood [on the fire].
When the sāmidhenī verses are increased, the pieces of wood are increased;
when they are reduced, [it proceeds] as in the base form.

meaning: समिद्धो अग्न आहुतेत्यभिज्ञायैकामनूयाजसमिधमवशिष्य सर्वमिध्मशेषमभ्यादधाति परिधानीयायां वा
text_mt: Recognizing: 'O Agni, you are kindled with an offering', having set aside one stick of firewood for the anūyāja offerings, he puts all the rest of the firewood on [the fire], or at the concluding verse.

sanskrit_iast: vedenāgniṃ trirupavājya sruveṇa dhruvāyā ājyamādāya vedenopayamyāsīna uttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhimanvavahṛtya prajāpatiṃ manasā dhyāyandakṣiṇāprāñcamṛjuṃ saṃtataṃ jyotiṣmatyāghāramāghārayansarvāṇīdhmakāṣṭhāni saṃsparśayati
meaning: वेदेनाग्निं त्रिरुपवाज्य स्रुवेण ध्रुवाया आज्यमादाय वेदेनोपयम्यासीन उत्तरं परिधिसंधिमन्ववहृत्य प्रजापतिं मनसा ध्यायन्दक्षिणाप्राञ्चमृजुं संततं ज्योतिष्मत्याघारमाघारयन्सर्वाणीध्मकाष्ठानि संस्पर्शयति
text_mt: Having fanned the fire three times with the veda broom, having taken clarified butter from the dhruvā ladle with the dipping-spoon, having supported it with the broom, seated, bringing it down along the northern junction of the enclosing sticks, meditating on Prajāpati in mind, pouring an uninterrupted straight line of clarified butter to the south-east with a luminous pouring, he makes it touch all the pieces of firewood.

sanskrit_iast: āghārayorvadatyṛjū prāñcau hotavyau tiryañcau vā vyatiṣaktāvavyatiṣaktau vā
meaning: आघारयोर्वदत्यृजू प्राञ्चौ होतव्यौ तिर्यञ्चौ वा व्यतिषक्तावव्यतिषक्तौ वा
text_mt: He speaks regarding the two lines of clarified butter: they should be offered straight forward, or crosswise, interwoven or not interwoven.

sanskrit_iast: sruveṇājyasthālyā ājyamādāyāpyāyatāṃ dhruvā ghṛtenety avadāyāvadāya dhruvāmāpyāyayatīti sārvatrikam
meaning: स्रुवेणाज्यस्थाल्या आज्यमादायाप्यायतां ध्रुवा घृतेनेत्य् अवदायावदाय ध्रुवामाप्याययतीति सार्वत्रिकम्
text_mt: Having taken clarified butter from the butter-pot with the dipping-spoon, with: 'May the dhruvā ladle swell with ghee', each time he takes a portion he replenishes the dhruvā ladle; this applies everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: agnīt paridhīṃś cāgniṃ ca tristriḥ saṃmṛḍḍhīti saṃpreṣyati
meaning: अग्नीत् परिधींश् चाग्निं च त्रिस्त्रिः संमृड्ढीति संप्रेष्यति
text_mt: He issues the call: 'O agnīdh, cleanse the enclosing sticks and the fire three times each.'

sanskrit_iast: idhmasaṃnahanaiḥ sahasphyair ṛtesphyair vāgnīdhro 'nuparikrāmaṃ paridhīnyathāparidhitamanvagraṃ tristriḥ saṃmṛjyāgne vājajidvājaṃ tvā sariṣyantaṃ vājaṃ jeṣyantaṃ vājinaṃ vājajitaṃ vājajityāyai saṃmārjmyagnimannādamannādyāyeti triragniṃ prāñcam
meaning: इध्मसंनहनैः सहस्फ्यैर् ऋतेस्फ्यैर् वाग्नीध्रो ऽनुपरिक्रामं परिधीन्यथापरिधितमन्वग्रं त्रिस्त्रिः संमृज्याग्ने वाजजिद्वाजं त्वा सरिष्यन्तं वाजं जेष्यन्तं वाजिनं वाजजितं वाजजित्यायै संमार्ज्म्यग्निमन्नादमन्नाद्यायेति त्रिरग्निं प्राञ्चम्
text_mt: The agnīdh, having circumambulated with the firewood cords, along with the wooden sword or without the wooden sword, having cleansed the enclosing sticks three times each from base to tip in the order in which they were enclosed, with: 'O Agni, winner of the prize, about to run for the prize, about to win the prize, swift runner, winner of the prize, for the winning of the prize I cleanse you; Agni, eater of food, for the eating of food', [cleanses] the fire three times forward to the east.

sanskrit_iast: bhuvanamasītyagreṇa dhruvāṃ juhūṃ vāñjaliṃ kṛtvā juhvehīti juhūmādatta upabhṛdehītyupabhṛtam
meaning: भुवनमसीत्यग्रेण ध्रुवां जुहूं वाञ्जलिं कृत्वा जुह्वेहीति जुहूमादत्त उपभृदेहीत्युपभृतम्
text_mt: Having folded his hands in front of the dhruvā ladle or the juhū ladle with: 'You are the world', he takes the juhū ladle with: 'Come, O juhū', the upabhṛt ladle with: 'Come, O upabhṛt.'

sanskrit_iast: suyame me adya ghṛtācī bhūyāstaṃ svāvṛtau sūpāvṛtāvityupabhṛti juhūmatyādadhāti
meaning: सुयमे मे अद्य घृताची भूयास्तं स्वावृतौ सूपावृतावित्युपभृति जुहूमत्यादधाति
text_mt: With: 'May you two, turned to ghee, be easy to manage for me today, well turned, well approached', he places the juhū over the upabhṛt ladle.
Bringing them together at their spouts, he separates them at their spouts.
Everywhere the placing-over and separating are thus.

sanskrit_iast: na ca saṃśiñjayati nābhideśe ca srucau dhārayati
meaning: न च संशिञ्जयति नाभिदेशे च स्रुचौ धारयति
text_mt: And he does not make them clink, and he holds the two ladles at the level of the navel.

sanskrit_iast: agnāviṣṇū mā vāmavakramiṣamityagreṇa sruco 'pareṇa madhyamaṃ paridhimanavakrāmaṃ prastaraṃ dakṣiṇena padā dakṣiṇātikrāmaty udak savyena
meaning: अग्नाविष्णू मा वामवक्रमिषमित्यग्रेण स्रुचो ऽपरेण मध्यमं परिधिमनवक्रामं प्रस्तरं दक्षिणेन पदा दक्षिणातिक्रामत्य् उदक् सव्येन
text_mt: With: 'O Agni and Viṣṇu, may I not step on you two', in front of the ladles, behind the middle enclosing stick, not stepping on the prastara, he steps over to the south with his right foot, [then] north with his left foot;
He stops with: 'You are the stepping place of Viṣṇu.'
The right foot is inside the altar ground, the left slightly outside.
Then standing upright, bringing [the ladle] down along the southern junction of the enclosing sticks,

sanskrit_iast: samārabhyordhvo adhvara iti prāñcamudañcamṛjuṃ saṃtataṃ jyotiṣmatyāghāramāghārayansarvāṇīdhmakāṣṭhāni saṃsparśayati
meaning: समारभ्योर्ध्वो अध्वर इति प्राञ्चमुदञ्चमृजुं संततं ज्योतिष्मत्याघारमाघारयन्सर्वाणीध्मकाष्ठानि संस्पर्शयति
text_mt: with: 'Beginning, upright is the sacrifice', pouring an uninterrupted straight line of clarified butter to the north-east with a luminous pouring, he makes it touch all the pieces of firewood.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syād iti jihmaṃ tasyety uktam
meaning: यं कामयेत प्रमायुकः स्याद् इति जिह्मं तस्येत्य् उक्तम्
text_mt: It has been said: regarding one whom he may desire: 'May he perish', crooked for him.
Having poured [the butter] upwards, he should break it off for one who is hated;
For one who desires heaven, he should offer the line of clarified butter upward, with the greatest amount among the oblations;

sanskrit_iast: api vā nāghārayetpūrvārdhe madhye paścārdhe vā juhuyāt
meaning: अपि वा नाघारयेत्पूर्वार्धे मध्ये पश्चार्धे वा जुहुयात्
text_mt: or he should not pour a line, [but] offer in the eastern half, in the middle, or in the western half.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhadbhā iti srucamudgṛhya pāhi māgne duścaritādā mā sucarite bhajetyasaṃsparśayan srucau pratyākrāmati
meaning: बृहद्भा इति स्रुचमुद्गृह्य पाहि माग्ने दुश्चरितादा मा सुचरिते भजेत्यसंस्पर्शयन् स्रुचौ प्रत्याक्रामति
text_mt: Raising the ladle with: 'O great light', with: 'Protect me, O Agni, from bad conduct; assign me to good conduct', not letting the two ladles touch, he steps back.
Only these two, the stepping over and stepping back, are accompanied by mantras.

sanskrit_iast: makhasya śiro 'sīti juhvā dhruvāṃ dvis trir vā samanakti
meaning: मखस्य शिरो ऽसीति जुह्वा ध्रुवां द्विस् त्रिर् वा समनक्ति
text_mt: With: 'You are the head of Makha', he smears the dhruvā ladle twice or three times with the juhū ladle.

sanskrit_iast: unnītaṃ rāya iti sruveṇa dhruvāyā ājyamādāya suvīrāya svāheti juhūmabhighārya juhvo 'pādāya yajñena yajñaḥ saṃtata iti dhruvāṃ pratyabhighāryāyatane srucau sādayitvā
meaning: उन्नीतं राय इति स्रुवेण ध्रुवाया आज्यमादाय सुवीराय स्वाहेति जुहूमभिघार्य जुह्वो ऽपादाय यज्ञेन यज्ञः संतत इति ध्रुवां प्रत्यभिघार्यायतने स्रुचौ सादयित्वा
text_mt: With: 'Raised for wealth', having taken clarified butter from the dhruvā ladle with the dipping-spoon, having besprinkled the juhū ladle with: 'Hail to the one of good heroes!', having taken [clarified butter] from the juhū, having besprinkled the dhruvā ladle back with: 'Through sacrifice the sacrifice is made continuous', having placed the two ladles in their place;

sanskrit_iast: ka idamadhvaryur bhaviṣyati sa idamadhvaryur bhaviṣyati yajño yajñasya vāgārtvijyaṃ karotu mana ārtvijyaṃ karotu vācaṃ prapadye bhūrbhuvaḥ suvar viṣṇo sthāne tiṣṭhāmītīdhmasaṃnahanāni sphya upasaṃgṛhya vedyāśca tṛṇamavyantamādāyottarataḥ pravarāyāvatiṣṭhete pūrvo 'dhvaryur apara āgnīdhraḥ
meaning: क इदमध्वर्युर् भविष्यति स इदमध्वर्युर् भविष्यति यज्ञो यज्ञस्य वागार्त्विज्यं करोतु मन आर्त्विज्यं करोतु वाचं प्रपद्ये भूर्भुवः सुवर् विष्णो स्थाने तिष्ठामीतीध्मसंनहनानि स्फ्य उपसंगृह्य वेद्याश्च तृणमव्यन्तमादायोत्तरतः प्रवरायावतिष्ठेते पूर्वो ऽध्वर्युर् अपर आग्नीध्रः
text_mt: with: 'Who will be the adhvaryu here? He will be the adhvaryu here; may the sacrifice perform the priestly office of the sacrifice; may speech perform the priestly office; may mind perform the priestly office; I resort to speech; bhūr, bhuvaḥ, suvar; I stand in the place of Viṣṇu', grasping the firewood cords upon the wooden sword, and taking an unbroken blade of grass from the altar ground, they two stand on the north for the pravara call: the adhvaryu in front, the agnīdh behind.

sanskrit_iast: idhmasaṃnahanānyāgnīdhro 'nvārabhya ka idamagnīdbhaviṣyati sa idamagnīdbhaviṣyatīti mantraṃ saṃnamati
meaning: इध्मसंनहनान्याग्नीध्रो ऽन्वारभ्य क इदमग्नीद्भविष्यति स इदमग्नीद्भविष्यतीति मन्त्रं संनमति
text_mt: The agnīdh, grasping the firewood cords from behind, adapts the mantra to: 'Who will be the agnīdh here? He will be the agnīdh here.'

sanskrit_iast: brahman pravarāyāśrāvayiṣyāmīti brahmāṇam āmantryāśrāvayo śrāvaya śrāvayomāśrāvayeti vāśrāvayati
meaning: ब्रह्मन् प्रवरायाश्रावयिष्यामीति ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्याश्रावयो श्रावय श्रावयोमाश्रावयेति वाश्रावयति
text_mt: Having addressed the brahman priest with: 'O brahman, I shall make the call for the pravara', he makes the call with: 'āśrāvaya', 'o śrāvaya', or 'śrāvayom āśrāvaya.'

sanskrit_iast: astu śrauṣaḍ ity āgnīdhro 'pareṇotkaraṃ dakṣiṇāmukhastiṣṭhansphyaṃ saṃmārgāṃśca dhārayan pratyāśrāvayati
meaning: अस्तु श्रौषड् इत्य् आग्नीध्रो ऽपरेणोत्करं दक्षिणामुखस्तिष्ठन्स्फ्यं संमार्गांश्च धारयन् प्रत्याश्रावयति
text_mt: With: 'astu śrauṣaṭ', the agnīdh, standing behind the rubbish heap facing south, holding the wooden sword and the cleansing grass, responds to the call.
Everywhere the call and counter-call are performed in this manner.
They proceed without uttering worldly speech.
About to make the call, one should say nothing other than the call; once the call is made, the āgnīdhra [should say] nothing other than the counter-call.

sanskrit_iast: pratyāśrāvite nānyadadhvaryur yajeti vacanādyajetyukte hotā nānyadvaṣaṭkārāt
meaning: प्रत्याश्राविते नान्यदध्वर्युर् यजेति वचनाद्यजेत्युक्ते होता नान्यद्वषट्कारात्
text_mt: Once the counter-call is made, the adhvaryu [should say] nothing other than the instruction, "Recite the consecratory verse!"; once "Recite the consecratory verse!" is spoken, the hotṛ [should say] nothing other than the vaṣaṭ-call.
If he should speak anything else, he should make the call again.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvajñumāsīnaṃ hotāraṃ vṛṇīte 'gnirdevo hotā devān yakṣad vidvāṃś cikitvān manuṣvad bharatavad amuvad amuvad iti yathārṣeyo yajamānaḥ
meaning: ऊर्ध्वज्ञुमासीनं होतारं वृणीते ऽग्निर्देवो होता देवान् यक्षद् विद्वांश् चिकित्वान् मनुष्वद् भरतवद् अमुवद् अमुवद् इति यथार्षेयो यजमानः
text_mt: He chooses the hotṛ who is seated with his right knee raised, saying: "Agni the god, the hotṛ, shall worship the gods, wise, observant, like Manu, like Bharata, like such-and-such, like such-and-such," according to the ancestral lineage of the sacrificer.
He chooses three mantra-makers according to the ancestral lineage.
Or also one, two, three, [or] five.
He does not choose four; he does not choose more than five.
The adhvaryu chooses them upwards from here; the hotṛ, downwards from there.
A king chooses according to the ancestral lineage of his domestic priest.

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇvad ā ca vakṣad brāhmaṇā asya yajñasya prāvitāra iti pravaraśeṣam āha
meaning: ब्रह्मण्वद् आ च वक्षद् ब्राह्मणा अस्य यज्ञस्य प्रावितार इति प्रवरशेषम् आह
text_mt: He utters the remainder of the ancestral list: "Endowed with Brahman may he bring [them] here; the Brahmins are the protectors of this sacrifice."

sanskrit_iast: hotur upāṃśu nāma gṛhṇāti mānuṣa ity uccaiḥ
meaning: होतुर् उपांशु नाम गृह्णाति मानुष इत्य् उच्चैः
text_mt: He takes the name of the hotṛ in a low voice, and "the mortal" aloud.
He throws a blade of grass onto the altar ground.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtavati śabde juhūpabhṛtāvādāya dakṣiṇā sakṛdatikrānto 'pareṇāghārasaṃbhedaṃ pañca prayājānprāco yajati
meaning: घृतवति शब्दे जुहूपभृतावादाय दक्षिणा सकृदतिक्रान्तो ऽपरेणाघारसंभेदं पञ्च प्रयाजान्प्राचो यजति
text_mt: At the words containing "ghee", taking the juhū and upabhṛt, having stepped once to the south, he offers the five fore-offerings towards the east, west of the intersection of the two continuous libations.

sanskrit_iast: pratidiśaṃ vā samidhaḥ purastāttanūnapātaṃ dakṣiṇata iḍaḥ paścādbarhiruttarataḥ svāhākāraṃ madhye
meaning: प्रतिदिशं वा समिधः पुरस्तात्तनूनपातं दक्षिणत इडः पश्चाद्बर्हिरुत्तरतः स्वाहाकारं मध्ये
text_mt: Or towards the cardinal directions: the firewood sticks in the east, Tanūnapāt in the south, the iḍās in the west, the sacrificial grass in the north, the svāhā-call in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvamāśrāvaṃ pratyāśrāvite samidho yajeti prathamaṃ saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: आश्रावमाश्रावं प्रत्याश्राविते समिधो यजेति प्रथमं संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having repeatedly made the call, when the counter-call has been given, he first gives the ritual call: "Recite the consecratory verse for the firewood sticks!"

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayetābhitaraṃ vasīyānsyādity abhikrāmaṃ tasya juhuyādavataraṃ pāpīyāniti pratikrāmaṃ na vasīyānna pāpīyāniti samānatra tiṣṭhan
meaning: यं कामयेताभितरं वसीयान्स्यादित्य् अभिक्रामं तस्य जुहुयादवतरं पापीयानिति प्रतिक्रामं न वसीयान्न पापीयानिति समानत्र तिष्ठन्
text_mt: For him whom he wishes, "May he become wealthier and wealthier," he should offer stepping forward; "May he become poorer and poorer," stepping backward; "May he become neither wealthier nor poorer," standing in the same place.

sanskrit_iast: trīniṣṭvārdhamaupabhṛtasya juhvāmānīyottarāviṣṭvā pratyākramya śeṣeṇa dhruvāmabhighāryānupūrvaṃ havīṃṣyabhighārayatyupabhṛtamantataḥ
meaning: त्रीनिष्ट्वार्धमौपभृतस्य जुह्वामानीयोत्तराविष्ट्वा प्रत्याक्रम्य शेषेण ध्रुवामभिघार्यानुपूर्वं हवींष्यभिघारयत्युपभृतमन्ततः
text_mt: Having offered three, having poured half of the contents of the upabhṛt into the juhū, having offered the next two, having stepped back, having basted the dhruvā with the remainder, he bastes the sacrificial offerings in regular order, [and] the upabhṛt last.
He should not baste the sacrificial offerings of an enemy.
He places the two offering ladles down in their place.
The two portions of clarified butter are the oblations of clarified butter dedicated to Agni and to Soma, [taken] with four ladlefuls [each].

sanskrit_iast: jamadagnīnāṃ tu pañcāvattamapyajāmadagnyo jāmadagnyamāmantrya pañcāvattaṃ kurvīta sarvatra
meaning: जमदग्नीनां तु पञ्चावत्तमप्यजामदग्न्यो जामदग्न्यमामन्त्र्य पञ्चावत्तं कुर्वीत सर्वत्र
text_mt: For the Jamadagnis, however, there are five portions; even a non-Jamadagni, having addressed a Jamadagni, may make five portions everywhere.
While cutting off [the portions], he gives the ritual call for the invitatory verse: "Recite the invitatory verse for such-and-such!"

sanskrit_iast: avadāyāvadāya sruveṇa prastarabarhiḥ samajya juhūpabhṛtāvādāya dakṣiṇātikramyāśrāvya pratyāśrāvite 'muṃ yajeti yājyāmiti sārvatrikam
meaning: अवदायावदाय स्रुवेण प्रस्तरबर्हिः समज्य जुहूपभृतावादाय दक्षिणातिक्रम्याश्राव्य प्रत्याश्राविते ऽमुं यजेति याज्यामिति सार्वत्रिकम्
text_mt: Having cut off each portion, having anointed the grass bunch and the sacrificial grass with the dipping spoon, having taken the juhū and upabhṛt, having stepped to the south, having made the call, when the counter-call is given, [saying] "Recite the consecratory verse for such-and-such!" for the consecratory verse—this applies everywhere.
He offers to Agni in the northeastern part.
To Soma in the southeastern part, on a line with the previous [offering].

sanskrit_iast: pūrvamājyabhāgaṃ prati srucāvātte na nidadhātyā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ
meaning: पूर्वमाज्यभागं प्रति स्रुचावात्ते न निदधात्या स्विष्टकृतः
text_mt: He takes up the two ladles for the first portion of clarified butter [and] does not set them down until the Sviṣṭakṛt.
Between the two portions of clarified butter he offers the other oblations.

sanskrit_iast: pratyākramya juhvāmupastīrya mā bhermā saṃvikthā mā tvā hiṃsiṣaṃ mā te tejo 'pakramīt /
meaning: प्रत्याक्रम्य जुह्वामुपस्तीर्य मा भेर्मा संविक्था मा त्वा हिंसिषं मा ते तेजो ऽपक्रमीत् /
text_mt: Having stepped back, having spread an underlayer [of clarified butter] in the juhū, [with the mantra:] "Do not fear, do not tremble, let me not injure you, let your brilliance not depart!
Bring forth, lift up, sprinkle after, I will cut out portions for you!

sanskrit_iast: namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīrityāgneyasya puroḍāśasya madhyādaṅguṣṭhaparvamātramavadānaṃ tirīcīnamavadyati /
meaning: नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीरित्याग्नेयस्य पुरोडाशस्य मध्यादङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्रमवदानं तिरीचीनमवद्यति /
text_mt: Homage be to you, do not injure me!"—with this he cuts out a portion of the size of the thumb's joint transversely from the middle of the sacrificial cake for Agni.
A second longitudinally from the eastern half, for one who cuts four portions.
A third from the western half, for one who cuts five portions.
Without breaking [it], he cuts off [the portion] of the sacrificial cake with the two fingers connected with the flesh, and with the thumb.
With the dipping spoon [in the case] of clarified butter and curd-milk offering.
For one born after [his siblings], having cut off the first portion from the eastern half, he should place it in the eastern half of the ladle.
Having cut off the second from the middle, [he should place it] in the western half of the ladle.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaprathamānyavadyejjyeṣṭhasya jyaiṣṭhineyasya yo vā gataśrīḥ syāt
meaning: पूर्वप्रथमान्यवद्येज्ज्येष्ठस्य ज्यैष्ठिनेयस्य यो वा गतश्रीः स्यात्
text_mt: He should cut the eastern [parts] first for the eldest son, for the son of the eldest wife, or for one who has attained prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: aparaprathamāni kaniṣṭhasya kāniṣṭhineyasya yo vānujāvaro yo vā bubhūṣet
meaning: अपरप्रथमानि कनिष्ठस्य कानिष्ठिनेयस्य यो वानुजावरो यो वा बुभूषेत्
text_mt: The western [parts] first for the youngest, for the son of the youngest wife, or for one born after, or for one who wishes to prosper.

sanskrit_iast: atha yadi purohitaḥ purodhākāmo vā yajeta pūrvārdhātprathamamavadānamavadāya pūrvārdhe sruco nidhāya pūrvārdhe 'nger juhuyāt
meaning: अथ यदि पुरोहितः पुरोधाकामो वा यजेत पूर्वार्धात्प्रथममवदानमवदाय पूर्वार्धे स्रुचो निधाय पूर्वार्धे ऽन्गेर् जुहुयात्
text_mt: Then, if a domestic priest or one who desires the office of domestic priest should sacrifice, having cut the first portion from the eastern half, having placed it in the eastern half of the ladle, he should offer in the eastern half of the fire.
Having basted the portions [with the mantra]: "What portions of you cutting out I have made irregular for myself,

sanskrit_iast: ājyena pratyanajmyenattatta āpyāyatāṃ punariti haviḥ pratyabhighāryāgnaye 'nubrūhyagniṃ yajeti saṃpraiṣau
meaning: आज्येन प्रत्यनज्म्येनत्तत्त आप्यायतां पुनरिति हविः प्रत्यभिघार्याग्नये ऽनुब्रूह्यग्निं यजेति संप्रैषौ
text_mt: I re-anoint that with clarified butter; let that swell again for you," having basted the sacrificial oblation, [he gives] the two ritual calls: "Recite the invitatory verse for Agni!" [and] "Recite the consecratory verse for Agni!"
Having let the clarified butter trickle down, as if covering [the flame] without extinguishing it, having made the offering, he causes [drops of] clarified butter to trickle down after it.
He carries out the oblations along the line of intersection of the two continuous libations.
He offers into the continuous libation in the ladle, each preceding [offering] contiguous [with the next].
Whomever he hates, he should offer the oblations dividing them with his mind against him.
When the fire has lost its flame, as it were flickering, then he offers the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: ājyahavirupāṃśuyājaḥ paurṇamāsyāmeva bhavati vaiṣṇavo 'gnīṣomīyaḥ prājāpatyo vā
meaning: आज्यहविरुपांशुयाजः पौर्णमास्यामेव भवति वैष्णवो ऽग्नीषोमीयः प्राजापत्यो वा
text_mt: The low-voiced offering with the oblation of clarified butter takes place only on the full moon day, dedicated to Viṣṇu, to Agni-Soma, or to Prajāpati.
One wishing to prosper should sacrifice to Viṣṇu.
One with a rival, to Agni-Soma.
With the subsequent sacrificial offerings he proceeds in the same manner as for that to Agni, according to the deity.
having cut off from the sour curd, he cuts off from the boiled milk; or the reverse.
He offers all liquid offerings with the spout of the ladle (juhū);
the two seasonal offerings (pārvaṇa-oblations) [he offers] with the dipping-spoon (sruva).
"The vigorous bull, the full moon, we worship;

sanskrit_iast: sa no dohatāṃ suvīryaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ sahasriṇam /
meaning: स नो दोहतां सुवीर्यं रायस्पोषं सहस्रिणम् /
text_mt: may it milk for us good heroic progeny and wealth-nourishment thousandfold;
to the out-breath of abundant wealth, to the full moon, svāhā"—on the full-moon day.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyā subhagā suśevā dhenur iva bhūya āpyāyamānā /
meaning: अमावास्या सुभगा सुशेवा धेनुर् इव भूय आप्यायमाना /
text_mt: "The new moon, fortunate and very kind, swelling abundantly like a milch cow;

sanskrit_iast: sā no dohatāṃ suvīryaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ sahasriṇam /
meaning: सा नो दोहतां सुवीर्यं रायस्पोषं सहस्रिणम् /
text_mt: may she milk for us good heroic progeny and wealth-nourishment thousandfold;
to the in-breath of abundant wealth, to the new moon, svāhā"—on the new-moon day.

sanskrit_iast: nāriṣṭhānhomāñjuhoti daśa te tanuvo yajña yajñiyāstāḥ prīṇātu yajamāno ghṛtena /
meaning: नारिष्ठान्होमाञ्जुहोति दश ते तनुवो यज्ञ यज्ञियास्ताः प्रीणातु यजमानो घृतेन /
text_mt: He offers the nāriṣṭha offerings: "Ten are your bodies, O sacrifice, worthy of sacrifice; let the sacrificer please them with clarified butter;

meaning: नारिष्ठयोः देवानां दैव्ये ऽपि यजमानो ऽमृतो ऽभूत् /
text_mt: of the two nāriṣṭhas, in the divine realm of the gods, the sacrificer has become immortal.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ vāṃ devā akalpayannūrjo bhāgaṃ śatakratū /
meaning: यं वां देवा अकल्पयन्नूर्जो भागं शतक्रतू /
text_mt: The portion of vigor which the gods assigned to you two, O you of hundredfold wisdom;
this of yours he pleases therewith; be satisfied therewith, O two destroyers of distress.

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ devānāṃ sukṛtāmasmi loke mamedamiṣṭaṃ na mithurbhavāti /
meaning: अहं देवानां सुकृतामस्मि लोके ममेदमिष्टं न मिथुर्भवाति /
text_mt: I am in the world of the well-doing gods; may this sacrifice of mine not fail;
knowing, I offer after-sacrifices to the two nāriṣṭhas, since Indra assigned a portion to them both.

sanskrit_iast: adārasṛdbhavata deva somāsminyajñe maruto mṛḍatā naḥ /
meaning: अदारसृद्भवत देव सोमास्मिन्यज्ञे मरुतो मृडता नः /
text_mt: Be non-injurious, O divine Soma; in this sacrifice, O Maruts, be gracious to us;

sanskrit_iast: mā no vidadabhibhāmo aśastirmā no vidadvṛjanā dveṣyā yā
meaning: मा नो विददभिभामो अशस्तिर्मा नो विदद्वृजना द्वेष्या या
text_mt: let not dread hostility find us; let not hateful distress find us.

sanskrit_iast: brahma pratiṣṭhā manaso brahma vāco brahma yajñānāṃ haviṣāmājyasya /
meaning: ब्रह्म प्रतिष्ठा मनसो ब्रह्म वाचो ब्रह्म यज्ञानां हविषामाज्यस्य /
text_mt: Brahman is the foundation of mind, Brahman of speech, Brahman of sacrifices, of oblations, and of clarified butter;

sanskrit_iast: atiriktaṃ karmaṇo yac ca hīnaṃ yajñaḥ parvāṇi pratiranneti kalpayan /
meaning: अतिरिक्तं कर्मणो यच् च हीनं यज्ञः पर्वाणि प्रतिरन्नेति कल्पयन् /
text_mt: whatever of the rite is redundant and whatever is deficient, the sacrifice goes along arranging it, lengthening its joints;
let the oblation offered with svāhā go to the gods.

sanskrit_iast: saṃ te manasā manaḥ saṃ prāṇe prāṇaṃ dadhāmi te saṃ vyāne samapānaṃ dadhāmi te /
meaning: सं ते मनसा मनः सं प्राणे प्राणं दधामि ते सं व्याने समपानं दधामि ते /
text_mt: I unite your mind with mind, I place breath in breath for you, in diffused breath I place in-breath for you;

sanskrit_iast: parigṛhya yajamāno 'mṛto 'bhūcchaṃ na edhi dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade svāhety etaiḥ pratimantram
meaning: परिगृह्य यजमानो ऽमृतो ऽभूच्छं न एधि द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे स्वाहेत्य् एतैः प्रतिमन्त्रम्
text_mt: having taken hold [of them], the sacrificer has become immortal; be welfare to our two-footed, welfare to our four-footed, svāhā"—with these, verse by verse.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa upahomānāṃ kālo 'nantaraṃ vā pradhānātprāgvā samiṣṭayajuṣaḥ
meaning: एष उपहोमानां कालो ऽनन्तरं वा प्रधानात्प्राग्वा समिष्टयजुषः
text_mt: This is the time for secondary offerings (upahoma); or immediately after the principal offering; or before the samiṣṭayajus offerings.
Having spread an under-layer in the juhū, he cuts off once each from the northern half of all oblations for [Agni] Sviṣṭakṛt.
Among those for the deities, for Sviṣṭakṛt, for the iḍā, and for the fourfold division, each succeeding one is larger.
Having poured clarified butter over [the cut portions] twice, he does not pour clarified butter back upon the [remaining] oblation.

meaning: अग्नये स्विष्टकृते ऽनुब्रूह्यग्निं स्विष्टकृतं यजेति संप्रैषौ /
text_mt: "Recite for Agni Sviṣṭakṛt," and "Offer to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt," are the two ritual calls.
He offers in the eastern part of the northern half, not touching the other offerings.

sanskrit_iast: pratyākramya juhvāmapa ānīya vaiśvānare haviridaṃ juhomi sāhasramutsaṃ śatadhārametam /
meaning: प्रत्याक्रम्य जुह्वामप आनीय वैश्वानरे हविरिदं जुहोमि साहस्रमुत्सं शतधारमेतम् /
text_mt: Having stepped back and brought water into the juhū, [with the verse:] "In Vaiśvānara I offer this oblation, this thousandfold fountain of a hundred streams;

sanskrit_iast: sa naḥ pitaraṃ pitāmahaṃ prapitāmahaṃ svarge loke pinvamāno bibhartu svāhety antaḥparidhi ninayati ninayati
meaning: स नः पितरं पितामहं प्रपितामहं स्वर्गे लोके पिन्वमानो बिभर्तु स्वाहेत्य् अन्तःपरिधि निनयति निनयति
text_mt: swelling, may it sustain our father, grandfather, and great-grandfather in the heavenly world, svāhā"—he pours it out inside the enclosing sticks; he pours it out.

sanskrit_iast: iḍām eke pūrvaṃ samāmananti prāśitram eke
meaning: इडाम् एके पूर्वं समामनन्ति प्राशित्रम् एके
title: praśnaḥ 03
text_mt: Some teach the iḍā first; some the portion for the Brahman (prāśitra).

sanskrit_iast: āgneyaṃ puroḍāśaṃ prāñcaṃ tiryañcaṃ vā virujyāṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayā cāṅgulyā vyūhya madhyātprāśitramavadyati yavamātraṃ pippalamātraṃ vājyāyo yavamātrādāvyādhātkṛtyatāmidam /
meaning: आग्नेयं पुरोडाशं प्राञ्चं तिर्यञ्चं वा विरुज्याङ्गुष्ठेनोपमध्यमया चाङ्गुल्या व्यूह्य मध्यात्प्राशित्रमवद्यति यवमात्रं पिप्पलमात्रं वाज्यायो यवमात्रादाव्याधात्कृत्यतामिदम् /
text_mt: Having broken the sacrificial cake for Agni toward the east or crosswise, and having separated it with the thumb and the middle finger, he cuts off from the middle the prāśitra of the size of a barley grain or the size of a pippala berry; or larger than the size of a barley grain, [reciting:] "Let this be cut off up to the perforation;

sanskrit_iast: mā rūrupāma yajñasya śuddhaṃ sviṣṭam idaṃ havir iti
meaning: मा रूरुपाम यज्ञस्य शुद्धं स्विष्टम् इदं हविर् इति
text_mt: let us not injure the sacrifice; pure, well-offered is this oblation."
In this manner he cuts off from the subsequent [oblation].
Having spread an under-layer, he does not pour clarified butter over it; or the reverse.
Or rather, he both spreads an under-layer and pours [clarified butter] over it.
Some teach the carrying around and eating of it right at this point.

sanskrit_iast: iḍāpātra upastīrya sarvebhyo havirbhya iḍāṃ samavadyati caturavattāṃ pañcāvattāṃ vā
meaning: इडापात्र उपस्तीर्य सर्वेभ्यो हविर्भ्य इडां समवद्यति चतुरवत्तां पञ्चावत्तां वा
text_mt: Having spread an under-layer in the iḍā-vessel, he cuts portions together for the iḍā from all oblations, making it four cuttings or five cuttings.
"Seen by Manu, butter-footed, impelled by Mitra and Varuṇa,
not cleaving from the southern half, I cut off [the iḍā] facing one direction"—[with this] he cuts off the first cutting from the southern half of the sacrificial cake for Agni.
And from the eastern half the sacrificer's share, slender as it were and long.
Having gratified it with clarified butter, he pushes it near the dhruvā.
Or else, having cut off from the southern half, [he cuts off] the sacrificer's share, then from the fissure.
In this manner he cuts off from the subsequent [oblation].

sanskrit_iast: abhighāryeḍāṃ hotre pradāya dakṣiṇena hotāram atikrāmatyanutsṛjan
meaning: अभिघार्येडां होत्रे प्रदाय दक्षिणेन होतारम् अतिक्रामत्यनुत्सृजन्
text_mt: Having poured clarified butter over it and handed the iḍā to the hotṛ, he steps beyond to the south of the hotṛ without letting go.
The hotṛ embraces the adhvaryu with the iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: api vā prācīmiḍāmapohya dakṣiṇata āsīnaḥ sruveṇa hotur aṅguliparvaṇī anakti
meaning: अपि वा प्राचीमिडामपोह्य दक्षिणत आसीनः स्रुवेण होतुर् अङ्गुलिपर्वणी अनक्ति
text_mt: Or rather, having moved the iḍā toward the east and sitting to the south, he anoints the finger-joints of the hotṛ with the sruva.
Having anointed the subsequent, [he anoints] the preceding; or the reverse.

sanskrit_iast: upasṛṣṭodakāya purastātpratyaṅṅāsīna iḍāyā hotur haste 'vāntareḍām avadyati
meaning: उपसृष्टोदकाय पुरस्तात्प्रत्यङ्ङासीन इडाया होतुर् हस्ते ऽवान्तरेडाम् अवद्यति
text_mt: For him who has touched water, sitting in front facing west, he cuts off the intermediate iḍā from the iḍā into the hand of the hotṛ.
The adhvaryu cuts the first portion; the hotṛ himself the next.
The under-layer and the pouring over are made from the smeared [butter remnants].
He should pour over twice for one who takes five portions.
While it is being invoked, both the adhvaryu and the sacrificer touch it from behind.

sanskrit_iast: daivyā adhvaryava upahūtā ity abhijñāyopahūtaḥ paśumānasānītyadhvaryurjapati /
meaning: दैव्या अध्वर्यव उपहूता इत्य् अभिज्ञायोपहूतः पशुमानसानीत्यध्वर्युर्जपति /
text_mt: Recognizing the words, "The divine adhvaryus are invoked," the adhvaryu mutters: "May I, being invoked, possess cattle."

sanskrit_iast: upahūto 'yaṃ yajamāna ity abhijñāyaitameva mantraṃ yajamānaḥ
meaning: उपहूतो ऽयं यजमान इत्य् अभिज्ञायैतमेव मन्त्रं यजमानः
text_mt: Recognizing the words, "This sacrificer is invoked," the sacrificer [mutters] this very formula.
When [the iḍā] has been invoked, he carries the prāśitra around in front of the āhavanīya to the Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: tasminprāśite hotāvāntareḍāṃ prāśnāti vācaspataye tvā hutaṃ prāśnāmi sadaspataye tvā hutaṃ prāśnāmīti
meaning: तस्मिन्प्राशिते होतावान्तरेडां प्राश्नाति वाचस्पतये त्वा हुतं प्राश्नामि सदस्पतये त्वा हुतं प्राश्नामीति
text_mt: When that has been consumed, the hotṛ consumes the intermediate iḍā with: 'I consume you offered to Vācaspati; I consume you offered to Sadaspati.'
