sanskrit_iast: prāśitāyāmiḍe bhāgaṃ juṣasva no jinva gā jinvārvataḥ /
meaning: प्राशितायामिडे भागं जुषस्व नो जिन्व गा जिन्वार्वतः /
text_mt: 'O iḍā, enjoy our share; invigorate the cattle, invigorate the horses!

sanskrit_iast: tasyāste bhakṣivāṇaḥ syāma sarvātmānaḥ sarvagaṇā iti yajamānapañcamā iḍāṃ prāśya
meaning: तस्यास्ते भक्षिवाणः स्याम सर्वात्मानः सर्वगणा इति यजमानपञ्चमा इडां प्राश्य
text_mt: May we, consuming you, be complete in ourselves, complete with our retinue'—having thus consumed the iḍā, with the sacrificer as fifth,
they sit restraining speech until the cleansing.

sanskrit_iast: mano jyotirjuṣātāmityadbhir antarvedi prastare mārjayitvāgneyaṃ puroḍāśaṃ caturdhākṛtvā barhiṣadaṃ karoti barhiṣadaṃ vā kṛtvā caturdhākaroti
meaning: मनो ज्योतिर्जुषातामित्यद्भिर् अन्तर्वेदि प्रस्तरे मार्जयित्वाग्नेयं पुरोडाशं चतुर्धाकृत्वा बर्हिषदं करोति बर्हिषदं वा कृत्वा चतुर्धाकरोति
text_mt: Having cleansed themselves with water inside the altar ground on the grass bunch with 'May mind and light take pleasure...', he divides the sacrificial cake for Agni into four and places it on the sacrificial grass, or having placed it on the sacrificial grass, he divides it into four.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ yajamāno vyādiśatīdaṃ brahmaṇa idaṃ hoturidamadhvaryoridamagnīdha iti
meaning: तं यजमानो व्यादिशतीदं ब्रह्मण इदं होतुरिदमध्वर्योरिदमग्नीध इति
text_mt: The sacrificer assigns it: 'This for the brahman, this for the hotṛ, this for the adhvaryu, this for the agnīdh.'
[He gives it] beginning with the agnīdh, or beginning with the hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ yajamānasyetyadhvaryur yajamānabhāgaṃ nirdiśya sthaviṣṭhamagnīdhe ṣaḍavattaṃ saṃpādayati
meaning: इदं यजमानस्येत्यध्वर्युर् यजमानभागं निर्दिश्य स्थविष्ठमग्नीधे षडवत्तं संपादयति
text_mt: Saying 'This is the sacrificer's,' the adhvaryu indicates the sacrificer's share, and produces the thickest sixfold cut portion for the agnīdh.
Having spread an underlayer once, placing [two portions], and having spread an underlayer, he bastes it twice;
or he spreads an underlayer twice, places [two portions] twice, and bastes twice.

sanskrit_iast: agnerāgnīdhramasyagneḥ śāmitramasi namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīrityāgnīdhro bhakṣayati
meaning: अग्नेराग्नीध्रमस्यग्नेः शामित्रमसि नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीरित्याग्नीध्रो भक्षयति
text_mt: The agnīdh consumes it with: 'You are Agni's Agnīdhra; you are Agni's slaughter-ground; homage to you; do not injure me.'
He hands over the portions of the brahman and the sacrificer using the veda grass broom,
with separate vessels in the case of the other two.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyai bhāgo 'sīti hotā bhakṣayatyantarikṣasya bhāgo 'sīty adhvaryur divo bhāgo 'sīti brahmā
meaning: पृथिव्यै भागो ऽसीति होता भक्षयत्यन्तरिक्षस्य भागो ऽसीत्य् अध्वर्युर् दिवो भागो ऽसीति ब्रह्मा
text_mt: The hotṛ consumes with 'You are the share of the earth,' the adhvaryu with 'You are the share of the intermediate space,' the brahman with 'You are the share of heaven.'
He cooks on the southern fire the anvāhārya cooked rice, large and unmeasured.
Having basted it, or without basting it, and having taken it down, he places it inside the altar ground,
and issues the call: 'To be brought near for those sitting to the south.'

sanskrit_iast: ye brāhmaṇā uttaratastānyajamāna āha dakṣināta eteti
meaning: ये ब्राह्मणा उत्तरतस्तान्यजमान आह दक्षिनात एतेति
text_mt: The sacrificer says to those brahmins who are to the north: 'Come to the south.'

sanskrit_iast: tebhyo 'nvāhāryaṃ dadāti brāhmaṇā ayaṃ va odana iti
meaning: तेभ्यो ऽन्वाहार्यं ददाति ब्राह्मणा अयं व ओदन इति
text_mt: He gives the anvāhārya to them: 'O brahmins, this is your cooked rice.'
He issues the call: 'Having received it, go round to the north.'

sanskrit_iast: haviḥśeṣānudvāsyāpisṛjyolmuke brahmanprasthāsyāmaḥ samidhamādhāyāgnītparidhīṃścāgniṃ ca sakṛtsakṛtsaṃmṛḍḍhīti saṃpreṣyati
meaning: हविःशेषानुद्वास्यापिसृज्योल्मुके ब्रह्मन्प्रस्थास्यामः समिधमाधायाग्नीत्परिधींश्चाग्निं च सकृत्सकृत्संमृड्ढीति संप्रेष्यति
text_mt: Having taken down the remnants of the sacrificial substance and having put back the firebrands, he issues the call: 'O brahman, we shall set forth; having placed the kindling stick, O agnīdh, wipe once each the enclosing sticks and the fire.'

sanskrit_iast: anujñāto brahmaṇāgnīdhraḥ samidhamādadhāty eṣā te agne samittayā vardhasva cā ca pyāyasva vardhatāṃ ca te yajñapatirā ca pyāyatāṃ vardhiṣīmahi ca vayamā ca pyāyiṣīmahi svāheti
meaning: अनुज्ञातो ब्रह्मणाग्नीध्रः समिधमादधात्य् एषा ते अग्ने समित्तया वर्धस्व चा च प्यायस्व वर्धतां च ते यज्ञपतिरा च प्यायतां वर्धिषीमहि च वयमा च प्यायिषीमहि स्वाहेति
text_mt: Permitted by the brahman, the agnīdh places the kindling stick with: 'This is your kindling stick, O Agni; grow by it and swell, and may your lord of sacrifice grow and swell, and may we grow and swell, svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: pūrvavatparidhīnsakṛtsakṛtsaṃmṛjyāgne vājajidvājaṃ tvā sasṛvāṃsaṃ vājaṃ jigivāṃsaṃ vājinaṃ vājajitaṃ vājajityāyai saṃmārjmyagnimannādamannādyāyeti sakṛdagniṃ prāñcam
meaning: पूर्ववत्परिधीन्सकृत्सकृत्संमृज्याग्ने वाजजिद्वाजं त्वा ससृवांसं वाजं जिगिवांसं वाजिनं वाजजितं वाजजित्यायै संमार्ज्म्यग्निमन्नादमन्नाद्यायेति सकृदग्निं प्राञ्चम्
text_mt: Having wiped the enclosing sticks once each as before, [he wipes] the fire once towards the east with: 'O Agni, winner of prize, you who have run for the prize, won the prize, the vigorous winner of the prize, for winning the prize I wipe you; Agni, the eater of food, for the eating of food.'

sanskrit_iast: idhmasaṃnahanānyadbhiḥ saṃsparśya yo bhūtānāmadhipatī rudrastanticaro vṛṣā /
meaning: इध्मसंनहनान्यद्भिः संस्पर्श्य यो भूतानामधिपती रुद्रस्तन्तिचरो वृषा /
text_mt: Having touched the firewood binding cords with water, with 'Rudra, who is the overlord of beings, wandering on cords, the bull,

sanskrit_iast: paśūnasmākaṃ mā hiṃsīretadastu hutaṃ tava svāhetyagnau praharatyutkare vā nyasyati śālāyāṃ balajāyāṃ parogoṣṭhe parogavyūtau vā
meaning: पशूनस्माकं मा हिंसीरेतदस्तु हुतं तव स्वाहेत्यग्नौ प्रहरत्युत्करे वा न्यस्यति शालायां बलजायां परोगोष्ठे परोगव्यूतौ वा
text_mt: do not injure our cattle; may this be your offering, svāhā,' he throws [them] into the fire, or casts [them] onto the heap of rubbish, or in the hall, or on the balajā grass, or outside the cowshed, or beyond the pasture.

sanskrit_iast: aupabhṛtaṃ juhvāmānīya juhūpabhṛtāv ādāya dakṣiṇā sakṛdatikrānto 'greṇāghārasaṃbhedaṃ pratīcas trīn anūyājān yajaty āśrāvamāśrāvaṃ pratyāśrāvite devānyajeti prathamaṃ saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: औपभृतं जुह्वामानीय जुहूपभृताव् आदाय दक्षिणा सकृदतिक्रान्तो ऽग्रेणाघारसंभेदं प्रतीचस् त्रीन् अनूयाजान् यजत्य् आश्रावमाश्रावं प्रत्याश्राविते देवान्यजेति प्रथमं संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having poured the [ghee] from the upabhṛt into the juhū and taken up the juhū and upabhṛt, having stepped across to the south once, in front of the crossing of the continuous libations, facing west, he performs the three after-offerings; uttering the call each time, when the response is uttered, he issues the first call: 'Recite the yājyā for the gods';

sanskrit_iast: pūrvārdhe prathamaṃ samidhi juhoti madhye dvitīyaṃ prāñcam uttamaṃ saṃsthāpayannitarāvanusaṃbhidya
meaning: पूर्वार्धे प्रथमं समिधि जुहोति मध्ये द्वितीयं प्राञ्चम् उत्तमं संस्थापयन्नितरावनुसंभिद्य
text_mt: In the eastern half he offers the first on the kindling stick, in the middle the second, the last towards the east, bringing them to completion by joining the other two.
Having stepped back and placed the ladles in their place, he shifts them apart with the two [verses] containing the word 'vājin'.

sanskrit_iast: vājasya mā prasaveneti dakṣiṇena hastenottānena saprastarāṃ juhūmudyacchati /
meaning: वाजस्य मा प्रसवेनेति दक्षिणेन हस्तेनोत्तानेन सप्रस्तरां जुहूमुद्यच्छति /
text_mt: With 'At the impulse of the prize...' he raises the juhū along with the grass bunch with his right hand turned upward;
with 'And then the rivals...' he holds down the upabhṛt with his left [hand].

sanskrit_iast: udgrābhaṃ ceti juhūmudyacchati nigrābhaṃ cetyupabhṛtaṃ niyacchati
meaning: उद्ग्राभं चेति जुहूमुद्यच्छति निग्राभं चेत्युपभृतं नियच्छति
text_mt: With 'And elevation...' he raises the juhū, and with 'And depression...' he holds down the upabhṛt.

sanskrit_iast: brahma devā avīvṛdhanniti prācīṃ juhūṃ prohati
meaning: ब्रह्म देवा अवीवृधन्निति प्राचीं जुहूं प्रोहति
text_mt: With 'The gods have magnified the sacred lore' he pushes forward the juhū towards the east.

sanskrit_iast: athā sapatnāniti savyenopabhṛtaṃ pratīcīṃ bahirvedi nirasitvā prokṣyaināmabhyudāhṛtya juhvā paridhīnanakti vasubhyastveti madhyamaṃ rudrebhyastveti dakṣiṇamādityebhyastvetyuttaram
meaning: अथा सपत्नानिति सव्येनोपभृतं प्रतीचीं बहिर्वेदि निरसित्वा प्रोक्ष्यैनामभ्युदाहृत्य जुह्वा परिधीननक्ति वसुभ्यस्त्वेति मध्यमं रुद्रेभ्यस्त्वेति दक्षिणमादित्येभ्यस्त्वेत्युत्तरम्
text_mt: With 'And then the rivals...' having cast down the upabhṛt towards the west with his left hand outside the altar ground, having sprinkled it with water and brought it back up, he anoints the enclosing sticks with the juhū: the middle one with 'For the Vasus, you,' the southern one with 'For the Rudras, you,' the northern one with 'For the Ādityas, you.'
He does not place the juhū on the grass bunch.

sanskrit_iast: saṃjānāthāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī mitrāvaruṇau tvā vṛṣṭyāvatāmiti vidhṛtībhyāṃ prastaramapādāya barhiṣi vidhṛtī apisṛjya srukṣu prastaramanakti
meaning: संजानाथां द्यावापृथिवी मित्रावरुणौ त्वा वृष्ट्यावतामिति विधृतीभ्यां प्रस्तरमपादाय बर्हिषि विधृती अपिसृज्य स्रुक्षु प्रस्तरमनक्ति
text_mt: With 'Agree together, O Heaven and Earth; may Mitra and Varuṇa help you with rain,' having taken the grass bunch off the two separators and having thrown the two separators into the sacrificial grass, he anoints the grass bunch in the ladles:
the tip in the juhū with 'Licking the anointed...';
the middle in the upabhṛt with 'Offspring, the womb...';
the root in the dhruvā with 'May waters and plants swell...';
Or the tip in the juhū with 'Be anointed in heaven';
the middle in the upabhṛt with 'Be anointed in the intermediate space';
the root in the dhruvā with 'Be anointed on earth';

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyai tveti dhruvāyāṃ mūlamantarikṣāya tvetyupabhṛti madhyaṃ dive tveti juhvāmagram
meaning: पृथिव्यै त्वेति ध्रुवायां मूलमन्तरिक्षाय त्वेत्युपभृति मध्यं दिवे त्वेति जुह्वामग्रम्
text_mt: the root in the dhruvā with 'For the earth, you'; the middle in the upabhṛt with 'For the intermediate space, you'; the tip in the juhū with 'For heaven, you.'

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣe tvetyaktasya tṛṇamapādāya prajñātaṃ nidhāya dakṣiṇottarābhyāṃ pāṇībhyāṃ prastaraṃ gṛhītvā juhvāṃ pratiṣṭhāpyāsīna āśrāvya pratyāśrāvite saṃpreṣyatīṣitā daivyā hotāro bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya sūktā brūhīti
meaning: आयुषे त्वेत्यक्तस्य तृणमपादाय प्रज्ञातं निधाय दक्षिणोत्तराभ्यां पाणीभ्यां प्रस्तरं गृहीत्वा जुह्वां प्रतिष्ठाप्यासीन आश्राव्य प्रत्याश्राविते संप्रेष्यतीषिता दैव्या होतारो भद्रवाच्याय प्रेषितो मानुषः सूक्तवाकाय सूक्ता ब्रूहीति
text_mt: Having taken a blade of the anointed [grass bunch] with 'For life, you,' and having placed it in a known spot, having grasped the grass bunch with both hands, the right over the left, and placed it upon the juhū, seated, having called and received the response, he issues the call: 'The divine hotṛs have been sent forth for uttering what is auspicious; the human [hotṛ] has been urged for the hymn-recitation; recite the hymns.'

sanskrit_iast: anūcyamāne sūktavāke marutāṃ pṛṣataya stheti saha śākhayā prastaramāhavanīye praharati
meaning: अनूच्यमाने सूक्तवाके मरुतां पृषतय स्थेति सह शाखया प्रस्तरमाहवनीये प्रहरति
text_mt: While the hymn-recitation is being uttered, with 'You are the dappled mares of the Maruts,' he throws the grass bunch along with the branch into the āhavanīya.

sanskrit_iast: na vidhūnoti nāvadhūnoti na vikṣipati na pramārṣṭi na pratimārṣṭi nānumārṣṭi nodañcaṃ praharet
meaning: न विधूनोति नावधूनोति न विक्षिपति न प्रमार्ष्टि न प्रतिमार्ष्टि नानुमार्ष्टि नोदञ्चं प्रहरेत्
text_mt: He does not shake it out, he does not shake it down, he does not fling it, he does not wipe it off, he does not wipe it back, he does not wipe it along, nor should he throw it towards the north.
Holding his hand horizontally, as if drawing it along, he throws it into the āhavanīya.
It has been said: 'He does not break it.'
For whomsoever he desires, 'May a female child be born to him,' he should throw it having spread it out.
He releases the grass bunch at the benediction,
turning his hand face downwards.
He issues the call: 'O agnīdh, make [it] reach [the goal].'

sanskrit_iast: trirañjalināgnīdhro 'viṣvañcaṃ prastaramūrdhvamudyauti rohitena tvāgnirdevatāṃ gamayatvityetaiḥ pratimantram
meaning: त्रिरञ्जलिनाग्नीध्रो ऽविष्वञ्चं प्रस्तरमूर्ध्वमुद्यौति रोहितेन त्वाग्निर्देवतां गमयत्वित्येतैः प्रतिमन्त्रम्
text_mt: Three times with his joined palms the agnīdh stirs up the grass bunch upwards without scattering it, with these formulas respectively: 'May Agni make you reach the deity with the red horse.'
Then the agnīdh says to him: 'Throw [the rest] after.'
The blade of grass that was taken from the grass bunch, that he throws after with: 'Hail to your bodies.'

sanskrit_iast: etadetad iti triraṅgulyā nirdiśyāgnimabhimantrayata āyuṣpā agne 'syāyur me pāhīti
meaning: एतदेतद् इति त्रिरङ्गुल्या निर्दिश्याग्निमभिमन्त्रयत आयुष्पा अग्ने ऽस्यायुर् मे पाहीति
text_mt: Pointing with his finger three times with the words, 'This, this,' he addresses the fire: 'Protector of life, O Agni, protect my life.'
With the words, 'You are firm,' he touches the earth inside the altar ground.
Then the agnīdh says to him, 'Converse.'
The adhvaryu says: 'Has it gone, Agnīdh?'

sanskrit_iast: madhyamaṃ paridhimanvārabhya saṃpreṣyati svagā daivyāhotṛbhyaḥ svastirmānuṣebhyaḥ śaṃyorbrūhīti
meaning: मध्यमं परिधिमन्वारभ्य संप्रेष्यति स्वगा दैव्याहोतृभ्यः स्वस्तिर्मानुषेभ्यः शंयोर्ब्रूहीति
text_mt: Touching the middle enclosing stick, he gives the ritual call: 'All hail to the divine hotṛs, well-being to the human ones; recite the śaṃyuvāka.'
While the śaṃyuvāka is being recited, he casts the enclosing sticks into the āhavanīya;
the middle one with the words, 'The enclosing stick which you placed around [us],'
and the other two with the words, 'Together coming to the path of sacrifice.'
He pushes the tip of the northern one into the embers.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānaṃ prathateti paridhīnabhimantrya juhvāmupabhṛto 'gramavadhāya saṃsrāvabhāgā iti saṃsrāveṇābhijuhoti
meaning: यजमानं प्रथतेति परिधीनभिमन्त्र्य जुह्वामुपभृतो ऽग्रमवधाय संस्रावभागा इति संस्रावेणाभिजुहोति
text_mt: Addressing the enclosing sticks with the words, 'Spread the sacrificer,' and placing the tip of the upabhṛt into the juhū, he pours an oblation with the residue of ghee, with the words, 'Having the residue for their share.'
Right here the priests consume the remains of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: ājyalepānprakṣālya sasruve juhūpabhṛtāvadhvaryurādatte vedaṃ hotā sphyamājyasthālīmudakamaṇḍaluṃ cāgnīdhraḥ
meaning: आज्यलेपान्प्रक्षाल्य सस्रुवे जुहूपभृतावध्वर्युरादत्ते वेदं होता स्फ्यमाज्यस्थालीमुदकमण्डलुं चाग्नीध्रः
text_mt: Having washed off the smears of ghee, the adhvaryu takes up the juhū and upabhṛt together with the sruva; the hotṛ [takes] the veda-broom, and the agnīdh [takes] the wooden sword, the ghee-pot, and the water jar.
Headed by the agnīdh, intending to perform the patnīsaṃyāja offerings, they go westward.
In front of the gārhapatya, the adhvaryu proceeds to the south, the other two to the north.

sanskrit_iast: agnervāmapannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmīti kastambhyāṃ srucau sādayitvā dhuri dhuryau pātamiti yugadhuroḥ prohati
meaning: अग्नेर्वामपन्नगृहस्य सदसि सादयामीति कस्तम्भ्यां स्रुचौ सादयित्वा धुरि धुर्यौ पातमिति युगधुरोः प्रोहति
text_mt: Having placed the two offering ladles on the prop with the words, 'I place you two in the seat of Agni whose house does not fall,' he pushes them forward onto the two yoke-pins with the words, 'Protect the two yoke-pins in the yoke.'

sanskrit_iast: yadi pātryā nirvaped etābhyām eva yajurbhyāṃ sphye srucau sādayet
meaning: यदि पात्र्या निर्वपेद् एताभ्याम् एव यजुर्भ्यां स्फ्ये स्रुचौ सादयेत्
text_mt: If he should pour out [the offerings] with a dish, he should place the two offering ladles on the wooden sword with these very two yajus-formulas.
They perform the patnīsaṃyāja offerings either with the two offering ladles or with two sruvas.

sanskrit_iast: vedamupabhṛtaṃ kṛtvā juhvā sruveṇa cety eke
meaning: वेदमुपभृतं कृत्वा जुह्वा स्रुवेण चेत्य् एके
text_mt: Some say: having made the veda-broom the upabhṛt, [they perform them] with the juhū and the sruva.

sanskrit_iast: apareṇa gārhapatyamūrdhvajñava āsīnā dhvānenopāṃśu vā patnīḥ saṃyājayanti
meaning: अपरेण गार्हपत्यमूर्ध्वज्ञव आसीना ध्वानेनोपांशु वा पत्नीः संयाजयन्ति
text_mt: Sitting behind the gārhapatya with their knees raised, they perform the patnīsaṃyāja offerings with a murmuring sound or in a whisper.
The adhvaryu is to the south, the agnīdh to the north, and the hotṛ in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: ājyena somatvaṣṭārāviṣṭvā jāghanyā patnīḥ saṃyājayantyājyasya vā yathāgṛhītena
meaning: आज्येन सोमत्वष्टाराविष्ट्वा जाघन्या पत्नीः संयाजयन्त्याज्यस्य वा यथागृहीतेन
text_mt: Having sacrificed to Soma and Tvaṣṭṛ with ghee, they perform the patnīsaṃyāja offerings with the tail [of the animal victim], or with ghee as it has been scooped.
The two ritual calls are: 'Recite for Soma,' and 'Sacrifice to Soma'; he makes the oblation in the northern half.
Likewise [he offers] to the other [deity], Tvaṣṭṛ;
to the wives of the gods, and to Agni Gṛhapati.

meaning: दक्षिणतस्त्वष्टारम् उत्तरतो वा मध्ये ऽग्निं गृहपतिम्
text_mt: [He offers] to Tvaṣṭṛ to the south, or to the north; to Agni Gṛhapati in the middle.
[He offers] to the wives of the gods while screened from the āhavanīya, or while unscreened.

sanskrit_iast: rākāṃ putrakāmo yajeta sinīvālīṃ paśukāmaḥ kuhūṃ puṣṭikāmaḥ
meaning: राकां पुत्रकामो यजेत सिनीवालीं पशुकामः कुहूं पुष्टिकामः
text_mt: One desiring a son should sacrifice to Rākā; one desiring cattle, to Sinīvālī; one desiring prosperity, to Kuhū.
Some teach [these offerings] as regular.
Some teach these [to be offered] before the wives of the gods;

sanskrit_iast: pūrvavaddhoturaṅguliparvaṇī aṅktvopaspṛṣṭodakāya hoturhaste catura ājyabindūniḍāmavadyati ṣaḍagnīdhaḥ
meaning: पूर्ववद्धोतुरङ्गुलिपर्वणी अङ्क्त्वोपस्पृष्टोदकाय होतुर्हस्ते चतुर आज्यबिन्दूनिडामवद्यति षडग्नीधः
text_mt: Having anointed the joints of the fingers of the hotṛ as before, he portions out the iḍā: four drops of ghee into the hand of the hotṛ who has touched water, and six into that of the agnīdh.
While it is being invoked, the adhvaryu, the agnīdh, and the wife take hold [of it].
When it has been invoked, the hotṛ and the agnīdh partake of it.

sanskrit_iast: atra sruveṇa saṃpatnīyaṃ juhoti patnyāmanvārabdhāyāṃ saṃ patnī patyā sukṛtena gacchatāṃ yajñasya yuktau dhuryāvabhūtām /
meaning: अत्र स्रुवेण संपत्नीयं जुहोति पत्न्यामन्वारब्धायां सं पत्नी पत्या सुकृतेन गच्छतां यज्ञस्य युक्तौ धुर्यावभूताम् /
text_mt: Then, while the wife holds on to him, he offers the saṃpatnī oblation with the sruva: 'May the wife go together with her husband by means of good deeds; yoked to the sacrifice, may they become bearers of the yoke;
harmonious, may they dispel foes; may they grasp unaging light in heaven, svāhā.'
Some teach this [oblation to be made] before the wives of the gods, or after [them];
or after the oblations of the dough-scrapings and chaff.
Having placed the wood-chips onto the southern fire, he offers the two oblations of dough-scrapings and chaff.
The oblation of chaff is first, or it is the reverse.

meaning: चतुर्गृहीत आज्ये फालीकरणानोप्याग्ने ऽदब्धायो ऽशीततनो इति जुहोति /
text_mt: Having thrown the chaff into four portions of ghee, he offers with the words, 'O Agni, of inviolable body, of unchilled body...'

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ piṣṭalepānulūkhale musale yacca śūrpa āśiśleṣa dṛṣadi yatkapāle /
meaning: एवं पिष्टलेपानुलूखले मुसले यच्च शूर्प आशिश्लेष दृषदि यत्कपाले /
text_mt: Likewise with the dough-scrapings: 'Whatever adhered to the mortar, to the pestle, and to the winnowing-basket, whatever to the lower grindstone, whatever to the potsherd,

sanskrit_iast: avapruṣo vipruṣaḥ saṃyajāmi viśve devā haviridaṃ juṣantām /
meaning: अवप्रुषो विप्रुषः संयजामि विश्वे देवा हविरिदं जुषन्ताम् /
text_mt: those scatterings, those drops I sacrifice; may all the gods relish this offering.

sanskrit_iast: yajñe yā vipruṣaḥ santi bahvīr agnau tāḥ sarvāḥ sviṣṭāḥ suhutā juhomi svāheti
meaning: यज्ञे या विप्रुषः सन्ति बह्वीर् अग्नौ ताः सर्वाः स्विष्टाः सुहुता जुहोमि स्वाहेति
text_mt: Whatever many drops there are in the sacrifice, all those, well-sacrificed, well-offered, I offer in the fire, svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: yā sarasvatī viśobhagīnā tasyai svāhā yā sarasvatī veśabhagīnā tasyai svāhendropānasyakehamanaso veśānkuru sumanasaḥ sajātānsvāheti dakṣiṇāgnau pratimantraṃ juhoti
meaning: या सरस्वती विशोभगीना तस्यै स्वाहा या सरस्वती वेशभगीना तस्यै स्वाहेन्द्रोपानस्यकेहमनसो वेशान्कुरु सुमनसः सजातान्स्वाहेति दक्षिणाग्नौ प्रतिमन्त्रं जुहोति
text_mt: With each mantra he offers in the southern fire: 'To Sarasvatī who brings prosperity to the people, svāhā; to Sarasvatī who brings prosperity to the dwelling, svāhā; O Indra, bringer of food(?), make the dwellings concordant here, of noble minds, born together, svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: vedo 'sīti vedaṃ hotā patnyā upasthe triḥ prāsyati
meaning: वेदो ऽसीति वेदं होता पत्न्या उपस्थे त्रिः प्रास्यति
text_mt: With the words, 'You are the veda,' the hotṛ tosses the veda-broom three times into the lap of the wife.
With the words, 'Cast out the hater, cast out the enemy,' the other casts it back each time it is tossed.

sanskrit_iast: tantuṃ tanvanniti vedaṃ hotā gārhapatyātprakramya saṃtatamāhavanīyātstṛṇātyā vā vedeḥ
meaning: तन्तुं तन्वन्निति वेदं होता गार्हपत्यात्प्रक्रम्य संततमाहवनीयात्स्तृणात्या वा वेदेः
text_mt: With the words, 'Weaving the thread,' the hotṛ, starting from the gārhapatya, strews the veda-broom continuously up to the āhavanīya, or up to the altar ground.
With the words, 'I untie this,' the wife unties the noose of the cord.
They bring a full cup [of water] into her joined hands which hold the cord.
While it is being brought, she mutters: 'Together with life, together with offspring...'

sanskrit_iast: ninīya mukhaṃ vimṛjyottiṣṭhati puṣṭimatī paśumatī prajāvatī gṛhamedhinī bhūyāsam iti
meaning: निनीय मुखं विमृज्योत्तिष्ठति पुष्टिमती पशुमती प्रजावती गृहमेधिनी भूयासम् इति
text_mt: Having poured it out and wiped her face, she stands up, [saying]: 'May I be full of nourishment, full of cattle, full of offspring, a good mistress of the house.'

sanskrit_iast: yathetamāhavanīyaṃ gatvā juhvā sruveṇa vā sarvaprāyaścattāni juhoti
meaning: यथेतमाहवनीयं गत्वा जुह्वा स्रुवेण वा सर्वप्रायश्चत्तानि जुहोति
text_mt: Having gone to the āhavanīya the way he came, he offers the all-expiatory oblations with the juhū or with the sruva.
This is [the verse]: 'The holy prayer is the support of the mind...'
'What was called for, what was called for too late, what was accompanied by vaṣaṭ and what was recited beyond in the sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast: atiriktaṃ karmaṇo yacca hīnaṃ yajñaḥ parvāṇi pratiranneti kalpayan /
meaning: अतिरिक्तं कर्मणो यच्च हीनं यज्ञः पर्वाणि प्रतिरन्नेति कल्पयन् /
text_mt: and whatever of the rite was excessive or deficient, may the sacrifice, prospering its joints, advance, arranging it;
may the oblation made with svāhā go to the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: yadvo devā atipādayāni vācā citprayataṃ devaheḍanam /
meaning: यद्वो देवा अतिपादयानि वाचा चित्प्रयतं देवहेडनम् /
text_mt: 'Whatever of yours, O gods, I might omit through speech, though intentional, an offense against the gods...'
The stingy one who acts malevolently toward us, / O Maruts, deposit him elsewhere than on us!

sanskrit_iast: tataṃ ma āpastadu tāyate punaḥ svādiṣṭhā dhītirucathāya śasyate /
meaning: ततं म आपस्तदु तायते पुनः स्वादिष्ठा धीतिरुचथाय शस्यते /
text_mt: My work is stretched out; it is stretched out again. / The sweetest thought is recited for the hymn.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ samudra uta viśvabheṣajaḥ svāhākṛtasya samu tṛpṇutarbhuvaḥ //
meaning: अयं समुद्र उत विश्वभेषजः स्वाहाकृतस्य समु तृप्णुतर्भुवः //
text_mt: This is the ocean and the universal medicine. / Enjoy fully the [offering] consecrated with svāhā, O Ṛbhus!

sanskrit_iast: udvayaṃ tamasasparyudu tyaṃ citramimaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne tvam agne ayāsyayāsanmanasā hitaḥ /
meaning: उद्वयं तमसस्पर्युदु त्यं चित्रमिमं मे वरुण तत्त्वा यामि त्वं नो अग्ने स त्वं नो अग्ने त्वम् अग्ने अयास्ययासन्मनसा हितः /
text_mt: [The mantras beginning with] 'Looking up from out of the darkness...', 'Up that [all-knowing god]...', 'The wonderful [face of the gods]...', 'Hear this of mine, O Varuṇa...', 'To thee I go...', 'Thou to us, O Agni...', 'So thou to us, O Agni...', 'Thou, O Agni, art Ayās, placed with tireless mind;
Tireless, thou hast carried the oblation; tireless, grant us medicine!'
'To the sacrificed, svāhā! vaṣaṭ! To the un-sacrificed, svāhā!
Medicine for ill-sacrificed, svāhā! For expiation, svāhā!
For overcoming failure, svāhā! To the divine bodies, svāhā!
To success, svāhā! To complete success, svāhā!'
'O Agni, thou art tireless and unassailable; truly thou art tireless.

sanskrit_iast: ayasā manasā dhṛto 'yasā havyamūhiṣe 'yā no dhehi bheṣajam //
meaning: अयसा मनसा धृतो ऽयसा हव्यमूहिषे ऽया नो धेहि भेषजम् //
text_mt: Held by an untiring mind, with untiringness thou hast carried the oblation; tireless, grant us medicine!'
'What in this sacrifice we have omitted, by formula or by ritual action,

sanskrit_iast: anayāhutyā tacchamayāmi sarvaṃ tṛpyantu devā āvṛṣantāṃ ghṛtena
meaning: अनयाहुत्या तच्छमयामि सर्वं तृप्यन्तु देवा आवृषन्तां घृतेन
text_mt: By this oblation I appease all that. May the gods be satisfied, may they rain down with ghee!'
'What has been known and what has not been known, what has been understood and what has not been understood—

sanskrit_iast: jātavedaḥ samdhehi tvaṃ hi vettha yathātatham //
meaning: जातवेदः सम्धेहि त्वं हि वेत्थ यथातथम् //
text_mt: O Jātavedas, put it together, for thou knowest it as it really is.'

sanskrit_iast: yadakarma yannākarma yadatyareci yannātyareci agniṣṭatsviṣṭakṛdvidvānsarvaṃ svīṣṭaṃ suhutaṃ karotu //
meaning: यदकर्म यन्नाकर्म यदत्यरेचि यन्नात्यरेचि अग्निष्टत्स्विष्टकृद्विद्वान्सर्वं स्वीष्टं सुहुतं करोतु //
text_mt: 'What we have done, what we have not done, what has been redundant, what has not been redundant—may Agni Sviṣṭakṛt, knowing, make all well-sacrificed and well-offered.'
'What in this action I have made redundant, or what here I have made deficient,
May Agni Sviṣṭakṛt, knowing, make all well-sacrificed and well-offered.'

sanskrit_iast: yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi /
meaning: यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि /
text_mt: 'Wherefrom we fear, O Indra, therefrom make us fearless.

sanskrit_iast: maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtaye vi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi //
meaning: मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि //
text_mt: O generous one, be able to help us; strike away the haters, strike away the assailants!'
'Giver of welfare, lord of the people, slayer of Vṛtra, subduer of assailants, ruler,

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ svastidā abhayaṃkaraḥ //
meaning: वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नः स्वस्तिदा अभयंकरः //
text_mt: May the bull Indra go before us, giver of welfare, maker of fearlessness.'
'Replenish by these praises whatever here is deficient for us, O lord of bay steeds, waxing great!

sanskrit_iast: yadā stotṛbhyo mahi gotrā rujāsi bhūyiṣṭhabhājo adha te syāma //
meaning: यदा स्तोतृभ्यो महि गोत्रा रुजासि भूयिष्ठभाजो अध ते स्याम //
text_mt: When thou breakest open the great cow-pens for the praisers, then may we have the largest shares!'
'What is done wrongly in the sacrifice, whether known or unknown,

sanskrit_iast: agne tadasya kalpaya tvaṃ hi vettha yathātatham //
meaning: अग्ने तदस्य कल्पय त्वं हि वेत्थ यथातथम् //
text_mt: O Agni, arrange that of it, for thou knowest it as it really is.'
'The sacrifice is commensurate with man, man is commensurate with the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: agne tadasya kalpaya tvaṃ hi vettha yathātatham //
meaning: अग्ने तदस्य कल्पय त्वं हि वेत्थ यथातथम् //
text_mt: O Agni, arrange that of it, for thou knowest it as it really is.'

sanskrit_iast: yatpākatrā manasā dīnadakṣā nayajñasya manvate martāsaḥ /
meaning: यत्पाकत्रा मनसा दीनदक्षा नयज्ञस्य मन्वते मर्तासः /
text_mt: 'Whatever of the sacrifice mortals of simple mind and feeble understanding do not think of,
That may Agni, the hotṛ, knowing the ritual procedure, most sacrifice-worthy, sacrifice to the gods in due season.'
'What the priests do, knowing or unknowing, being bewildered,

sanskrit_iast: agnirmā tasmādenasaḥ śraddhā devī ca muñcatām
meaning: अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसः श्रद्धा देवी च मुञ्चताम्
text_mt: From that sin may Agni and the goddess Śraddhā release me!'
'Agni Jātavedas has sacrificed, sitting down within, prior to us.

sanskrit_iast: sanvansaniṃ suvimucā vimuñca dhehyasmāsu draviṇaṃ jātavedo yacca bhadram //
meaning: सन्वन्सनिं सुविमुचा विमुञ्च धेह्यस्मासु द्रविणं जातवेदो यच्च भद्रम् //
text_mt: Winning, releasing the gain with a good release, place in us, O Jātavedas, wealth and whatever is auspicious!'

sanskrit_iast: ye te śataṃ varuṇa ye sahasraṃ yajñiyāḥ pāśā vitatāḥ purutrā /
meaning: ये ते शतं वरुण ये सहस्रं यज्ञियाः पाशा वितताः पुरुत्रा /
text_mt: 'Whatever hundred, whatever thousand sacrificial fetters of thine, O Varuṇa, are spread far and wide,

sanskrit_iast: tebhyo na indraḥ savitota viṣṇurviśve devā muñcantu marutaḥ svastyā //
meaning: तेभ्यो न इन्द्रः सवितोत विष्णुर्विश्वे देवा मुञ्चन्तु मरुतः स्वस्त्या //
text_mt: From them may Indra, Savitṛ, and Viṣṇu, all the gods and the Maruts release us with welfare!'

sanskrit_iast: yo bhūtānāmudbudhyasvāgna uduttamamiti vyāhṛtibhirvihṛtābhiḥ samastābhiśca hutvā
meaning: यो भूतानामुद्बुध्यस्वाग्न उदुत्तममिति व्याहृतिभिर्विहृताभिः समस्ताभिश्च हुत्वा
text_mt: Having offered with 'He who among beings...', 'Awake, O Agni...', and 'The highest...', [and] with the vyāhṛtis individually and collectively,

sanskrit_iast: pūrvavaddhruvāmāpyāyya devā gātuvida ity antarvedyūrdhvastiṣṭhandhruvayā samiṣṭayajurjuhoti
meaning: पूर्ववद्ध्रुवामाप्याय्य देवा गातुविद इत्य् अन्तर्वेद्यूर्ध्वस्तिष्ठन्ध्रुवया समिष्टयजुर्जुहोति
text_mt: Having replenished the dhruvā as before, standing upright inside the altar ground, he offers the samiṣṭayajus with the dhruvā with 'O gods, finding the path...'.
At the middle 'svāhā' he throws the sacrificial grass after it into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: yadi yajamānaḥ pravasetprajāpatervibhānnāma loka iti dhruvāyāṃ yajamānabhāgamavadhāya samiṣṭayajuṣā saha juhuyāt
meaning: यदि यजमानः प्रवसेत्प्रजापतेर्विभान्नाम लोक इति ध्रुवायां यजमानभागमवधाय समिष्टयजुषा सह जुहुयात्
text_mt: If the sacrificer is away from home, having placed the sacrificer's share in the dhruvā with 'The world named Shining of Prajāpati...', he should offer it together with the samiṣṭayajus.

sanskrit_iast: abhistṛṇīhi paridhehi vediṃ jāmiṃ mā hiṃsīramuyā śayānā /
meaning: अभिस्तृणीहि परिधेहि वेदिं जामिं मा हिंसीरमुया शयाना /
text_mt: 'Strew around, enclose the altar ground; do not harm the sister who lies over there!'

sanskrit_iast: hotṛṣadanā haritāḥ suvarṇā niṣkā ime yajamānasya bradhna iti hotṛṣadanairvedimabhistīrya ko vo 'yokṣītsa vo vimuñcatvityantarvedi praṇītā āsādya vimuñcati
meaning: होतृषदना हरिताः सुवर्णा निष्का इमे यजमानस्य ब्रध्न इति होतृषदनैर्वेदिमभिस्तीर्य को वो ऽयोक्षीत्स वो विमुञ्चत्वित्यन्तर्वेदि प्रणीता आसाद्य विमुञ्चति
text_mt: Having strewn around the altar ground with the hotṛ's seats with 'These hotṛ's seats, green, golden, [are] the coins of the sacrificer, O sun!', having set down the praṇītā water inside the altar ground with 'Who has yoked you? May he unyoke you', he unyokes it.
'The fire-poker which the gods maintained among men,
Those who are senseless against us, bring them here under our power!'
'O fire-poker, strengthen our offspring, nourishment, and wealth;

sanskrit_iast: dvipado naścatuṣpado dhruvānanapagānkurviti purastātpratyañcamutkara upaveṣaṃ sthavimata upagūhati
meaning: द्विपदो नश्चतुष्पदो ध्रुवाननपगान्कुर्विति पुरस्तात्प्रत्यञ्चमुत्कर उपवेषं स्थविमत उपगूहति
text_mt: Make our two-footed and four-footed [creatures] firm and non-departing!'—with these [words] he hides the fire-poker by its thick end into the rubbish heap from east to west.

sanskrit_iast: yady abhicaredyopaveṣe śuk sāmumṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣma ityathāsmai nāmagṛhya praharati
meaning: यद्य् अभिचरेद्योपवेषे शुक् सामुमृच्छतु यं द्विष्म इत्यथास्मै नामगृह्य प्रहरति
text_mt: If he performs sorcery, he throws it at him, mentioning his name: 'Whatever grief is in the fire-poker, let it reach that one whom we hate!'

sanskrit_iast: niramuṃ nuda okasaḥ sapatno yaḥ pṛtanyati /
meaning: निरमुं नुद ओकसः सपत्नो यः पृतन्यति /
text_mt: 'Expel that one from the abode, the rival who fights [us]!
By the repelling oblation Indra has cast him away!'

sanskrit_iast: iti tisraḥ parāvata ihi pañca janām̐ ati /
meaning: इति तिस्रः परावत इहि पञ्च जनाम्̐ अति /
text_mt: 'Go to the three distant lands, beyond the five peoples!'

meaning: इति तिस्रो ऽति रोचना यावत्सूर्यो असद्दिवि //
text_mt: 'Beyond the three luminous realms, as long as the sun shall be in the sky!'

sanskrit_iast: paramāṃ tvā parāvatamindro nayatu vṛtrahā yato na punarāyasi śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhya iti hato 'sāvavadhiṣmāmumityetābhiḥ pañcabhir nirasyennikhaned vā
meaning: परमां त्वा परावतमिन्द्रो नयतु वृत्रहा यतो न पुनरायसि शश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्य इति हतो ऽसाववधिष्मामुमित्येताभिः पञ्चभिर् निरस्येन्निखनेद् वा
text_mt: With these five [mantras]: 'To the furthest distance may Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, lead thee, whence thou shalt not return for endless years!', 'Slain is that one; we have killed that one', he should throw it away or bury it.
'Discharged, fly far away, arrow sharpened by sacred formula!
Go to the enemies, enter [them]; leave none of them behind!'—or [with this].

sanskrit_iast: yāni gharme kapālānīti catuṣpadayarcā kapālāni vimucya saṃkhyāyodvāsayati
meaning: यानि घर्मे कपालानीति चतुष्पदयर्चा कपालानि विमुच्य संख्यायोद्वासयति
text_mt: With the four-footed verse 'The potsherds which in the gharma...', he unyokes the potsherds, counts them, and removes them.
The New and Full Moon sacrifices are concluded.
Or he may conclude them at the āhavanīya ending with the śaṃyu, [and] at the gārhapatya ending with the clarified-butter-iḍā;
Or ending with the iḍā at the āhavanīya, [and] ending with the śaṃyu at the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: yadi śaṃyvantaṃ paścātsyādvedāttṛṇamapādāya juhvāmagramañjyātsruve madhyamupabhṛti vājyasthālyāṃ mūlam /
meaning: यदि शंय्वन्तं पश्चात्स्याद्वेदात्तृणमपादाय जुह्वामग्रमञ्ज्यात्स्रुवे मध्यमुपभृति वाज्यस्थाल्यां मूलम् /
text_mt: If the conclusion ending with the śaṃyu should take place at the rear [gārhapatya], having taken a blade of grass from the veda, he should smear the tip in the juhū, the middle in the sruva, and the base in the upabhṛt or in the pot of clarified butter.
The procedure for it is like that for the grass bunch, from the recitation of the blessings (sūktavāka) up to the Śaṃyu-formula.
One desirous of heaven [should sacrifice with] the New and Full Moon sacrifices.
He may desire [them] simultaneously or separately day by day.
He should sacrifice with the two for as long as he lives,

sanskrit_iast: dve paurṇamāsyau dve amāvāsye yajeta yaḥ kāmayetardhnuyāmityuktvāhaikāmeva yajeteti
meaning: द्वे पौर्णमास्यौ द्वे अमावास्ये यजेत यः कामयेतर्ध्नुयामित्युक्त्वाहैकामेव यजेतेति
text_mt: Having stated, 'One who desires "May I prosper" should sacrifice with two full-moon sacrifices and two new-moon sacrifices,' it is said, 'He should sacrifice with only one.'
Having concluded the Full Moon sacrifice, he subsequently offers a sacrificial cake on eleven potsherds to Indra Vaimṛdha.
Some teach it as having a common ritual framework.
Regarding it, there is free choice at the commencement.
From the commencement onward, however, it is restricted.
It has seventeen kindling verses; its sacrificial gift is according to faith.

sanskrit_iast: śardhavatyau saṃyājye agne śrdha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnānyuttamāni santu /
meaning: शर्धवत्यौ संयाज्ये अग्ने श्र्ध महते सौभगाय तव द्युम्नान्युत्तमानि सन्तु /
text_mt: The two concluding verses contain the word 'śardha': 'O Agni, be bold for great fortune; let thy splendors be supreme.
Make marital harmony well governed; overcome the powers of those who act as enemies.'

sanskrit_iast: vātopadhūta iṣiro vaśām̐ anu tṛṣu yadannā veviṣadvitiṣṭhase /
meaning: वातोपधूत इषिरो वशाम्̐ अनु तृषु यदन्ना वेविषद्वितिष्ठसे /
text_mt: 'Fanned by the wind, vigorous, along the dry brushwood, when eagerly consuming thy food thou spreadest out abroad,

sanskrit_iast: ā te yatante rathyī yathā pṛthāk śrdhāṃsyagne ajarāṇi dhakṣyasa iti
meaning: आ ते यतन्ते रथ्यी यथा पृथाक् श्र्धांस्यग्ने अजराणि धक्ष्यस इति
text_mt: Thine ageless boldly rushing hosts strive in different directions like charioteers, O Agni, when thou art about to burn.'

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ paurṇamāsyāmanunirvapatyādityaṃ ghṛte caruṃ sārasvataṃ carumamāvāsyāyāṃ pauṣṇaṃ caindramekādaśakapālamamāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca bhrātṛvyavato 'bhicarato vā
meaning: अग्नीषोमीयमेकादशकपालं पौर्णमास्यामनुनिर्वपत्यादित्यं घृते चरुं सारस्वतं चरुममावास्यायां पौष्णं चैन्द्रमेकादशकपालममावास्यायां पौर्णमास्यां च भ्रातृव्यवतो ऽभिचरतो वा
text_mt: For one having a rival or one practicing sorcery, he subsequently offers a sacrificial cake on eleven potsherds to Agni-Soma at the Full Moon, a caru cooked in ghee to Aditi, a caru to Sarasvatī, a caru to Pūṣan at the New Moon, and a sacrificial cake on eleven potsherds to Indra at both the New Moon and the Full Moon.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya trātre caruṃ dvitīyaṃ vaimṛdhasya kuryādyo mṛtyorjyānyā vā bibhīyāt /
meaning: इन्द्राय त्रात्रे चरुं द्वितीयं वैमृधस्य कुर्याद्यो मृत्योर्ज्यान्या वा बिभीयात् /
text_mt: One who fears death or loss of vitality should make a caru to Indra the Protector as the second offering of the Vaimṛdha [offering].
One desiring offspring, one desiring cattle, or one desiring kin should subsequently offer a sacrificial cake on eleven potsherds to Indra Indriyāvat.
Or he should make this [offering] as the subsequent offering,
he should subsequently offer to Indra Vaimṛdha.

sanskrit_iast: no neva ghoṣenneva śṛṇuyāt sa indrāyāṃhomuce
meaning: नो नेव घोषेन्नेव शृणुयात् स इन्द्रायांहोमुचे
text_mt: If he should hear a sound as if not hearing it, he [offers] to Indra Aṃhomuc.
He who has a rival [offers] to Indra Vṛtratur.
Now, he who is not distressed from any side [offers] to Indra alone.

sanskrit_iast: yo bhrātṛvyavānsyāt sa paurṇamāsaṃ saṃsthāpyaitāmiṣṭimanunirvapedāgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ sarasvatyai caruṃ sarasvate carum
meaning: यो भ्रातृव्यवान्स्यात् स पौर्णमासं संस्थाप्यैतामिष्टिमनुनिर्वपेदाग्नावैष्णवमेकादशकपालं सरस्वत्यै चरुं सरस्वते चरुम्
text_mt: One who has a rival, having concluded the Full Moon sacrifice, should subsequently offer this sacrifice: a sacrificial cake on eleven potsherds to Agni-Viṣṇu, a caru to Sarasvatī, and a caru to Sarasvat.
One who has a rival should sacrifice only at the full moon, not at the new moon.
He performs only the Pitṛyajña at the new moon.
'At each transition, he hurls the thunderbolt at his rival,' so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].
He passes over the new moon at least three times.

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomīyāni pradhānāni syuramāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca bhrātṛvyavato 'bhicarato vā
meaning: अग्नीषोमीयानि प्रधानानि स्युरमावास्यायां पौर्णमास्यां च भ्रातृव्यवतो ऽभिचरतो वा
text_mt: For one who has a rival or one who practices sorcery, the principal offerings at both the New Moon and the Full Moon should be to Agni-Soma.
'One desiring cattle should sacrifice with the Sākaṃprasthāyīya': thus the New Moon sacrifice is modified.
There are two evening milkings, and likewise two morning milkings.
In the evening they proceed with the two evening milkings; in the morning with the two morning milkings.
At the time of placing the vessels, he sets up four vessels made of udumbara wood.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracaryāgneyena ca puroḍāśenāgnīdhe srucau pradāya saha kumbhībhirabhikrāmannāhendrāyānubrūhyāśrāvayendraṃ yajeti saṃpraiṣau
meaning: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्याग्नेयेन च पुरोडाशेनाग्नीधे स्रुचौ प्रदाय सह कुम्भीभिरभिक्रामन्नाहेन्द्रायानुब्रूह्याश्रावयेन्द्रं यजेति संप्रैषौ
text_mt: Having proceeded with the two portions of clarified butter and with the sacrificial cake to Agni, having handed the two ladles to the agnīdh, stepping forward together with the pitchers, he gives the two ritual calls: 'Recite [the invitatory verse] for Indra,' and 'Make [the hotṛ] announce; sacrifice to Indra!'

sanskrit_iast: yāvatyaḥ kumbhyastāvanto brāhmaṇā dakṣiṇataupavītina upotthāya kumbhībhyaḥ pātrāṇi pūrayitvā tairadhvaryuṃ juhvatam anu juhvati
meaning: यावत्यः कुम्भ्यस्तावन्तो ब्राह्मणा दक्षिणतौपवीतिन उपोत्थाय कुम्भीभ्यः पात्राणि पूरयित्वा तैरध्वर्युं जुह्वतम् अनु जुह्वति
text_mt: As many brahmins as there are pitchers, having their sacred threads over the left shoulder, rising up from the south and having filled the vessels from the pitchers, make their offerings following along after the adhvaryu as he offers.
The Sviṣṭakṛt offering and the portions to be consumed do not exist.
The Sākaṃprasthāyīya is concluded.
One desirous of heaven [sacrifices] with the Dākṣāyaṇayajña.
He should sacrifice with two full-moon sacrifices and two new-moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālo 'gnīṣomīya ekādaśakapālaḥ pūrvasyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmāgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla aindraṃ dadhyuttarasyām /
meaning: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालो ऽग्नीषोमीय एकादशकपालः पूर्वस्यां पौर्णमास्यामाग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल ऐन्द्रं दध्युत्तरस्याम् /
text_mt:
At the first full-moon sacrifice there is a sacrificial cake on eight potsherds to Agni and one on eleven potsherds to Agni-Soma; at the second, a sacrificial cake on eight potsherds to Agni and curd to Indra.

At the first new-moon sacrifice there is a sacrificial cake on eight potsherds to Agni and one on eleven potsherds to Indrāgni; at the second, a sacrificial cake on eight potsherds to Agni and, as the second [offering], curdled milk to Mitra-Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla aindrāgna ekādaśakapālaḥ pūrvasyāmamāvāsyāyāmāgeyo 'ṣṭākapālo maitrāvaruṇyāmikṣā dvitīyottarasyām
meaning: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल ऐन्द्राग्न एकादशकपालः पूर्वस्याममावास्यायामागेयो ऽष्टाकपालो मैत्रावरुण्यामिक्षा द्वितीयोत्तरस्याम्

sanskrit_iast: so 'yaṃ darśapūrṇamāsāyoḥ prakrame vikalpo 'nena darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ vā yajeta
meaning: सो ऽयं दर्शपूर्णमासायोः प्रक्रमे विकल्पो ऽनेन दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्यां वा यजेत
text_mt: This is the option at the commencement of the New and Full Moon sacrifices: he may sacrifice with this, or with the New and Full Moon sacrifices.
Having sacrificed with it for fifteen years, he may cease or he may continue to sacrifice.
The Dākṣāyaṇayajña is concluded.
By this the Iḍādadha, the Sārvaseniya sacrifice, the Vasiṣṭha sacrifice, and the Śaunaka sacrifice are explained.
At the New and Full Moon sacrifices, the brahman priest should be the most learned in sacred lore.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vṛṇīte bhūpate bhuvanapate mahato bhūtasya pate brahmāṇaṃ tvā vṛṇīmaha iti
meaning: तं वृणीते भूपते भुवनपते महतो भूतस्य पते ब्रह्माणं त्वा वृणीमह इति
text_mt: He chooses him with: 'O Lord of the earth, Lord of the world, Lord of the great being, we choose thee as brahman priest.'

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ bhūpatirahaṃ bhuvanapatirahaṃ mahato bhūtasya patirdevena savitrā prasūta ārtvijyaṃ kariṣyāmi deva savitaretaṃ tvā vṛṇate bṛhaspatiṃ daivyaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tadahaṃ manase prabravīmi mano gāyatriyai gayatrī triṣṭubhe triṣṭubjagatyai jagatyanuṣṭubhe 'nuṣṭuppaṅktyai paṅktiḥ prajāpataye prajāpatirviśvebhyo viśve devā bṛhaspataye bṛhaspatirbrahmaṇe brahma bhūrbhuvaḥ suvar bṛhaspatirdevānāṃ brahmāhaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ brāhaspate yajñaṃ gopāyety uktvāpareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇātikramya nirastaḥ parāgvasuḥ saha pāpmaneti brahmasadanāttṛṇaṃ nirasyedamahamarvāgvaptoḥ sadane sīdāmi prasūto devena savitrā bṛhaspateḥ sadane sīdāmi tadagnaye prabravīmi tadvāyave tatsūryāya tatpṛthivyā ity upaviśati
meaning: अहं भूपतिरहं भुवनपतिरहं महतो भूतस्य पतिर्देवेन सवित्रा प्रसूत आर्त्विज्यं करिष्यामि देव सवितरेतं त्वा वृणते बृहस्पतिं दैव्यं ब्रह्माणं तदहं मनसे प्रब्रवीमि मनो गायत्रियै गयत्री त्रिष्टुभे त्रिष्टुब्जगत्यै जगत्यनुष्टुभे ऽनुष्टुप्पङ्क्त्यै पङ्क्तिः प्रजापतये प्रजापतिर्विश्वेभ्यो विश्वे देवा बृहस्पतये बृहस्पतिर्ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्म भूर्भुवः सुवर् बृहस्पतिर्देवानां ब्रह्माहं मनुष्याणां ब्राहस्पते यज्ञं गोपायेत्य् उक्त्वापरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य निरस्तः पराग्वसुः सह पाप्मनेति ब्रह्मसदनात्तृणं निरस्येदमहमर्वाग्वप्तोः सदने सीदामि प्रसूतो देवेन सवित्रा बृहस्पतेः सदने सीदामि तदग्नये प्रब्रवीमि तद्वायवे तत्सूर्याय तत्पृथिव्या इत्य् उपविशति
text_mt: 'I am the Lord of the earth, I am the Lord of the world, I am the Lord of the great being; impelled by the divine Savitṛ I will perform the priestly office. O divine Savitṛ, they choose this Bṛhaspati as divine brahman priest; that I proclaim to the Mind, the Mind to the Gāyatrī, the Gāyatrī to the Triṣṭubh, the Triṣṭubh to the Jagatī, the Jagatī to the Anuṣṭubh, the Anuṣṭubh to the Paṅkti, the Paṅkti to Prajāpati, Prajāpati to the All-Gods, the All-Gods to Bṛhaspati, Bṛhaspati to Brahman. Brahman! Bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, suvar! Bṛhaspati is the brahman priest of the gods, I of men. O Bṛhaspati, protect the sacrifice!' Having spoken thus, passing by to the south behind the āhavanīya fire, having cast away a grass blade from the seat of the brahman priest with 'Parāgvasu is cast away together with evil,' he sits down with 'Here do I sit in the seat of Arvāgvasu; impelled by the divine Savitṛ, I sit in the seat of Bṛhaspati; that I announce to Agni, that to Vāyu, that to Sūrya, that to the Earth.'
He remains seated, turned toward the āhavanīya fire.
At every ritual action he restrains his speech,
or at those ritual actions accompanied by mantras.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pramatto vyāharedvaiṣṇavīmṛcaṃ vyāhṛtīśca japitvā vācaṃ yacchet
meaning: यदि प्रमत्तो व्याहरेद्वैष्णवीमृचं व्याहृतीश्च जपित्वा वाचं यच्छेत्
text_mt: If through carelessness he should speak, he restrains his speech after muttering a verse to Viṣṇu and the vyāhṛtis.
When it is said: “O brahman, I shall bring forward the waters,”

sanskrit_iast: praṇaya yajñaṃ devatā vardhaya tvaṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhe yajamāno astu /
meaning: प्रणय यज्ञं देवता वर्धय त्वं नाकस्य पृष्ठे यजमानो अस्तु /
text_mt: he gives the impulse with: “Lead forward the sacrifice; increase the deities; may the sacrificer be on the back of the firmament;

sanskrit_iast: saptarṣīṇāṃ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokastatremaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca dhehyoṃ praṇayeti prasauti
meaning: सप्तर्षीणां सुकृतां यत्र लोकस्तत्रेमं यज्ञं यजमानं च धेह्यों प्रणयेति प्रसौति
text_mt: where the world of the Seven Seers of righteous deeds is, there place this sacrifice and the sacrificer. Om, lead forward!”

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣv āmantraṇeṣv evaṃ prasavas tena karmaṇā yasminn āmantrayate
meaning: सर्वेष्व् आमन्त्रणेष्व् एवं प्रसवस् तेन कर्मणा यस्मिन्न् आमन्त्रयते
text_mt: At all invitations, such is the impelling, [substituted] with the [specific] action concerning which he is invited.
“Sprinkle the sacrifice!” at the sprinkling of the oblation material and the firewood and sacrificial grass;

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspate parigṛhāṇa vediṃ svagā vo devāḥ sadanāni santu /
meaning: बृहस्पते परिगृहाण वेदिं स्वगा वो देवाः सदनानि सन्तु /
text_mt: “O Bṛhaspati, enclose the altar ground! May your seats be auspicious, O gods!

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṃ barhiḥ prathatāṃ sādhvantarahiṃsrā naḥ pṛthivī devyastv ity parigrāhe /
meaning: तस्यां बर्हिः प्रथतां साध्वन्तरहिंस्रा नः पृथिवी देव्यस्त्व् इत्य् परिग्राहे /
text_mt: Upon it may the sacrificial grass spread well; harmless to us may the divine earth be!” at the enclosing [of the altar ground];
“O Prajāpati, recite for the sacrifice!” to him who is about to recite the kindling verses;

sanskrit_iast: vācaspate vācamāśrāvayaitāmāśrāvaya yajñaṃ deveṣu mā manuṣyeṣv iti pravare
meaning: वाचस्पते वाचमाश्रावयैतामाश्रावय यज्ञं देवेषु मा मनुष्येष्व् इति प्रवरे
text_mt: “O Lord of Speech, make speech resound! Make this sacrifice resound among the gods, not among men!” at the selection [of the hotṛ];
he attaches “increase the deities” everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: mitrasya tvā cakṣuṣā prekṣa iti prāśitramavadīyamānaṃ prekṣate
meaning: मित्रस्य त्वा चक्षुषा प्रेक्ष इति प्राशित्रमवदीयमानं प्रेक्षते
text_mt: With “I look upon you with the eye of Mitra,” he looks at the prāśitra portion while it is being cut off;

sanskrit_iast: ṛtasya pathā paryehīti parihriyamāṇaṃ sūryasya tvā cakṣuṣā pratipaśyāmīty āhriyamāṇam
meaning: ऋतस्य पथा पर्येहीति परिह्रियमाणं सूर्यस्य त्वा चक्षुषा प्रतिपश्यामीत्य् आह्रियमाणम्
text_mt: with “Come around by the path of truth,” while it is being carried around; with “I gaze upon you with the eye of the sun,” while it is being brought near.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitreṇa pratigṛhya pṛthivyāstvā nābhau sādayāmīḍāyāḥ pada ityantarvedi vyūhya tṛṇāni prāgdaṇḍaṃ sādayitvādabdhena tvā cakṣuṣāvekṣa ity avekṣya sāvitreṇāṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayā cāṅgulyādāyāgnestvāsyena prāśnāmi brāhmaṇasyodareṇa bṛhaspaterbrahmaṇendrasya tvā jaṭhare sādayāmītyasaṃmletyāpigirati
meaning: सावित्रेण प्रतिगृह्य पृथिव्यास्त्वा नाभौ सादयामीडायाः पद इत्यन्तर्वेदि व्यूह्य तृणानि प्राग्दण्डं सादयित्वादब्धेन त्वा चक्षुषावेक्ष इत्य् अवेक्ष्य सावित्रेणाङ्गुष्ठेनोपमध्यमया चाङ्गुल्यादायाग्नेस्त्वास्येन प्राश्नामि ब्राह्मणस्योदरेण बृहस्पतेर्ब्रह्मणेन्द्रस्य त्वा जठरे सादयामीत्यसंम्लेत्यापिगिरति
text_mt: Having received it with the [mantra] to Savitṛ, having pushed aside the grasses inside the altar ground, having set it down with its handle pointing east with “I set you down on the navel of the earth, in the place of iḍā,” having looked at it with “I look at you with an unblinking eye,” having taken it with the thumb and the ring-finger with the [mantra] to Savitṛ, he swallows it without chewing, with “With the mouth of Agni I eat you, with the belly of a brāhmaṇa, with the brahman of Bṛhaspati; I set you down in the belly of Indra.”

sanskrit_iast: yā apsvantardevatāstā idaṃ śamayantu svāhākṛtaṃ jaṭharamindrasya gaccha svāhetyadbhirabhyavanīyācamya ghasīnā me mā saṃpṛkthā ūrdhvaṃ me nābheḥ sīdendrasya tvā jaṭhare sādyāmīti nābhideśamabhimṛśati
meaning: या अप्स्वन्तर्देवतास्ता इदं शमयन्तु स्वाहाकृतं जठरमिन्द्रस्य गच्छ स्वाहेत्यद्भिरभ्यवनीयाचम्य घसीना मे मा संपृक्था ऊर्ध्वं मे नाभेः सीदेन्द्रस्य त्वा जठरे साद्यामीति नाभिदेशमभिमृशति
text_mt: Having poured water over [his hands] with “May the deities who are within the waters calm this; go to the belly of Indra, made into a svāhā-offering, svāhā!”, having sipped water, he touches his navel region with “Do not touch my food-passages! Sit above my navel; I set you down in the belly of Indra.”
[He touches] his limbs according to the characteristic marks [in the mantra] with “Speech in my mouth…”;
the remaining ones with “uninjured, all…”.

sanskrit_iast: prakṣālya pātraṃ pūrayitvā diśo jinveti parācinaṃ ninayati
meaning: प्रक्षाल्य पात्रं पूरयित्वा दिशो जिन्वेति पराचिनं निनयति
text_mt: Having washed the vessel and filled it, he pours it away from himself with “Invigorate the quarters!”;

sanskrit_iast: yatrāsmai brahmabhāgamāharati taṃ pratigṛhya nāsaṃsthite bhakṣayati
meaning: यत्रास्मै ब्रह्मभागमाहरति तं प्रतिगृह्य नासंस्थिते भक्षयति
text_mt: When he brings the brahman's portion to him, having received it, he does not partake of it until [the ritual] is concluded.

sanskrit_iast: brahmanbrahmāsi brahmaṇe tvāhutādya mā mā hiṃsīrahuto mahyaṃ śivo bhavetyantarvedyanvāhāryamāsannamabhimṛśati
meaning: ब्रह्मन्ब्रह्मासि ब्रह्मणे त्वाहुताद्य मा मा हिंसीरहुतो मह्यं शिवो भवेत्यन्तर्वेद्यन्वाहार्यमासन्नमभिमृशति
text_mt: With “O brahman, you are Brahman; for Brahman to you, the consumer of the oblation; do not injure me! Free from injury, be propitious to me!” he touches the anvāhārya cooked rice set down inside the altar ground.

sanskrit_iast: brahmanprasthāsyāma ity ucyamāne deva savitaretatte prāha tatpra ca suva pra ca yaja bṛhaspatir brahmā sa yajñaṃ pāhi sa yajñapatiṃ pāhi sa māṃ pāhy oṃ pratiṣṭeti prasauti
meaning: ब्रह्मन्प्रस्थास्याम इत्य् उच्यमाने देव सवितरेतत्ते प्राह तत्प्र च सुव प्र च यज बृहस्पतिर् ब्रह्मा स यज्ञं पाहि स यज्ञपतिं पाहि स मां पाह्य् ओं प्रतिष्टेति प्रसौति
text_mt: When it is said: “O brahman, we shall set forth,” he gives the impulse with: “O divine Savitṛ, this he has proclaimed to you; impel it and sacrifice it! Bṛhaspati is the brahman; may he protect the sacrifice, may he protect the lord of the sacrifice, may he protect me! Om, stand firm!”
“Earth has gone to earth, the mother has gone to the mother.

sanskrit_iast: bhūyāsma putraiḥ paśubhir yo no dveṣṭi sa bhidyatām iti yatdiṃca yajñe mṛnmayaṃ bhidyeta tadabhimantrayeta
meaning: भूयास्म पुत्रैः पशुभिर् यो नो द्वेष्टि स भिद्यताम् इति यत्दिंच यज्ञे मृन्मयं भिद्येत तदभिमन्त्रयेत
text_mt: May we abound in sons and cattle! He who hates us, let him be broken!”—if whatever earthenware vessel should break in the sacrifice, he should consecrate it with this [mantra].

sanskrit_iast: brahmabhāgaṃ prāśyāyāḍagnirjātavedāḥ pra ṇo yakṣyabhivasyo asmān saṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyetyāhavanīyamupasthāya yathetaṃ pratiniṣkrāmati
meaning: ब्रह्मभागं प्राश्यायाडग्निर्जातवेदाः प्र णो यक्ष्यभिवस्यो अस्मान् सं नः सृज सुमत्या वाजवत्येत्याहवनीयमुपस्थाय यथेतं प्रतिनिष्क्रामति
text_mt: Having partaken of the brahman's portion, having worshipped the āhavanīya with “Agni Jātavedas has sacrificed; sacrifice for us, give us more wealth, unite us with benevolence rich in vigour!” he walks out the way he entered.
Thus the function of the brahman for the iṣṭis and animal sacrifices is prescribed—the function of the brahman.
We shall explain the duties of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānasya brahmacaryaṃ dakṣiṇādānaṃ dravyaprakalpanaṃ kāmānāṃ kāmanam
meaning: यजमानस्य ब्रह्मचर्यं दक्षिणादानं द्रव्यप्रकल्पनं कामानां कामनम्
text_mt: [The duties] of the sacrificer are: celibacy, giving the sacrificial gifts, arranging the materials, and wishing of desires.
He mutters the mantras that contain blessings for himself, attends upon [the fires] without ritual implements, and follows [the rites] with consecratory mutterings.
And on the new- or full-moon day he has his hair and beard shaved.
“He also has the body hair shaved in part,” so says the Vājasaneyaka.

sanskrit_iast: vidyudasi vidya me pāpmānamṛtātsatyamupaimīti yakṣyamāṇo 'pa upaspṛśati
meaning: विद्युदसि विद्य मे पाप्मानमृतात्सत्यमुपैमीति यक्ष्यमाणो ऽप उपस्पृशति
text_mt: About to sacrifice, he touches water with: “You are lightning; sever my sin! From untruth I approach truth.”
This touching [of water] takes place in all sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ gṛhṇāmi surathaṃ yo mayobhūrya udyantamārohati sūryamahne /
meaning: अग्निं गृह्णामि सुरथं यो मयोभूर्य उद्यन्तमारोहति सूर्यमह्ने /
text_mt: “I take Agni of good chariot, who is delightful, who climbs up to the rising sun for the day;

sanskrit_iast: ādityaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamaṃ śvoyajñāya ramatāṃ devatābhyaḥ //
meaning: आदित्यं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरुत्तमं श्वोयज्ञाय रमतां देवताभ्यः //
text_mt: may the Āditya, highest light of lights, stay for tomorrow's sacrifice for the deities!
The Vasus, Rudras, Ādityas, the deities along with Indra:

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi sva āyatane manīṣayā //
meaning: ताः पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि स्व आयतने मनीषया //
text_mt: them I, beforehand, lay hold of in their own abode with my thought.
Those gods who have entered into this fifteenth nourishment, them I, beforehand, lay hold of;

sanskrit_iast: agnirhavyavāḍiha tānāvahatu paurnamāsaṃ haviridameṣāṃ mayyāmāvāsyaṃ haviridameṣāṃ mayīti yathāliṅgamāhavanīye 'nvādhīyamāne japati
meaning: अग्निर्हव्यवाडिह तानावहतु पौर्नमासं हविरिदमेषां मय्यामावास्यं हविरिदमेषां मयीति यथालिङ्गमाहवनीये ऽन्वाधीयमाने जपति
text_mt: may Agni the bearer of oblations bring them here! May this full-moon oblation of theirs be in me! May this new-moon oblation of theirs be in me!”—according to the characteristic mark, he mutters while fuel is being added to the āhavanīya.
“Between the fires the cattle have come to the assembly of the gods;
them I, beforehand, lay hold of in their own abode with my thought,” he mutters standing between the fires.

sanskrit_iast: iha prajā viśvarūpā ramantām agniṃ gṛhapatimabhisaṃvasānāḥ /
meaning: इह प्रजा विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् अग्निं गृहपतिमभिसंवसानाः /
text_mt: “Here may manifold offspring delight, dwelling together facing Agni the lord of the house;

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi sva āyatane manīṣayā //
meaning: ताः पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि स्व आयतने मनीषया //
text_mt: them I, beforehand, lay hold of in their own abode with my thought.
Here may manifold cattle delight, dwelling together facing Agni the lord of the house;

sanskrit_iast: tānpūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi sva āyatane manīṣayeti gārhapatyam
meaning: तान्पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि स्व आयतने मनीषयेति गार्हपत्यम्
text_mt: them I, beforehand, lay hold of in their own abode with my thought,” [he mutters facing] the gārhapatya.
“This Agni of the fathers has conveyed the oblations to the fathers;

sanskrit_iast: taṃ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmyaviṣaṃ naḥ pituṃ karaditi dakṣiṇāgnim //
meaning: तं पूर्वः परिगृह्णाम्यविषं नः पितुं करदिति दक्षिणाग्निम् //
text_mt: him I, beforehand, lay hold of; may he make our nourishment free from poison,” [he mutters facing] the dakṣiṇāgni.
“May the guardians of the assembly kindle you incessantly as the share of victory;

sanskrit_iast: agne dīdāya me sabhya vijityai śaradaḥ śatamiti sabhyam //
meaning: अग्ने दीदाय मे सभ्य विजित्यै शरदः शतमिति सभ्यम् //
text_mt: O Agni, shine for my assembly, for victory for a hundred autumns,” [he mutters facing] the sabhya fire.
“May I bring food fit for the dwelling for a hundred autumns;

sanskrit_iast: āvasathe śriyaṃ mantramahirbudhniyo niyacchatv ity āvasathyam
meaning: आवसथे श्रियं मन्त्रमहिर्बुध्नियो नियच्छत्व् इत्य् आवसथ्यम्
text_mt: in the dwelling may Ahirbudhnya bestow fortune and sacred counsel,” [he mutters facing] the āvasathya fire.
“Here I proclaim the sacrifice to the Vasus, whose eldest is Agni;
here I proclaim the sacrifice to the Rudras, whose eldest is Indra;

sanskrit_iast: idamahaṃ varuṇajyeṣṭhebhya ādityebhyo yajñaṃ prabravīmītyanvāhiteṣu japati
meaning: इदमहं वरुणज्येष्ठेभ्य आदित्येभ्यो यज्ञं प्रब्रवीमीत्यन्वाहितेषु जपति
text_mt: here I proclaim the sacrifice to the Ādityas, whose eldest is Varuṇa,” he mutters when the fires have had fuel added to them.

sanskrit_iast: pasavatīroṣadhaya iti purā barhiṣa āhartorjāyāpatī aśnītaḥ /
meaning: पसवतीरोषधय इति पुरा बर्हिष आहर्तोर्जायापती अश्नीतः /
text_mt: With “May the plants be rich in cattle,” the husband and wife eat before the sacrificial grass is brought;
before the separation of the calves on the new-moon day.
About to observe the fast for the Full Moon sacrifice, they do not become overly sated.
They should eat food free of beans and meat with clarified butter, or in its absence, with curd or milk.
At the Full Moon [sacrifice], he enters upon the vow [when the adhvaryu sets out to cut] the sacrificial grass
or at the New Moon, when the calves have been driven away.

sanskrit_iast: praṇītāsu praṇīyamānāsvāsanneṣu vā haviḥṣu vratamupaitītyubhayatra sādhāraṇam
meaning: प्रणीतासु प्रणीयमानास्वासन्नेषु वा हविःषु व्रतमुपैतीत्युभयत्र साधारणम्
text_mt: Or, common to both [occasions], he enters upon the vow while the praṇītā waters are being brought forward, or when the oblations have been placed [near the fires].
Some [say that the order is]: eating, adding fuel to the fires, entering upon the vow;
some [say]: entering upon the vow, eating, adding fuel to the fires;
some [say]: adding fuel to the fires, entering upon the vow, eating.
With [the mantra]: 'May the plants be full of milk,' he sips or touches water.
He crosses behind the āhavanīya towards the south.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa evāta ūrdhvaṃ yajamānasya saṃcaro bhavati
meaning: एष एवात ऊर्ध्वं यजमानस्य संचरो भवति
text_mt: From this point on, this alone is the sacrificer's path of movement.
Standing south of the āhavanīya, about to enter upon the vow, he meditates upon the ocean with his mind.

sanskrit_iast: atha japaty agne vratapate vrataṃ cariṣyāmīti brāhmaṇaḥ /
meaning: अथ जपत्य् अग्ने व्रतपते व्रतं चरिष्यामीति ब्राह्मणः /
text_mt: Then a brāhmaṇa mutters: 'O Agni, lord of vows, I will observe the vow.'

sanskrit_iast: vāyo vratapata āditya vratapate vratānāṃ vratapate vrataṃ cariṣyāmīti rājanyavaiśyau
meaning: वायो व्रतपत आदित्य व्रतपते व्रतानां व्रतपते व्रतं चरिष्यामीति राजन्यवैश्यौ
text_mt: A rājanya and a vaiśya [mutter]: 'O Vāyu, lord of vows! O Āditya, lord of vows! O lord of the vows of vows, I will observe the vow!'

sanskrit_iast: athādityamupatiṣṭhate samrāḍ asi vratapā asi vratapatir asi tatte prabravīmi tacchakeyaṃ tena śakeyaṃ tena rādhyāsam iti
meaning: अथादित्यमुपतिष्ठते सम्राड् असि व्रतपा असि व्रतपतिर् असि तत्ते प्रब्रवीमि तच्छकेयं तेन शकेयं तेन राध्यासम् इति
text_mt: Then he pays reverence to the sun [with the mantra]: 'You are sovereign, you are the guardian of vows, you are the lord of vows; I proclaim that to you; may I be able to do that; with that may I succeed; with that may I prosper.'
If he should enter upon the vow after sunset, paying reverence to the āhavanīya, he should mutter this yajus-formula:
'They strew grass around both fires; may the deities dwell near me.

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ grāmyānupavasāmi mahyaṃ gopataye paśuniti sāyaṃ paristīryamāṇeṣu japati
meaning: अहं ग्राम्यानुपवसामि मह्यं गोपतये पशुनिति सायं परिस्तीर्यमाणेषु जपति
text_mt: I dwell near the domestic animals; [dwell near] the animals for me, the lord of cattle,' he mutters while [the fires] are being surrounded with grass in the evening.
At the evening meal, he eats wild food, free of beans and meat;

sanskrit_iast: api vā kāmamā mārgādā madhuna ā prāśātikāt
meaning: अपि वा काममा मार्गादा मधुन आ प्राशातिकात्
text_mt: or indeed as he pleases, up to venison, up to honey, up to millet;
He should not eat in the evening of that with which he is to sacrifice in the morning.
About to fast for wild food, he drinks water or does not.
Yawning, he should say: 'May skill and insight be in me.'
On the night of the New Moon, he remains awake.

sanskrit_iast: api vā supyādupari tveva na śayīta
meaning: अपि वा सुप्यादुपरि त्वेव न शयीत
text_mt: Or he may sleep, but he should not sleep on a raised bed.

sanskrit_iast: api vopari śayīta brahmacārī tveva syāt
meaning: अपि वोपरि शयीत ब्रह्मचारी त्वेव स्यात्
text_mt: Or he may even sleep on a raised bed, but he must remain celibate.
Some teach staying awake on both [nights].
He sleeps in the shed of the āhavanīya or in the shed of the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: devā deveṣu parākramdhvaṃ prathamā dvitīyeṣu dvitīyāstṛtīyeṣu trirekādaśā iha māvata idaṃ śakeyaṃ yadidaṃ karomy ātmā karotvātmane /
meaning: देवा देवेषु पराक्रम्ध्वं प्रथमा द्वितीयेषु द्वितीयास्तृतीयेषु त्रिरेकादशा इह मावत इदं शकेयं यदिदं करोम्य् आत्मा करोत्वात्मने /
text_mt: 'O gods, display your prowess among the gods, the first among the second, the second among the third; thirty-three [gods], protect me here; may I be able to do this which I do; let the self act for itself.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ kariṣye bheṣajam idaṃ me viśvabheṣajā aśvinā prāvataṃ yuvam iti japitvā śvobhūte brahmāṇaṃ vṛṇīte
meaning: इदं करिष्ये भेषजम् इदं मे विश्वभेषजा अश्विना प्रावतं युवम् इति जपित्वा श्वोभूते ब्रह्माणं वृणीते
text_mt: I will make this healing; O Aśvins, possessing all healings, protect this of mine'—having muttered this, when the morrow comes, he chooses the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: bhūpate bhuvanapate mahato bhūtasya pate brahmāṇaṃ tvā vṛṇīmaha ity uktvāpareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇātikramyopaviśati
meaning: भूपते भुवनपते महतो भूतस्य पते ब्रह्माणं त्वा वृणीमह इत्य् उक्त्वापरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणातिक्रम्योपविशति
text_mt: Having said: 'O lord of the earth, lord of the world, lord of the great being, we choose you as brahman,' and having crossed behind the āhavanīya towards the south, he sits down.
The brahman is in front, the sacrificer behind.

sanskrit_iast: bhūśca kaśca vāk cark ca gauśca vaṭ ca khaṃ ca dhūṃśca nūṃśca pūṃścaikākṣarāḥ pūṃrdaśamā virājo yā idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vyānaśustā no devīstarasā saṃvidānāḥ svasti yajñaṃ nayata prajānatīrbrahmāpūtā stha /
meaning: भूश्च कश्च वाक् चर्क् च गौश्च वट् च खं च धूंश्च नूंश्च पूंश्चैकाक्षराः पूंर्दशमा विराजो या इदं विश्वं भुवनं व्यानशुस्ता नो देवीस्तरसा संविदानाः स्वस्ति यज्ञं नयत प्रजानतीर्ब्रह्मापूता स्थ /
text_mt: 'Earth, and Who, and Speech, and Verse, and Cow, and Vaṭ, and Sky, and Smoke, and Now, and City—the ten single-syllabled Virājes who have pervaded this entire world—may those goddesses, in harmony, swiftly carry the sacrifice to well-being, knowing it. You are purified by the brahman. /'

sanskrit_iast: ko vo yunakti sa vo yunaktu viśvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo devayajyāyai /
meaning: को वो युनक्ति स वो युनक्तु विश्वेभ्यः कामेभ्यो देवयज्यायै /
text_mt: 'Who yokes you? May he yoke you for all desires, for the worship of the gods.'
'Those [waters] which flow in front, above, and on all sides— /'

sanskrit_iast: tābhī raśmipavitrābhiḥ śraddhāṃ yajñamārabha iti praṇītāḥ praṇīyamānā anumantrayate //
meaning: ताभी रश्मिपवित्राभिः श्रद्धां यज्ञमारभ इति प्रणीताः प्रणीयमाना अनुमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: 'with those, which have rays as strainers, I undertake faith and the sacrifice'—[with these words] he follows with a mantra the praṇītā waters while they are being brought forward.

sanskrit_iast: yajamāna havirnirvapsyāmītyucyamāna oṃ nirvapety uccair anujānāti
meaning: यजमान हविर्निर्वप्स्यामीत्युच्यमान ओं निर्वपेत्य् उच्चैर् अनुजानाति
text_mt: Being addressed: 'O sacrificer, I shall apportion the oblation,' he consents aloud: 'Om, apportion!'

sanskrit_iast: agnīm hotāramiha taṃ huva iti havirnirupyamāṇam abhimantrayate
meaning: अग्नीम् होतारमिह तं हुव इति हविर्निरुप्यमाणम् अभिमन्त्रयते
text_mt: With [the mantra]: 'Here I invoke Agni, the hotṛ,' he addresses the oblation being apportioned.
Or he touches the vessel for apportioning the oblation, or he addresses it with a mantra.
Having spoken that, he restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: kastvā yunakti sa tvā yunaktv iti sarvaṃ vihāramanuvīkṣate
meaning: कस्त्वा युनक्ति स त्वा युनक्त्व् इति सर्वं विहारमनुवीक्षते
text_mt: With [the mantra]: 'Who yokes you? May he yoke you,' he surveys the whole sacrificial ground.

sanskrit_iast: catuḥśikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśā ghṛtapratīkā bhuvanasya madhye /
meaning: चतुःशिखण्डा युवतिः सुपेशा घृतप्रतीका भुवनस्य मध्ये /
text_mt: 'A young woman with four braids, well-adorned, facing with clarified butter in the middle of the world, /'

sanskrit_iast: marmṛjyamānā mahate saubhagāya mahyaṃ dhukṣva yajamānāya kāmāniti vediṃ saṃmṛjyamānām
meaning: मर्मृज्यमाना महते सौभगाय मह्यं धुक्ष्व यजमानाय कामानिति वेदिं संमृज्यमानाम्
text_mt: 'being cleansed for great good fortune, yield desires to me, the sacrificer'—[with this he follows] the altar ground while it is being swept.

sanskrit_iast: yo mā hṛdā manasā yaśca vācā yo brahmaṇā karmaṇā dveṣṭi devāḥ /
meaning: यो मा हृदा मनसा यश्च वाचा यो ब्रह्मणा कर्मणा द्वेष्टि देवाः /
text_mt: 'Whoever hates me in heart and mind, and whoever in speech, whoever with sacred lore and deed, O gods, /'

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ śrutena hṛdayeneṣṇatā ca tasyendra vajreṇa śiraśchinadmīti stambayajurhriyamāṇam
meaning: यः श्रुतेन हृदयेनेष्णता च तस्येन्द्र वज्रेण शिरश्छिनद्मीति स्तम्बयजुर्ह्रियमाणम्
text_mt: 'whoever with learning, heart, and malice—his head do I cut off with Indra's thunderbolt'—[with this he follows] the grass-bundle yajus while it is being carried away.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ tasmai harmyaṃ karomi yo vo devāścarati brahmacaryam /
meaning: इदं तस्मै हर्म्यं करोमि यो वो देवाश्चरति ब्रह्मचर्यम् /
text_mt: 'I make this mansion for him who among you, O gods, practices celibacy, /'

sanskrit_iast: medhāvī dikṣu manasā tapasvyantardūtaścarati mānuṣīṣv ity utkaram abhigṛhyamāṇam
meaning: मेधावी दिक्षु मनसा तपस्व्यन्तर्दूतश्चरति मानुषीष्व् इत्य् उत्करम् अभिगृह्यमाणम्
text_mt: 'wise in the quarters of space with his mind, performing austerity, walking as a messenger within the human [folk]'—[with this he follows] the rubbish heap while [earth] is being taken onto it.

sanskrit_iast: yajñasya tvā pramayābhimayā pratimayonmayā parigṛhṇāmīti vediṃ parigṛhyamāṇām
meaning: यज्ञस्य त्वा प्रमयाभिमया प्रतिमयोन्मया परिगृह्णामीति वेदिं परिगृह्यमाणाम्
text_mt: With [the formula]: 'By the measure of the sacrifice, by its counter-measure, by its matching measure, by its uplifted measure do I enclose you,' [he addresses] the altar ground while it is being enclosed [by lines].
'What we have injured in digging up the earth, the plants, and the waters, /'

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryavaḥ sphyakṛtaḥ sphyenāntarikṣaṃ moru pātu tasmāt //
meaning: अध्वर्यवः स्फ्यकृतः स्फ्येनान्तरिक्षं मोरु पातु तस्मात् //
text_mt: 'the adhvaryus who make use of the wooden sword, may the wide midspace protect me from that with the wooden sword.'

sanskrit_iast: yadudghnanto jihiṃsima krūramasyā vediṃ cakṛmā manasā devayantaḥ /
meaning: यदुद्घ्नन्तो जिहिंसिम क्रूरमस्या वेदिं चकृमा मनसा देवयन्तः /
text_mt: 'What we have injured in digging up, what cruel harm we have done to her altar ground, seeking the gods in our mind, /'

sanskrit_iast: mā tena heḍa upagāma bhūmyāḥ śivo no viśvairbhuvanebhirastvityuddhanyamānām //
meaning: मा तेन हेड उपगाम भूम्याः शिवो नो विश्वैर्भुवनेभिरस्त्वित्युद्धन्यमानाम् //
text_mt: 'may we not incur the wrath of the earth on account of that; may she be auspicious to us along with all worlds'—[with these verses he follows the altar ground] while it is being dug up.

sanskrit_iast: bhūmirbhūtvā mahimānaṃ pupoṣa tato devī vardhayate payāṃsi /
meaning: भूमिर्भूत्वा महिमानं पुपोष ततो देवी वर्धयते पयांसि /
text_mt: 'Having become the earth, she nourished majesty; then the goddess increases the streams of milk; /'

sanskrit_iast: yajñiyā yajñaṃ vicayanti śaṃ cauṣadhīrāpa iha śkvarīśceti kriyamāṇām //
meaning: यज्ञिया यज्ञं विचयन्ति शं चौषधीराप इह श्क्वरीश्चेति क्रियमाणाम् //
text_mt: 'the sacrificial [waters] prepare the sacrifice, and may the plants and the able waters be beneficial here'—[with this he follows the altar ground] while it is being constructed.
'I, with mind intent on praise, call upon the divine waters, /'
'flowing by day and night, rich in holy work'—[with this he follows] the sprinkling waters while they are being set down.

sanskrit_iast: ūrṇāmṛdu prathamānaṃ syonaṃ devebhyo juṣṭaṃ sadanāya barhiḥ /
meaning: ऊर्णामृदु प्रथमानं स्योनं देवेभ्यो जुष्टं सदनाय बर्हिः /
text_mt: 'Soft as wool, spreading wide, pleasant, dear to the gods as a seat is the sacrificial grass /'

sanskrit_iast: suvarge loke yajamānaṃ hi dhehi māṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhe parame vyomanniti barhirāsādyamānam
meaning: सुवर्गे लोके यजमानं हि धेहि मां नाकस्य पृष्ठे परमे व्योमन्निति बर्हिरासाद्यमानम्
text_mt: "Place the sacrificer in the heavenly world; me on the back of the firmament in the highest heaven"—[with these words he touches] the barhis being set down;
"Purify the clarified butter with the waters, the waters with the clarified butter, completely with the strainers of Savitṛ;

sanskrit_iast: tā devīḥ śakvarīḥ śākvareṇemaṃ yajñamavata saṃvidānā ityājyaṃ prokṣaṇīścotpūyamānāḥ
meaning: ता देवीः शक्वरीः शाक्वरेणेमं यज्ञमवत संविदाना इत्याज्यं प्रोक्षणीश्चोत्पूयमानाः
text_mt: do you divine Śakvarī waters, agreeing together, protect this sacrifice with what is mighty"—[with these words he touches] the clarified butter and the sprinkling waters being purified;
both murmur [the formula for] the ladlings of clarified butter;
"We have laid down the barhis within the earth, causing the cut plants to grow up again;

sanskrit_iast: yāsāṃ mūlamudavadhīḥ sphyena śivā nastāḥ suhavā bhavantu //
meaning: यासां मूलमुदवधीः स्फ्येन शिवा नस्ताः सुहवा भवन्तु //
text_mt: whose roots you struck away with the wooden sword, may they be propitious and easy to invoke for us;

sanskrit_iast: sumanaso yajamānāya santv oṣadhīrāpa iha śakvarīśca /
meaning: सुमनसो यजमानाय सन्त्व् ओषधीराप इह शक्वरीश्च /
text_mt: may the plants and the Śakvarī waters here be well-disposed to the sacrificer;

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭidyāvā parjanya enā virohayatu hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śatavalśā adabdhā ityantarvedi barhirāsannam
meaning: वृष्टिद्यावा पर्जन्य एना विरोहयतु हिरण्यवर्णाः शतवल्शा अदब्धा इत्यन्तर्वेदि बर्हिरासन्नम्
text_mt: may Parjanya with rainy sky make these grow up, golden-colored, hundred-branched, uninjured"—[with these words he touches] the barhis set down inside the altar ground;

sanskrit_iast: catuḥśikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśā ghṛtapratīkā vayunāni vaste /
meaning: चतुःशिखण्डा युवतिः सुपेशा घृतप्रतीका वयुनानि वस्ते /
text_mt: "Having four locks of hair, youthful, well-formed, butter-faced, she clothes herself in designs;

sanskrit_iast: sā stīryamāṇā mahate saubhagāya sā me dhukṣa yajamānāya kāmān //
meaning: सा स्तीर्यमाणा महते सौभगाय सा मे धुक्ष यजमानाय कामान् //
text_mt: being strewn for great good fortune, may she yield wishes to me, the sacrificer;

sanskrit_iast: śivā ca me śagmā caidhi syonā ca me suṣadā caidhyūrjasvatī ca me payasvatī caidhi /
meaning: शिवा च मे शग्मा चैधि स्योना च मे सुषदा चैध्यूर्जस्वती च मे पयस्वती चैधि /
text_mt: be propitious and beneficial to me, be pleasant and comfortable to sit on for me, and be rich in strength and milk for me;

sanskrit_iast: iṣamūrjaṃ me pinvasva brahma tejo me pinvasva kṣatramojo me pinvasva viśaṃ puṣṭiṃ me pinvasvāyurannādyaṃ me pinvasva prajāṃ paśūnme pinvasveti stīryamāṇām
meaning: इषमूर्जं मे पिन्वस्व ब्रह्म तेजो मे पिन्वस्व क्षत्रमोजो मे पिन्वस्व विशं पुष्टिं मे पिन्वस्वायुरन्नाद्यं मे पिन्वस्व प्रजां पशून्मे पिन्वस्वेति स्तीर्यमाणाम्
text_mt: swell nourishment and strength for me, swell sacred knowledge and fiery energy for me, swell royal power and vigor for me, swell the clan and prosperity for me, swell lifespan and food for me, swell offspring and cattle for me"—[with these words he touches the altar ground] being strewn;
with "You are firm" and the verses that follow, verse by verse, [he addresses] the enclosing sticks being laid round;

sanskrit_iast: asminyajña upa bhūya innu me 'vikṣobhāya paridhīndadhāmi /
meaning: अस्मिन्यज्ञ उप भूय इन्नु मे ऽविक्षोभाय परिधीन्दधामि /
text_mt: "In this sacrifice, for further [benefit] to me, I now lay down the enclosing sticks for stability;

sanskrit_iast: dhratā dharuṇo dharīyānagnirdveṣāṃsi nirito nu dātā iti ca
meaning: ध्रता धरुणो धरीयानग्निर्द्वेषांसि निरितो नु दाता इति च
text_mt: Agni, the sustainer, holder, best supporter, will now drive away hatreds from here"; and
"I yoke you with divine prayer"—[with this he touches] the āhavanīya;

sanskrit_iast: tejiṣṭhā te tapanā yā ca rocanā pratyoṣantīstanvo yāste agne /
meaning: तेजिष्ठा ते तपना या च रोचना प्रत्योषन्तीस्तन्वो यास्ते अग्ने /
text_mt: "Those sharpest burning and shining bodies of yours, O Agni, that burn against [enemies];

sanskrit_iast: tābhirvarmāṇyabhito vyayasva mā tvā dabhanyajñahanaḥ piśācā iti ca
meaning: ताभिर्वर्माण्यभितो व्ययस्व मा त्वा दभन्यज्ञहनः पिशाचा इति च
text_mt: with them gird armors all around; let not the Piśācas, the destroyers of sacrifice, harm you"; and
"With the two dividers I cut off rivals, rivals born and those yet to be born;

meaning: विशो यन्त्राभ्यां विधमाम्येनानहं स्वानामुत्तमो ऽसानि देवाः //
text_mt: with the two restrainers of the clan I blow them away; O gods, may I be the highest of my own people;

sanskrit_iast: viśo yantre nudamāne arātiṃ viśvaṃ pāpmānamamatiṃ durmarāyum /
meaning: विशो यन्त्रे नुदमाने अरातिं विश्वं पाप्मानममतिं दुर्मरायुम् /
text_mt: the two restrainers of the clan pushing away the enemy, all evil, distress, and the malicious enemy;

sanskrit_iast: sīdantī devī sukṛtasya loke dhṛtī stho vidhṛtī svadhṛtī svadhṛtī prāṇānmayi dhārayataṃ prajāṃ mayi dhārayataṃ paśūnmayi dhārayatam iti vidhṛtī āsādyamāne
meaning: सीदन्ती देवी सुकृतस्य लोके धृती स्थो विधृती स्वधृती स्वधृती प्राणान्मयि धारयतं प्रजां मयि धारयतं पशून्मयि धारयतम् इति विधृती आसाद्यमाने
text_mt: sitting, divine, in the world of good deeds, you are supports, dividers, self-supporters, self-supporters; maintain the vital breaths in me, maintain offspring in me, maintain cattle in me"—[with these words] the two dividers being set down;

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ prastara ubhayasya dhartā dartā prayājānāmutānūyājānām /
meaning: अयं प्रस्तर उभयस्य धर्ता दर्ता प्रयाजानामुतानूयाजानाम् /
text_mt: "This grass bunch is the upholder of both, the upholder of the fore-sacrifices and of the after-sacrifices;

sanskrit_iast: sa dādhāra samidho viśvarūpāstasminsruco adhyāsādayāmīti prastaramāsādyamānam
meaning: स दाधार समिधो विश्वरूपास्तस्मिन्स्रुचो अध्यासादयामीति प्रस्तरमासाद्यमानम्
text_mt: it supports kindling-sticks of all forms; upon it I place the offering ladles"—[with these words he addresses] the grass bunch being set down;

sanskrit_iast: āroha patho juhu devayānānyatrarṣayaḥ prathamajā ye purāṇāḥ /
meaning: आरोह पथो जुहु देवयानान्यत्रर्षयः प्रथमजा ये पुराणाः /
text_mt: "Mount the paths leading to the gods, O juhū, where are the first-born, ancient seers;

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyapakṣājirā saṃbhṛtāṅgā vahāsi mā sukṛtāṃ yatra lokāḥ //
meaning: हिरण्यपक्षाजिरा संभृताङ्गा वहासि मा सुकृतां यत्र लोकाः //
text_mt: golden-winged, quick, with collected limbs, you shall bear me to where the worlds of the righteous are;
you are the juhū, turned to butter, whose path is the gāyatrī, enjoyed by the wise;

sanskrit_iast: avyathamānā yajñamanuyacchasva sunītī yajñaṃ nayāsyupa devānāgneyena śarmaṇā daivyeneti juhūm //
meaning: अव्यथमाना यज्ञमनुयच्छस्व सुनीती यज्ञं नयास्युप देवानाग्नेयेन शर्मणा दैव्येनेति जुहूम् //
text_mt: unfaltering, keep hold of the sacrifice; with good guidance lead the sacrifice to the gods, with divine, Āgneya shelter"—[with these verses he touches] the juhū;

sanskrit_iast: avāhaṃ bādha upabhṛtā sapatnāñjātānbhrātṛvyānye ca janiṣyamāṇāḥ /
meaning: अवाहं बाध उपभृता सपत्नाञ्जातान्भ्रातृव्यान्ये च जनिष्यमाणाः /
text_mt: "Downwards with the upabhṛt I push rivals, rivals born and those yet to be born;

sanskrit_iast: dohai yajñaṃ sudughāmiva dhenumahamuttaro bhūyāsamadhare matsapatnāḥ //
meaning: दोहै यज्ञं सुदुघामिव धेनुमहमुत्तरो भूयासमधरे मत्सपत्नाः //
text_mt: I milk the sacrifice like a cow that milks well; may I become superior, my rivals inferior;
you are well-held, the upabhṛt, turned to butter, having the triṣṭubh meter, all-knowing;

sanskrit_iast: avyathamānā yajñamanuyacchasva sunītī yajñaṃ nayāsyupa devānaindreṇa śarmaṇā daivyenetyupabhṛtam //
meaning: अव्यथमाना यज्ञमनुयच्छस्व सुनीती यज्ञं नयास्युप देवानैन्द्रेण शर्मणा दैव्येनेत्युपभृतम् //
text_mt: unfaltering, keep hold of the sacrifice; with good guidance lead the sacrifice to the gods, with divine, Aindra shelter"—[with these verses he touches] the upabhṛt;
"He who, malicious in mind, speech, and heart, acts as an enemy against me, works against me, O Agni;

sanskrit_iast: idamasya cittamadharaṃ dhruvāyā ahamuttaro bhūyāsamadhare matsapatnāḥ //
meaning: इदमस्य चित्तमधरं ध्रुवाया अहमुत्तरो भूयासमधरे मत्सपत्नाः //
text_mt: downward beneath the dhruvā is this mind of his; may I become superior, my rivals inferior;

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāsi dharaṇī dhanasya pūrṇā jāgatena chandasā viśvavedāḥ /
meaning: ध्रुवासि धरणी धनस्य पूर्णा जागतेन छन्दसा विश्ववेदाः /
text_mt: you are the dhruvā, the sustainer, full of wealth, having the jagatī meter, all-knowing;

sanskrit_iast: avyathamānā yajñamanuyacchasva sunītī yajñaṃ nayāsyupa devānvaiśvadevena śarmaṇā daivyeneti dhruvām //
meaning: अव्यथमाना यज्ञमनुयच्छस्व सुनीती यज्ञं नयास्युप देवान्वैश्वदेवेन शर्मणा दैव्येनेति ध्रुवाम् //
text_mt: unfaltering, keep hold of the sacrifice; with good guidance lead the sacrifice to the gods, with divine, Vaiśvadeva shelter"—[with these verses he touches] the dhruvā;

sanskrit_iast: syono me sīda suṣadaḥ pṛthivyāṃ prathayi prajayā paśubhiḥ suvarge loke /
meaning: स्योनो मे सीद सुषदः पृथिव्यां प्रथयि प्रजया पशुभिः सुवर्गे लोके /
text_mt: "Sit pleasantly for me, easy to sit upon on the earth; expand with offspring and cattle in the heavenly world;
