meaning: दिवि सीद पृथिव्यामन्तरिक्षे ऽहमुत्तरो भूयासमधरे मत्सपत्नाः //
text_mt: sit in heaven, on earth, in the atmosphere; may I become superior, my rivals inferior;
this sruva ladle brings offerings forward, having a hundred syllables with the anuṣṭubh meter;

sanskrit_iast: sarvā yajñasya samanakti viṣṭhā bārhaspatyena śarmaṇā daivyeneti sruvam //
meaning: सर्वा यज्ञस्य समनक्ति विष्ठा बार्हस्पत्येन शर्मणा दैव्येनेति स्रुवम् //
text_mt: it anoints all the forms of the sacrifice, with divine, Bārhaspatya shelter"—[with these verses he touches] the sruva;

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ sthālī ghṛtasya pūrṇācchinnapayāḥ śatadhāra utsaḥ /
meaning: इयं स्थाली घृतस्य पूर्णाच्छिन्नपयाः शतधार उत्सः /
text_mt: "This pot is full of butter, with unbroken milk, a hundred-streamed well;
with divine, Māruta shelter"—[with these words he touches] the butter-pot;

sanskrit_iast: tṛptirasi gāyatraṃ chandastarpaya mā tejasā brahmavarcasena tṛptirasi traiṣṭubhaṃ chandastarpaya maujasā vīryeṇa tṛptirasi jāgataṃ chandastarpaya mā prajayā paśubhiriti puroḍāśānajyamānān
meaning: तृप्तिरसि गायत्रं छन्दस्तर्पय मा तेजसा ब्रह्मवर्चसेन तृप्तिरसि त्रैष्टुभं छन्दस्तर्पय मौजसा वीर्येण तृप्तिरसि जागतं छन्दस्तर्पय मा प्रजया पशुभिरिति पुरोडाशानज्यमानान्
text_mt: "You are satisfaction, the gāyatrī meter, satisfy me with fiery energy and sacred luster; you are satisfaction, the triṣṭubh meter, satisfy me with vigor and heroism; you are satisfaction, the jagatī meter, satisfy me with offspring and cattle"—[with these words he touches] the sacrificial cakes being anointed;

sanskrit_iast: yajño 'si sarvataḥ śritaḥ sarvato māṃ bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacchrayatāṃ śataṃ me santvāśiṣaḥ sahasraṃ me santu sūnṛtā irāvatīḥ paśumatīḥ prajāpatirasi sarvataḥ śritaḥ sarvato māṃ bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacchrayatāṃ śataṃ me santvāśiṣaḥ sahasraṃ me santu sūnṛtā irāvatīḥ paśumatīr ity āgneyaṃ puroḍāśamāsannamabhimṛśati sarvāṇi vā havīṃṣi
meaning: यज्ञो ऽसि सर्वतः श्रितः सर्वतो मां भूतं भविष्यच्छ्रयतां शतं मे सन्त्वाशिषः सहस्रं मे सन्तु सूनृता इरावतीः पशुमतीः प्रजापतिरसि सर्वतः श्रितः सर्वतो मां भूतं भविष्यच्छ्रयतां शतं मे सन्त्वाशिषः सहस्रं मे सन्तु सूनृता इरावतीः पशुमतीर् इत्य् आग्नेयं पुरोडाशमासन्नमभिमृशति सर्वाणि वा हवींषि
text_mt: "You are the sacrifice supported on all sides; may the past and future support me on all sides; may a hundred blessings be mine; may a thousand true words, full of refreshing drink and rich in cattle, be mine; you are Prajāpati supported on all sides; may the past and future support me on all sides; may a hundred blessings be mine; may a thousand true words, full of refreshing drink and rich in cattle, be mine"—with this he touches the sacrificial cake for Agni that has been set down, or all the oblations;
"This is power of the senses, immortal vigor, with which the cattle observed Indra;

sanskrit_iast: tena devā avatopa māmiheṣamūrjaṃ yaśaḥ saha ojaḥ saneyaṃ śṛtaṃ mayi śrayatām iti prātardoham /
meaning: तेन देवा अवतोप मामिहेषमूर्जं यशः सह ओजः सनेयं शृतं मयि श्रयताम् इति प्रातर्दोहम् /
text_mt: with that, O gods, protect me here; may I gain nourishment, strength, glory, power, vigor; may what is boiled rest in me"—[with these words he touches] the morning milking;
"What moved upon the earth, entering into it, with which Prajāpati poured strength into Indra;

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ tacchukraṃ madhu vājinīvadyenopariṣṭādadhinonmahendraṃ dadhi māṃ dhinotv iti dadhi
meaning: इदं तच्छुक्रं मधु वाजिनीवद्येनोपरिष्टादधिनोन्महेन्द्रं दधि मां धिनोत्व् इति दधि
text_mt: this is that bright, sweet [substance] rich in steeds, with which he gladdened Mahendra from above; may the curd gladden me"—[with these words he touches] the curd;

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ yajñaḥ samasadaddhviṣmānṛcā ṣamnā yajuṣā devatābhiḥ /
meaning: अयं यज्ञः समसदद्ध्विष्मानृचा षम्ना यजुषा देवताभिः /
text_mt: "This sacrifice has assembled, possessing oblations, with ṛc, sāman, yajus, and deities;

sanskrit_iast: tena lokānsūryavato jayemendrasya sakhyamamṛtatvamaśyāmiti sarvāṇi havīṃṣi
meaning: तेन लोकान्सूर्यवतो जयेमेन्द्रस्य सख्यममृतत्वमश्यामिति सर्वाणि हवींषि
text_mt: by it may we win sun-lit worlds; may I attain companionship with Indra and immortality"—[with these words he touches] all the oblations;

sanskrit_iast: yo naḥ kanīya iha kāmayātā asminyajñe yajamānāya mahyam /
meaning: यो नः कनीय इह कामयाता अस्मिन्यज्ञे यजमानाय मह्यम् /
text_mt: "Whoever here wishes [anything] lesser for us, for me the sacrificer in this sacrifice;

sanskrit_iast: apa tamindrāgnī bhuvanānnudetāmahaṃ prajāṃ vīravatīṃ videyetyaindrāgnam
meaning: अप तमिन्द्राग्नी भुवनान्नुदेतामहं प्रजां वीरवतीं विदेयेत्यैन्द्राग्नम्
text_mt: may Indrāgnī push him away from this world; may I obtain offspring possessing heroes"—[with these words he touches the cake] dedicated to Indrāgnī;

sanskrit_iast: mamāgne varco vihaveṣv astv ity anuvākena sarvāṇi havīṃṣy āsannāny abhimṛśed aṣṭābhir vā
meaning: ममाग्ने वर्चो विहवेष्व् अस्त्व् इत्य् अनुवाकेन सर्वाणि हवींष्य् आसन्नान्य् अभिमृशेद् अष्टाभिर् वा
text_mt: He should touch all the oblations that have been set down with the section "May my luster in the invocations be, O Agni...", or with eight [verses];

sanskrit_iast: caturhotrā paurṇamāsyāṃ havīṃṣyāsannānyabhimṛśet prajākāmaḥ pañcahotrāmāvāsyāyāṃ svargakāmo nityavad eke samāmananti
meaning: चतुर्होत्रा पौर्णमास्यां हवींष्यासन्नान्यभिमृशेत् प्रजाकामः पञ्चहोत्रामावास्यायां स्वर्गकामो नित्यवद् एके समामनन्ति
text_mt: One desiring offspring should touch the oblations that have been set down on the full-moon day with the caturhotṛ formula, and on the new-moon day one desiring heaven with the pañcahotṛ formula; some hand down [this practice] as obligatory;
He should utter the daśahotṛ formula before the kindling verses;

sanskrit_iast: aṅgiraso māsya yajñasya prātaranuvākairavantviti sāmidhenīnāṃ pratipadi japati
meaning: अङ्गिरसो मास्य यज्ञस्य प्रातरनुवाकैरवन्त्विति सामिधेनीनां प्रतिपदि जपति
text_mt: "May the Aṅgirases protect me in this sacrifice with the morning recitations"—[with this] he murmurs at the introductory verse of the kindling verses;

sanskrit_iast: anūcyamānāsu daśahotāraṃ vyākhyāyocchuṣmo agna iti samidhyamānam /
meaning: अनूच्यमानासु दशहोतारं व्याख्यायोच्छुष्मो अग्न इति समिध्यमानम् /
text_mt: While they are being recited, having recited the daśahotṛ formula, with "Your fury, O Agni..." [he addresses the fire] being kindled;
"Kindled, offered to, greeted with svāhā, may Agni bring us across;

sanskrit_iast: svagā devebhya idaṃ nama iti samiddham
meaning: स्वगा देवेभ्य इदं नम इति समिद्धम्
text_mt: easy going to the gods, this homage"—[with these words he addresses the fire] when kindled;
"You are the mind, related to Prajāpati"—[with this he touches] the ladle-libation being poured.
Touching the ladle from behind, he recites the consecratory formula: 'You are speech, belonging to Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: devāḥ pitaraḥ pitaro devā yo 'ham asmi sa sanyaje yasyāsmi na tamantaremi svaṃ ma iṣṭaṃ svaṃ dattaṃ svaṃ pūrtaṃ svaṃ śrāntaṃ svaṃ hutam /
meaning: देवाः पितरः पितरो देवा यो ऽहम् अस्मि स सन्यजे यस्यास्मि न तमन्तरेमि स्वं म इष्टं स्वं दत्तं स्वं पूर्तं स्वं श्रान्तं स्वं हुतम् /
text_mt: 'Gods, ancestors; ancestors, gods! Whosoever I am, being that one I sacrifice. Whose I am, him I do not bypass. Mine is what has been sacrificed, mine what has been given, mine what has been dedicated to public welfare, mine the hardship endured, mine the offering made.'

sanskrit_iast: tasya me 'gnirupadraṣṭā vāyurupaśrotādityo 'nukhyātā dyauḥ pitā pṛthivī mātā prajāpatir bandhur ya evāsmi sa sanyaja iti hotṛpravare 'dhvaryupravare ca pravriyamāṇe
meaning: तस्य मे ऽग्निरुपद्रष्टा वायुरुपश्रोतादित्यो ऽनुख्याता द्यौः पिता पृथिवी माता प्रजापतिर् बन्धुर् य एवास्मि स सन्यज इति होतृप्रवरे ऽध्वर्युप्रवरे च प्रव्रियमाणे
text_mt: 'Of that [sacrifice] of mine, Agni is the overseer, Vāyu the listener, Āditya the announcer, heaven the father, earth the mother, Prajāpati the kinsman. Whosoever I am, being that one I sacrifice.' [He recites this] while the pravara of the hotṛ and the pravara of the adhvaryu are being recited.

sanskrit_iast: caturhotāraṃ vyākhyāya vasantamṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmīty etaiḥ pratimantraṃ prayājān hutaṃhutam
meaning: चतुर्होतारं व्याख्याय वसन्तमृतूनां प्रीणामीत्य् एतैः प्रतिमन्त्रं प्रयाजान् हुतंहुतम्
text_mt: Having explained the Caturhotṛ formula, with these mantras: 'I gladden spring of the seasons...', [he recites] separately for each formula over each of the fore-offerings after it is offered.

sanskrit_iast: eko mamaikā tasya yo 'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmo dvau mama dve tasya trayo mama tisrastasya catvāro mama catasrastasya pañca mama na tasya kiṃcana yo 'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma ity etaiśca pratimantram
meaning: एको ममैका तस्य यो ऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मो द्वौ मम द्वे तस्य त्रयो मम तिस्रस्तस्य चत्वारो मम चतस्रस्तस्य पञ्च मम न तस्य किंचन यो ऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्म इत्य् एतैश्च प्रतिमन्त्रम्
text_mt: And with each of these mantras separately: 'One is mine, one is his who hates us and whom we hate; two are mine, two are his; three are mine, three are his; four are mine, four are his; five are mine, nothing is his who hates us and whom we hate.'
'Through the sacrifice to the gods Agni and Soma may I become possessed of sight,' [he recites over] the two butter-portions.
'Through Agni the sacrifice is possessed of sight; through the sacrifice to Agni may I become possessed of sight.'

sanskrit_iast: somena yajñaścakṣuṣmām̐ somasyāhaṃ devayajyayā cakṣuṣmānbhūyāsamiti vihṛtau
meaning: सोमेन यज्ञश्चक्षुष्माम्̐ सोमस्याहं देवयज्यया चक्षुष्मान्भूयासमिति विहृतौ
text_mt: 'Through Soma the sacrifice is possessed of sight; through the sacrifice to Soma may I become possessed of sight.' Thus when split.
He should recite the Pañcahotṛ formula before cutting portions of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: agner ahaṃ devayajyayānnādo bhūyāsam ity āgneyaṃ hutam anumantrayate dabdhir asīty upāṃśuyājam agnīṣomayor ity agnīṣomīyam indrāgniyor ity aindrāgnam indrasyety aindraṃ sāmnāyyaṃ mahendrasyeti māhendramagneḥ sviṣṭakṛta iti sauviṣṭakṛtam
meaning: अग्नेर् अहं देवयज्ययान्नादो भूयासम् इत्य् आग्नेयं हुतम् अनुमन्त्रयते दब्धिर् असीत्य् उपांशुयाजम् अग्नीषोमयोर् इत्य् अग्नीषोमीयम् इन्द्राग्नियोर् इत्य् ऐन्द्राग्नम् इन्द्रस्येत्य् ऐन्द्रं साम्नाय्यं महेन्द्रस्येति माहेन्द्रमग्नेः स्विष्टकृत इति सौविष्टकृतम्
text_mt: With 'Through the sacrifice to Agni may I become an eater of food', he recites over the offering to Agni after it is offered; with 'You are harmless', over the silent sacrifice; with 'Of Agni and Soma...', over the one to Agni and Soma; with 'Of Indra and Agni...', over the one to Indra and Agni; with 'Of Indra...', over the Indra-sāmnāyya; with 'Of Mahendra...', over the Mahendra-sāmnāyya; with 'Of Agni Sviṣṭakṛt...', over the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.
Some teach [the offerings] to other deities before the Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya vaimṛdhasyāhaṃ devayajyayāsapatno vīryavānbhūyāsam indrasya trāturahaṃ devayajyayā trāto bhūyāsaṃ dyāvāpṛthivyor ahaṃ devayajyayobhayor lokayor ṛdhyāsaṃ /
meaning: इन्द्रस्य वैमृधस्याहं देवयज्ययासपत्नो वीर्यवान्भूयासम् इन्द्रस्य त्रातुरहं देवयज्यया त्रातो भूयासं द्यावापृथिव्योर् अहं देवयज्ययोभयोर् लोकयोर् ऋध्यासं /
text_mt: 'Through the sacrifice to Indra Vaimṛdha may I become free of rivals and full of vigor; through the sacrifice to Indra the Protector may I become protected; through the sacrifice to Heaven and Earth may I prosper in both worlds;'
'May I attain abundance and a firm foundation,' according to some.

sanskrit_iast: pūṣṇo 'haṃ devayajyayā prajaniṣīya prajayā paśubhiḥ sarasvatyā ahaṃ devayajyayā vācamannādyaṃ puṣeyaṃ viśveṣāṃ devānāmahaṃ devayajyayā prāṇaiḥ sāyujyaṃ gameyamaryamṇo 'haṃ devayajyayā svargaṃ lokaṃ gameyamadityā ahaṃ devayajyayā pra prajayā ca paśubhiś ca janiṣīyendrasyendriyāvato 'haṃ devayajyayendriyāvayannādo bhūyāsamiti yathāliṅgaṃ vaikṛtīḥ
meaning: पूष्णो ऽहं देवयज्यया प्रजनिषीय प्रजया पशुभिः सरस्वत्या अहं देवयज्यया वाचमन्नाद्यं पुषेयं विश्वेषां देवानामहं देवयज्यया प्राणैः सायुज्यं गमेयमर्यम्णो ऽहं देवयज्यया स्वर्गं लोकं गमेयमदित्या अहं देवयज्यया प्र प्रजया च पशुभिश् च जनिषीयेन्द्रस्येन्द्रियावतो ऽहं देवयज्ययेन्द्रियावयन्नादो भूयासमिति यथालिङ्गं वैकृतीः
text_mt: 'Through the sacrifice to Pūṣan may I be propagated with offspring and livestock; through the sacrifice to Sarasvatī may I foster speech and food consumption; through the sacrifice to the Viśve Devas may I attain union with the vital breaths; through the sacrifice to Aryaman may I go to the heavenly world; through the sacrifice to Aditi may I bring forth offspring and livestock; through the sacrifice to Indra possessing indriya may I be endowed with indriya and an eater of food'—thus over the modified offerings according to the characteristic mark.

sanskrit_iast: agnir mā duriṣṭāt pātv iti prāśitramavadīyamānam
meaning: अग्निर् मा दुरिष्टात् पात्व् इति प्राशित्रमवदीयमानम्
text_mt: With 'May Agni protect me from an ill-performed sacrifice', [he recites over] the prāśitra portion while it is being cut off.
With 'You of beautiful form and of the color of rain, come!', [he recites over] the iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: bhūyasyehi śreyasyehi vasīyasyehi citta ehi dadhiṣa ehīḍa ehi sūnṛta ehītīḍāyā upāṃśūpahave sapta devagavīrjapati /
meaning: भूयस्येहि श्रेयस्येहि वसीयस्येहि चित्त एहि दधिष एहीड एहि सूनृत एहीतीडाया उपांशूपहवे सप्त देवगवीर्जपति /
text_mt: With 'O more abundant one, come; O better one, come; O wealthier one, come; O thought, come; O supporter, come; O iḍā, come; O gracious speech, come!', he murmurs during the silent invitation of the iḍā to the seven divine cows.

sanskrit_iast: cidasi manāsi dhīrasi rantī ramatiḥ sūnuḥ sūnarītyuccairupahave sapta manuṣyagavīḥ /
meaning: चिदसि मनासि धीरसि रन्ती रमतिः सूनुः सूनरीत्युच्चैरुपहवे सप्त मनुष्यगवीः /
text_mt: With 'You are thought, you are mind, you are meditation, rejoicing, delight, daughter, gracious', [he murmurs] during the loud invitation to the seven human cows.

sanskrit_iast: devīrdevairabhi mā nivartadhvaṃ syonāḥ syonena ghṛtena mā samukṣata nama idamudaṃ bhiṣagṛṣirbrahmā yaddade samudrādudacanniva srucā vāgagre viprasya tiṣṭhati śṛṅgebhirdaśabhirdiśanniti ca
meaning: देवीर्देवैरभि मा निवर्तध्वं स्योनाः स्योनेन घृतेन मा समुक्षत नम इदमुदं भिषगृषिर्ब्रह्मा यद्ददे समुद्रादुदचन्निव स्रुचा वागग्रे विप्रस्य तिष्ठति शृङ्गेभिर्दशभिर्दिशन्निति च
text_mt: And [he recites]: 'Divine ones, turn toward me together with the gods; gentle ones, sprinkle me with gentle clarified butter; this obeisance, this water... which the healer, the sage, the brahman took as if ladling from the ocean with a ladle, speech stands at the tip of the inspired poet, showing with ten horns.'

sanskrit_iast: upahūyamānāyaṃ vāyaviḍā te māteti hotāramīkṣamāṇo vāyuṃ manasā dhyāyet
meaning: उपहूयमानायं वायविडा ते मातेति होतारमीक्षमाणो वायुं मनसा ध्यायेत्
text_mt: While [the iḍā] is being invoked, looking at the hotṛ, he should mentally meditate on Vāyu with: 'O Vāyu, iḍā is your mother.'
At the benedictions: 'May that benediction of mine be true.'

sanskrit_iast: iḍāyā ahaṃ devayajyayā paśumānbhūyāsam ity upahūtām //
meaning: इडाया अहं देवयज्यया पशुमान्भूयासम् इत्य् उपहूताम् //
text_mt: Over [the iḍā] when invoked: 'Through the sacrifice of the iḍā may I become rich in cattle.'

sanskrit_iast: iḍā dhenuḥ sahavatsā na āgādūrjaṃ duhānā payasā prapīnā /
meaning: इडा धेनुः सहवत्सा न आगादूर्जं दुहाना पयसा प्रपीना /
text_mt: 'The iḍā, a milch-cow accompanied by her calf, has come to us, yielding nourishment, swelling with milk.

sanskrit_iast: sā no annene haviṣota gobhir iḍābhyas mām̐ āgād iti bhakṣāyāhriyamāṇām
meaning: सा नो अन्नेने हविषोत गोभिर् इडाभ्यस् माम्̐ आगाद् इति भक्षायाह्रियमाणाम्
text_mt: May she come to us with food, with oblation, and with cows; the iḍā has come to us,' [he recites over the iḍā] while it is being brought forward for consumption.
The consumption of the iḍā and the cleansing have already been explained.

sanskrit_iast: bradhna pinvasva dadato me mā kṣāyi kurvato me mopadasaddiśāṃ kḷpirasi diśo me kalpantāṃ kalpantāṃ me diśo daivīśca mānuṣīścāhorātre me kalpetāmardhamāsā me kalpantāṃ māsā me kalpantāmṛtavo me kalpantāṃ saṃvatsaro me kalpatāṃ kḷptir asi kalpatāṃ ma iti barhiṣi puroḍāśamāsannamabhimṛśati
meaning: ब्रध्न पिन्वस्व ददतो मे मा क्षायि कुर्वतो मे मोपदसद्दिशां कॢपिरसि दिशो मे कल्पन्तां कल्पन्तां मे दिशो दैवीश्च मानुषीश्चाहोरात्रे मे कल्पेतामर्धमासा मे कल्पन्तां मासा मे कल्पन्तामृतवो मे कल्पन्तां संवत्सरो मे कल्पतां कॢप्तिर् असि कल्पतां म इति बर्हिषि पुरोडाशमासन्नमभिमृशति
text_mt: With 'O sun, swell; may [wealth] not fail me as I give; may it not diminish for me as I act; you are the arrangement of the directions; may the directions be arranged for me; may the divine and human directions be arranged for me; may the day and night be arranged for me; may the fortnights be arranged for me; may the months be arranged for me; may the seasons be arranged for me; may the year be arranged for me; you are the arrangement, let it be arranged for me', he touches the sacrificial cake placed on the sacrificial grass.
Then he pushes it out toward the directions with: 'To you, [belonging] to the regions, to the four immortal guardians of the regions;
let us honor these overseers of what has come into being with the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: brahmapā hi bhajatāṃ bhāgi bhāgaṃ mābhāgo bhakta nirabhāgaṃ bhajāmaḥ /
meaning: ब्रह्मपा हि भजतां भागि भागं माभागो भक्त निरभागं भजामः /
text_mt: Indeed let the protector of sacred knowledge take a share; let the sharer [receive] the portion; let him who is without a portion not share; we exclude the unportioned.
Swell the waters, enliven the plants, protect the two-footed, favor the four-footed, send rain down from heaven!
This oblation belongs to the brāhmaṇas who are worthy of soma and drink soma.
The non-brāhmaṇa is excluded; there is nothing here for a non-brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: upahūto dyauḥ pitopa māṃ dyauḥ pitā hvayatām agnirāgnīdhrādāyuṣe varcase jivātvai puṇyāyopahūtā pṛthivī mātopa māṃ mātā pṛthivī hvayatāmagnirāgnīdhrādāyuṣe varcase jīvātvai puṇyāyetyāgnīdhrabhāgasya vaiśeṣikam
meaning: उपहूतो द्यौः पितोप मां द्यौः पिता ह्वयताम् अग्निराग्नीध्रादायुषे वर्चसे जिवात्वै पुण्यायोपहूता पृथिवी मातोप मां माता पृथिवी ह्वयतामग्निराग्नीध्रादायुषे वर्चसे जीवात्वै पुण्यायेत्याग्नीध्रभागस्य वैशेषिकम्
text_mt: 'Invoked is Father Heaven; may Father Heaven call me; may Agni from the Āgnīdhra [hearth] [give] life, splendor, livelihood, merit. Invoked is Mother Earth; may Mother Earth call me; may Agni from the Āgnīdhra [hearth] [give] life, splendor, livelihood, merit'—this is specific to the portion of the agnīdh.
With 'O sun, swell...', he touches the anvāhārya cooked rice placed inside the altar ground.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ sthālyamṛtasya pūrṇā sahasradhāra utso akṣīyamāṇaḥ /
meaning: इयं स्थाल्यमृतस्य पूर्णा सहस्रधार उत्सो अक्षीयमाणः /
text_mt: And: 'This pot is full of immortality, a thousand-streamed, unfailing spring;

sanskrit_iast: sa dādhāra pṛthivīmantarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca tenaudanenātitarāṇi mṛtyum iti ca
meaning: स दाधार पृथिवीमन्तरिक्षं दिवं च तेनौदनेनातितराणि मृत्युम् इति च
text_mt: it holds heaven, earth, and the intermediate space; by means of that cooked rice may I transcend death.'
The ritual call and the giving of the anvāhārya cooked rice have already been explained.

sanskrit_iast: eṣā te agne samid ity ānūyājikīṃ samidhamādhīyamānām //
meaning: एषा ते अग्ने समिद् इत्य् आनूयाजिकीं समिधमाधीयमानाम् //
text_mt: With 'This is your kindling stick, O Agni...', [he recites over] the after-offering kindling stick being placed [on the fire].

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ te agna āvṛścāmyahaṃ vā kṣipitaścaran /
meaning: यं ते अग्न आवृश्चाम्यहं वा क्षिपितश्चरन् /
text_mt: 'Whomsoever I cut off for you, O Agni, or wandering about hungry,

sanskrit_iast: prajāṃ ca tasya mūlaṃ ca nīcairdevā nivṛścata //
meaning: प्रजां च तस्य मूलं च नीचैर्देवा निवृश्चत //
text_mt: both his offspring and his root do you, O gods, cut down below.

sanskrit_iast: agne yo no 'bhidāsati samāno yaś ca niṣṭyaḥ /
meaning: अग्ने यो नो ऽभिदासति समानो यश् च निष्ट्यः /
text_mt: O Agni, he who plots against us, whether an equal or a stranger,
like a burning piece of firewood, let nothing remain of him!

sanskrit_iast: yo māṃ dveṣṭi jātavedo yaṃ cāhaṃ dveṣmi yaśca mām /
meaning: यो मां द्वेष्टि जातवेदो यं चाहं द्वेष्मि यश्च माम् /
text_mt: Whoever hates me, O Jātavedas, and whomsoever I hate, and whoever [hates] me—

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṃstānagne saṃdaha yāṃścāhaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām ity āhitāyām agnim
meaning: सर्वांस्तानग्ने संदह यांश्चाहं द्वेष्मि ये च माम् इत्य् आहितायाम् अग्निम्
text_mt: burn all of them completely, O Agni, whom I hate and who [hate] me'—[he recites this over] Agni when it is placed [on the fire].
'Altar ground, sacrificial grass, cooked oblation, firewood, enclosing sticks, ladles,
ghee, sacrifice, verses, formulas, consecratory verses, and vaṣaṭ-calls,

sanskrit_iast: saṃ me saṃnatayo namantāmidhmasaṃnahane huta iti saṃmārgān hutān
meaning: सं मे संनतयो नमन्तामिध्मसंनहने हुत इति संमार्गान् हुतान्
text_mt: may my homages bend down harmoniously; offered in the tying of the firewood', [he recites over] the sweeping-grasses after they are offered.

sanskrit_iast: saptahotāraṃ vadet purastād anūyājānām upariṣṭād vā
meaning: सप्तहोतारं वदेत् पुरस्ताद् अनूयाजानाम् उपरिष्टाद् वा
text_mt: He should recite the Saptahotṛ formula before or after the after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣo 'haṃ devayajyayā prajāvānbhūyāsam ity etaiḥ pratimantram anūyājān hutaṃhutam
meaning: बर्हिषो ऽहं देवयज्यया प्रजावान्भूयासम् इत्य् एतैः प्रतिमन्त्रम् अनूयाजान् हुतंहुतम्
text_mt: With 'Through the sacrifice to the sacrificial grass may I become possessed of offspring...', [he recites] separately for each formula over each of the after-offerings after it is offered.
Both [the adhvaryu and the sacrificer] murmur the two Vājavatī verses.

'I have gladdened the divine Vasus with the sacrifice; I have gladdened the divine Rudras with the sacrifice; I have gladdened the divine Ādityas with the sacrifice'—[he recites this] with each formula over the enclosing sticks while they are being anointed.

sanskrit_iast: samaṅktāṃ barhirhaviṣā ghṛtena samādityairvasubhiḥ saṃ marudbhiḥ /
meaning: समङ्क्तां बर्हिर्हविषा घृतेन समादित्यैर्वसुभिः सं मरुद्भिः /
text_mt: 'May the sacrificial grass be anointed with the oblation, with ghee, together with the Ādityas, the Vasus, and the Maruts;

sanskrit_iast: samindreṇa viśvebhir devebhir aṅktāṃ divyaṃ nabho gacchatu yatsvāheti prastaramajyamānam
meaning: समिन्द्रेण विश्वेभिर् देवेभिर् अङ्क्तां दिव्यं नभो गच्छतु यत्स्वाहेति प्रस्तरमज्यमानम्
text_mt: [He follows] the grass bunch being anointed with: 'May it be anointed with Indra, with the All-gods! May it go to the divine sky! Svāhā!'
With: 'After the triumph of Agni may I triumph,' according to their characteristics, [he addresses] the deities of the sūktavāka.

sanskrit_iast: yadā cāsya hotā nāma gṛhṇīyādatha brūyād emā agmannāśiṣo dohakāmā iti
meaning: यदा चास्य होता नाम गृह्णीयादथ ब्रूयाद् एमा अग्मन्नाशिषो दोहकामा इति
text_mt: And when the hotṛ pronounces his name, he should then say: 'Hither have these wishes come, fulfilling wishes.'

sanskrit_iast: sā me satyāśīrdevāngamyājjuṣṭājjuṣṭatarā paṇyātpaṇyatarāreḍatā manasā devāngamyādyajño devāngacchatvado ma āgacchatv iti sūktavākasyāśiḥṣu yatkāmayate tasya nāma gṛhṇāti
meaning: सा मे सत्याशीर्देवान्गम्याज्जुष्टाज्जुष्टतरा पण्यात्पण्यतरारेडता मनसा देवान्गम्याद्यज्ञो देवान्गच्छत्वदो म आगच्छत्व् इति सूक्तवाकस्याशिःषु यत्कामयते तस्य नाम गृह्णाति
text_mt: At the blessings of the sūktavāka, with: 'May that true blessing of mine go to the gods, welcomed, more welcomed, praised, more praised! With ungrudging mind may it go to the gods! May the sacrifice go to the gods, may that [such-and-such] come to me!' he names whatever he desires.

sanskrit_iast: rohitena tvāgnirdevatāṃ gamayatvityetaiḥ pratimantramagnīdhā prastaraṃ prahriyamāṇam
meaning: रोहितेन त्वाग्निर्देवतां गमयत्वित्येतैः प्रतिमन्त्रमग्नीधा प्रस्तरं प्रह्रियमाणम्
text_mt: [He follows] the grass bunch being cast into the fire by the agnīdh with these mantras, one for each: 'May Agni lead you to the deity by means of his red steed!'
'The peg has stretched down from heaven, arisen from the earth;
With that, thousand-jointed, do we torment him who hates us.

sanskrit_iast: dviṣanme bahu śocatvoṣadhe mo ahaṃ śucam iti prastaratṛṇe prahriyamāṇe
meaning: द्विषन्मे बहु शोचत्वोषधे मो अहं शुचम् इति प्रस्तरतृणे प्रह्रियमाणे
text_mt: May he who hates me be tormented greatly! O herb, may I not be tormented!' [with these words he follows] two blades from the grass bunch being cast into the fire.
With: 'I unloose you,' while the enclosing sticks are being unloosed.
At the śaṃyuvāka, with: 'Of Viṣṇu, blessing and relief!'

sanskrit_iast: yajña namaste yajña namo namaśca te yajña śivena me saṃtiṣṭhasva syonena me saṃtiṣṭhasva subhūtena me saṃtiṣṭhasva brahmavarcasena me saṃtiṣṭhasva yajñasyarddhimanu saṃtiṣṭhasvopa te yajña nama upa te nama upa te nama iti ca //
meaning: यज्ञ नमस्ते यज्ञ नमो नमश्च ते यज्ञ शिवेन मे संतिष्ठस्व स्योनेन मे संतिष्ठस्व सुभूतेन मे संतिष्ठस्व ब्रह्मवर्चसेन मे संतिष्ठस्व यज्ञस्यर्द्धिमनु संतिष्ठस्वोप ते यज्ञ नम उप ते नम उप ते नम इति च //
text_mt: And with: 'O sacrifice, homage to you! O sacrifice, homage and homage to you, O sacrifice! Conclude auspiciously for me, conclude pleasantly for me, conclude with prosperity for me, conclude with spiritual lustre for me, conclude in accordance with the success of the sacrifice! Near unto you, O sacrifice, homage! Near unto you, homage! Near unto you, homage!'
'The sacrifice has been offered, bestowing wealth through the Bhṛgus, bestowing blessings through the Yatis, full of blessings through the Vasus;

sanskrit_iast: atharvabhistasya meṣṭasya vītasya draviṇehāgameriti saṃsrāvaṃ hutam
meaning: अथर्वभिस्तस्य मेष्टस्य वीतस्य द्रविणेहागमेरिति संस्रावं हुतम्
text_mt: Through the Atharvans, from that which has been offered and accepted, may wealth come to me here!' [with this he follows] the combined remnants [of clarified butter] offered.

sanskrit_iast: somasyāhaṃ devayajyayā suretā reto dhiṣīyeti yathāliṅgaṃ patnīsaṃyājān hutaṃhutam
meaning: सोमस्याहं देवयज्यया सुरेता रेतो धिषीयेति यथालिङ्गं पत्नीसंयाजान् हुतंहुतम्
text_mt: With: 'Through the god-worship of Soma, well-seeded may I bear seed,' according to their characteristics, [he follows] each wife-sacrifice (patnīsaṃyāja) as it is offered.

sanskrit_iast: rākāyā ahaṃ devayajyayā prajāvānbhūyāsaṃ sinīvalyā ahaṃ devayajyayā paśumānbhūyāsaṃ kuhvā ahaṃ devayajyayā puṣṭimān paśumān bhūyāsam iti kāmyāḥ
meaning: राकाया अहं देवयज्यया प्रजावान्भूयासं सिनीवल्या अहं देवयज्यया पशुमान्भूयासं कुह्वा अहं देवयज्यया पुष्टिमान् पशुमान् भूयासम् इति काम्याः
text_mt: 'Through the god-worship of Rākā may I become rich in offspring! Through the god-worship of Sinīvālī may I become rich in cattle! Through the god-worship of Kuhū may I become prosperous and rich in cattle!'—these are optional.

sanskrit_iast: rākāyā ahaṃ devayajyayā prajāvatī bhūyāsaṃ sinīvālyā ahaṃ devayajyayā paśumatī bhūyāsaṃ kuhvā ahaṃ devayajyayā puṣṭimatī paśumatī bhūyāsam iti patnyanumantrayate
meaning: राकाया अहं देवयज्यया प्रजावती भूयासं सिनीवाल्या अहं देवयज्यया पशुमती भूयासं कुह्वा अहं देवयज्यया पुष्टिमती पशुमती भूयासम् इति पत्न्यनुमन्त्रयते
text_mt: The wife follows with: 'Through the god-worship of Rākā may I become rich in offspring! Through the god-worship of Sinīvālī may I become rich in cattle! Through the god-worship of Kuhū may I become prosperous and rich in cattle!'

sanskrit_iast: iḍāsmānanu vastāṃ ghṛtena yasyāḥ pade punate devayantaḥ /
meaning: इडास्माननु वस्तां घृतेन यस्याः पदे पुनते देवयन्तः /
text_mt: 'May Iḍā clothe us with clarified butter, in whose footprint those who seek the gods purify themselves;

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānarī śakvarī vāvṛdhānopa yajñamasthita vaiśvadevīty ājyeḍām
meaning: वैश्वानरी शक्वरी वावृधानोप यज्ञमस्थित वैश्वदेवीत्य् आज्येडाम्
text_mt: Belonging to Vaiśvānara, mighty, strengthened, belonging to the All-gods, she has approached the sacrifice'—[with this he follows] the butter-iḍā.
Having placed the veda-broom inside the altar ground, he touches it with: 'You are the veda.'
At 'before I may obtain', he should name whatever of his rival's he covets:
'It is recognized that he strips away all that of his.'

sanskrit_iast: yā sarasvatī viśobhagīnā tasyāṃ me rāsva tasyāste bhaktivāno bhūyāsmeti phalīkaraṇahome hute mukhaṃ vimṛṣṭe
meaning: या सरस्वती विशोभगीना तस्यां मे रास्व तस्यास्ते भक्तिवानो भूयास्मेति फलीकरणहोमे हुते मुखं विमृष्टे
text_mt: When the oblation of grain-chaff has been offered, he wipes his face with: 'The Sarasvatī who is beneficial to all people, grant [a share] in her to me; may we share in her!'

sanskrit_iast: vasuryajño vasumānyajñastasya mā yajñasya vasorvasumato vasvāgacchatvado ma āgacchatv iti samiṣṭayajurhutamanumantrayate /
meaning: वसुर्यज्ञो वसुमान्यज्ञस्तस्य मा यज्ञस्य वसोर्वसुमतो वस्वागच्छत्वदो म आगच्छत्व् इति समिष्टयजुर्हुतमनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He follows the offered samiṣṭayajus with: 'The sacrifice is rich, the sacrifice possesses wealth; may the wealth of that rich, wealth-possessing sacrifice come to me! May that [such-and-such] come to me!'
He names whatever he desires.
He eats the sacrificer's portion with: 'United with the blessing, the lord of the sacrifice...'
With: 'I have praised Dadhikrāvan,' [he eats] the evening milking;
With: 'This offering...' [he eats] the morning milking.
A non-Brahmin should not eat the curd-and-milk offering (sāṃnāyya).
From the praṇītā water inside the altar ground, the adhvaryu pours an unbroken stream of water;

sanskrit_iast: sadasi sanme bhūyā ity ānīyamānāyāṃ japati
meaning: सदसि सन्मे भूया इत्य् आनीयमानायां जपति
text_mt: While it is being led forth, [the sacrificer] whispers: 'Sitting in the assembly, may there be good for me!'

sanskrit_iast: prācyāṃ diśi devā ṛtvijo mārjayantām ity etair yathāliṅgaṃ vyutsicya samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomi svām yonim apigacchata /
meaning: प्राच्यां दिशि देवा ऋत्विजो मार्जयन्ताम् इत्य् एतैर् यथालिङ्गं व्युत्सिच्य समुद्रं वः प्रहिणोमि स्वाम् योनिम् अपिगच्छत /
text_mt: Having poured it out in different directions according to the marks with these [formulas]: 'In the eastern direction may the divine priests cleanse themselves...', [he recites:] 'I send you to the ocean; go to your own source!

sanskrit_iast: acchidraḥ prajayā bhūyāsaṃ mā parāseci matpaya ityantarvedi śeṣaṃ ninīya yadapsu te sarasvati goṣvaśveṣu yan madhu /
meaning: अच्छिद्रः प्रजया भूयासं मा परासेचि मत्पय इत्यन्तर्वेदि शेषं निनीय यदप्सु ते सरस्वति गोष्वश्वेषु यन् मधु /
text_mt: May I be unbroken with offspring; may my milk not be poured away!' Having poured the remainder inside the altar ground, [and with:] 'Whatever honey of yours is in the waters, O Sarasvatī, whatever in cows, in horses,
Therewith, O swift one, anoint my face, O Sarasvatī!

sanskrit_iast: yā sarasvatī vaiśambalyā tasyāṃ me rāsva tasyāste bhakṣīya tasyāste bhūyiṣṭhabhājo bhūyāsmeti mukhaṃ vimṛṣṭe
meaning: या सरस्वती वैशम्बल्या तस्यां मे रास्व तस्यास्ते भक्षीय तस्यास्ते भूयिष्ठभाजो भूयास्मेति मुखं विमृष्टे
text_mt: The Sarasvatī who is Vaiśambalyā, grant [a share] in her to me; may I partake of her; may we be the greatest recipients of her!' he wipes his face.
Both whisper the formula for releasing the potsherds.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'sīti dakṣiṇe vedyante dakṣiṇena padā caturo viṣṇukramānprācaḥ krāmatyuttaramuttaraṃ jyāyāmsamanatiharansavyam
meaning: विष्णोः क्रमो ऽसीति दक्षिणे वेद्यन्ते दक्षिणेन पदा चतुरो विष्णुक्रमान्प्राचः क्रामत्युत्तरमुत्तरं ज्यायाम्समनतिहरन्सव्यम्
text_mt: With: 'You are the stride of Viṣṇu,' on the southern edge of the altar ground, he takes four Viṣṇu-strides towards the east with the right foot, each succeeding stride greater, without crossing the left foot over.
He does not step beyond the āhavanīya.
Stopping short, he whispers the fourth.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇukramān viṣṇvatikramān atīmokṣān iti vyatiṣaktān eke samāmananti /
meaning: विष्णुक्रमान् विष्ण्वतिक्रमान् अतीमोक्षान् इति व्यतिषक्तान् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Some teach the Viṣṇu-strides, Viṣṇu-over-strides, and releases intertwined;
'With the god Agni I conquer the armies'—these are the Viṣṇu-over-strides;
'Which gods slay the sacrifice...'—these are the releases.
With: 'We have gone to the light, to the light we have gone,' he pays reverence to the sun.
'Rising today, O you of friendly majesty, destroy my rivals!
Slay them by day with lightning; setting, make them sink below!

sanskrit_iast: udyannadya vi no bhaja pitā putrebhyo yathā /
meaning: उद्यन्नद्य वि नो भज पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा /
text_mt: Rising today, apportion to us as a father to his sons;

sanskrit_iast: dīrghāyutvasya heśiṣe tasya no dehi sūrya //
meaning: दीर्घायुत्वस्य हेशिषे तस्य नो देहि सूर्य //
text_mt: For you rule over longevity: grant that to us, O Sūrya!
Rising today, O you of friendly majesty, ascending to the higher sky,

sanskrit_iast: hṛdrogaṃ mama sūrya harimāṇaṃ ca nāśaya //
meaning: हृद्रोगं मम सूर्य हरिमाणं च नाशय //
text_mt: My heartache and jaundice, O Sūrya, banish!
Into parrots and starling-birds we deposit my jaundice,
And also into yellow wagtails we deposit my jaundice.
This sun has risen together with all power,

sanskrit_iast: dviṣantaṃ mama randhayanmo ahaṃ dviṣato radham //
meaning: द्विषन्तं मम रन्धयन्मो अहं द्विषतो रधम् //
text_mt: Subduing him who hates me; let me not be subdued by him who hates me!

sanskrit_iast: yo naḥ śapādaśapato yaśca naḥ śapataḥ śapāt /
meaning: यो नः शपादशपतो यश्च नः शपतः शपात् /
text_mt: He who curses us when we curse not, and he who curses us when we curse,

sanskrit_iast: uṣāśca tasmai nimrukca sarvaṃ pāpaṃ samūhatām iti ca
meaning: उषाश्च तस्मै निम्रुक्च सर्वं पापं समूहताम् इति च
text_mt: Upon him may dawn and sunset sweep together all evil!' and with this.
With: 'I turn with the turning of Indra,' he turns sunwise.

sanskrit_iast: yadyabhicaredidamahamamuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya prāṇaṃ niveṣṭayāmīti dakṣiṇasya padaḥ pārṣṇyā nimṛdgīyāt
meaning: यद्यभिचरेदिदमहममुष्यामुष्यायणस्य प्राणं निवेष्टयामीति दक्षिणस्य पदः पार्ष्ण्या निमृद्गीयात्
text_mt: If he should practice sorcery, he should crush [the ground] with the heel of his right foot, saying: 'Here I wrap up the life-breath of so-and-so, son of so-and-so.'

sanskrit_iast: puṇyā bhavantu yā lakṣmīḥ parābhavantu yāḥ pāpīrity uktvā samahaṃ prajayā saṃ mayā prajeti punarupāvartate
meaning: पुण्या भवन्तु या लक्ष्मीः पराभवन्तु याः पापीरित्य् उक्त्वा समहं प्रजया सं मया प्रजेति पुनरुपावर्तते
text_mt: Having said: 'May the good fortunes become auspicious; may the evil fortunes perish,' he turns back with: 'Together may I be with offspring, together with me may offspring be!'

sanskrit_iast: samiddho agne me dīdihi sameddhā te agne dīdyāsamityāhavanīyamupasaminddhe /
meaning: समिद्धो अग्ने मे दीदिहि समेद्धा ते अग्ने दीद्यासमित्याहवनीयमुपसमिन्द्धे /
text_mt: With: 'Enkindled, O Agni, shine for me; enkindling, may I shine for you, O Agni!' he kindles the āhavanīya;
With: 'Possessing wealth is the sacrifice, may I become wealthier!' he pays reverence [to it].

sanskrit_iast: yo naḥ sapatno yo 'raṇo marto 'bhidāsati devāḥ /
meaning: यो नः सपत्नो यो ऽरणो मर्तो ऽभिदासति देवाः /
text_mt: "Whatever rival of ours, whatever alien mortal plots against us, O gods,

sanskrit_iast: idhmasyeva prakṣāyato mā tasyoccheṣi kiṃcaneti ca
meaning: इध्मस्येव प्रक्षायतो मा तस्योच्छेषि किंचनेति च
text_mt: like a burning log of firewood, let nothing of him remain!"—and with this [he attends the āhavanīya].

sanskrit_iast: agna āyūṃṣi pavasa ity āgnipāvamānībhyāṃ gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate /
meaning: अग्न आयूंषि पवस इत्य् आग्निपावमानीभ्यां गार्हपत्यमुपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: With the two verses addressed to Agni Pavamāna, "O Agni, you purify our life-spans", he attends the gārhapatya,

sanskrit_iast: putrasya nāma gṛhṇāti tāmāśiṣamāśāse tantava ity ajātasya /
meaning: पुत्रस्य नाम गृह्णाति तामाशिषमाशासे तन्तव इत्य् अजातस्य /
text_mt: He mentions the name of his son: for one unborn, with "I pray for that blessing for the lineage";

sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣe tantave tvāsāvanu mā tanvacchinno daivyastantur mā manuṣyaśchedi divyāddhāmno mā cchitsi mā mānuṣāditi priyasya putrasya nāma gṛhṇāti
meaning: ज्योतिषे तन्तवे त्वासावनु मा तन्वच्छिन्नो दैव्यस्तन्तुर् मा मनुष्यश्छेदि दिव्याद्धाम्नो मा च्छित्सि मा मानुषादिति प्रियस्य पुत्रस्य नाम गृह्णाति
text_mt: With: "For light, for lineage, you, so-and-so, may you stretch out after me; may the divine thread not be broken, may the human thread not be severed; may I not be cut off from the divine realm, nor from the human!", he mentions the name of his beloved son.

sanskrit_iast: agne vahne svaditaṃ nastanaye pituṃ paca /
meaning: अग्ने वह्ने स्वदितं नस्तनये पितुं पच /
text_mt: "O Agni, the conveyer, cook well-seasoned food for our offspring,

sanskrit_iast: śaṃ tokāya tanuve syona iti dakṣiṇāgnim
meaning: शं तोकाय तनुवे स्योन इति दक्षिणाग्निम्
text_mt: peace for our descendants, pleasant for our bodies"—with this [he attends] the dakṣiṇāgni.
With: "For light, for lineage, to you…", he sits down inside the altar ground.
The mentioning of the name is as before.
Having sat down, he whispers: "You are light, for lineage…".
Having placed the veda on his lap, seated inside the altar ground, he whispers the Atīmokṣa formulas.

sanskrit_iast: atra vedastaraṇaṃ yajamānabhāgasya ca prāśanam eke samāmananti
meaning: अत्र वेदस्तरणं यजमानभागस्य च प्राशनम् एके समामनन्ति
text_mt: At this point, some teachers prescribe the strewing of the veda and the consumption of the sacrificer's share.

sanskrit_iast: kastvā yunakti sa tvā vimuñcatviti yajñaṃ vimuñcati
meaning: कस्त्वा युनक्ति स त्वा विमुञ्चत्विति यज्ञं विमुञ्चति
text_mt: With: "Who unyokes you? May he unyoke you", he unyokes the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: agne vratapate vratam acāriṣam iti vrataṃ visṛjate
meaning: अग्ने व्रतपते व्रतम् अचारिषम् इति व्रतं विसृजते
text_mt: With: "O Agni, lord of vows, I have observed my vow", he releases the vow.
With: "The sacrifice has come to be", he whispers the formula for resuming the sacrifice.
Having stepped forward toward the east, he whispers the Gomatī verse: "Possessing cows…".
Or at this point he may consume the sacrificer's share.

sanskrit_iast: yajña śaṃ ca ma upa ca ma āyuśca me balaṃ ca me yajña śivo me saṃtiṣṭhasva yajña sviṣṭo me saṃtiṣṭhasva yajñāriṣṭo me saṃtiṣṭhasveti darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ somena paśunā veṣṭvā japati
meaning: यज्ञ शं च म उप च म आयुश्च मे बलं च मे यज्ञ शिवो मे संतिष्ठस्व यज्ञ स्विष्टो मे संतिष्ठस्व यज्ञारिष्टो मे संतिष्ठस्वेति दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्यां सोमेन पशुना वेष्ट्वा जपति
text_mt: Having sacrificed with the New and Full Moon sacrifices, or with soma, or with an animal sacrifice, he whispers: "O sacrifice, be peace to me and access to me, life to me and strength to me; O sacrifice, turn out auspiciously for me; O sacrifice, turn out well-offered for me; O sacrifice, turn out unharmed for me!".
With: "You are rain; cut off my evil! From non-truth I have arrived at truth", having sacrificed, he touches water.
This touching [of water] applies in all sacrifices.
He calls out: "Satisfy the brāhmaṇas!".
When he is setting out on a journey, facing the sacred hearths at the proper time, he whispers the sacrificer's formulas.
He takes the Viṣṇu strides towards the east.
Having stepped forward toward the east, he whispers, he whispers the Gomatī verse.
We shall explain the setting up of the sacred fires.

sanskrit_iast: yo aśvatthaḥ śamīgarbha āruroha tve sacā /
meaning: यो अश्वत्थः शमीगर्भ आरुरोह त्वे सचा /
text_mt: "The aśvattha tree which grew inside the śamī, having ascended together with you:

sanskrit_iast: taṃ te harāmi brahmaṇā yajñiyaiḥ ketubhiḥ saheti śamīgarbhasyāśvatthasyāraṇī āharati
meaning: तं ते हरामि ब्रह्मणा यज्ञियैः केतुभिः सहेति शमीगर्भस्याश्वत्थस्यारणी आहरति
text_mt: that [wood] of yours I fetch with sacred prayer along with sacrificial signs"—with this he fetches the two kindling sticks from an aśvattha tree grown inside a śamī tree.
Even if not grown inside a śamī tree, says the Vājasaneyaka.
"From the aśvattha, from the conveyer of oblations, I collect the sacrificial body of Agni that is born:
having a peaceful womb, born inside a śamī, for Agni to be generated!

sanskrit_iast: āyurmayi dhehyāyuryajamāna ityaraṇī abhimantrya sapta pārthivān saṃ bhārānāharati /
meaning: आयुर्मयि धेह्यायुर्यजमान इत्यरणी अभिमन्त्र्य सप्त पार्थिवान् सं भारानाहरति /
text_mt: Bestow life upon me, life upon the sacrificer"—having addressed the two kindling sticks with this, he fetches the seven earthly materials
He should not collect the materials, says the Vājasaneyaka.
"Form of Vaiśvānara, overflowing upon the earth,
let them enter our abode gently"—[with this he fetches] sand.

sanskrit_iast: yadidaṃ divo yadadaḥ pṛthivyāḥ saṃjajñāne rodasī saṃbabhūvatuḥ /
meaning: यदिदं दिवो यददः पृथिव्याः संजज्ञाने रोदसी संबभूवतुः /
text_mt: "Whatever is this of heaven, whatever is that of earth, the two world-halves having agreed came into being;
may the saline soil protect the black antelope skin, may the black antelope skin protect the saline soil; the most fit for sacrifice of both has come here"—[with this he fetches] saline soil.
"Providing protections, when you wandered over the earth, assuming a hidden form, taking on the shape of a mole:

sanskrit_iast: tatte nyaktamiha saṃbharantaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ suvīrā ityākhukarīṣam //
meaning: तत्ते न्यक्तमिह संभरन्तः शतं जीवेम शरदः सुवीरा इत्याखुकरीषम् //
text_mt: collecting here that indented trace of yours, may we live a hundred autumns with good heroes!"—[with this he fetches] molehill-earth.

sanskrit_iast: ūrjaṃ pṛthivyā rasamābharantaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ purūcīḥ /
meaning: ऊर्जं पृथिव्या रसमाभरन्तः शतं जीवेम शरदः पुरूचीः /
text_mt: "Bringing vigor, the sap of the earth, may we live a hundred full autumns;

sanskrit_iast: vamrībhiranuvittaṃ guhāsu śrotraṃ ta urvyabadhirā bhavāma iti valmīkavapām //
meaning: वम्रीभिरनुवित्तं गुहासु श्रोत्रं त उर्व्यबधिरा भवाम इति वल्मीकवपाम् //
text_mt: found by the ants in the cavities, O wide earth, may we become non-deaf ears to you"—[with this he fetches] an anthill-core.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatisṛṣṭānāṃ prajānāṃ kṣudho 'pahatyai suvitaṃ no astu /
meaning: प्रजापतिसृष्टानां प्रजानां क्षुधो ऽपहत्यै सुवितं नो अस्तु /
text_mt: "For the warding off of hunger of the creatures created by Prajāpati, may there be welfare for us;

sanskrit_iast: upaprabhinnamiṣamūrjaṃ prajābhyaḥ sūdaṃ gṛhebhyo rasamābharāmīti sūdam //
meaning: उपप्रभिन्नमिषमूर्जं प्रजाभ्यः सूदं गृहेभ्यो रसमाभरामीति सूदम् //
text_mt: food and vigor split open for the creatures, mud, the sap, I fetch for the houses"—[with this he fetches] swamp-mud.

sanskrit_iast: yasya rūpaṃ bibhradimāmavindadguhā praviṣṭāṃ sarirasya madhye /
meaning: यस्य रूपं बिभ्रदिमामविन्दद्गुहा प्रविष्टां सरिरस्य मध्ये /
text_mt: "Bearing whose form, he found her who had entered the hidden depths in the midst of the water:
fetching here this earth turned up by him, may we perform worship on her without stumbling!"—[with this he fetches] earth turned up by a boar.
"With which he made firm the support of the world, this broad supporter of all people,

sanskrit_iast: tā naḥ śivāḥ śarkarāḥ santu sarvā iti śarkarāḥ //
meaning: ता नः शिवाः शर्कराः सन्तु सर्वा इति शर्कराः //
text_mt: may all those gravel-stones be auspicious to us"—[with this he fetches] gravel-stones.
"Agni's seed, shining, gold born from the waters, immortal among offspring:
collecting that, placing it on the north, handing it over, may I cross beyond misfortune"—[with this he fetches] gold.
If there are five, pieces of udumbara wood or pieces of copper become the fifth.

sanskrit_iast: aśvo rūpaṃ kṛtvā yadaśvatthe 'tiṣṭhaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ devebhyo nilāya /
meaning: अश्वो रूपं कृत्वा यदश्वत्थे ऽतिष्ठः संवत्सरं देवेभ्यो निलाय /
text_mt: "Assuming the form of a horse, when you stayed in the aśvattha for a year, hiding from the gods:

sanskrit_iast: tatte nyaktamiha saṃbharantaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ suvīrā ity aśvattham //
meaning: तत्ते न्यक्तमिह संभरन्तः शतं जीवेम शरदः सुवीरा इत्य् अश्वत्थम् //
text_mt: collecting here that indented trace of yours, may we live a hundred autumns with good heroes!"—[with this he fetches] aśvattha wood.

sanskrit_iast: ūrjaḥ pṛthivyā adhyutthito 'si vanaspate śatavalśo viroha /
meaning: ऊर्जः पृथिव्या अध्युत्थितो ऽसि वनस्पते शतवल्शो विरोह /
text_mt: "You have arisen from the vigor of the earth; O tree, sprout with a hundred branches!

sanskrit_iast: tvayā vayamiṣamūrjaṃ madanto rāyaspoṣeṇa samiṣā mademetyudumbaram //
meaning: त्वया वयमिषमूर्जं मदन्तो रायस्पोषेण समिषा मदेमेत्युदुम्बरम् //
text_mt: Exulting in food and vigor through you, may we exult in wealth and prosperity, with abundance of food"—[with this he fetches] udumbara wood.

meaning: गायत्रिया ह्रियमाणस्य यत्ते पर्णमपतत्तृतीयस्यै दिवो ऽधि /
text_mt: "What leaf of yours fell from the third heaven as it was being carried away by the Gāyatrī...

sanskrit_iast: so 'yaṃ parṇaḥ somaparṇāddhi jātastato harāmi somapīthasyāvaruddhyai //
meaning: सो ऽयं पर्णः सोमपर्णाद्धि जातस्ततो हरामि सोमपीथस्यावरुद्ध्यै //
text_mt: ‘This parṇa tree was born from the leaf of Soma; therefore I fetch it to obtain the drinking of Soma.’

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ brahmavādaṃ vadatāṃ yadupāśṛṇoḥ suśravā vai śruto 'si /
meaning: देवानां ब्रह्मवादं वदतां यदुपाशृणोः सुश्रवा वै श्रुतो ऽसि /
text_mt: ‘As you listened to the gods speaking of sacred lore, you are indeed renowned as Suśravas;

sanskrit_iast: tato māmāviśatu brahmavarcasaṃ tatsaṃbharaṃstadavarundhīya sākṣādityetābhyāṃ parṇam //
meaning: ततो मामाविशतु ब्रह्मवर्चसं तत्संभरंस्तदवरुन्धीय साक्षादित्येताभ्यां पर्णम् //
text_mt: may spiritual radiance enter me therefrom; bringing it together, may I obtain that directly’—with these two [verses he fetches the wood of] the parṇa tree.
‘With which Prajāpati pacified the missile of Agni when he had been created,
that śamī tree I fetch for appeasement, that there be no burning down’—[with this verse he fetches the wood of] the śamī tree.

sanskrit_iast: yatte sṛṣṭasya yato vikaṅkataṃ bhā ārchajjātavedaḥ /
meaning: यत्ते सृष्टस्य यतो विकङ्कतं भा आर्छज्जातवेदः /
text_mt: ‘When you were created, O Jātavedas, from whom radiance reached the vikaṅkata tree,

sanskrit_iast: tayā bhāsā saṃmita uruṃ no lokamanuprabhāhīti vikaṅkatam /
meaning: तया भासा संमित उरुं नो लोकमनुप्रभाहीति विकङ्कतम् /
text_mt: measuring up to us with that radiance, shine along our wide world’—[with this verse he fetches the wood of] the vikaṅkata tree.
‘When you were moving, O Jātavedas, the Maruts, causing rain with waters, snatched away your heart;

sanskrit_iast: etat te tad aśaneḥ saṃbharāmi sātmā agne sahṛdayo bhavehetyaśanihatasya vṛkṣasya //
meaning: एतत् ते तद् अशनेः संभरामि सात्मा अग्ने सहृदयो भवेहेत्यशनिहतस्य वृक्षस्य //
text_mt: this of yours I collect from that lightning; O Agni, become embodied, endowed with a heart here’—[with this verse he fetches the wood] of a lightning-struck tree.
‘When he looked around the middle of the sea, he saw the broad earth, the foundation of the world;

sanskrit_iast: tatpuṣkarasyāyatanāddhi jātaṃ parṇaṃ pṛthivyāḥ prathanaṃ harāmīti puṣkaraparṇam //
meaning: तत्पुष्करस्यायतनाद्धि जातं पर्णं पृथिव्याः प्रथनं हरामीति पुष्करपर्णम् //
text_mt: that leaf born from the abode of the lotus, the expansion of the earth, I fetch’—[with this verse he fetches] a lotus leaf.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ tvā samabharaṃ jātavedo yathā śarīraṃ bhūteṣu nyaktam /
meaning: यं त्वा समभरं जातवेदो यथा शरीरं भूतेषु न्यक्तम् /
text_mt: ‘Thee, whom I have collected, O Jātavedas, as the body embedded in beings,

sanskrit_iast: sa saṃbhṛtaḥ sīda śivaḥ prajābhya uruṃ no lokamanuneṣi vidvāniti saṃbhṛtya nidadhāti
meaning: स संभृतः सीद शिवः प्रजाभ्य उरुं नो लोकमनुनेषि विद्वानिति संभृत्य निदधाति
text_mt: do thou, thus collected, sit auspicious for offspring; knowing, lead us to the wide world’—having collected [them], he deposits them [with this verse].

sanskrit_iast: kṛttikāsu brāhmaṇa ādadhīta mukhyo brahmavarcasī bhavati
meaning: कृत्तिकासु ब्राह्मण आदधीत मुख्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa should set up [the fires] under the Kṛttikās; he becomes eminent [and] endowed with spiritual radiance.
His fire burns down his houses.
Having set them up under Rohiṇī, he attains all attainments.
Under Mṛgaśīrṣa, one who is desirous of spiritual radiance or desirous of sacrifice [should set them up].
One who, having previously been prosperous, has become degraded, [should set them up] under the Punarvasus.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayoḥ phalgunyoryaḥ kāmayeta dānakāmā me prajā syur iti
meaning: पूर्वयोः फल्गुन्योर्यः कामयेत दानकामा मे प्रजा स्युर् इति
text_mt: Under the Pūrva Phalgunīs, one who desires: ‘May my offspring be generous!’
Under the Uttara [Phalgunīs], one who desires: ‘May I be fortunate and an eater of food!’

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayor ādhāya pāpīyān bhavaty uttarayor vasīyān
meaning: पूर्वयोर् आधाय पापीयान् भवत्य् उत्तरयोर् वसीयान्
text_mt: Having set them up under the former, he becomes worse off; under the latter, he becomes wealthier.

sanskrit_iast: haste yaḥ kāmayeta pra me dīyeteti
meaning: हस्ते यः कामयेत प्र मे दीयेतेति
text_mt: Under Hasta, one who desires: ‘May [gifts] be given to me!’
Under Citrā, a rājanya or one who has a rival [should set them up].

sanskrit_iast: viśākhayoḥ prajākāmo 'nurādheṣvṛddhikāmaḥ śravaṇe puṣṭikāma uttareṣu proṣṭhapadeṣu pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ
meaning: विशाखयोः प्रजाकामो ऽनुराधेष्वृद्धिकामः श्रवणे पुष्टिकाम उत्तरेषु प्रोष्ठपदेषु प्रतिष्ठाकामः
text_mt: Under the Viśākhās, one desirous of offspring; under Anurādhā, one desirous of prosperity; under Śravaṇa, one desirous of nourishment; under the Uttara Proṣṭhapadās, one desirous of a firm foundation.
Some recite all [these asterisms] as optional alternatives.

meaning: फल्गुनीपूर्णमास आदधीतेत्युक्त्वाह यत्फल्गुनीपूर्णमास आदध्यात्संवत्सरस्यैनमासन्दध्याद्द्व्यहे पुरैकाहे वा
text_mt: Having said: ‘He should set up [the fires] at the Phalgunī full moon,’ [the sacred text] says: ‘If he sets them up at the Phalgunī full moon, he would set them up in the face of the year, two days before or one day before.’
They are to be set up on a new moon or on a full moon.

sanskrit_iast: vasanto brāhmaṇasya grīṣmo rājanyasya hemanto vā śaradvaiśyasya varṣā rathakārasya
meaning: वसन्तो ब्राह्मणस्य ग्रीष्मो राजन्यस्य हेमन्तो वा शरद्वैश्यस्य वर्षा रथकारस्य
text_mt: Spring is for a brāhmaṇa, summer or winter for a rājanya, autumn for a vaiśya, the rainy season for a chariot-maker.
Those who perform this work belonging to the three castes—this is the time for them.
The cool season is common to all castes.
One who intends to sacrifice with soma should heed neither season nor asterism.
A householder should set up [the fires] after moving to a new abode; a wanderer without moving to a new abode.
‘May the impure evil of this earth, being dug up, strike down the sin of the sacrificer;

sanskrit_iast: śivā naḥ santu pradiśaścatasraḥ śaṃ no mātā pṛthivī tokasāteti prācīnapravaṇaṃ devayajanamuddhatya śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye /
meaning: शिवा नः सन्तु प्रदिशश्चतस्रः शं नो माता पृथिवी तोकसातेति प्राचीनप्रवणं देवयजनमुद्धत्य शं नो देवीरभिष्टय आपो भवन्तु पीतये /
text_mt: may the four quarters be auspicious for us, may mother earth be salutary to us for gaining offspring’—having thus prepared the sacrificial place sloping towards the east; and [saying]: ‘May the divine waters be for our aid, for our drinking;

sanskrit_iast: śaṃyorabhisravantu na ity adbhir avokṣya tasminnudīcīnavaṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ karoti
meaning: शंयोरभिस्रवन्तु न इत्य् अद्भिर् अवोक्ष्य तस्मिन्नुदीचीनवंशं शरणं करोति
text_mt: may they flow towards us for wellbeing and blessing’—having sprinkled [the ground] with waters, he constructs a shelter with its ridgepole pointing north.
In front of its central beam is the fireplace of the gārhapatya.
Eastward from that at [a distance of] eight paces is the fireplace of the āhavanīya for a brāhmaṇa;
at eleven for a rājanya;

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśatyāmaparimite yāvatā vā cakṣuṣā manyate tasmānnātidūramādheya iti sarveṣāmaviśeṣeṇa śrūyate
meaning: चतुर्विंशत्यामपरिमिते यावता वा चक्षुषा मन्यते तस्मान्नातिदूरमाधेय इति सर्वेषामविशेषेण श्रूयते
text_mt: ‘At twenty-four, [or] at an unmeasured [distance], or as far as he considers by sight: from that [distance] it should not be set up too far’—so it is heard without distinction for all.
To the south-east, in the third-part space nearer to the gārhapatya, is the fireplace of the dakṣiṇāgni.
One shed is for the āhavanīya; another for the gārhapatya.
In front of the āhavanīya, in the assembly hall, is the sabhya fire.
East of it, in the residence, is the āvasathya fire.
He shaves his head and beard, pares his nails, and bathes.
Wearing linen garments, the husband and wife should set up the fires.
Those [garments] they give to the adhvaryu at the time of the sacrificial gifts.
In the afternoon, or when the sun is above the trees, having brought fire from the aupāsana [fire], he sets up the brāhmaudanika fire behind the gārhapatya fireplace.

sanskrit_iast: yadi sarvamaupāsanamāharedapūpaṃ yavamayaṃ vrīhimayaṃ caudumbaraparṇābhyāṃ saṃgṛhyāyatana upāsyedyavamayaṃ paścādvrīhimayaṃ purastāttasminnādadhyāt
meaning: यदि सर्वमौपासनमाहरेदपूपं यवमयं व्रीहिमयं चौदुम्बरपर्णाभ्यां संगृह्यायतन उपास्येद्यवमयं पश्चाद्व्रीहिमयं पुरस्तात्तस्मिन्नादध्यात्
text_mt: If he brings the entire aupāsana [fire], he should wrap a barley cake and a rice cake with two udumbara leaves and cast them into the fireplace—the barley cake in the west, the rice cake in the east—[and] set up [the fire] upon that.
Even when bringing the entire aupāsana fire, he need not cast the two cakes—thus another [rule].

sanskrit_iast: apareṇa brāhmaudanikaṃ lohite carmaṇyānaḍuhe prācīnagrīva uttaralomni pājake vā niśāyāṃ brahmaudanaṃ catuḥśarāvaṃ nirvapati
meaning: अपरेण ब्राह्मौदनिकं लोहिते चर्मण्यानडुहे प्राचीनग्रीव उत्तरलोम्नि पाजके वा निशायां ब्रह्मौदनं चतुःशरावं निर्वपति
text_mt: Behind the brāhmaudanika fire, on a red ox-hide with the neck to the east and the hairy side turned up, or in a winnowing basket, at night, he measures out the four-cup mess of cooked rice for the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvetyanudrutya brahmaṇe prāṇāya juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmīti prathamamapānāyeti dvitīyaṃ vyānāyeti tṛtīyaṃ brahmaṇe juṣṭam iti caturtham
meaning: देवस्य त्वेत्यनुद्रुत्य ब्रह्मणे प्राणाय जुष्टं निर्वपामीति प्रथममपानायेति द्वितीयं व्यानायेति तृतीयं ब्रह्मणे जुष्टम् इति चतुर्थम्
text_mt: Having recited after ‘At the impulse of god Savitṛ…’, [he pours it out saying]: ‘For the Brahman, for the out-breath, I measure thee out, agreeable’—the first [cup]; ‘For the in-breath’—the second; ‘For the diffused breath’—the third; ‘For the Brahman, agreeable’—the fourth.
He cooks [it] in four water vessels.
He does not wash [the grains], nor does he drain off the water.
"He cooks it so that the grains remain as if alive," thus it is known from the scripture.

sanskrit_iast: darvyā brahmaudanāduddhṛtya pra vedhase kavaye medhyāya vaco vandāru vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe /
meaning: दर्व्या ब्रह्मौदनादुद्धृत्य प्र वेधसे कवये मेध्याय वचो वन्दारु वृषभाय वृष्णे /
text_mt: Having ladled out from the brahmaudana with a spoon, [with the verse:] "To the wise, the poet, the holy, reverent speech to the bull, the manly;

sanskrit_iast: yato bhayamabhayaṃ tanno astvava devānyajeheḍyāniti juhoty abhi vā mantrayate
meaning: यतो भयमभयं तन्नो अस्त्वव देवान्यजेहेड्यानिति जुहोत्य् अभि वा मन्त्रयते
text_mt: From where there is fear, let there be fearlessness for us; turn aside the anger of the gods!"—he offers, or he recites over [it].

sanskrit_iast: caturdhā brahmaudanaṃ vyuddhṛtya prabhūtena sarpiṣopasicya karṣannanucchindaṃścaturbhya ārṣeyebhya ṛtvigbhya upohati
meaning: चतुर्धा ब्रह्मौदनं व्युद्धृत्य प्रभूतेन सर्पिषोपसिच्य कर्षन्ननुच्छिन्दंश्चतुर्भ्य आर्षेयेभ्य ऋत्विग्भ्य उपोहति
text_mt: Having apportioned the brahmaudana into four parts and poured plenty of clarified butter over it, dragging it without lifting it off, he pushes it toward the four officiating priests of ṛṣi descent.
"The first morsels are taken; the hands are unimpeded;

sanskrit_iast: atha brahmaudanaśeṣaṃ saṃkṛṣya tasminnājyaśeṣamānīya tasmiṃścitriyasyāśvatthasya tisraḥ samidha ārdrāḥ sapalāśāḥ prādeśamātryaḥ stibhigavatyo vivartayati
meaning: अथ ब्रह्मौदनशेषं संकृष्य तस्मिन्नाज्यशेषमानीय तस्मिंश्चित्रियस्याश्वत्थस्य तिस्रः समिध आर्द्राः सपलाशाः प्रादेशमात्र्यः स्तिभिगवत्यो विवर्तयति
text_mt: Then, having gathered the remainder of the brahmaudana, poured the remainder of the clarified butter into it, he rolls in it three wet firewood sticks with leaves, a span in length and possessing sprouts, from an aśvattha tree grown on a holy site,
[reciting:] "Gathered from an aśvattha grown on a holy site, great ones, you have prepared the body;
Equal to Prajāpati, the mouth of the sacrifice, three united with threefold [qualities] for procreation."
Then he places [them on the fire] with butter-filled verses dedicated to Agni: with Gāyatrī verses for a Brāhmaṇa, with Triṣṭubh verses for a Rājanya, with Jagatī verses for a Vaiśya.
"Attend upon Agni with firewood..." is this [first verse].
"To you, O Agni, let the butter-bearing [ladles], full of oblation, go, O lovely one;
"We increase you, that one, with firewood, O Aṅgiras, with clarified butter;
Flame up greatly, O youngest one!"—these are for a Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: samidhyamānaḥ prathamo nu dharmaḥ samaktubhirajyate viśvavāraḥ /
meaning: समिध्यमानः प्रथमो नु धर्मः समक्तुभिरज्यते विश्ववारः /
text_mt: "Being kindled, the first law is now anointed with balms, possessing all boons;

sanskrit_iast: śociṣkeśo ghṛtanirṇik pāvakaḥ suyajño agniryajathāya devān //
meaning: शोचिष्केशो घृतनिर्णिक् पावकः सुयज्ञो अग्निर्यजथाय देवान् //
text_mt: Flaming-haired, robed in clarified butter, purifying, of fair sacrifice, Agni [is ready] to sacrifice to the gods."
"Agni whose face is butter, whose womb is butter, kindled with butter; butter is his food;

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtapruṣastvā sarito vahanti ghṛtaṃ pibansuyajā yakṣi devān //
meaning: घृतप्रुषस्त्वा सरितो वहन्ति घृतं पिबन्सुयजा यक्षि देवान् //
text_mt: Streams dripping butter bear you; drinking butter, sacrifice well to the gods!"
"Giver of life, O Agni..."—these are for a Rājanya.

sanskrit_iast: tvāmagne samidhānaṃ yaviṣṭha devā dūtaṃ cakrire havyavāham /
meaning: त्वामग्ने समिधानं यविष्ठ देवा दूतं चक्रिरे हव्यवाहम् /
text_mt: "The gods made you, O Agni, when kindled, O youngest one, their messenger, oblation-bearer;
Wide-ranging, having butter for your womb, offered unto, they placed brilliant sight in the impelling one."

sanskrit_iast: tvāmagne pradiva āhutaṃ ghṛtena sumnāyavaḥ suṣamidhā samīdhire /
meaning: त्वामग्ने प्रदिव आहुतं घृतेन सुम्नायवः सुषमिधा समीधिरे /
text_mt: "You, O Agni, offered unto with butter since ancient times, those desirous of favour have kindled with good firewood;

sanskrit_iast: sa vāvṛdhāna oṣadhībhirukṣita uru jrayāṃsi pārthivā vitiṣṭhase //
meaning: स वावृधान ओषधीभिरुक्षित उरु ज्रयांसि पार्थिवा वितिष्ठसे //
text_mt: Having grown, invigorated by plants, you extend across the broad earthly expanses."

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtapratīkaṃ va ṛtasya dhūrṣadamagniṃ mitraṃ na samidhāna ṛñjate /
meaning: घृतप्रतीकं व ऋतस्य धूर्षदमग्निं मित्रं न समिधान ऋञ्जते /
text_mt: "Agni, whose face is butter, who sits at the yoke of truth, they praise as a friend when kindling;

sanskrit_iast: indhāno akro vidatheṣu dīdyacchukravarṇāmudu no yaṃsate dhiyamiti vaiśyasya
meaning: इन्धानो अक्रो विदथेषु दीद्यच्छुक्रवर्णामुदु नो यंसते धियमिति वैश्यस्य
text_mt: The banner shining bright at the rites, burning, shall extend for us shining insight"—these are for a Vaiśya.
At the [placing of] the firewood sticks, he gives three heifers.
The Brāhmaṇas eat the boiled rice.
To those who have eaten, he gives an equal choice boon.

sanskrit_iast: yasminnakṣatre 'gnimādhāsyansyāttasminsaṃvatsare purastādetāḥ samidha ādadhyāddvādaśāhe dvyahe tryaha ekāhe vā
meaning: यस्मिन्नक्षत्रे ऽग्निमाधास्यन्स्यात्तस्मिन्संवत्सरे पुरस्तादेताः समिध आदध्याद्द्वादशाहे द्व्यहे त्र्यह एकाहे वा
text_mt: Under whatever asterism he intends to establish the fires, under that [same asterism] a year beforehand he should place these firewood sticks, or twelve days, or two days, or three days, or one day beforehand.
They must indeed be placed by one establishing the fire.

sanskrit_iast: atha vrataṃ carati na māṃsamaśnāti na striyamupaiti nāsyāgniṃ gṛhāddharanti nānyata āharanti
meaning: अथ व्रतं चरति न मांसमश्नाति न स्त्रियमुपैति नास्याग्निं गृहाद्धरन्ति नान्यत आहरन्ति
text_mt: Then he observes a vow: he does not eat meat, he does not approach a woman, they do not carry his fire away from the house, nor do they bring in [fire] from elsewhere.
He should remain for a year with the brahmaudana fire.
If the domestic fire has been established, his fire-rites are performed in this [fire].

sanskrit_iast: yadi prayāyādanu vā gacchedbrahmaudanaṃ paktvaitayaivāvṛtā samidha ādadhyāt
meaning: यदि प्रयायादनु वा गच्छेद्ब्रह्मौदनं पक्त्वैतयैवावृता समिध आदध्यात्
text_mt: If he goes on a journey or if it goes out, having cooked the brahmaudana, he should place the firewood sticks by this very ritual procedure.

sanskrit_iast: yadyenaṃ saṃvatsare 'gnyādheyaṃ nopanamedbrahmaudanaṃ paktvā samidha ādhāya yadainamupanamedathādadhīta
meaning: यद्येनं संवत्सरे ऽग्न्याधेयं नोपनमेद्ब्रह्मौदनं पक्त्वा समिध आधाय यदैनमुपनमेदथादधीत
text_mt: If the establishment of the fires does not present itself to him in the course of the year, having cooked the brahmaudana and placed the firewood sticks, he should establish [the fires] whenever it presents itself to him.
Concerning it, there is free choice among the modes of maintaining [the fire].
He should observe [the vow] for twelve days or for one day.
Intending to establish [the fires] on the morrow, he cooks the brahmaudana again.

sanskrit_iast: yo 'syāgnimādhāsyan syāt sa etāṃ rātriṃ vrataṃ carati na māṃsam aśnāti na striyam upaiti
meaning: यो ऽस्याग्निमाधास्यन् स्यात् स एतां रात्रिं व्रतं चरति न मांसम् अश्नाति न स्त्रियम् उपैति
text_mt: Whoever is about to establish his fires observes a vow on that night: he does not eat meat, he does not approach a woman.
"Settle the offspring, O Agni, and the quarters together with the beasts;

sanskrit_iast: rāṣṭrāṇyasmā ādhehi yānyāsansavituḥ sava ity uttareṇa gārhapatyāyatanaṃ kalmāṣamajaṃ badhnāti
meaning: राष्ट्राण्यस्मा आधेहि यान्यासन्सवितुः सव इत्य् उत्तरेण गार्हपत्यायतनं कल्माषमजं बध्नाति
text_mt: Establish for him the realms that were in the impulsion of Savitṛ"—with this, he binds a spotted he-goat to the north of the gārhapatya fire-hearth.

sanskrit_iast: atha yajamāno vratamupaiti vācaṃ ca yacchatyanṛtātsatyamupaimi mānuṣāddaivyamupaimi daivīṃ vācaṃ yacchāmīti
meaning: अथ यजमानो व्रतमुपैति वाचं च यच्छत्यनृतात्सत्यमुपैमि मानुषाद्दैव्यमुपैमि दैवीं वाचं यच्छामीति
text_mt: Then the sacrificer undertakes the vow and restrains his speech, [saying:] "From untruth I enter upon truth; from the human I enter upon the divine; I restrain divine speech."
They keep him awake on that night with lute and flute.

sanskrit_iast: api vā na jāgarti na vācaṃ yacchati
meaning: अपि वा न जागर्ति न वाचं यच्छति
text_mt: Or rather, he does not stay awake, nor does he restrain speech.

sanskrit_iast: śalkairetāṃ rātrimetamagnimindhāna āste śalkairagnimindhāna ubhau lokau sanemaham /
meaning: शल्कैरेतां रात्रिमेतमग्निमिन्धान आस्ते शल्कैरग्निमिन्धान उभौ लोकौ सनेमहम् /
text_mt: Kindling this fire with chips of wood through that night, he sits, [reciting:] "Kindling the fire with chips of wood, may I win both worlds;
Prospering in both worlds, may I cross beyond death"—with this verse.

sanskrit_iast: tasminnupavyuṣamaraṇī niṣṭapati jātavedo bhuvanasya reta iha siñca tapaso yajjaniṣyate /
meaning: तस्मिन्नुपव्युषमरणी निष्टपति जातवेदो भुवनस्य रेत इह सिञ्च तपसो यज्जनिष्यते /
text_mt: Over it, toward daybreak, he heats the churning sticks, [reciting:] "O Jātavedas, pour here the seed of the world, that which shall be born of heat,
Generating Agni, the oblation-bearer, from the aśvattha born of the śamī, the source of delight;

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviya ity etābhyām
meaning: अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्विय इत्य् एताभ्याम्
text_mt: This is your seasonal womb..."—with these two [verses].
"Agni drives away the demons, bright-flaming, immortal;

sanskrit_iast: śuciḥ pāvaka īḍya ityaraṇī abhimantrya mahī viśpatnī sadane ṛtasyārvācī etaṃ dharuṇe rayīṇām /
meaning: शुचिः पावक ईड्य इत्यरणी अभिमन्त्र्य मही विश्पत्नी सदने ऋतस्यार्वाची एतं धरुणे रयीणाम् /
text_mt: Pure, purifying, praiseworthy"—having addressed the two churning sticks with this verse; the sacrificer looks at the two churning sticks as they are being brought, [reciting:] "Great ones, mistresses of the clan, in the seat of truth, come hither, O two supports of wealth; / pregnant, give birth to the people's Jātavedas, the leader of the rites."

sanskrit_iast: antarvatnī janyaṃ jātavedasamadhvarāṇāṃ janayathaḥ purogāmityaraṇī āhriyamāṇe yajamānaḥ pratīkṣate
meaning: अन्तर्वत्नी जन्यं जातवेदसमध्वराणां जनयथः पुरोगामित्यरणी आह्रियमाणे यजमानः प्रतीक्षते
text_mt: He gives [them] to the sacrificer, saying: "She who is to be milked, and she who bears milk, and she who is fertile: I give you your share."

sanskrit_iast: dohyā ca te dugdhabhṛccorvarī te te bhāgadheyaṃ prayacchāmīti yajamānāya prayacchati
meaning: दोह्या च ते दुग्धभृच्चोर्वरी ते ते भागधेयं प्रयच्छामीति यजमानाय प्रयच्छति
text_mt: "Mount the ten Śakvarī verses of mine, along with an immortal lifespan, O Agni, with splendour;

sanskrit_iast: ārohataṃ daśataṃ śakvarīrmamartenāgna āyuṣā varcasā saha /
meaning: आरोहतं दशतं शक्वरीर्ममर्तेनाग्न आयुषा वर्चसा सह /

sanskrit_iast: jyogjīvanta uttarāmuttarāṃ samāṃ darśamahaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ yajñaṃ yathā yajā iti pratigṛhyartviyavatī stho agniretasau garbhaṃ dadhāthāṃ te vāmahaṃ dade /
meaning: ज्योग्जीवन्त उत्तरामुत्तरां समां दर्शमहं पूर्णमासं यज्ञं यथा यजा इति प्रतिगृह्यर्त्वियवती स्थो अग्निरेतसौ गर्भं दधाथां ते वामहं ददे /
text_mt: ‘So that I may sacrifice, living a long life, year after year, with the New and Full Moon sacrifices,’ having accepted [them with this formula, he recites]: ‘You two possess the proper season, bearing the seed of Agni; bear the embryo! I receive the two of you.’
‘That is true, since you bear a hero, you will bring forth a hero.’

sanskrit_iast: te matprātaḥ prajaniṣyethe te mā prajāte prajanayiṣyathaḥ /
meaning: ते मत्प्रातः प्रजनिष्येथे ते मा प्रजाते प्रजनयिष्यथः /
text_mt: ‘You two shall be born from me in the morning; having been born, you shall bring forth for me’

sanskrit_iast: prajayā paśubhirbrahmavarcasena suvarge loka iti pratigṛhyābhimantrayate yajamānaḥ
meaning: प्रजया पशुभिर्ब्रह्मवर्चसेन सुवर्गे लोक इति प्रतिगृह्याभिमन्त्रयते यजमानः
text_mt: ‘offspring, cattle, spiritual luster, in the heavenly world.’ Having accepted [them], the sacrificer addresses [them].

sanskrit_iast: mayi gṛhṇāmyagre agniṃ yo no agniḥ pitara ity ubhau japataḥ /
meaning: मयि गृह्णाम्यग्रे अग्निं यो नो अग्निः पितर इत्य् उभौ जपतः /
text_mt: Both mutter: ‘I take into myself Agni first…’, ‘Whatever fire of ours, O fathers…’

sanskrit_iast: apeta vīteti gārhapatyāyatanamuddhatya śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya ityadbhiravokṣati
meaning: अपेत वीतेति गार्हपत्यायतनमुद्धत्य शं नो देवीरभिष्टय इत्यद्भिरवोक्षति
text_mt: Having dug up the hearth of the gārhapatya with ‘Begone, disperse!’, he sprinkles it with water using ‘May the divine waters be for our welfare and aid…’
In this same way [he proceeds] for the dakṣiṇāgni, the āhavanīya, and the sabhya and āvasathya.
In this very order are the rites performed henceforth on these [hearths].

sanskrit_iast: sikatānāmardhaṃ dvaidhaṃ vibhajyārdhaṃ gārhapatyāyatane nivapaty ardhaṃ dakṣiṇāgneḥ /
meaning: सिकतानामर्धं द्वैधं विभज्यार्धं गार्हपत्यायतने निवपत्य् अर्धं दक्षिणाग्नेः /
text_mt: Dividing half of the sand into two parts, he scatters half in the hearth of the gārhapatya and half in that of the dakṣiṇāgni.
Dividing the [other] half into three parts, [he scatters them] on the eastern [hearths].
According to this very rule he scatters all the earthen materials.
He scatters the sand with: ‘You are the ash of Agni.’
Scattering them, he meditates in his mind: ‘What is black in yonder moon, let that be here.’

sanskrit_iast: udehyagne adhi mātuḥ pṛthivyā viśa āviśa mahataḥ sadhasthāt /
meaning: उदेह्यग्ने अधि मातुः पृथिव्या विश आविश महतः सधस्थात् /
text_mt: ‘Rise up, O Agni, upon Mother Earth! Enter into the settlements from the great dwelling!’

sanskrit_iast: ākhuṃ tvā ye dadhire devayanto havyavāhaṃ bhuvanasya gopāmityākhukarīṣam //
meaning: आखुं त्वा ये दधिरे देवयन्तो हव्यवाहं भुवनस्य गोपामित्याखुकरीषम् //
text_mt: ‘Thee, whom god-fearing men set as a mole, as the carrier of oblations, the protector of the world…’—with this, [he scatters] the earth from a mole-hill.
‘That immortal part of the earth which arose in union with thee,’
‘which Agni gave to Agni: on that let this one be established’—with this he scatters the ant-hill earth in the hearth of the gārhapatya.
With ‘That of the midspace…’ on that of the dakṣiṇāgni.
‘From the ocean has arisen the sweet wave, bringing supreme sovereignty further forward;’

sanskrit_iast: amī ca ye maghavāno vayaṃ ceṣamūrjaṃ madhumatsaṃbharemeti sūdam /
meaning: अमी च ये मघवानो वयं चेषमूर्जं मधुमत्संभरेमेति सूदम् /
text_mt: ‘may we and those generous patrons gather sweet food and strength’—with this [he deposits] mud from a dried pool.
With ‘So large you were at first…’ [he scatters] earth dug up by a boar.

sanskrit_iast: ado devī prathamānā pṛthagyaddevairnyuptā vyasarpo mahitvā /
meaning: अदो देवी प्रथमाना पृथग्यद्देवैर्न्युप्ता व्यसर्पो महित्वा /
text_mt: ‘Yonder goddess, spreading afar, which, scattered by the gods, spread out in greatness,’
‘you grew firm with gravel; conquering the three worlds, you won the realms and four quarters’—with this [he scatters] gravel.
And he meditates in mind on the one he hates.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtaṃ stṛṇāmi purīṣaṃ pṛthivyāmṛte 'dhyagnimādadhe satye 'dhyagnimādadha ity āyataneṣu saṃbhārānanuvyūhati
meaning: ऋतं स्तृणामि पुरीषं पृथिव्यामृते ऽध्यग्निमादधे सत्ये ऽध्यग्निमादध इत्य् आयतनेषु संभाराननुव्यूहति
text_mt: ‘I strew order, the filling, on earth; upon order I place Agni, upon truth I place Agni’—with this he spreads out the materials in the hearths.

sanskrit_iast: saṃ yā vaḥ priyāstanuva ity eṣā //
meaning: सं या वः प्रियास्तनुव इत्य् एषा //
text_mt: This [verse]: ‘Those dear forms of yours that are together…’

sanskrit_iast: saṃ vaḥ sṛjāmi hṛdayāni saṃsṛṣṭaṃ mano astu vaḥ /
meaning: सं वः सृजामि हृदयानि संसृष्टं मनो अस्तु वः /
text_mt: ‘I unite your hearts; united let your mind be;’

sanskrit_iast: saṃsṛṣṭaḥ prāṇo astu va iti vānaspatyānsaṃsṛjya sikatāvannivapatītaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe agnir ity etayā
meaning: संसृष्टः प्राणो अस्तु व इति वानस्पत्यान्संसृज्य सिकतावन्निवपतीतः प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निर् इत्य् एतया
text_mt: ‘united let your breath be’—having mixed together the wooden materials [with this formula], he scatters them like the sand, with this [verse]: ‘From here first Agni was born…’

sanskrit_iast: yāste śivāstanuvo jātavedo yā antarikṣe divi yāḥ pṛthivyām /
meaning: यास्ते शिवास्तनुवो जातवेदो या अन्तरिक्षे दिवि याः पृथिव्याम् /
text_mt: ‘Those auspicious forms of yours, O Jātavedas, which are in the midspace, which in heaven, which on earth—’

sanskrit_iast: tābhiḥ saṃbhūya sagaṇaḥ sajoṣā hiraṇyayonirvaha havyamagna iti gārhapatyāyatane sauvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaśakalamuttarataḥ saṃbhāreṣūpāsyati
meaning: ताभिः संभूय सगणः सजोषा हिरण्ययोनिर्वह हव्यमग्न इति गार्हपत्यायतने सौवर्णं हिरण्यशकलमुत्तरतः संभारेषूपास्यति
text_mt: ‘uniting with them, along with your troop, being gracious, of golden womb, carry the oblation, O Agni!’ With this, he casts a piece of gold onto the materials on the north side in the gārhapatya hearth.
‘The shining Agni, with shining chariot, golden-skinned, belonging to all men, seated in the waters, finding the sun,’

sanskrit_iast: vigāhaṃ tūrṇiṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtaṃ bhūrṇiṃ devāsa iha suśriyaṃ dadhur ity upāstam abhimantrayate /
meaning: विगाहं तूर्णिं तविषीभिरावृतं भूर्णिं देवास इह सुश्रियं दधुर् इत्य् उपास्तम् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: ‘penetrating, swift, clothed in strengths, eager, the gods have set here of good fortune’—with this he addresses what was cast down.
He gives silver to the person he hates.

sanskrit_iast: yadi dveṣyaṃ nādhigacchedyāṃ diśaṃ dveṣyaḥ syāttena nirasyet
meaning: यदि द्वेष्यं नाधिगच्छेद्यां दिशं द्वेष्यः स्यात्तेन निरस्येत्
text_mt: If he should not find anyone he hates, he should cast it away in the direction in which someone he hates might be.
Thus he does, casting [gold] into all [the hearths].
Having removed the ashes from the brāhmaudana fire, in it he churns out the fire from [the churning-sticks made of] śamī-wood holding an aśvattha tree within.
When the sun's rays are rising, he puts the two churning-sticks together with the daśahotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: sahāgne 'gninā jāyasva saha rayyā saha puṣṭyā saha prajayā saha paśubhiḥ saha brahmavarcasenetyupatiṣṭhatyaśve 'gniṃ manthati
meaning: सहाग्ने ऽग्निना जायस्व सह रय्या सह पुष्ट्या सह प्रजया सह पशुभिः सह ब्रह्मवर्चसेनेत्युपतिष्ठत्यश्वे ऽग्निं मन्थति
text_mt: With ‘O Agni, be born along with the fire, along with wealth, along with nourishment, along with offspring, along with cattle, along with spiritual luster!’, he attends [it]; he churns the fire on a horse.

sanskrit_iast: śveto 'śvo 'viklinnākṣo bhavati rohito vāsitajānurapi vā ya eva kaścitsāṇḍaḥ
meaning: श्वेतो ऽश्वो ऽविक्लिन्नाक्षो भवति रोहितो वासितजानुरपि वा य एव कश्चित्साण्डः
text_mt: The horse is white with clear eyes, or reddish with black knees, or indeed any uncastrated horse whatsoever.
While it is being churned, he sings the Sāman of Śakti, the son of Saṅkṛti.
When smoke has arisen, [the Sāman] of Gāthin, the son of Kuśika;
and [he recites]: ‘Jātavedas is laid down in the two churning-sticks…’
With ‘Come down, O Jātavedas!’, he addresses the [fire] being produced.
Here he causes the sacrificer to recite the caturhotṛ formulas.

sanskrit_iast: ajannagniḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvebhyaḥ pavamānaḥ śuciḥ pāvaka īḍya iti jātamabhimantrayate
meaning: अजन्नग्निः पूर्वः पूर्वेभ्यः पवमानः शुचिः पावक ईड्य इति जातमभिमन्त्रयते
text_mt: With ‘Agni was born, the former for the former ones, the purifying, pure, cleansing, to be praised’, he addresses [the fire] once it is born.
When it is born, the sacrificer gives a choice gift.

sanskrit_iast: gaur vai varo 'tivaro 'nyo dhenurvaro 'tivaro 'nyo 'naḍvānvaro 'tivaro 'nyaḥ paṣṭhauhī varo 'tivaro 'nyaḥ
meaning: गौर् वै वरो ऽतिवरो ऽन्यो धेनुर्वरो ऽतिवरो ऽन्यो ऽनड्वान्वरो ऽतिवरो ऽन्यः पष्ठौही वरो ऽतिवरो ऽन्यः
text_mt: A cow is indeed a choice gift; another is an extra choice gift: a milch cow is a choice gift, another is an extra choice gift; an ox is a choice gift, another is an extra choice gift; a four-year-old cow is a choice gift, another is an extra choice gift.

sanskrit_iast: jātaṃ yajamāno 'bhiprāṇiti prajāpatestvā prāṇenābhiprāṇimi pūṣṇaḥ poṣeṇa mahyaṃ dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya śataṃ śaradbhya āyuṣe varcase jīvātvai puṇyāyeti
meaning: जातं यजमानो ऽभिप्राणिति प्रजापतेस्त्वा प्राणेनाभिप्राणिमि पूष्णः पोषेण मह्यं दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय शतं शरद्भ्य आयुषे वर्चसे जीवात्वै पुण्यायेति
text_mt: The sacrificer breathes upon [the fire] once born: ‘I breathe upon you with the breath of Prajāpati, with the nourishment of Pūṣan, for my long life, for a hundred autumns, for a life of a hundred autumns, for luster, for living, for holy merit.’
‘Mortals have generated the immortal, the unfailing, the swift, with strong jaws;’

sanskrit_iast: daśa svasāro agruvaḥ samīcīḥ pumāṃsaṃ jātamabhisaṃrabhantāmiti jātamañjalinābhigṛhya samrāḍasi virāḍasi sārasvatau tvotsau samindhātāmannādaṃ tvānnapatyāyetyupasamidhyāthainaṃ prāñcamuddhṛtyāsīnaḥ sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāmantena rathaṃtare gīyamāne yajñāyajñīye ca yatharṣyādhānena prathamayā vyāhṛtyā dvābhyāṃ vā prathamābhyāṃ ca sarparājñībhyāṃ prathamena ca gharmaśirasā
meaning: दश स्वसारो अग्रुवः समीचीः पुमांसं जातमभिसंरभन्तामिति जातमञ्जलिनाभिगृह्य सम्राडसि विराडसि सारस्वतौ त्वोत्सौ समिन्धातामन्नादं त्वान्नपत्यायेत्युपसमिध्याथैनं प्राञ्चमुद्धृत्यासीनः सर्वेषां मन्त्राणामन्तेन रथंतरे गीयमाने यज्ञायज्ञीये च यथर्ष्याधानेन प्रथमया व्याहृत्या द्वाभ्यां वा प्रथमाभ्यां च सर्पराज्ञीभ्यां प्रथमेन च घर्मशिरसा
text_mt: ‘may the ten unwedded sisters together take hold of the male born’—having taken up the born [fire] with cupped hands with this, having kindled it with ‘You are an emperor, you are a sovereign ruler, may the two Sarasvatī springs kindle you; you, the consumer of food, for food-lordship’, then lifting it eastward while seated, at the end of all the formulas, while the Rathaṃtara and Yajñāyajñīya [sāmans] are being sung, with the formula of establishment according to the ṛṣi lineage, with the first vyāhṛti or with the two first ones, and with the two first sarparājñī verses, and with the first gharmaśiras formula—

sanskrit_iast: bhṛgūṇāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratapate vratenādadhāmīti bhārgavasyādadhyāt /
meaning: भृगूणां त्वा देवानां व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीति भार्गवस्यादध्यात् /
text_mt: for a descendant of Bhṛgu he should establish it with: ‘By the vow of the Bhṛgus, the gods, O lord of vows, I establish you’;

sanskrit_iast: aṅgirasāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratapate vratenādadhāmīti yo brāhmaṇa āṅgirasaḥ syāt /
meaning: अङ्गिरसां त्वा देवानां व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीति यो ब्राह्मण आङ्गिरसः स्यात् /
text_mt: for a brāhmaṇa who is an Āṅgirasa, with: ‘By the vow of the Aṅgirases, the gods, O lord of vows, I establish you’;

sanskrit_iast: ādityānāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratapate vratenādadhāmītyanyāsāṃ brāhmaṇīnāṃ prajānām /
meaning: आदित्यानां त्वा देवानां व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीत्यन्यासां ब्राह्मणीनां प्रजानाम् /
text_mt: for other brāhmaṇa descendants, with: ‘By the vow of the Ādityas, the gods, O lord of vows, I establish you’;

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasya tvā rājño vratapate vratenādadhāmīti rājñaḥ /
meaning: वरुणस्य त्वा राज्ञो व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीति राज्ञः /
text_mt: for a king, with: ‘By the vow of King Varuṇa, O lord of vows, I establish you’;
for a rājanya, with: ‘By the power of Indra, O lord of vows, I establish you’;
for a vaiśya, with: ‘By the vow of Manu, the village headman, O lord of vows, I establish you’;

sanskrit_iast: ṛbhūṇāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratapate vratenādadhāmīti rathakārasyeti yatharṣyādhānāni
meaning: ऋभूणां त्वा देवानां व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीति रथकारस्येति यथर्ष्याधानानि
text_mt: for a chariot-maker, with: ‘By the vow of the Ṛbhus, the gods, O lord of vows, I establish you’—these are the establishments according to the ṛṣi lineage.
The vyāhṛtis are bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, suvaḥ.
With ‘The earth by broadness…’ [he recites] the Sarparājñī verses.
‘The head is the gharma; may this Agni here become dear to the cattle!’
‘Grant shelter to our offspring, to our children.’
‘The out-breath is the wind; may this Agni here become dear to the cattle!’
‘Cook food tasty for our offspring, for our children.’
‘The eye is the sun; that is the sun yonder; may this Agni here become dear to the cattle!’

sanskrit_iast: yatte śukra śaukraṃ varcaḥ śukrā tanūḥ śukraṃ jyotirajasraṃ tena me dīdihi tena tvādadhe 'gnināgne brahmaṇeti gharmaśirāṃsi
meaning: यत्ते शुक्र शौक्रं वर्चः शुक्रा तनूः शुक्रं ज्योतिरजस्रं तेन मे दीदिहि तेन त्वादधे ऽग्निनाग्ने ब्रह्मणेति घर्मशिरांसि
text_mt: ‘Whatever bright radiance of thine is brilliant, O bright one, whatever body is bright, whatever light is bright and unceasing, shine with that for me; with that I set thee down, with Agni, O Agni, with Brahman’—these are the Gharma-heads.

sanskrit_iast: yāste śivāstanuvo jātavedo yā antarikṣa uta pārthivīryāḥ /
meaning: यास्ते शिवास्तनुवो जातवेदो या अन्तरिक्ष उत पार्थिवीर्याः /
text_mt: ‘Whatever auspicious bodies of thine [there are], O Jātavedas, which are in the intermediate space, and which are of the earth—

sanskrit_iast: tābhiḥ saṃbhūya sagaṇaḥ sajoṣā hiraṇyayonirvaha havyamagne //
meaning: ताभिः संभूय सगणः सजोषा हिरण्ययोनिर्वह हव्यमग्ने //
text_mt: uniting with these, having thy troop, being in agreement, possessing a golden womb, carry the oblation, O Agni!’
