‘I establish thee as out-breath in the immortal, food-eater for eating food, protector for protection.’

sanskrit_iast: divastvā vīryeṇa pṛthivyai mahimnāntarikṣasya poṣeṇa paśūnāṃ tejasā sarvapaśumādadhe //
meaning: दिवस्त्वा वीर्येण पृथिव्यै महिम्नान्तरिक्षस्य पोषेण पशूनां तेजसा सर्वपशुमादधे //
text_mt: ‘By the virility of heaven, by the greatness of earth, by the nourishment of intermediate space, by the splendour of cattle, I establish thee, possessing all cattle.’

sanskrit_iast: agne gṛhapate 'he budhnya pariṣadya divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣāllokaṃ vinda yajamānāya /
meaning: अग्ने गृहपते ऽहे बुध्न्य परिषद्य दिवः पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षाल्लोकं विन्द यजमानाय /
text_mt: ‘O Agni, lord of the house, Ahi Budhnya, attendant, from heaven, from earth, from intermediate space find a place for the sacrificer!’
‘I seat thee on the head of earth in the sacrificial place.’

sanskrit_iast: yo no agne niṣṭyo yo 'niṣṭyo 'bhidāsatīdamahaṃ taṃ tvayābhinidadhāmīti saṃbhāreṣu nidadhāti
meaning: यो नो अग्ने निष्ट्यो यो ऽनिष्ट्यो ऽभिदासतीदमहं तं त्वयाभिनिदधामीति संभारेषु निदधाति
text_mt: ‘O Agni, whether related or unrelated, whoever attacks us, here I place him down with thee’—[saying this,] he places [the fire] down upon the ritual requisites.
‘Being a good master of the household, burning down enemies, bringing ever better dawns,

sanskrit_iast: agne sapatnām̐ apabādhamāno rāyaspoṣamiṣamūrjamasmāsu dhehītyādhīyamānamabhimantrayate yajamāno ghramaśirāṃsi cainamadhvaryurvācayati
meaning: अग्ने सपत्नाम्̐ अपबाधमानो रायस्पोषमिषमूर्जमस्मासु धेहीत्याधीयमानमभिमन्त्रयते यजमानो घ्रमशिरांसि चैनमध्वर्युर्वाचयति
text_mt: O Agni, repelling rivals, place in us increase of wealth, food, and vigour’—with this the sacrificer addresses [the fire] being established, and the adhvaryu has him recite the Gharma-heads.
When the sun is half-risen, he establishes the āhavanīya.
When it has fully risen, for one who desires spiritual splendour.
He kindles on the gārhapatya the carrying firewood-bundle of aśvattha wood, and prepares the sand acting as underlayer.

sanskrit_iast: tamudyacchatyojase balāya tvodyacche vṛṣaṇe śuṣmāyāyuṣe varcase /
meaning: तमुद्यच्छत्योजसे बलाय त्वोद्यच्छे वृषणे शुष्मायायुषे वर्चसे /
text_mt: He lifts it up with: ‘For vigor, for strength I lift thee up, for the bull, for energy, for life, for radiance.’
‘Thou art the slayer of rivals, the slayer of Vṛtra.’

sanskrit_iast: yaste deveṣu mahimā suvargo yasta ātmā paśuṣu praviṣṭaḥ /
meaning: यस्ते देवेषु महिमा सुवर्गो यस्त आत्मा पशुषु प्रविष्टः /
text_mt: ‘Whatever greatness of thine among the gods is heavenly, whatever self of thine has entered into cattle,

sanskrit_iast: puṣṭiryā te manuṣyeṣu paprathe tayā no agne juṣamāṇa ehi //
meaning: पुष्टिर्या ते मनुष्येषु पप्रथे तया नो अग्ने जुषमाण एहि //
text_mt: whatever nourishment of thine has extended among men, with that, O Agni, being pleased, come to us!’
‘From heaven, from earth, from intermediate space, from the wind, from cattle, from the plants,

sanskrit_iast: yatrayatra jātavedaḥ saṃbabhūtha tato no agne juṣamāṇa ehi //
meaning: यत्रयत्र जातवेदः संबभूथ ततो नो अग्ने जुषमाण एहि //
text_mt: wherever, O Jātavedas, thou hast arisen, from there, O Agni, being pleased, come to us!’

sanskrit_iast: udu tvā viśve devā ity etābhiścatasṛbhiḥ
meaning: उदु त्वा विश्वे देवा इत्य् एताभिश्चतसृभिः
text_mt: [He lifts it up] with these four [verses] beginning with: ‘The All-gods [have lifted] thee up…’
He lifts the fire somewhat high.
He holds the sand acting as underlayer beneath the lifted fire.

sanskrit_iast: athāśvasya dakṣiṇe karṇe yajamānamagnitanūrvācayati yā vājinnagneḥ paśuṣu pavamānā priyā tanūstāmāvaha yā vājinnagnerapsu pāvakā priyā tanūstāmāvaha yā vājinnagneḥ sūrye śuciḥ priyā tanūstāmāvaheti /
meaning: अथाश्वस्य दक्षिणे कर्णे यजमानमग्नितनूर्वाचयति या वाजिन्नग्नेः पशुषु पवमाना प्रिया तनूस्तामावह या वाजिन्नग्नेरप्सु पावका प्रिया तनूस्तामावह या वाजिन्नग्नेः सूर्ये शुचिः प्रिया तनूस्तामावहेति /
text_mt: Then he makes the sacrificer recite into the right ear of the horse the Agni-bodies: ‘O swift courser, bring that dear body of Agni which purifies among cattle; O swift courser, bring that dear body of Agni which is pure in the waters; O swift courser, bring that dear body of Agni which is radiant in the sun.’

sanskrit_iast: athāgnīdhro laukikamagnimāhṛtya mathitvā vordhvajñurāsīno dakṣiṇāmagnimādadhāti yajñāyajñīye gīyamāne yatharṣyādhānena dvitīyayā vyāhṛtyā tiṣrbhiḥ sarparājñībhirdvitīyena ca gharmaśirasā //
meaning: अथाग्नीध्रो लौकिकमग्निमाहृत्य मथित्वा वोर्ध्वज्ञुरासीनो दक्षिणामग्निमादधाति यज्ञायज्ञीये गीयमाने यथर्ष्याधानेन द्वितीयया व्याहृत्या तिष्र्भिः सर्पराज्ञीभिर्द्वितीयेन च घर्मशिरसा //
text_mt: Then the agnīdh, having fetched secular fire or having churned it, sitting with his right knee raised, establishes the dakṣiṇa fire while the Yajñāyajñīya is being sung, with the establishment formula according to his seer, with the second vyāhṛti, with three Sarparājñī verses, and with the second Gharma-head:

sanskrit_iast: yāste śivāstanuvo jātavedo yā antarikṣa uta pārthivīryāḥ /
meaning: यास्ते शिवास्तनुवो जातवेदो या अन्तरिक्ष उत पार्थिवीर्याः /
text_mt: ‘Whatever auspicious bodies of thine [there are], O Jātavedas, which are in the intermediate space, and which are of the earth—
uniting with these, having thy troop, being in agreement, possessing a golden womb, carry the oblation, O Agni!’
‘I establish thee as diffused breath in the immortal, food-eater for eating food, protector for protection.’

sanskrit_iast: divastvā vīryeṇa pṛthivyai mahimnāntarikṣasya poṣeṇa paśūnāṃ tejasā sarvapaśumādadhe //
meaning: दिवस्त्वा वीर्येण पृथिव्यै महिम्नान्तरिक्षस्य पोषेण पशूनां तेजसा सर्वपशुमादधे //
text_mt: ‘By the virility of heaven, by the greatness of earth, by the nourishment of intermediate space, by the splendour of cattle, I establish thee, possessing all cattle.’

sanskrit_iast: agne 'nnapā mayobhuva suśevadivaḥ pṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣāllokaṃ vinda yajamānāya /
meaning: अग्ने ऽन्नपा मयोभुव सुशेवदिवः पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षाल्लोकं विन्द यजमानाय /
text_mt: ‘O Agni, guardian of food, bringing delight, gracious one, from heaven, from earth, from intermediate space find a place for the sacrificer!’
‘I seat thee on the head of earth in the sacrificial place.’

sanskrit_iast: yo no agne niṣṭyo yo 'niṣṭyo 'bhidāsatīdamahaṃ taṃ tvayābhinidadhāmīti saṃbhāreṣu nidadhāti
meaning: यो नो अग्ने निष्ट्यो यो ऽनिष्ट्यो ऽभिदासतीदमहं तं त्वयाभिनिदधामीति संभारेषु निदधाति
text_mt: ‘O Agni, whether related or unrelated, whoever attacks us, here I place him down with thee’—[saying this,] he places [the fire] down upon the ritual requisites.

sanskrit_iast: yo brāhmaṇo rājanyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vāsura iva bahupuṣṭaḥ syāttasya gṛhādāhṛtyādadhyātpuṣṭikāmasya
meaning: यो ब्राह्मणो राजन्यो वैश्यः शूद्रो वासुर इव बहुपुष्टः स्यात्तस्य गृहादाहृत्यादध्यात्पुष्टिकामस्य
text_mt: For one who desires prosperity, he should establish [the dakṣiṇa fire] having brought it from the house of a brāhmaṇa, a rājanya, a vaiśya, or a śūdra, who is very prosperous like an Asura.
However, he should not eat in his house afterwards.
For one who desires food, [it should be taken] from a frying pan; for one who desires spiritual splendour, from a blazing treetop.
They sing the Vāmadevya chant as the āhavanīya is being taken out.
This [verse] is: ‘Along the eastern quarter…’
‘Stride forward; great art thou, a seat on the altar ground for humans;

sanskrit_iast: triṣu lokeṣu jāgṛhi prajayā ca dhanena ca //
meaning: त्रिषु लोकेषु जागृहि प्रजया च धनेन च //
text_mt: watch over the three worlds with offspring and with wealth!’

sanskrit_iast: imā u māmupatiṣṭhantu rāya ābhiḥ prajābhiriha saṃvaseya /
meaning: इमा उ मामुपतिष्ठन्तु राय आभिः प्रजाभिरिह संवसेय /
text_mt: ‘May these riches approach me; may I dwell here together with these offspring;

sanskrit_iast: iho iḍā tiṣṭhatu viśvarūpī madhye vasordīdihi jātaveda iti prāñco 'śvaprathamā abhipravrajanti
meaning: इहो इडा तिष्ठतु विश्वरूपी मध्ये वसोर्दीदिहि जातवेद इति प्राञ्चो ऽश्वप्रथमा अभिप्रव्रजन्ति
text_mt: may all-formed Iḍā dwell here; shine in the midst of wealth, O Jātavedas!’—with these [verses] they march forward towards the east, preceded by the horse.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇato brahmā rathaṃ rathaṃ rathacakraṃ vā vartayati yāvaccakraṃ triḥ parivartate
meaning: दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा रथं रथं रथचक्रं वा वर्तयति यावच्चक्रं त्रिः परिवर्तते
text_mt: To the south the brahman rolls a chariot or a chariot wheel, so long as the wheel turns around three times.

sanskrit_iast: jānudaghne dhārayamāṇastṛtīyamadhvano 'gniṃ harati nābhidaghne tṛtīyamāsyadaghne tṛtīyam /
meaning: जानुदघ्ने धारयमाणस्तृतीयमध्वनो ऽग्निं हरति नाभिदघ्ने तृतीयमास्यदघ्ने तृतीयम् /
text_mt: Holding it knee-high, he carries the fire for a third of the way; navel-high for a third; mouth-high for a third.
He does not lift it higher than ear-height.
If, having raised it, he should lower it, he should establish it after measuring it with his mouth.
He should not step between the fire and the sun.
Grasping it from the south, he carries it.
Halfway along the path, the sacrificer gives a boon.

sanskrit_iast: ardhādhve hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya nāko 'si bradhnaḥ pratiṣṭhā saṃkramaṇa ityatikrāmati
meaning: अर्धाध्वे हिरण्यं निधाय नाको ऽसि ब्रध्नः प्रतिष्ठा संक्रमण इत्यतिक्रामति
text_mt: Having placed gold halfway along the path, he steps over it with: ‘Thou art heaven, the sun, the firm foundation, the crossing.’

sanskrit_iast: prāñcamaśvamabhyasthādviśvā iti dakṣiṇena padottarataḥ saṃbhārānākramayati yathāhitasyāgneraṅgārāḥ padamabhyavavarteranniti
meaning: प्राञ्चमश्वमभ्यस्थाद्विश्वा इति दक्षिणेन पदोत्तरतः संभारानाक्रमयति यथाहितस्याग्नेरङ्गाराः पदमभ्यववर्तेरन्निति
text_mt: With ‘He has stepped upon all…’, he makes the horse step upon the ritual requisites northwards with its right foot, facing east, so that the coals of the established fire might roll towards the footprint.
Having turned it clockwise, he makes it step again with: ‘When thou didst neigh…’
He holds the horse in front, facing west.

meaning: तदभावे ऽनड्वान्पूर्ववाडेतानि कर्माणि करोतीति पैङ्गायनिब्राह्मणं भवति
text_mt: In its absence, a previously harnessed ox performs these duties—so states a Paiṅgāyani-brāhmaṇa.
'One should establish [the fire] in the footprint of a water-jar'—thus [says] the Bahvṛca-brāhmaṇa.
'One should establish [it] in the footprint of a goat'—thus the Vājasaneyaka.

sanskrit_iast: atha yajamānaḥ śivā japati ye te agne śive tanuvau virāṭca svarāṭca te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām /
meaning: अथ यजमानः शिवा जपति ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ विराट्च स्वराट्च ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् /
text_mt: Then the sacrificer mutters the auspicious [formulas]: 'Those two auspicious bodies of yours, O Agni, Virāj and Svarāj, let them enter me, let them invigorate me!

sanskrit_iast: ye te agne śive tanuvau samrāṭcābhibhūśca te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām /
meaning: ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ सम्राट्चाभिभूश्च ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् /
text_mt: Those two auspicious bodies of yours, O Agni, Samrāj and Abhibhū, let them enter me, let them invigorate me!

sanskrit_iast: ye te agne śive tanuvau vibhūśca paribhūśca te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām /
meaning: ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ विभूश्च परिभूश्च ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् /
text_mt: Those two auspicious bodies of yours, O Agni, Vibhū and Paribhū, let them enter me, let them invigorate me!

sanskrit_iast: ye te agne śive tanuvau prabhvī ca prabhūtiśca te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām /
meaning: ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ प्रभ्वी च प्रभूतिश्च ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् /
text_mt: Those two auspicious bodies of yours, O Agni, Prabhvī and Prabhūti, let them enter me, let them invigorate me!
With those auspicious bodies of yours, O Agni, with them I establish you.'

sanskrit_iast: yāste agne ghorāstanuvastābhiramuṃ gaccheti yajamāno dveṣyāya prahiṇoti tābhirenaṃ parābhāvayati
meaning: यास्ते अग्ने घोरास्तनुवस्ताभिरमुं गच्छेति यजमानो द्वेष्याय प्रहिणोति ताभिरेनं पराभावयति
text_mt: With: 'Those terrifying bodies of yours, O Agni, with them go to so-and-so,' the sacrificer dispatches [them] against one who is hated; with them he causes him to perish.
They are to be recited in the wilderness.

sanskrit_iast: yadidaṃ divo yadadaḥ pṛthivyāḥ saṃvidāne rodasī saṃbabhūvatuḥ /
meaning: यदिदं दिवो यददः पृथिव्याः संविदाने रोदसी संबभूवतुः /
text_mt: 'What was here of the sky, what was there of the earth—the two consenting firmaments came together:

sanskrit_iast: tayoḥ pṛṣṭhe sīdatu jātavedāḥ śaṃbhūḥ prajābhyastanuve syona ity abhimantrya purastātpratyaṅ tiṣṭhannāhavanīyamādadhāti
meaning: तयोः पृष्ठे सीदतु जातवेदाः शंभूः प्रजाभ्यस्तनुवे स्योन इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य पुरस्तात्प्रत्यङ् तिष्ठन्नाहवनीयमादधाति
text_mt: on the back of them both let Jātavedas sit, bringing welfare to offspring, gentle to the self'—having addressed [the fire] with this [verse], standing facing west to the east [of the hearth], he establishes the āhavanīya.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhati gīyamāne śyaitavāravantīyayoryajñāyajñīye ca yatharṣyādhānena sarvābhirvyāhṛtībhiḥ sarvābhiḥ sarparājñībhistṛtīyena ca gharmaśirasā yāste śivāstanuvo jātavedo yā antarikṣa uta pārthivīryāḥ /
meaning: बृहति गीयमाने श्यैतवारवन्तीययोर्यज्ञायज्ञीये च यथर्ष्याधानेन सर्वाभिर्व्याहृतीभिः सर्वाभिः सर्पराज्ञीभिस्तृतीयेन च घर्मशिरसा यास्ते शिवास्तनुवो जातवेदो या अन्तरिक्ष उत पार्थिवीर्याः /
text_mt: While the Bṛhat [sāman] is being sung, or the Śyaita and Vāravantīya, or the Yajñāyajñīya, with the establishment according to the ṛṣis, with all the vyāhṛtis, with all the Sarparājñī verses, and with the third Gharmaśiras verse: 'Those auspicious bodies of yours, O Jātavedas, which are in the intermediate space and which are of the earth—

sanskrit_iast: tābhiḥ saṃbhūya sagaṇaḥ sajoṣā hiraṇyayonir vaha havyamagne //
meaning: ताभिः संभूय सगणः सजोषा हिरण्ययोनिर् वह हव्यमग्ने //
text_mt: uniting with them, accompanied by your troop, harmonious, having a golden womb, convey the offering, O Agni!
I establish you, the out-breath, in the immortal, the eater of food for food-eating, the protector for protection!

sanskrit_iast: divastvā vīryeṇa pṛthivyai mahimnāntarikṣasya poṣeṇa paśūnāṃ tejasā sarvapaśumādadhe //
meaning: दिवस्त्वा वीर्येण पृथिव्यै महिम्नान्तरिक्षस्य पोषेण पशूनां तेजसा सर्वपशुमादधे //
text_mt: By the vigor of the sky, by the greatness of the earth, by the nourishment of the intermediate space, by the splendor of cattle, I establish [you], possessing all cattle!

sanskrit_iast: agne samrāḍajaikapādāhavanīya divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣāllokaṃ vinda yajamānāya /
meaning: अग्ने सम्राडजैकपादाहवनीय दिवः पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षाल्लोकं विन्द यजमानाय /
text_mt: O Agni, sovereign, Aja Ekapād, āhavanīya, find a realm for the sacrificer from the sky, from the earth, and around from the intermediate space!
I seat you on the head of the earth, in the sacrificial place!

sanskrit_iast: yo no agne niṣṭyo yo 'niṣṭyo 'bhidāsatīdamahaṃ taṃ tvayābhinidadhāmīti saṃbhāreṣu nidadhāti
meaning: यो नो अग्ने निष्ट्यो यो ऽनिष्ट्यो ऽभिदासतीदमहं तं त्वयाभिनिदधामीति संभारेषु निदधाति
text_mt: Whoever, O Agni, whether an insider or an outsider, assails us, here with you I press him down'—with these words he places [the fire] upon the materials.
'I have attained, I have pervaded, I have attained all lifespan!

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ tvadasmi madasi tvametanmamāsi yonistava yonirasmi /
meaning: अहं त्वदस्मि मदसि त्वमेतन्ममासि योनिस्तव योनिरस्मि /
text_mt: I am from you, you are from me, thus: you are my womb, I am your womb!

sanskrit_iast: mamaiva sanvaha havyānyagne putraḥ pitre lokakṛjjātaveda ity ādhīyamānamabhimantrayate yajamānaḥ
meaning: ममैव सन्वह हव्यान्यग्ने पुत्रः पित्रे लोककृज्जातवेद इत्य् आधीयमानमभिमन्त्रयते यजमानः
text_mt: Being indeed my own, convey the offerings, O Agni, like a son for a father making a place, O Jātavedas'—with these words the sacrificer addresses [the fire] being established.

meaning: व्याहृतीः सर्पराज्ञीर्घर्मशिरांसीति सर्वेष्वाधानेषु यजमानो ऽनुवर्तयते येनयेनादधाति
text_mt: In all establishments, with whichever [formula] he establishes [the fire], the sacrificer repeats along with it the vyāhṛtis, the Sarparājñī verses, and the Gharmaśiras verses.
One does not touch a fire that has been established but not offered into.
It is to be appeased with clarified butter and herbs.

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne paśuṣu pavamānā priyā tanūryā pṛthivyāṃ yāgnau yā rathantare yā gāyatre chandasi tāṃ ta etenāvayaje svāhā /
meaning: या ते अग्ने पशुषु पवमाना प्रिया तनूर्या पृथिव्यां याग्नौ या रथन्तरे या गायत्रे छन्दसि तां त एतेनावयजे स्वाहा /
text_mt: 'That purifying, dear body of yours, O Agni, which is in cattle, which is on earth, which is in fire, which is in the Rathantara, which is in the Gāyatrī metre—that [body] of yours I propitiate with this, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne 'psu pāvakā priyā tanūryāntarikṣe yā vāyau yā vāmadevye yā traiṣṭubhe chandasi tāṃ ta etenāvayaje svāhā /
meaning: या ते अग्ने ऽप्सु पावका प्रिया तनूर्यान्तरिक्षे या वायौ या वामदेव्ये या त्रैष्टुभे छन्दसि तां त एतेनावयजे स्वाहा /
text_mt: That cleansing, dear body of yours, O Agni, which is in the waters, which is in the intermediate space, which is in the wind, which is in the Vāmadevya, which is in the Triṣṭubh metre—that [body] of yours I propitiate with this, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne sūrye śuciḥ priyā tanūryā divi yāditye yā bṛhati yā jāgate chandasi tāṃ ta etenāvayaje svāhetyetaiḥ pratimantramājyamoṣadhīśca juhoti
meaning: या ते अग्ने सूर्ये शुचिः प्रिया तनूर्या दिवि यादित्ये या बृहति या जागते छन्दसि तां त एतेनावयजे स्वाहेत्येतैः प्रतिमन्त्रमाज्यमोषधीश्च जुहोति
text_mt: That bright, dear body of yours, O Agni, which is in the sun, which is in the sky, which is in Āditya, which is in the Bṛhat, which is in the Jagatī metre—that [body] of yours I propitiate with this, svāhā!' With these formulas, verse by verse, he offers clarified butter and herbs.
Some say: 'He places firesticks [on the fire].'
At the setting up of the fires, the brahman sings sāmans.
'The udgītha is performed solely with the vyāhṛtis'—thus the Vājasaneyaka.
Then he establishes the sabhya and the āvasathya [fires], having fetched worldly fire or having churned [it], or from the āhavanīya, with the establishment according to the ṛṣis.

meaning: अग्न आयूंषि पवसे ऽग्ने पवस्व स्वपाः /
text_mt: 'O Agni, you purify lifespans; O Agni, purify [us], doing good work!
Agni, the purifying seer, belonging to the five peoples, the domestic priest:

sanskrit_iast: tamīmahe mahāgayamiti tisra āśvatthyaḥ samidha ekaikasminnādadhāti
meaning: तमीमहे महागयमिति तिस्र आश्वत्थ्यः समिध एकैकस्मिन्नादधाति
text_mt: him we beseech for a great household'—with these [verses] he places three aśvattha firesticks on each one.
'From the ocean the sweet wave has arisen; along with Upāṃśu it reached immortality.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ //
meaning: घृतस्य नाम गुह्यं यदस्ति जिह्वा देवानाममृतस्य नाभिः //
text_mt: The secret name of clarified butter that exists—the tongue of the gods, the navel of immortality—

sanskrit_iast: vayaṃ nāma prabravāmā ghṛtenāsminyajñe dhārayāmā namobhiḥ /
meaning: वयं नाम प्रब्रवामा घृतेनास्मिन्यज्ञे धारयामा नमोभिः /
text_mt: let us proclaim the name with clarified butter; in this sacrifice let us support [it] with homages.

meaning: उप ब्रह्मा शृणवच्छस्यमानं चतुःशृङ्गो ऽवमीद्गौर एतत् //
text_mt: Let the brahman hear what is being recited; the four-horned ox bellowed this.

sanskrit_iast: catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya /
meaning: चत्वारि शृङ्गा त्रयो अस्य पादा द्वे शीर्षे सप्त हस्तासो अस्य /
text_mt: Four are his horns, three are his feet, two his heads, seven his hands;

sanskrit_iast: tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti maho devo martyām̐ āviveśeti śamīmayyo ghṛtānvaktāstisṛbhistisra ekaikasminnādadhāti /
meaning: त्रिधा बद्धो वृषभो रोरवीति महो देवो मर्त्याम्̐ आविवेशेति शमीमय्यो घृतान्वक्तास्तिसृभिस्तिस्र एकैकस्मिन्नादधाति /
text_mt: bound in three places, the bull roars loudly; the great god has entered mortals'—with these three [verses] he places three [firesticks] made of śamī wood and smeared with clarified butter on each one.

sanskrit_iast: preddho agne dīdihi puro na ityaudumbarīṃ samidhamādadhāti /
meaning: प्रेद्धो अग्ने दीदिहि पुरो न इत्यौदुम्बरीं समिधमादधाति /
text_mt: 'Enkindled forward, O Agni, shine forth before us'—with this he places a firestick of udumbara wood;

sanskrit_iast: vidhema te parame janmannagna iti vaikaṅkatīm /
meaning: विधेम ते परमे जन्मन्नग्न इति वैकङ्कतीम् /
text_mt: 'Let us pay worship to you at your highest birth, O Agni'—[with this, one] of vikaṅkata wood;
'That wondrous [splendor] of the choice Savitṛ'—[with this, one] of śamī wood.
Then he performs the agnihotra silently.

sanskrit_iast: api vā dvādaśagṛhītena srucaṃ pūrayitvā prajāpatiṃ manasā dhyāyañjuhoti /
meaning: अपि वा द्वादशगृहीतेन स्रुचं पूरयित्वा प्रजापतिं मनसा ध्यायञ्जुहोति /
text_mt: Or, having filled the ladle with a twelvefold scoop, meditating upon Prajāpati in thought, he offers.
This takes the place of the agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: yaste agne ghorāstanuvastābhiramuṃ gaccheti yajamāno dveṣyāya prahiṇoti tābhirenaṃ nitamayati /
meaning: यस्ते अग्ने घोरास्तनुवस्ताभिरमुं गच्छेति यजमानो द्वेष्याय प्रहिणोति ताभिरेनं नितमयति /
text_mt: With: 'Those terrifying bodies of yours, O Agni, with them go to so-and-so,' the sacrificer dispatches [them] against one who is hated; with them he brings him down.
They are to be recited in the wilderness.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśagṛhītena srucaṃ pūrayitvā sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvā iti saptavatyā pūrṇāhutiṃ juhoti /
meaning: द्वादशगृहीतेन स्रुचं पूरयित्वा सप्त ते अग्ने समिधः सप्त जिह्वा इति सप्तवत्या पूर्णाहुतिं जुहोति /
text_mt: Having filled the ladle with a twelvefold scoop, he offers the full oblation with the seven-part verse: 'Seven are your firesticks, O Agni, seven your tongues.'

sanskrit_iast: hutāyāṃ yajamāno varaṃ dattvā śivā japati /
meaning: हुतायां यजमानो वरं दत्त्वा शिवा जपति /
text_mt: When it has been offered, the sacrificer, having given a boon, mutters the auspicious [formulas].

sanskrit_iast: ye agnayo divo ye pṛthivyāḥ samāgacchantīṣamūrjaṃ duhānāḥ /
meaning: ये अग्नयो दिवो ये पृथिव्याः समागच्छन्तीषमूर्जं दुहानाः /
text_mt: 'Whichsoever fires of the sky, whichsoever of the earth, come together, yielding refreshment and strength:

sanskrit_iast: te asmā agnayo draviṇaṃ dattveṣṭāḥ prītā āhutibhājo bhūtvā yathālokaṃ punarastaṃ pareta svāheti juhoti
meaning: ते अस्मा अग्नयो द्रविणं दत्त्वेष्टाः प्रीता आहुतिभाजो भूत्वा यथालोकं पुनरस्तं परेत स्वाहेति जुहोति
text_mt: let those fires, having given wealth to us, worshipped, gratified, having received oblations, depart back home according to their proper place, svāhā'—with this he offers.

sanskrit_iast: atha virāṭkramairyajamāna upatiṣṭhate 'tharva pituṃ me gopāyānnaṃ prānena saṃmitam /
meaning: अथ विराट्क्रमैर्यजमान उपतिष्ठते ऽथर्व पितुं मे गोपायान्नं प्रानेन संमितम् /
text_mt: Then with the Virāj steps the sacrificer attends [upon the fires]: 'O Atharvan, protect my food, nourishment commensurate with breath;

sanskrit_iast: tvayā guptā iṣamūrjaṃ madanto rāyaspoṣeṇa samiṣā mademetyanvāhāryapacanam //
meaning: त्वया गुप्ता इषमूर्जं मदन्तो रायस्पोषेण समिषा मदेमेत्यन्वाहार्यपचनम् //
text_mt: protected by you, rejoicing in refreshment and strength, let us rejoice with abundance of wealth, with nourishment'—[thus he attends upon] the anvāhāryapacana.

sanskrit_iast: narya prajāṃ me gopāya mūlaṃ lokasya saṃtatim /
meaning: नर्य प्रजां मे गोपाय मूलं लोकस्य संततिम् /
text_mt: 'O Narya, protect my offspring, the root of the world, the lineage!'

sanskrit_iast: ātmano hṛdayānnirmitāṃ tāṃ te paridadāmyahamiti gārhapatyam //
meaning: आत्मनो हृदयान्निर्मितां तां ते परिददाम्यहमिति गार्हपत्यम् //
text_mt: [With the words:] 'fashioned from my own heart, that I entrust to you,' [he worships] the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃsya paśūnme gopāya viśvarūpaṃ dhanaṃ vasu /
meaning: शंस्य पशून्मे गोपाय विश्वरूपं धनं वसु /
text_mt: 'O Praiseworthy one, protect my livestock, all-formed wealth and treasure;
the nourishment and joy of our homes, these I entrust to you,' [with these words he worships] the āhavanīya.
'O Far-reaching one, protect my assembly, vital power that increases prosperity;

sanskrit_iast: viśvajanasya chāyāṃ tāṃ te paridadāmyahamiti sabhyam //
meaning: विश्वजनस्य छायां तां ते परिददाम्यहमिति सभ्यम् //
text_mt: the shelter of all people, that I entrust to you,' [with these words he worships] the sabhya.

sanskrit_iast: ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya śriyaṃ ca yaśasā saha /
meaning: अहे बुध्निय मन्त्रं मे गोपाय श्रियं च यशसा सह /
text_mt: 'O Serpent of the Deep, protect my sacred prayer, and fortune along with fame;

sanskrit_iast: ahaye budhniyāya mantraṃ śriyaṃ yaśaḥ paridadāmyahamityāvasathyam //
meaning: अहये बुध्नियाय मन्त्रं श्रियं यशः परिददाम्यहमित्यावसथ्यम् //
text_mt: to the Serpent of the Deep I entrust prayer, fortune, and fame,' [with these words he worships] the āvasathya.
'Fivefold the Virāj strode across the fires, created from Prajāpati;
the red dawn ascended upward, the womb of Agni, the foundation,' with these words [he worships] all [the fires].
He sets in motion the procedure of the eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni.
The oblation is ladled out and brought forward, but not [yet] sprinkled.

sanskrit_iast: atha sabhāyā madhye 'dhidevanamuddhatyāvokṣyākṣānnyupyākṣeṣu hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya samūhya vyūhya prathayitvā niṣasāda dhṛtavrata iti madhye 'dhidevane rājanyasya juhoti
meaning: अथ सभाया मध्ये ऽधिदेवनमुद्धत्यावोक्ष्याक्षान्न्युप्याक्षेषु हिरण्यं निधाय समूह्य व्यूह्य प्रथयित्वा निषसाद धृतव्रत इति मध्ये ऽधिदेवने राजन्यस्य जुहोति
text_mt: Then, in the middle of the assembly hall, having raised the gaming ground, sprinkled it, cast down the dice, placed gold upon the dice, gathered them together, spread them out, and extended them, he makes an offering for a kṣatriya on the middle of the gaming ground with [the verse]: 'He sat down, he whose ordinances are firm...'

sanskrit_iast: āvasathe pariṣado madhye hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya mantravatyā hiraṇye juhoti pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatirmantraṃ vadatyukthyam /
meaning: आवसथे परिषदो मध्ये हिरण्यं निधाय मन्त्रवत्या हिरण्ये जुहोति प्र नूनं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्मन्त्रं वदत्युक्थ्यम् /
text_mt: In the āvasatha hall, having placed gold in the middle of the gathered assembly, he makes an offering upon the gold with the verse containing the word 'mantra': 'Now indeed Brahmaṇaspati speaks the mantra worthy of laudation,

sanskrit_iast: yasminnindro varuṇo mitro aryamā devā okāṃsi cakrira iti
meaning: यस्मिन्निन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा देवा ओकांसि चक्रिर इति
text_mt: in which Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, the gods have made their abodes.'

meaning: उत नो ऽहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणोत्वज एकपात्पृथिवी समुद्रः /
text_mt: 'And may the Serpent of the Deep hear us, Aja Ekapād, the earth, the ocean;

sanskrit_iast: viśve devā ṛtāvṛdho huvānāḥ stutā mantrāḥ kaviśastā avantu na ity uktvā śatamakṣānyajamānāya prayacchannāha vrīhibhyo gāṃ dīvyatāhiṃsantaḥ parūṃṣi viśasateti
meaning: विश्वे देवा ऋतावृधो हुवानाः स्तुता मन्त्राः कविशस्ता अवन्तु न इत्य् उक्त्वा शतमक्षान्यजमानाय प्रयच्छन्नाह व्रीहिभ्यो गां दीव्यताहिंसन्तः परूंषि विशसतेति
text_mt: may all the gods, augmenters of truth, when invoked, and the recited mantras praised by sages, protect us'—having said this, handing a hundred dice to the sacrificer, he says: 'Play for the cow [as stakes] against rice; without harming it, butcher the joints.'
They act according to the ritual call.
The sacrificer wins the winning throw.

sanskrit_iast: tayā yajjayanti tadannaṃ saṃskṛtya sabhāsadbhya upaharanti
meaning: तया यज्जयन्ति तदन्नं संस्कृत्य सभासद्भ्य उपहरन्ति
text_mt: Preparing the food that they win by means of it [the cow], they serve it to the members of the assembly.

sanskrit_iast: kḷptisāmanasībhyāmagnīnyajamāna upatiṣṭhate kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ye 'gnayaḥ samanasa iti
meaning: कॢप्तिसामनसीभ्यामग्नीन्यजमान उपतिष्ठते कल्पेतां द्यावापृथिवी ये ऽग्नयः समनस इति
text_mt: The sacrificer worships the fires with the Kḷpti and Sāmanasī verses: 'May heaven and earth be fit...' and 'Those fires that are concordant...'
He undertakes the rite beginning with the sprinkling.
At the time of the sacrificial gifts of the cake for Agni, he gives the sacrificial gifts.
A goat, a full vessel, a bolster, and an entire garment of wool [he gives] to the agnīdh.
A draft horse to the brahman or to the adhvaryu.
An ox in the place of the āhavanīya to the adhvaryu.
To the west of the gārhapatya, a milch cow to the hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: vāso mithunau gāvau navaṃ ca rathaṃ dadāti /
meaning: वासो मिथुनौ गावौ नवं च रथं ददाति /
text_mt: He gives a garment, a pair of cattle, and a new chariot;
these are shared among all [the priests].

sanskrit_iast: ā dvādaśabhyo dadātītyuktvāha kāmamūrdhvaṃ deyamaparimitasyāvaruddhyā iti vijñāyate
meaning: आ द्वादशभ्यो ददातीत्युक्त्वाह काममूर्ध्वं देयमपरिमितस्यावरुद्ध्या इति विज्ञायते
text_mt: 'He gives up to twelve,' having said this, [the scripture] says: 'He may give at will beyond that, for the attainment of the boundless,' so it is taught.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvamādiṣṭadakṣiṇābhyo vadati ṣaḍ deyā dvādaśa deyāścaturviṃśatirdeyā iti
meaning: ऊर्ध्वमादिष्टदक्षिणाभ्यो वदति षड् देया द्वादश देयाश्चतुर्विंशतिर्देया इति
text_mt: Beyond the prescribed sacrificial gifts, it says: 'Six should be given, twelve should be given, twenty-four should be given.'

sanskrit_iast: yeṣāṃ paśūnāṃ puṣṭiṃ bhūyasīṃ kāmayeta teṣāṃ vayasām
meaning: येषां पशूनां पुष्टिं भूयसीं कामयेत तेषां वयसाम्
text_mt: Of whichever animals he should desire greater thriving, [he gives beasts] of their ages:
he should give an eighteen-month-old heifer, and an uncastrated eighteen-month-old bull.
He gives an increasing sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: yadyanāḍhyo 'gnīnādadhīta kāmamevaikāṃ gāṃ dadyātsā gavāṃ pratyāmnāyo bhavatīti vijñāyate
meaning: यद्यनाढ्यो ऽग्नीनादधीत काममेवैकां गां दद्यात्सा गवां प्रत्याम्नायो भवतीति विज्ञायते
text_mt: 'If an impoverished man should establish the fires, he may give only a single cow at will; that becomes the substitute for [all] the cows,' so it is taught.
The offering is concluded in the established manner.
He should offer the Pavamāna oblations immediately on the same day,

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhe dvyahe tryahe caturahe 'rdhamāse māsyṛtau saṃvatsare vā
meaning: द्वादशाहे द्व्यहे त्र्यहे चतुरहे ऽर्धमासे मास्यृतौ संवत्सरे वा
text_mt: or after twelve days, after two days, after three days, after four days, after half a month, after a month, after a season, or after a year.
One who does not intend to sacrifice with soma should not offer [them] before a year.

sanskrit_iast: yadi nirvapedagnaye pavamānāyāgnaye pāvakāyāgnaye śucaya iti tisra ājyāhutīḥ somadevatābhyo vā hutvā nirvapet
meaning: यदि निर्वपेदग्नये पवमानायाग्नये पावकायाग्नये शुचय इति तिस्र आज्याहुतीः सोमदेवताभ्यो वा हुत्वा निर्वपेत्
text_mt: If he should offer [them earlier], he should offer [them] after making three clarified-butter offerings with: 'To Agni Pavamāna,' 'To Agni Pāvaka,' 'To Agni Śuci,' or to the deities of soma.
They share a single framework, or have separate frameworks, or share the framework with the [offering] to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta pāpīyānsyāditi tasyaikamekam etāni havīṃṣi nirvapet /
meaning: यं कामयेत पापीयान्स्यादिति तस्यैकमेकम् एतानि हवींषि निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: For one whom he desires, 'May he become worse,' he should offer these oblations one by one;

sanskrit_iast: na vasīyānna pāpīyāniti tasya sākaṃ sarvāṇi /
meaning: न वसीयान्न पापीयानिति तस्य साकं सर्वाणि /
text_mt: for one whom he desires, 'May he become neither better nor worse,' he should offer all of them together;

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayetottaraṃ vasīyāñchreyān syād iti tasyāgnaye pavamānāya nirupya pāvakaśucibhyāṃ samānabarhiṣī nirvapet
meaning: यं कामयेतोत्तरं वसीयाञ्छ्रेयान् स्याद् इति तस्याग्नये पवमानाय निरुप्य पावकशुचिभ्यां समानबर्हिषी निर्वपेत्
text_mt: for one whom he desires, 'May he become progressively better and superior,' having offered [the oblation] for Agni Pavamāna, he should offer those for Pāvaka and Śuci on the same sacrificial grass.
A hundred measures of gold is the sacrificial gift.
For the first two oblations, two pieces of thirty measures [each]; for the latter one, a piece of forty measures.

sanskrit_iast: yena hiraṇyaṃ mimate tena mītvā dadāti
meaning: येन हिरण्यं मिमते तेन मीत्वा ददाति
text_mt: Measuring with whatever [unit] they measure gold, he gives it.
The offering is concluded in the established manner.
He performs a subsequent offering of an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Indra and Agni, and a caru in clarified butter to the Ādityas.
There are seventeen kindling verses.
At the time of the fourfold division, he hands the [caru] for the Ādityas to the brahman.
Four descendants of ṛṣis partake of it.
To those who have partaken of it he gives an identical choice gift;
some teach the gift of a cow and an ox.
The offering is concluded in the established manner.

He performs a subsequent offering of an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Agni and Viṣṇu, an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Agni and Soma, and a caru in clarified butter cooked with three portions of rice to Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa.
The offering is concluded in the established manner.

sanskrit_iast: ādityaṃ ghṛte caruṃ saptadaśasāmidhenīkaṃ dhenudakṣiṇaṃ sarveṣāmanunirvāpyāṇāṃ sthāne vājasneyinaḥ samāmananti
meaning: आदित्यं घृते चरुं सप्तदशसामिधेनीकं धेनुदक्षिणं सर्वेषामनुनिर्वाप्याणां स्थाने वाजस्नेयिनः समामनन्ति
text_mt: The followers of the Vājasaneyaka teach a caru in clarified butter to the Ādityas, accompanied by seventeen kindling verses and with a cow as the sacrificial gift, in place of all the subsequent offerings.
The iṣṭi is concluded in the established manner.

sanskrit_iast: agnihotramārapsyamāno daśahotāraṃ manasānudrutyāhavanīye sagrahaṃ hutvātha sāyamagnihotraṃ juhoti
meaning: अग्निहोत्रमारप्स्यमानो दशहोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्याहवनीये सग्रहं हुत्वाथ सायमग्निहोत्रं जुहोति
text_mt: When about to begin the agnihotra, he recites the daśahotṛ formula mentally, offers it together with the graha into the āhavanīya fire, and then offers the evening agnihotra.
He should set down [the offering] with the vyāhṛtis.
When the year has elapsed, he should set down [the offering] with these very [vyāhṛtis].

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhamajasreṣvagniṣu yajamānaḥ svayamagnihotraṃ juhuyādapravasannahataṃ vāso bibharti
meaning: द्वादशाहमजस्रेष्वग्निषु यजमानः स्वयमग्निहोत्रं जुहुयादप्रवसन्नहतं वासो बिभर्ति
text_mt: For twelve days, in fires that are kept constantly burning, the sacrificer should himself offer the agnihotra; without travelling away from home, he wears an unwashed garment.

sanskrit_iast: yāṃ prathamāmagnihotrāya dogdhi tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti
meaning: यां प्रथमामग्निहोत्राय दोग्धि तां दक्षिणां ददाति
text_mt: The cow that he milks first for the agnihotra, that one he gives as a sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: agnīnādhāya hastāvavanijya saṃvatsaramagnihotraṃ hutvātha darśapūrṇamāsāvārabhate tābhyāṃ saṃvatsaramiṣṭvā somena paśunā vā yajate tata ūrdhvamanyāni karmāṇi kurute
meaning: अग्नीनाधाय हस्ताववनिज्य संवत्सरमग्निहोत्रं हुत्वाथ दर्शपूर्णमासावारभते ताभ्यां संवत्सरमिष्ट्वा सोमेन पशुना वा यजते तत ऊर्ध्वमन्यानि कर्माणि कुरुते
text_mt: Having established the fires and washed his hands, having offered the agnihotra for a year, he then begins the New and Full Moon sacrifices; having sacrificed with both of them for a year, he sacrifices with soma or with an animal; thereafter, he performs other rites.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśarātramahatavāsā yajamānaḥ svayamagnihotraṃ juhuyādapravasannatraiva somena paśunā veṣṭvāgnīnutsṛjati yathā suyavasānkṛtvā prājyāttādṛktaditi śāṭyāyanibrāhmaṇaṃ bhavati
meaning: त्रयोदशरात्रमहतवासा यजमानः स्वयमग्निहोत्रं जुहुयादप्रवसन्नत्रैव सोमेन पशुना वेष्ट्वाग्नीनुत्सृजति यथा सुयवसान्कृत्वा प्राज्यात्तादृक्तदिति शाट्यायनिब्राह्मणं भवति
text_mt: For thirteen nights, wearing an unwashed garment, the sacrificer should himself offer the agnihotra without travelling away; right here, having sacrificed with soma or with an animal, he lets the fires go out; 'just as one having brought [cattle] to good pasture might drive them forth, such is that'—so says the Śāṭyāyani Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇā paścādyatte devā adadhuriti sārasvatau homau hutvānvārambhaṇīyāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati
meaning: पूर्णा पश्चाद्यत्ते देवा अदधुरिति सारस्वतौ होमौ हुत्वान्वारम्भणीयामिष्टिं निर्वपति
text_mt: Having offered the two Sārasvata oblations with: 'Full behind...' and 'What the gods placed...', he prepares the Anvārambhaṇīyā iṣṭi.
[It consists of] a cake on eleven potsherds for Agni and Viṣṇu, a caru for Sarasvatī, and a cake on twelve potsherds for Sarasvat.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye bhagine 'ṣṭākapālaṃ yaḥ kāmayeta bhagyannādaḥ syāmiti
meaning: अग्नये भगिने ऽष्टाकपालं यः कामयेत भग्यन्नादः स्यामिति
text_mt: For Agni Bhagin, a cake on eight potsherds, if he desires: 'May I be fortunate and an eater of food.'
Some hand it down as obligatory.

sanskrit_iast: tvadviśvā subhaga saubhagānyagne vi yanti vanino na vayāḥ /
meaning: त्वद्विश्वा सुभग सौभगान्यग्ने वि यन्ति वनिनो न वयाः /
text_mt: 'From you, fortunate Agni, all fortunes branch out like boughs from a tree,

sanskrit_iast: śruṣṭī rayirvājo vṛtratūrye divo vṛṣṭirīḍyo rītirapām //
meaning: श्रुष्टी रयिर्वाजो वृत्रतूर्ये दिवो वृष्टिरीड्यो रीतिरपाम् //
text_mt: Obedience, wealth, food in the contest with Vṛtra, praise-worthy rain of heaven, the flow of waters.

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ bhago na ā hi ratnamiṣe parijmeva kṣayasi dasmavarcāḥ /
meaning: त्वं भगो न आ हि रत्नमिषे परिज्मेव क्षयसि दस्मवर्चाः /
text_mt: Like Bhaga, you bring us treasure for refreshment; like one encircling, you rule, endowed with wondrous splendour.

sanskrit_iast: agne mitro na bṛhata ṛtasyāsi kṣattā vāmasya deva bhūreriti yājyānuvākye
meaning: अग्ने मित्रो न बृहत ऋतस्यासि क्षत्ता वामस्य देव भूरेरिति याज्यानुवाक्ये
text_mt: Agni, like Mitra of the great cosmic order, you are the dispenser of abundant loveliness, O god'—these are the invitatory and consecratory verses.
Before the Sviṣṭakṛt, he offers the Jaya oblations with: 'Thought and thinking...'

sanskrit_iast: cittāya svāhā cittyai svāhety eke samāmananti
meaning: चित्ताय स्वाहा चित्त्यै स्वाहेत्य् एके समामनन्ति
text_mt: 'To thought, svāhā! To thinking, svāhā!'—thus some hand it down.
With: 'Prajāpati [created] the Jayas...', he offers the thirteenth [oblation].

sanskrit_iast: agne balada saha ojaḥ kramamāṇāya me dāḥ /
meaning: अग्ने बलद सह ओजः क्रममाणाय मे दाः /
text_mt: 'O Agni, giver of strength, bestow vigour and might upon me as I step forward,

sanskrit_iast: abhiśastikṛte 'nabhiśastenyāyāsyai janatāyai śraiṣṭyāyeti caturdaśīṃ yaḥ kāmayeta citraṃ janatāyāṃ syāmiti /
meaning: अभिशस्तिकृते ऽनभिशस्तेन्यायास्यै जनतायै श्रैष्ट्यायेति चतुर्दशीं यः कामयेत चित्रं जनतायां स्यामिति /
text_mt: Upon the curser, upon the blameless, for the supremacy of this community'—with this fourteenth [mantra] one who desires: 'May I be distinguished among the community.'

sanskrit_iast: citraṃ bhavati śabalaṃ tvasya mukhe jāyate
meaning: चित्रं भवति शबलं त्वस्य मुखे जायते
text_mt: He becomes distinguished; but a speckled mark appears on his face.
A pair of cattle is the sacrificial gift.
The iṣṭi is concluded in the established manner.

When about to begin the New and Full Moon sacrifices, he recites the caturhotṛ formula mentally, offers it together with the graha into the āhavanīya fire, and then begins the New and Full Moon sacrifices.
He should place the oblations with the vyāhṛtis; when the year has elapsed, he should place them with these very [vyāhṛtis].
This is for one establishing the fires on a new moon day.
On a full moon day, however, having completed the establishment of the fires along with the iṣṭi and the Anvārambhaṇīyā on the preceding joint-day,
On the next day, he sacrifices with the Full Moon sacrifice.
Directly after the establishment of the fires are the vows of one who has established the fires:
A brāhmaṇa should not stay in his house without having eaten.
He should not turn away for lodging a guest brought by the setting sun.
He should not eat food cooked in an earthen oven.
He should not put wet wood on [the fire].
He should not eat from water that is navigable by boat.
He should not settle on a naturally barren tract.
Having uttered the hiṅ-sound, with restrained speech, he should approach his wife.
He should not eat in the evening when the evening oblation is not yet offered.

sanskrit_iast: āhitāgnergṛhe na sāyamahute bhoktavyaṃ tathā prātarityanyeṣāṃ vratam
meaning: आहिताग्नेर्गृहे न सायमहुते भोक्तव्यं तथा प्रातरित्यन्येषां व्रतम्
text_mt: 'In the house of one who has established the fires, one should not eat when the evening [oblation] is not offered; likewise in the morning'—this is the vow according to others.
At night he should give nothing other than food.
Giving food, however, he should eat.
During this year, he should not eat meat without having sacrificed with an animal.

sanskrit_iast: manasāgnibhyaḥ prahiṇomi bhakṣaṃ mama vācā taṃ saha bhakṣayantu /
meaning: मनसाग्निभ्यः प्रहिणोमि भक्षं मम वाचा तं सह भक्षयन्तु /
text_mt: 'Mentally I dispatch the portion to the fires; with my speech let them eat it together;

sanskrit_iast: apramādyannapramattaścarāmi śivena manasā saha bhakṣayateti yadyādiṣṭo bhakṣayed etaṃ mantramuktvā bhakṣayet
meaning: अप्रमाद्यन्नप्रमत्तश्चरामि शिवेन मनसा सह भक्षयतेति यद्यादिष्टो भक्षयेद् एतं मन्त्रमुक्त्वा भक्षयेत्
text_mt: Not erring, vigilant, I walk; with an auspicious mind, do you eat together'—if, being prescribed [to do so], he should eat, he should eat having recited this mantra.
We shall explain the re-establishment of the fires.
Its procedure is like that of the establishment of the fires.

sanskrit_iast: agnīnādhāyaitasminsaṃvatsare yo nardhnuyātsa punarādadhīta prajākāmaḥ paśukāmaḥ puṣṭikāmo jyānyāṃ putramartyāyāṃ sveṣvārudhyamāneṣu yadā vāṅgena vidhuratāṃ nīyāt
meaning: अग्नीनाधायैतस्मिन्संवत्सरे यो नर्ध्नुयात्स पुनरादधीत प्रजाकामः पशुकामः पुष्टिकामो ज्यान्यां पुत्रमर्त्यायां स्वेष्वारुध्यमानेषु यदा वाङ्गेन विधुरतां नीयात्
text_mt: He who, having established the fires, does not prosper during this year, should re-establish them, if desiring offspring, desiring cattle, desiring prosperity, or upon suffering loss, upon the death of a son, when his own people are kept in distress, or when he is reduced to infirmity in a limb.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedvaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ vāruṇaṃ daśakapālamagnaye 'psumate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ maitraṃ carumagnimudvāsayiṣyan
meaning: आग्नेयमष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद्वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालं वारुणं दशकपालमग्नये ऽप्सुमते ऽष्टाकपालं मैत्रं चरुमग्निमुद्वासयिष्यन्
text_mt: When about to extinguish the fire, he should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni, a cake on twelve potsherds to Vaiśvānara, a cake on ten potsherds to Varuṇa, a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Apsumat, and a caru to Mitra.

sanskrit_iast: yā te agna utsīdataḥ pavamānā priyā tanūḥ /
meaning: या ते अग्न उत्सीदतः पवमाना प्रिया तनूः /
text_mt: 'O Agni, that dear purifying form of yours which rises up,

sanskrit_iast: tayā saha pṛthivīmāviśa rathaṃtareṇa sāmnā gāyatreṇa ca chandasā //
meaning: तया सह पृथिवीमाविश रथंतरेण साम्ना गायत्रेण च छन्दसा //
text_mt: With that enter into the earth, together with the Rathaṃtara Sāman and the Gāyatrī metre.

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne pāvakā yā manasā preyasī priyā tanūḥ /
meaning: या ते अग्ने पावका या मनसा प्रेयसी प्रिया तनूः /
text_mt: O Agni, that purifying, that dear form of yours which is dearer than the mind,

sanskrit_iast: tayā sahāntarikṣamāviśa vāmadevyena sāmnā traiṣṭubhena ca chandasā /
meaning: तया सहान्तरिक्षमाविश वामदेव्येन साम्ना त्रैष्टुभेन च छन्दसा /
text_mt: With that enter into the atmosphere, together with the Vāmadevya Sāman and the Traiṣṭubha metre;

sanskrit_iast: tato na ūrjamā kṛdhi gṛhamedhaṃ ca vardhaya //
meaning: ततो न ऊर्जमा कृधि गृहमेधं च वर्धय //
text_mt: Thence make us vigour and increase the domestic sacrifice.'

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne sūrye śuciḥ priyā tanūḥ śukre 'dhyadhi saṃbhṛtā /
meaning: या ते अग्ने सूर्ये शुचिः प्रिया तनूः शुक्रे ऽध्यधि संभृता /
text_mt: "O Agni, that pure, beloved form of yours, which is brought together over the bright [sun],

sanskrit_iast: tayā saha divamāviśa bṛhatā sāmnā jāgatena ca chandasā tato no vṛṣṭyāvata //
meaning: तया सह दिवमाविश बृहता साम्ना जागतेन च छन्दसा ततो नो वृष्ट्यावत //
text_mt: together with it enter heaven with the Bṛhat chant and the Jāgatī metre; thence protect us with rain."
"O Agni, those wish-granting distributed forms of yours that have been gathered together:
with them milk for us wishes here: offspring, prosperity, and wealth."
"O Agni, the materials which Indra, as a boar, brought for you:

sanskrit_iast: tāsu śociṣu sīdeha bhasma vaiśvānarasya yat
meaning: तासु शोचिषु सीदेह भस्म वैश्वानरस्य यत्
text_mt: in those flames sit here, what is the ash of Vaiśvānara."

sanskrit_iast: ye te agne vānaspatyāḥ saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhṛtāḥ saha /
meaning: ये ते अग्ने वानस्पत्याः संभाराः संभृताः सह /
text_mt: "O Agni, those materials belonging to trees that have been gathered together:
with them go each to the trees, to your own womb."
"Agni has gone according to his realm; he has sat in his own seat.

sanskrit_iast: avīrahatyaṃ deveṣūpāgāṃ manasā saheti purastātsviṣṭakṛtaḥ saptāhutīrjuhoti
meaning: अवीरहत्यं देवेषूपागां मनसा सहेति पुरस्तात्स्विष्टकृतः सप्ताहुतीर्जुहोति
text_mt: With my mind I have approached non-destruction of heroes among the gods"—with [these mantras] he offers seven oblations before the Sviṣṭakṛt [offering].
The sacrifice concludes in the established manner.
Having performed the Full Moon sacrifice, he discards the burning fires.
He remains one who has discarded his fires for a year at most.
Rohiṇī, Punarvasū, [or] Anurādhā are the asterisms [for re-establishing them].
He should establish them in the rainy season or in autumn.
The ritual materials and the yajus mantras are optional.
Or rather, he brings five earthen materials;
Having strewn old darbha grass on the hearths, he establishes the gārhapatya fire with the Sarparājñī verses, [beginning with] "Earth with fullness".
With scorched darbha grass from last year, withered by the wind for a year, he takes out the burning āhavanīya fire.
With "Since an angry one discarded you" [he takes out] the southern fire;
with "What of you discarded through fury" [he takes out] the other [fires].
He reveres [the fire] with the verse containing [the name of] Bṛhaspati: "May Mind delight in the light".

sanskrit_iast: sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvā ityagnihotraṃ juhoti
meaning: सप्त ते अग्ने समिधः सप्त जिह्वा इत्यग्निहोत्रं जुहोति
text_mt: He offers the agnihotra with: "Seven are your kindling sticks, O Agni; seven your tongues".
He measures out [a cake] on five potsherds or on eight potsherds for Agni.
If it is on five potsherds, the two consecratory-and-invitatory verses are in the Gāyatrī metre;
if it is on eight potsherds, they are in the Paṅkti metre.
Everything belongs to Agni.
The kindling verses are fifteen or seventeen.
Beginning with the kindling verses, he sacrifices in a low voice until the final after-offering, [and] loud for the Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: agnāgne 'gnāvagne 'gnināgne 'gnimagna iti caturṣu prayājeṣu catasro vibhaktīrdadhāti
meaning: अग्नाग्ने ऽग्नावग्ने ऽग्निनाग्ने ऽग्निमग्न इति चतुर्षु प्रयाजेषु चतस्रो विभक्तीर्दधाति
text_mt: In four fore-offerings he inserts four case-forms: "agnā agne", "agnāv agne", "agninā agne", [and] "agnim agne".
Having uttered the case-form, he utters the vaṣaṭ-call with the fore-offering [formula].

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayetardhnuyāditi tasyopariṣṭādyeyajāmahādvibhaktiṃ dadhyātpurā vā vaṣaṭkārāt
meaning: यं कामयेतर्ध्नुयादिति तस्योपरिष्टाद्येयजामहाद्विभक्तिं दध्यात्पुरा वा वषट्कारात्
text_mt: For one whom he wishes should thrive, he should insert the case-form after "ye yajāmahe" or before the vaṣaṭ-call.

meaning: अग्निं स्तोमेन बोधयेत्याग्नेयस्याज्यभागस्य पुरो ऽनुवाक्या भवति /
text_mt: "Awaken Agni with praise" is the invitatory verse of the butter portion for Agni;
"O Agni, [give] life spans from marrow" [is the invitatory verse] of that for Soma.
Or he may make "Agni is the head" [the invitatory verse] of that for Soma
for one desirous of offspring, desirous of cattle, or deprived of offspring or deprived of cattle.
The verses of the Patnīsaṃyāja offerings are marked by [the name] Agni.
Or rather, just as the two butter portions are according to the original model, so are the Patnīsaṃyāja offerings.
The invitatory and consecratory verses are in the Akṣarapaṅkti metre: "O Agni, that horse today";
two for the [offering] to Agni, two for the Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: punarūrjā saha rayyetyabhitaḥ puroḍāśam āhutīr juhoti
meaning: पुनरूर्जा सह रय्येत्यभितः पुरोडाशम् आहुतीर् जुहोति
text_mt: With "Again with strength" [and] "Together with wealth" he offers oblations on both sides of the sacrificial cake.
Or with "Again with strength" before the fore-offerings, and with "Together with wealth" after the after-offerings.
He gives both kinds of sacrificial gifts:

sanskrit_iast: āgnyādheyikīḥ paunarādheyikīśca punarniṣkṛto ratha ity etāḥ śatamānaṃ ca hiraṇyam
meaning: आग्न्याधेयिकीः पौनराधेयिकीश्च पुनर्निष्कृतो रथ इत्य् एताः शतमानं च हिरण्यम्
text_mt: those belonging to the fire-establishment and those belonging to the re-establishment: "a renovated chariot" and these, and gold weighing a hundred mānas.
"Therefore silver gold" has been stated.

sanskrit_iast: punarabhihito rathaḥ punarutsyūtaṃ syāmūlaṃ punaḥkāmasyāptyā ity ekeṣām
meaning: पुनरभिहितो रथः पुनरुत्स्यूतं स्यामूलं पुनःकामस्याप्त्या इत्य् एकेषाम्
text_mt: "A chariot harnessed anew, a garment made of coarse cloth stitched anew, for the attainment of renewed desire"—according to some.
If the others are not found, he should give even an ox alone;

sanskrit_iast: anaḍuhi ha vā ete ca kāmā ataśca bhūyāṃsa iti paiṅgāyanibrāhmaṇaṃ bhavati
meaning: अनडुहि ह वा एते च कामा अतश्च भूयांस इति पैङ्गायनिब्राह्मणं भवति
text_mt: "In an ox, indeed, are these desires, and even more than this"—so is the Paiṅgāyani Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: deve agnau devo agniriti dvayoranūyājayorvibhaktī dadhāti
meaning: देवे अग्नौ देवो अग्निरिति द्वयोरनूयाजयोर्विभक्ती दधाति
text_mt: In two after-offerings he inserts case-forms: "deve agnau", "devo agniḥ".
He issues the ritual call for the last one loudly.
The sacrifice concludes in the established manner.
He pours out an offering on eleven potsherds to Agni and Varuṇa following it, in place of all the subsequent offerings, or for those [gods] sharing two deities.
The sacrifice concludes in the established manner;
the re-establishment concludes.

sanskrit_iast: yastṛtīyamādadhīta sa etānhomāñjuhuyāllekaḥ salekaḥ suleka iti
meaning: यस्तृतीयमादधीत स एतान्होमाञ्जुहुयाल्लेकः सलेकः सुलेक इति
text_mt: He who would establish [the fires] a third time should offer these oblations: "Leka, Saleka, Suleka".
If [the fire] taken up into the two churning sticks is lost,
or if the sun should set or rise when both his fires have gone out, the punarādheya is the expiation for it.
“The punarādheya,” says Āśmarathya; “the agnyādheya,” says Ālekhana, Ālekhana.
We shall explain the agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: adhivṛkṣasūrya āviḥsūrye vā dhṛṣṭirasi brahma yacchetyupaveṣamādāya gārhapatyamabhimantrayate sugārhapatya iti
meaning: अधिवृक्षसूर्य आविःसूर्ये वा धृष्टिरसि ब्रह्म यच्छेत्युपवेषमादाय गार्हपत्यमभिमन्त्रयते सुगार्हपत्य इति
text_mt: When the sun is above the trees or when the sun is visible, taking the fire-poker with: “You are the fire-stirrer; grant sacred power,” he addresses the gārhapatya with: “Good gārhapatya…”

sanskrit_iast: athainaṃ bodhayaty udbudhyasvāgne prati jāgṛhyenam iṣṭāpūrte saṃsṛjethāmayaṃ ca /
meaning: अथैनं बोधयत्य् उद्बुध्यस्वाग्ने प्रति जागृह्येनम् इष्टापूर्ते संसृजेथामयं च /
text_mt: Then he awakens it with: “Awake, O Agni, be vigilant towards him; let this man and his sacrificial and charitable deeds unite

sanskrit_iast: asmin sadhasthe adhyuttarasmin viśve devā yajamānaś ca sīdateti
meaning: अस्मिन् सधस्थे अध्युत्तरस्मिन् विश्वे देवा यजमानश् च सीदतेति
text_mt: in this higher seat; O all gods and sacrificer, sit down!”
“Bring out [the fire]!” is indeed what the sacrificer says in the evening;
By this he secures a thousand wish-granting cows.

sanskrit_iast: vācā tvā hotrā prāṇenodgātrā cakṣuṣādhvaryuṇā manasā brahmaṇā śrotreṇāgnīdhaitaistvā pañcabhirdaivyair ṛtvigbhir uddharāmīti gārhapatyādāhavanīyaṃ jvalantamuddharati
meaning: वाचा त्वा होत्रा प्राणेनोद्गात्रा चक्षुषाध्वर्युणा मनसा ब्रह्मणा श्रोत्रेणाग्नीधैतैस्त्वा पञ्चभिर्दैव्यैर् ऋत्विग्भिर् उद्धरामीति गार्हपत्यादाहवनीयं ज्वलन्तमुद्धरति
text_mt: With: “With speech as hotṛ, with breath as udgātṛ, with sight as adhvaryu, with mind as brahman, with hearing as agnīdh—with these five divine officiants I bring you out,” he brings out the blazing āhavanīya from the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaruddhriyamāṇa uddhara pāpmano mā yadavidvānyacca vidvāṃścakāra /
meaning: भूर्भुवः सुवरुद्ध्रियमाण उद्धर पाप्मनो मा यदविद्वान्यच्च विद्वांश्चकार /
text_mt: “Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ! Being brought out, bring me out from evil, whatever I have done knowingly and whatever unknowingly;

sanskrit_iast: ahnā yadenaḥ kṛtamasti pāpaṃ sarvasmānmoddhṛto muñca tasmādityuddhriyamāṇamabhimantrayate yajamānaḥ sāyam /
meaning: अह्ना यदेनः कृतमस्ति पापं सर्वस्मान्मोद्धृतो मुञ्च तस्मादित्युद्ध्रियमाणमभिमन्त्रयते यजमानः सायम् /
text_mt: whatever sinful deed has been done by day, from all that, being brought out, release me!”—with this [formula] the sacrificer addresses [the fire] while it is being brought out in the evening;

sanskrit_iast: rātryā yadenaḥ kṛtamasti pāpaṃ sarvasmānmoddhṛto muñca tasmāditi prātaḥ
meaning: रात्र्या यदेनः कृतमस्ति पापं सर्वस्मान्मोद्धृतो मुञ्च तस्मादिति प्रातः
text_mt: with: “Whatever sinful deed has been done by night, from all that, being brought out, release me!” in the morning.

meaning: अग्निपतये ऽग्नये मे विद्ध्यग्निपतये ऽग्नये मे मृड /
text_mt: “Know me, O Agni, lord of fire; be gracious to me, O Agni, lord of fire!
I offer the immortal oblation into the immortal Agni on the earth for the conquest of immortality;

sanskrit_iast: tayānantaṃ kāmamahaṃ jayāni prajāpatiryaṃ prathamo jigāyāgnimagnau svāhā
meaning: तयानन्तं काममहं जयानि प्रजापतिर्यं प्रथमो जिगायाग्निमग्नौ स्वाहा
text_mt: by it may I conquer endless desire, which Prajāpati first conquered; to Agni in Agni, svāhā!”

sanskrit_iast: agne samrāḍajaikapādāhavanīya divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣāllokaṃ vinda yajamānāya /
meaning: अग्ने सम्राडजैकपादाहवनीय दिवः पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षाल्लोकं विन्द यजमानाय /
text_mt: “O Agni, sovereign, Aja Ekapād, āhavanīya! From sky, from earth, from the intermediate space find a world for the sacrificer!
I set you down on the head of the earth, in the sacred realm.

sanskrit_iast: yo no agne niṣṭyo yo 'niṣṭyo 'bhidāsatīdamahaṃ taṃ tvayābhinidadhāmīti purastātparikramyodaṅmukhaḥ pratyaṅmukho vā sāyamāyatane 'gniṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati /
meaning: यो नो अग्ने निष्ट्यो यो ऽनिष्ट्यो ऽभिदासतीदमहं तं त्वयाभिनिदधामीति पुरस्तात्परिक्रम्योदङ्मुखः प्रत्यङ्मुखो वा सायमायतने ऽग्निं प्रतिष्ठापयति /
text_mt: He who, kin to us, O Agni, or not kin to us, attacks us, him do I here set down by means of you!”—having walked around from the east, facing north or facing west, he establishes the fire in its seat in the evening;

sanskrit_iast: svayaṃ yajamāna idhmānāharati viśvadānīmābharanto nātureṇa manasā /
meaning: स्वयं यजमान इध्मानाहरति विश्वदानीमाभरन्तो नातुरेण मनसा /
text_mt: The sacrificer himself brings pieces of firewood with: “Bringing [them] at all times with an untroubled mind,
O Agni, may we, your neighbours, not be harmed.”

sanskrit_iast: yadagne yāni kāni cetyetābhiḥ pañcabhiḥ pratimantramagniṣu mhata idhmānādadhāti
meaning: यदग्ने यानि कानि चेत्येताभिः पञ्चभिः प्रतिमन्त्रमग्निषु म्हत इध्मानादधाति
text_mt: With these five [verses], “Whatever [fuel], O Agni…”, he places fuel sticks on the fires, one verse to each stick.
In the order in which they were established, or starting from the āhavanīya.
The fire should be laid so that the oblation does not go astray.
If the eastern [fire] has gone out, one may pass through,
for it has then gone back to the west.
“At will one may pass through after the offering has been made,” say some.
He maintains the āhavanīya during the night.
For one who has attained prosperity, it is maintained constantly.
Likewise the anvāhāryapacana, if it has been established by churning.
If it is to be brought, they bring it every day from the south.
“They should bring it only on the fast day, or they should bring it only on entering a new residence,” states the Vājasaneyaka.
They adorn the fires by sweeping around them.
Adornment is done beforehand in the evening, afterward in the morning.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayato 'laṃkārāḥ sāyaṃ tathā prātar ity eke
meaning: उभयतो ऽलंकाराः सायं तथा प्रातर् इत्य् एके
text_mt: “Adornment on both sides in the evening, likewise in the morning,” say some.

sanskrit_iast: agne gṛhapate śundhasveti gārhapatyamagne vahne śundhasveti dakṣiṇāgnimange samrāṭ śundhasvetyāhavanīyamagne sabhya śundhasveti sabhyamagne pariṣadya śundhasvetyāvasathyam
meaning: अग्ने गृहपते शुन्धस्वेति गार्हपत्यमग्ने वह्ने शुन्धस्वेति दक्षिणाग्निमन्गे सम्राट् शुन्धस्वेत्याहवनीयमग्ने सभ्य शुन्धस्वेति सभ्यमग्ने परिषद्य शुन्धस्वेत्यावसथ्यम्
text_mt: With: “O Agni, lord of the house, purify yourself,” [he sweeps around] the gārhapatya; with: “O Agni, bearer [of oblations], purify yourself,” the dakṣiṇāgni; with: “O Agni, sovereign, purify yourself,” the āhavanīya; with: “O Agni of the hall, purify yourself,” the sabhya; with: “O Agni of the assembly, purify yourself,” the āvasathya.
With darbha grass or other grass pointing north and pointing east, he strews around the fires, or fire by fire.
The sruva is made of khadira wood; the agnihotra-ladle is made of vikankata wood, measuring an arm’s length or a cubit.
The agnihotra pot is broad-shaped, made by an Ārya, with an upright rim, and formed without a potter’s wheel.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena vihāramagnihotrī tiṣṭhati tāṃ yajamāno 'bhimantrayata iḍāsi vratabhṛdahaṃ nāvubhayorvrataṃ cariṣyāmi surohiṇyahaṃ nāvubhayorvrataṃ cariṣyāmīḍa ehi mayi śrayasvera ehyadita ehi gaurehi śraddha ehi satyena tvāhvayāmīti
meaning: दक्षिणेन विहारमग्निहोत्री तिष्ठति तां यजमानो ऽभिमन्त्रयत इडासि व्रतभृदहं नावुभयोर्व्रतं चरिष्यामि सुरोहिण्यहं नावुभयोर्व्रतं चरिष्यामीड एहि मयि श्रयस्वेर एह्यदित एहि गौरेहि श्रद्ध एहि सत्येन त्वाह्वयामीति
text_mt: To the south of the sacred ground stands the agnihotra cow; the sacrificer addresses her with: “You are Iḍā, observer of vows; I will observe the vow of both of us. O good Rohiṇī, I will observe the vow of both of us. O Iḍā, come; stay in me. O food, come; O Aditi, come; O cow, come; O faith, come; with truth I summon you!”

sanskrit_iast: atha vedideśamabhimṛśatīyamasi tasyāste 'gnirvatsaḥ sā me svargaṃ ca lokamamṛtaṃ ca dhukṣveti
meaning: अथ वेदिदेशमभिमृशतीयमसि तस्यास्ते ऽग्निर्वत्सः सा मे स्वर्गं च लोकममृतं च धुक्ष्वेति
text_mt: Then he touches the place of the altar ground with: “You are this [earth]; Agni is your calf. As such, milk for me the heavenly world and immortality!”

sanskrit_iast: pūṣāsīti dakṣiṇato vatsamupasṛjya prācīmāvṛtya dogdhyudīcīṃ prācīmudīcīṃ vā
meaning: पूषासीति दक्षिणतो वत्समुपसृज्य प्राचीमावृत्य दोग्ध्युदीचीं प्राचीमुदीचीं वा
text_mt: Having let loose the calf from the south with: “You are Pūṣan,” turning [her] eastward, he milks her facing north, or facing northeast.
For what the Śūdra is, is born of non-existence.
Because he puts it over the gārhapatya, he thereby purifies it.
He milks using the agnihotra pot and the milking pail.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvau duhyājjyeṣṭhasya jyaiṣṭhineyasya yo vā gataśrīḥ syāt /
meaning: पूर्वौ दुह्याज्ज्येष्ठस्य ज्यैष्ठिनेयस्य यो वा गतश्रीः स्यात् /
text_mt: He should milk the two front [teats] for the eldest son, for the son of the eldest wife, or for one who has attained prosperity;

sanskrit_iast: aparau duhyātkaniṣṭhasya kāniṣṭhaneyasya yo vānujāvaro yo vā bubhūṣet
meaning: अपरौ दुह्यात्कनिष्ठस्य कानिष्ठनेयस्य यो वानुजावरो यो वा बुभूषेत्
text_mt: he should milk the two hind [teats] for the youngest son, for the son of the youngest wife, for a younger brother, or for one who desires to prosper.
In the regular ritual form, he milks according to how they are grasped.

meaning: पूर्ववदुपसृष्टां दुह्यमानां धाराघोषं च यजमानो ऽनुमन्त्रयते
text_mt: The sacrificer follows [with formulas] the cow let loose, being milked, and the sound of the milk-stream, as before.
The offering should be made immediately after sunset.

sanskrit_iast: samudro vā eṣa yadahorātrastasyaite gādhe tīrthe yatsaṃdhī tasmātsamdhau hotavyamiti śailālibrāhmaṇaṃ bhavati
meaning: समुद्रो वा एष यदहोरात्रस्तस्यैते गाधे तीर्थे यत्संधी तस्मात्सम्धौ होतव्यमिति शैलालिब्राह्मणं भवति
text_mt: "Day and night are indeed an ocean; its shallow fords are the twilights. Therefore one should offer at twilight"—so says the Śailāli-Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭvā pradoṣe niśāyāṃ vā sāyam
meaning: नक्षत्रं दृष्ट्वा प्रदोषे निशायां वा सायम्
text_mt: In the evening, [one offers] having seen a star, at nightfall, or at night.
In the morning, [one offers] at dawn, near sunrise, when the sun is halfway risen, or when it has risen.

sanskrit_iast: yadudite juhotyagniṣṭomaṃ tenāvarunddhe yanmadhyaṃdine juhotyukthyaṃ tenāvarunddhe yadaparāhṇe juhoti ṣoḍaśinaṃ tenāvarunddhe yatpūrvarātre juhoti prathamaṃ tena rātriparyāyamapnoti yanmadhyarātre juhoti madhyamaṃ tena rātriparyāyamāpnoti yadapararātre juhoti jaghanyaṃ tena rātriparyāyamāpnoti
meaning: यदुदिते जुहोत्यग्निष्टोमं तेनावरुन्द्धे यन्मध्यंदिने जुहोत्युक्थ्यं तेनावरुन्द्धे यदपराह्णे जुहोति षोडशिनं तेनावरुन्द्धे यत्पूर्वरात्रे जुहोति प्रथमं तेन रात्रिपर्यायमप्नोति यन्मध्यरात्रे जुहोति मध्यमं तेन रात्रिपर्यायमाप्नोति यदपररात्रे जुहोति जघन्यं तेन रात्रिपर्यायमाप्नोति
text_mt: "When one offers after sunrise, thereby one secures the Agniṣṭoma; when one offers at midday, thereby one secures the Ukthya; when one offers in the afternoon, thereby one secures the Ṣoḍaśin; when one offers in the first part of the night, thereby one obtains the first night round; when one offers at midnight, thereby one obtains the middle night round; when one offers in the latter part of the night, thereby one obtains the last night round.

sanskrit_iast: sa na manyeta sarveṣveteṣu kāleṣu hotavyamāpadi hutamityeva pratīyāditi vijñāyate
meaning: स न मन्येत सर्वेष्वेतेषु कालेषु होतव्यमापदि हुतमित्येव प्रतीयादिति विज्ञायते
text_mt: He should not think that one ought to offer at all these times; one should understand that it is offered [at those times only] in case of emergency"—so it is known [from sacred tradition].
His agnihotra is accompanied by his wife.
The wife sits down in her own place.

sanskrit_iast: apareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇātikramyopaviśya yajamāno vidyudasi vidya me pāpmānamṛtātsatyamupaimi mayi śraddhetyapa ācāmati
meaning: अपरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणातिक्रम्योपविश्य यजमानो विद्युदसि विद्य मे पाप्मानमृतात्सत्यमुपैमि मयि श्रद्धेत्यप आचामति
text_mt: Having stepped beyond [the space] to the west of the āhavanīya toward the south and sat down, the sacrificer sips water, saying: "You are lightning; dispel my evil. From the cosmic order I approach truth; faith [be] in me."

sanskrit_iast: ṛtaṃ tvā satyena pariṣiñcāmīti sāyaṃ pariṣiñcati /
meaning: ऋतं त्वा सत्येन परिषिञ्चामीति सायं परिषिञ्चति /
text_mt: In the evening he sprinkles [the fires with water] with: "I sprinkle around you, cosmic order, with truth."
In the morning with: "I sprinkle around you, truth, with cosmic order."

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyamagre 'tha gārhapatyamatha dakṣiṇāgnimapi vā gārhapatyamāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇāgniṃ yathā vāhitāḥ
meaning: आहवनीयमग्रे ऽथ गार्हपत्यमथ दक्षिणाग्निमपि वा गार्हपत्यमाहवनीयं दक्षिणाग्निं यथा वाहिताः
text_mt: First the āhavanīya, then the gārhapatya, then the anvāhāryapacana; or the gārhapatya, the āhavanīya, and the anvāhāryapacana; or in the order in which they were established.

sanskrit_iast: yajñasya saṃtatirasi yajñasya tvā saṃtatimanusaṃtanomīti gārhaptayātprakramya saṃtatāmudakadhārāṃ srāvayatyāhavanīyāt
meaning: यज्ञस्य संततिरसि यज्ञस्य त्वा संततिमनुसंतनोमीति गार्हप्तयात्प्रक्रम्य संततामुदकधारां स्रावयत्याहवनीयात्
text_mt: Starting from the gārhapatya, he pours an unbroken stream of water up to the āhavanīya, saying: "You are the continuity of the sacrifice; I extend you continuously along the continuity of the sacrifice."

sanskrit_iast: dhṛṣṭirasi brahma yacchetyupaveṣamādāya bhūtakṛta sthāpoḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayamapoḍhāḥ senā abhītvarīriti gārhapatyādudīco 'ṅgārānnirūhya vyantāngārhapatyena kṛtvā sagrā sthetyabhimantrya japatyagnaya ādityaṃ gṛhṇāmyahne rātrimiti sāyam /
meaning: धृष्टिरसि ब्रह्म यच्छेत्युपवेषमादाय भूतकृत स्थापोढं जन्यं भयमपोढाः सेना अभीत्वरीरिति गार्हपत्यादुदीचो ऽङ्गारान्निरूह्य व्यन्तान्गार्हपत्येन कृत्वा सग्रा स्थेत्यभिमन्त्र्य जपत्यग्नय आदित्यं गृह्णाम्यह्ने रात्रिमिति सायम् /
text_mt: Taking the fire-shovel with: "You are the poker; bestow sacred power," having drawn out glowing coals toward the north from the gārhapatya with: "You are the performers of good deeds; pushed away is the peril caused by strangers; pushed away are the attacking armies," having placed them separate from the gārhapatya, and having addressed them with: "You are of the community," he mutters in the evening: "For Agni I take the sun, for the day the night."
In the morning: "For the sun I take Agni, for the night the day."

sanskrit_iast: iḍāyāḥ padaṃ ghṛtavaccarācaraṃ jātavedo haviridaṃ juṣasva /
meaning: इडायाः पदं घृतवच्चराचरं जातवेदो हविरिदं जुषस्व /
text_mt: "The step of Iḍā, rich in ghee, moving and unmoving, O Jātavedas, enjoy this oblation

sanskrit_iast: ye grāmyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpā virūpāsteṣāṃ saptānāmiha rantirastu /
meaning: ये ग्राम्याः पशवो विश्वरूपा विरूपास्तेषां सप्तानामिह रन्तिरस्तु /
text_mt: Whichever domestic animals of all kinds and diverse forms there are, may those seven find pleasure here
For increase of wealth, for good offspring, for good valour"—with these words he sets the agnihotra [milk] on those [coals].

meaning: न सुशृतं कुर्याद्रेतः कूलयेन्नो ऽशृतमन्तरेवैव स्यात्
text_mt: He should not make it fully cooked, [lest] he burn the semen; nor should it be uncooked; it should be just in between.
Having caused the bubbles to cease, [water] is to be poured in.

sanskrit_iast: apratiṣekyaṃ syāt tejaskāmasya brahmavarcasakāmasya pāpmānaṃ tustūrṣamāṇasyātho sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo 'tho yaḥ kāmayeta vīro ma ājāyeteti
meaning: अप्रतिषेक्यं स्यात् तेजस्कामस्य ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य पाप्मानं तुस्तूर्षमाणस्याथो सर्वेभ्यः कामेभ्यो ऽथो यः कामयेत वीरो म आजायेतेति
text_mt: It should not have [water] poured into it for one who desires lustre, for one who desires sacred splendour, for one wishing to overcome evil, as well as for all [other] desires, and for one who desires: "May a heroic son be born to me."

sanskrit_iast: adabdhena tvā cakṣuṣāvekṣa iti tṛṇena jvalatāvekṣate
meaning: अदब्धेन त्वा चक्षुषावेक्ष इति तृणेन ज्वलतावेक्षते
text_mt: He inspects it with a burning grass blade, saying: "I inspect you with an undeceiving eye."

sanskrit_iast: dohanasaṃkṣālanaṃ sruva ānīya haraste mā vinaiṣamiti tena pratiṣiñcaty apāṃ vā stokena
meaning: दोहनसंक्षालनं स्रुव आनीय हरस्ते मा विनैषमिति तेन प्रतिषिञ्चत्य् अपां वा स्तोकेन
text_mt: Having poured the wash-water of the milking vessel into the sruva, he pours it in with: "May I not take away your heat," or with a drop of water.

sanskrit_iast: udbhava sthodahaṃ prajayā pra paśubhirbhūyāsaṃ haraste mā vigādudyansuvargo lokastriṣu lokeṣu rocayeti punarevāvekṣyāntaritaṃ rakṣo 'ntaritā arātayo 'pahatā vyṛddhirapahataṃ pāpaṃ karmāpahataṃ pāpasya pāpakṛtaḥ pāpaṃ karma yo naḥ pāpaṃ karma cikīrṣati pratyagenamṛccheti triḥ paryagnikṛtvā gharmo 'si rāyaspoṣavanirihorjaṃ dṛṃheti vartma kruvan prāgudvāsayatyudak prāgudagvā
meaning: उद्भव स्थोदहं प्रजया प्र पशुभिर्भूयासं हरस्ते मा विगादुद्यन्सुवर्गो लोकस्त्रिषु लोकेषु रोचयेति पुनरेवावेक्ष्यान्तरितं रक्षो ऽन्तरिता अरातयो ऽपहता व्यृद्धिरपहतं पापं कर्मापहतं पापस्य पापकृतः पापं कर्म यो नः पापं कर्म चिकीर्षति प्रत्यगेनमृच्छेति त्रिः पर्यग्निकृत्वा घर्मो ऽसि रायस्पोषवनिरिहोर्जं दृंहेति वर्त्म क्रुवन् प्रागुद्वासयत्युदक् प्रागुदग्वा
text_mt: Saying: "You are originators; may I increase in offspring and cattle; may your heat not depart; rising, shine in the heavenly world, in the three worlds," having inspected it again, and having moved a firebrand three times around it with: "Warded off is the demon, warded off are the foes, smitten is failure, smitten is the evil deed, smitten is the evil deed of the evil evildoer; whoever wishes to do an evil deed to us, may he meet it head-on," he moves it off [the coals] toward the east, north-east, or north, making a path [in the ashes] with: "You are the hot drink, possessing increase of wealth; strengthen refreshment here."

sanskrit_iast: iha prajāṃ paśūndṛṃheti trirbhūmau pratiṣṭhāpya subhūtakṛta stha pratyūḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayaṃ pratyūḍhāḥ senā abhītvarīriti gārhapatye 'ṅgārān pratyūhya
meaning: इह प्रजां पशून्दृंहेति त्रिर्भूमौ प्रतिष्ठाप्य सुभूतकृत स्थ प्रत्यूढं जन्यं भयं प्रत्यूढाः सेना अभीत्वरीरिति गार्हपत्ये ऽङ्गारान् प्रत्यूह्य
text_mt: Having set it down three times on the ground with: "Strengthen offspring and cattle here," and having pushed back the coals into the gārhapatya with: "You are the performers of good deeds; driven back is the peril caused by strangers; driven back are the attacking armies,"

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasava iti sruksruvam ādāya pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ityāhavanīye gārhapatye vā pratitapyāriṣṭo yajamānaḥ patnī ceti saṃmṛśya hiraṇyayaṣṭirasyamṛtapalāśā sroto yajñānāmityagnihotrahavaṇīmabhimantryomunneṣyāmi havyaṃ devebhyaḥ pāpmano yajamānamiti sāyamāha /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इति स्रुक्स्रुवम् आदाय प्रत्युष्टं रक्षः प्रत्युष्टा अरातय इत्याहवनीये गार्हपत्ये वा प्रतितप्यारिष्टो यजमानः पत्नी चेति संमृश्य हिरण्ययष्टिरस्यमृतपलाशा स्रोतो यज्ञानामित्यग्निहोत्रहवणीमभिमन्त्र्योमुन्नेष्यामि हव्यं देवेभ्यः पाप्मनो यजमानमिति सायमाह /
text_mt: having taken the sruc and sruva with: "At the impulse of divine Savitṛ," having heated them at the āhavanīya or at the gārhapatya with: "Scorched is the demon, scorched are the foes," having touched them with: "Uninjured be the sacrificer and his wife," and having addressed the agnihotra ladle with: "You are a golden staff, with leaves of immortality, the stream of sacrifices," he says in the evening: "Om, I shall draw out the oblation for the gods, [and] the sacrificer from evil."

sanskrit_iast: havirdevānāmasi mṛtyorme 'bhayaṃ svasti me 'stvabhayaṃ me astvityupāṃśūktvomunnayetyuccairanujānāti /
meaning: हविर्देवानामसि मृत्योर्मे ऽभयं स्वस्ति मे ऽस्त्वभयं मे अस्त्वित्युपांशूक्त्वोमुन्नयेत्युच्चैरनुजानाति /
text_mt: Having said in a low voice: "You are the oblation of the gods; my fearlessness from death; may well-being be mine, may fearlessness be mine," he permits aloud with: "Om, draw it out."
In the absence of the sacrificer, [the adhvaryu] himself should give permission to himself.

sanskrit_iast: unnīyamāna ubau vācaṃ yacchata ā homāt
meaning: उन्नीयमान उबौ वाचं यच्छत आ होमात्
text_mt: While it is being drawn out, both restrain their speech until the oblation.
And the sacrificer does not close his eyes and stands.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta putrāṇāmayamṛdhnuyāditi taṃ prati pūrṇamunnayet
meaning: यं कामयेत पुत्राणामयमृध्नुयादिति तं प्रति पूर्णमुन्नयेत्
text_mt: Whichever of his sons he wishes: "May this one prosper," for him he should draw out a full ladleful.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta jyeṣṭhato 'sya prajārdhukā syāditi pūrṇaṃ prathamamunnayettata ūnataramūnataram /
meaning: यदि कामयेत ज्येष्ठतो ऽस्य प्रजार्धुका स्यादिति पूर्णं प्रथममुन्नयेत्तत ऊनतरमूनतरम् /
text_mt: If he wishes that his offspring should prosper starting from the eldest, he should draw out the first ladleful full, and then each subsequent one less and less.
Starting from the youngest, this is reversed.
If all [are to be] of equal vigour, [he draws out] equal amounts.
In the regular ritual, he draws it out as it comes to hand.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye ca tvā pṛthivyai connayāmīti prathamaṃ vāyave ca tvāntarikṣāya ceti dvitīyaṃ sūryāya ca tvā dive ceti tṛtīyaṃ candramase ca tvā nakṣatrebhyaśceti caturtham
meaning: अग्नये च त्वा पृथिव्यै चोन्नयामीति प्रथमं वायवे च त्वान्तरिक्षाय चेति द्वितीयं सूर्याय च त्वा दिवे चेति तृतीयं चन्द्रमसे च त्वा नक्षत्रेभ्यश्चेति चतुर्थम्
text_mt: [He draws out] the first with: "I draw you out for Agni and the earth," the second with: "For Vāyu and the atmosphere," the third with: "For Sūrya and the sky," and the fourth with: "For Candramas and the constellations."
For descendants of Jamadagni, a fifth with: "And for the waters and the plants."

sanskrit_iast: bhūriḍā bhuva iḍā suvariḍā karadiḍā pṛthigiḍeti vā pratimantram
meaning: भूरिडा भुव इडा सुवरिडा करदिडा पृथिगिडेति वा प्रतिमन्त्रम्
text_mt: Or [he draws it out] with the respective formulas: "Bhūḥ-iḍā, Bhuvaḥ-iḍā, Suvar-iḍā, Kara-iḍā, Pṛthak-iḍā."

sanskrit_iast: paśūnme yacchetyapareṇa gārhapatyamunnayanadeśe 'bhitarāṃ vā sādayitvā gārhapatye hastaṃ pratāpya saṃmṛśati sajūrdevaiḥ sāyaṃyāvabhiḥ sāyaṃyāvāno devāḥ svasti saṃpārayantu paśubhiḥ saṃpṛcīya prajāṃ dṛṃheti sāyam /
meaning: पशून्मे यच्छेत्यपरेण गार्हपत्यमुन्नयनदेशे ऽभितरां वा सादयित्वा गार्हपत्ये हस्तं प्रताप्य संमृशति सजूर्देवैः सायंयावभिः सायंयावानो देवाः स्वस्ति संपारयन्तु पशुभिः संपृचीय प्रजां दृंहेति सायम् /
text_mt: Having placed [the ladle] to the west of the gārhapatya at the drawing place or further inward with: "Bestow cattle upon me," and having warmed his hand at the gārhapatya, he touches [the ladle] in the evening with: "Together with the gods who go in the evening; may the gods who go in the evening bring about well-being; may I be united with cattle; strengthen the offspring."

sanskrit_iast: sajūrdevaiḥ prātaryāvabhiḥ prātaryāvāṇo devāḥ svasti saṃpārayantu paśubhiḥ saṃpṛcīya prajāṃ dṛṃheti prātaḥ
meaning: सजूर्देवैः प्रातर्यावभिः प्रातर्यावाणो देवाः स्वस्ति संपारयन्तु पशुभिः संपृचीय प्रजां दृंहेति प्रातः
text_mt: In the morning with: "Together with the gods who go in the morning; may the gods who go in the morning bring about well-being; may I be united with cattle; strengthen the offspring."

sanskrit_iast: daśahotrā cābhimṛśya pālāśīṃ samidhaṃ prādeśamātrīmupari dhārayangārhapatyasya samayārcirharati
meaning: दशहोत्रा चाभिमृश्य पालाशीं समिधं प्रादेशमात्रीमुपरि धारयन्गार्हपत्यस्य समयार्चिर्हरति
text_mt: And having touched it with the daśahotṛ formula, holding a palāśa kindling-stick a span long over it, he carries it past the flame of the gārhapatya.
He steps forward with: "Traverse the wide intermediate space."
While stepping forward, he recites the daśahotṛ formula.
At the middle region, he lowers it with: "Svāhā to Agni Vaiśvānara."
He raises it with: "For Vāta."

sanskrit_iast: upapreta saṃyatadhvaṃ māntargāta bhaginaṃ bhāgadheyātsaptarṣīṇāṃ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokastatremaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca dhehy upapratnamupa bhūrbhuvaḥ suvarāyurme yacchetyapareṇāhavanīyaṃ darbheṣu sādayati
meaning: उपप्रेत संयतध्वं मान्तर्गात भगिनं भागधेयात्सप्तर्षीणां सुकृतां यत्र लोकस्तत्रेमं यज्ञं यजमानं च धेह्य् उपप्रत्नमुप भूर्भुवः सुवरायुर्मे यच्छेत्यपरेणाहवनीयं दर्भेषु सादयति
text_mt: With: "Approach, unite yourselves; do not exclude him who has a portion from his share; where the world of the seven sages, the performers of good deeds, is, there place this sacrifice and the sacrificer; approach the ancient one, approach; bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar; bestow life upon me," he sets it down on darbha grass to the west of the āhavanīya.
"When it is offered while the fire is being carried forward, it is offered to the Vasus
When it lies smoking, [it is offered] to the Rudras
When the flame reaches the first firewood stick, [it is offered] to the Ādityas

sanskrit_iast: sarva eva sarvaśa idhma ādīpto bhavati viśveṣu deveṣu /
meaning: सर्व एव सर्वश इध्म आदीप्तो भवति विश्वेषु देवेषु /
text_mt: When the firewood is completely ablaze on all sides, [it is offered] to the Viśve Devas /"
When the flame goes down and becomes reddish, as it were, it is offered to Indra.

meaning: अङ्गारा भवन्ति तेभ्यो ऽङ्गारेभ्यो ऽर्चिरुदेति प्रजापतावेव /
text_mt: When there are coals and from those coals a flame rises up, it is [offered] to Prajāpati himself.

sanskrit_iast: śro 'ṅgārā adhyūhante tato nīlopakāśo 'rcirudeti brahmaṇi hutaṃ bhavati
meaning: श्रो ऽङ्गारा अध्यूहन्ते ततो नीलोपकाशो ऽर्चिरुदेति ब्रह्मणि हुतं भवति
text_mt: When coals are heaped up and then a flame with a bluish sheen rises up, it is offered to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: yadaṅgāreṣu vyavaśānteṣu lelāyadvīva bhāti taddevānāmāsyaṃ tasmāt tathā hotavyaṃ yathāsye 'pidadhātyevaṃ taditi vijñāyate
meaning: यदङ्गारेषु व्यवशान्तेषु लेलायद्वीव भाति तद्देवानामास्यं तस्मात् तथा होतव्यं यथास्ये ऽपिदधात्येवं तदिति विज्ञायते
text_mt: “When the coals have died down and it shines, flickering as it were, that is the mouth of the gods; therefore one should offer in such a way, just as one places [food] into a mouth, like that it is,” thus it is known from the tradition.

sanskrit_iast: vidyudasi vidya me pāpmānamṛtātsatyamupaimīti hoṣyannapa upaspṛśya pālāśīṃ samidhamādadhātyekāṃ dve tisro vā
meaning: विद्युदसि विद्य मे पाप्मानमृतात्सत्यमुपैमीति होष्यन्नप उपस्पृश्य पालाशीं समिधमादधात्येकां द्वे तिस्रो वा
text_mt: About to offer, he touches water with the words: “You are lightning; strike away my evil; from non-truth I approach truth,” and puts on a firewood stick of palāśa wood: one, two, or three.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyayaṃ tvā vaṃśaṃ svargasya lokasya saṃkramaṇaṃ dadhāmīti dvitīyām /
meaning: हिरण्ययं त्वा वंशं स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य संक्रमणं दधामीति द्वितीयाम् /
text_mt: With: “I place you as a golden beam, a stepping-stone to the heavenly world,” the second.

sanskrit_iast: rajatāṃ tvā haritagarbhāmagnijyotiṣamakṣitiṃ kāmadughāṃ svargyāṃ svargāya lokāya rātrimiṣṭakāmupadadhe tayā devatayāṅgirasvaddhruvā sīdeti sāyaṃ tṛtīyām /
meaning: रजतां त्वा हरितगर्भामग्निज्योतिषमक्षितिं कामदुघां स्वर्ग्यां स्वर्गाय लोकाय रात्रिमिष्टकामुपदधे तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीदेति सायं तृतीयाम् /
text_mt: In the evening, the third with: “You of silver, with a golden womb, whose light is fire, imperishable, milking desires, leading to heaven, I place as the night-brick for the heavenly world; through that deity, in the manner of the Aṅgirases, sit firm.”

sanskrit_iast: hariṇīṃ tvā rajatagarbhāṃ sūryajyotiṣamakṣitiṃ kāmadughāṃ svargyāṃ svargāya lokāyāhariṣṭakāmupadadha iti prātaḥ
meaning: हरिणीं त्वा रजतगर्भां सूर्यज्योतिषमक्षितिं कामदुघां स्वर्ग्यां स्वर्गाय लोकायाहरिष्टकामुपदध इति प्रातः
text_mt: In the morning with: “You of gold, with a silver womb, whose light is the sun, imperishable, milking desires, leading to heaven, I place as the day-brick for the heavenly world.”

sanskrit_iast: samidhamādhāya prāṇyāpānya nimīlya vīkṣya hutvā dhyāyedyatkāmaḥ syāt
meaning: समिधमाधाय प्राण्यापान्य निमील्य वीक्ष्य हुत्वा ध्यायेद्यत्कामः स्यात्
text_mt: Having put on the firewood stick, breathing in and out, closing his eyes and opening them, having offered, he should meditate on whatever he may desire.
Having offered, he looks intently at the great [fire].

sanskrit_iast: ādīptāyāṃ juhoti śyāvāyāṃ vā yadā vā samatītārcirlelāyatīva /
meaning: आदीप्तायां जुहोति श्यावायां वा यदा वा समतीतार्चिर्लेलायतीव /
text_mt: He offers when it is blazing, or when it has turned dark brown, or when the flame, having passed away, flickers as it were.
When it is smoking, for one who desires a village; when it is flaming, for one who desires spiritual luster; upon coals, for one who desires splendor.
He offers on the firewood stick two angulas from the base.
He offers stepping forward in the evening, stepping backward in the morning;
or stepping forward in both cases.
About to offer, he whispers: “Bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ.”
In the evening he offers the agnihotra with: “Agni is light, light is Agni, svāhā.”
In the morning with: “Sūrya is light, light is Sūrya, svāhā.”
Or the combined offering: in the evening with: “Agni is light, light is Sūrya, svāhā;”
