text_mt: fearlessness for our animals! Homage to bounteous Rudra!'—with this he should make an oblation or address [the cow].

And if she should sit down, having addressed her with this same [verse, substituting:] 'From whatever terror you have sat down', and having made her stand up with: 'The divine Aditi, having all forms, has stood up; she has placed life in the lord of the sacrifice;

sanskrit_iast: indrāya kṛṇvatī bhāgaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya cetyupasthāpya tāṃ dugdhvā brāhmaṇāya dadyādyasyānnaṃ nādyāt /
meaning: इन्द्राय कृण्वती भागं मित्राय वरुणाय चेत्युपस्थाप्य तां दुग्ध्वा ब्राह्मणाय दद्याद्यस्यान्नं नाद्यात् /
text_mt: making a portion for Indra, for Mitra, and for Varuṇa'—and having milked her, he should give [the milk] to a brahmin whose food he would not eat.
'He attaches misfortune and evil to him,' it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].
Or, having driven [her] away or made [her] rise with a stick, beating or not beating, he should keep [her] for himself.

sanskrit_iast: sūyavasādbhagavatī hi bhūyā atho vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma /
meaning: सूयवसाद्भगवती हि भूया अथो वयं भगवन्तः स्याम /
text_mt: 'May you be fortunate with good pasture, and so may we be fortunate;

sanskrit_iast: addhi tṛṇamadhnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddhamudakamācarantīti darbhastambamālupya grāsayet
meaning: अद्धि तृणमध्न्ये विश्वदानीं पिब शुद्धमुदकमाचरन्तीति दर्भस्तम्बमालुप्य ग्रासयेत्
text_mt: eat grass, O inviolable cow, at all times; drink pure water as you wander'—having pulled out a clump of darbha grass, he should feed it [to her].

sanskrit_iast: yadyu vai lohitaṃ duhīta vyutkrāmatetyuktvā dakṣiṇamagniṃ pariśritya tasminnetacchrapayitvā tasminvyāhṛtībhistūṣṇīṃ vā hutvā tāṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyādyamanabhyāgamiṣyansyāt
meaning: यद्यु वै लोहितं दुहीत व्युत्क्रामतेत्युक्त्वा दक्षिणमग्निं परिश्रित्य तस्मिन्नेतच्छ्रपयित्वा तस्मिन्व्याहृतीभिस्तूष्णीं वा हुत्वा तां ब्राह्मणाय दद्याद्यमनभ्यागमिष्यन्स्यात्
text_mt: And if she should yield blood, having said: 'Step apart!', having enclosed the southern fire, having boiled this [milk] on it, having offered [oblations] into it with the vyāhṛtis or silently, he should give that [cow] to a brahmin whom he does not intend to visit again.

sanskrit_iast: yadi duhyamānaṃ skandedyadadya dugdhaṃ pṛthivīmasakta yadoṣadhīrapyasaradyadāpaḥ /
meaning: यदि दुह्यमानं स्कन्देद्यदद्य दुग्धं पृथिवीमसक्त यदोषधीरप्यसरद्यदापः /
text_mt: If [the milk] being milked should spill: 'What milk today has adhered to the earth, what has gone into the plants, what into the waters,

sanskrit_iast: payo gṛheṣu payo aghniyāsu payo vatseṣu payo astu tanmayityenadabhimantrya samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomītyadbhirupasṛjet
meaning: पयो गृहेषु पयो अघ्नियासु पयो वत्सेषु पयो अस्तु तन्मयित्येनदभिमन्त्र्य समुद्रं वः प्रहिणोमीत्यद्भिरुपसृजेत्
text_mt: may there be milk in our houses, milk in the inviolable cows, milk in the calves, milk in me!'—having addressed it with this [verse], he should pour water over it with: 'I send you to the ocean.'
If [the cow] being milked should break the pot, having washed another, he should milk into it, or into that very one.

sanskrit_iast: yadi duhyamānaṃ dugdhaṃ hriyamāṇaṃ hṛtamadhiśrīyamāṇamadhiśritamudvāsyamānamudvāsitamunnīyamānamunnītaṃ vā skandettadeva yādṛkkīdṛkca hotavyamanyayā vābhidohyam
meaning: यदि दुह्यमानं दुग्धं ह्रियमाणं हृतमधिश्रीयमाणमधिश्रितमुद्वास्यमानमुद्वासितमुन्नीयमानमुन्नीतं वा स्कन्देत्तदेव यादृक्कीदृक्च होतव्यमन्यया वाभिदोह्यम्
text_mt: If [the milk] being milked, having been milked, being carried, having been carried, being placed on [the fire], having been placed on [the fire], being taken off, having been taken off, being drawn up, or having been drawn up should spill, just whatever it is should be offered, or [the milk of] another [cow] should be milked into it.
If, having been drawn once, it should spill, or twice or thrice, he should not pay heed to that.

sanskrit_iast: yadyu vai caturthamunnītaṃ skandetsthālyāṃ śeṣamavanīya caturabhyunnīya hotavyamanyayā vābhidohyam
meaning: यद्यु वै चतुर्थमुन्नीतं स्कन्देत्स्थाल्यां शेषमवनीय चतुरभ्युन्नीय होतव्यमन्यया वाभिदोह्यम्
text_mt: And if, having been drawn a fourth time, it should spill, having poured the remainder into the pot and having drawn [it] four times, it should be offered, or [the milk of] another [cow] should be milked into it.

sanskrit_iast: yadyuddrutasya skandettanniṣadya punargṛhītvā tadeva yādṛkkīdṛkca hotavyam /
meaning: यद्युद्द्रुतस्य स्कन्देत्तन्निषद्य पुनर्गृहीत्वा तदेव यादृक्कीदृक्च होतव्यम् /
text_mt: If it should spill of one who has run up, having sat down and taken it again, just whatever it is should be offered.
Then, having milked another [cow], an offering should be made again.
Then, having recited an invitatory verse addressed to Varuṇa, he should offer ghee with a consecratory verse addressed to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prācīnaṃ skandettadeva yādṛkkīdṛkca hotavyamanyayā vābhidohyam
meaning: यदि प्राचीनं स्कन्देत्तदेव यादृक्कीदृक्च होतव्यमन्यया वाभिदोह्यम्
text_mt: If it should spill toward the east, just whatever it is should be offered, or [the milk of] another [cow] should be milked into it.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prācīnaṃ hriyamāṇaṃ skandetprajāpaterviśvabhṛti tanvaṃ hutamasi svāhetyenadabhimantryaitadevāgnihotraṃ syādityāśmārathyaḥ /
meaning: यदि प्राचीनं ह्रियमाणं स्कन्देत्प्रजापतेर्विश्वभृति तन्वं हुतमसि स्वाहेत्येनदभिमन्त्र्यैतदेवाग्निहोत्रं स्यादित्याश्मारथ्यः /
text_mt: If it should spill while being carried toward the east, having addressed it with: 'You are offered as a body into Prajāpati's all-nourishing [fire], svāhā!', this alone should be the agnihotra, says Āśmarathya.
'Having milked another [cow], an offering should be made again,' says Ālekhana.

sanskrit_iast: yadi puraḥ parāhṛtaṃ skandedanūdāhṛtya caturabhyunnīya hotavyamanyayā vābhidohyam
meaning: यदि पुरः पराहृतं स्कन्देदनूदाहृत्य चतुरभ्युन्नीय होतव्यमन्यया वाभिदोह्यम्
text_mt: If it should spill after being carried forward, having brought [more milk] after it and having drawn it four times, it should be offered, or [the milk of] another [cow] should be milked into it.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pura upasannaṃ skandettadeva yādṛkkīdṛkca hotavyamanyayā vābhidohyam
meaning: यदि पुर उपसन्नं स्कन्देत्तदेव यादृक्कीदृक्च होतव्यमन्यया वाभिदोह्यम्
text_mt: If it should spill when placed in front [of the fire], just whatever it is should be offered, or [the milk of] another [cow] should be milked into it.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pura upasannamahutaṃ skandettadeva yādṛkkīdṛkca hotavyam /
meaning: यदि पुर उपसन्नमहुतं स्कन्देत्तदेव यादृक्कीदृक्च होतव्यम् /
text_mt: If it should spill unoffered when placed in front [of the fire], just whatever it is should be offered.
Then, having milked another [cow], an offering should be made again.
Then with ghee [he offers to] Varuṇa—the rest is the same.
'The sky has spilled onto the earth; the youthful bull has spilled onto the cows;

sanskrit_iast: skannemā viśvā bhuvanā skanno yañaḥ prajanayatu //
meaning: स्कन्नेमा विश्वा भुवना स्कन्नो यञः प्रजनयतु //
text_mt: having spilled, [may it quicken] all these worlds; may the spilled sacrifice produce offspring!
It has spilled, it has been born, related to Prajāpati; from what has spilled a bull is born;
from what has spilled may we be born with offspring'—having addressed what has spilled with this [formula], he should pour water over it with: 'Make the earth swell!'
Whatever is not the measure of an oblation is merely a drop.
If it should spill in the evening, he should not eat until the morning offering.
If in the morning, he should not eat until the evening offering.
A divine thunderbolt indeed comes down upon him whose agnihotra [milk] hisses;
he should say: 'Burn so-and-so!', naming the one whom he hates.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāgnihotre 'dhiśrite śvāntarāgnī dhāvedgārhapatyādbhasmādāyedaṃ viṣṇurvicakrama iti vaiṣṇavyarcāhavanīyāddhvaṃsayannuddrutyaitayaiva bhasmanā śunaḥ padamapivapet
meaning: यस्याग्निहोत्रे ऽधिश्रिते श्वान्तराग्नी धावेद्गार्हपत्याद्भस्मादायेदं विष्णुर्विचक्रम इति वैष्णव्यर्चाहवनीयाद्ध्वंसयन्नुद्द्रुत्यैतयैव भस्मना शुनः पदमपिवपेत्
text_mt: If a dog should run between the fires while his agnihotra is placed on [the fire], having taken ashes from the gārhapatya, scattering them from the āhavanīya with the verse addressed to Viṣṇu: 'Through this Viṣṇu strode...', having run up, he should strew the dog's footprint with ashes with this very [verse].

sanskrit_iast: yasyāgnimanāhṛtaṃ sūryo 'bhinimrocedyatra dīpyamānaṃ parāpaśyettata āhṛtyaitaṃ praviśānīti vaiṣa ādhīyate
meaning: यस्याग्निमनाहृतं सूर्यो ऽभिनिम्रोचेद्यत्र दीप्यमानं परापश्येत्तत आहृत्यैतं प्रविशानीति वैष आधीयते
text_mt: If the sun should set while his fire has not been brought [forward], having fetched it from where he sees it burning in the distance, it is established with: 'May I enter this.'
Such is the procedure for establishing the dakṣiṇāgni when it has become extinguished.
If the sun should set while his fire has not been taken out [from the gārhapatya]:
Having tied gold with a blade of darbha grass, he should carry it in front.
Behind [it], an Ārṣeya brahmin of great learning should take out the fire.
Behind [him], he should run after with the agnihotra [milk].

sanskrit_iast: āyatane hiraṇye 'gniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya nityamagnihotramupasādyā tamitoraprāṇannāsitvā samanya hutvā bhūrbhuvaḥ suvarityupasthāya vāruṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapet
meaning: आयतने हिरण्ये ऽग्निं प्रतिष्ठाप्य नित्यमग्निहोत्रमुपसाद्या तमितोरप्राणन्नासित्वा समन्य हुत्वा भूर्भुवः सुवरित्युपस्थाय वारुणं चरुं निर्वपेत्
text_mt: Having established the fire on gold in its proper place, having set down the regular agnihotra, having sat without exhaling until exhaustion, having breathed out and offered, and having attended upon [the fire] with 'Bhūḥ Bhuvaḥ Suvaḥ', he should set apart a cooked mess for Varuṇa.
Some teach a second [offering] dedicated to the Vrātabhṛts;
some teach that the bringing forward is done without gold.

sanskrit_iast: yadi sāyamagnihotrakālo 'tipadyeta doṣā vastornamaḥ svāheti kālasamāpādanīyaṃ homaṃ hutvā nityamagnihotramupasādyā tamitoraprāṇannāsitvā samanya hutvā bhūrbhuvaḥ suvar ity upatiṣṭheta
meaning: यदि सायमग्निहोत्रकालो ऽतिपद्येत दोषा वस्तोर्नमः स्वाहेति कालसमापादनीयं होमं हुत्वा नित्यमग्निहोत्रमुपसाद्या तमितोरप्राणन्नासित्वा समन्य हुत्वा भूर्भुवः सुवर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत
text_mt: If the time for the evening agnihotra should pass, having offered the oblation that adjusts the proper time with: 'In the evening and in the morning, reverence, svāhā!', having set down the regular agnihotra, having sat without exhaling until exhaustion, having breathed out and offered, he should attend upon [the fire] with 'Bhūḥ Bhuvaḥ Suvaḥ'.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prātaḥ prātarvastornamaḥ svāheti kālasamāpādanīyaṃ homaṃ hutvā nityamagnihotramupasādyā tamitoraprāṇannāsitvā samanya hutvā bhūrbhuvaḥ suvar ity upatiṣṭheta
meaning: यदि प्रातः प्रातर्वस्तोर्नमः स्वाहेति कालसमापादनीयं होमं हुत्वा नित्यमग्निहोत्रमुपसाद्या तमितोरप्राणन्नासित्वा समन्य हुत्वा भूर्भुवः सुवर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत
text_mt: If [it is] in the morning, having offered the time-fitting libation with "In the morning, to the light, homage, svāhā!", having set down the regular agnihotra, having sat without breathing until [he feels] suffocated, having breathed out and offered, he should worship [the sun] with: "Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ!"

sanskrit_iast: hutvāhavanīyamudvāpyānvagniruṣasāmagramakhyadityanyaṃ praṇīyehaiva kṣemya edhi mā prahāsīnmāmumāmuṣyāyaṇamityādityamupasthāya maitraṃ caruṃ nirvapet
meaning: हुत्वाहवनीयमुद्वाप्यान्वग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यदित्यन्यं प्रणीयेहैव क्षेम्य एधि मा प्रहासीन्मामुमामुष्यायणमित्यादित्यमुपस्थाय मैत्रं चरुं निर्वपेत्
text_mt: Having offered, having extinguished the āhavanīya, having brought forward another [fire] with "Agni has seen the front of the dawns...", and having worshipped the sun with "Be prosperous right here; do not abandon me, such and such a person, son of such and such!", he should offer a caru to Mitra.
Some teach [a cake] on one potsherd to Sūrya.
When the sacrifice is completed, the sacrificer and his wife remain fasting and restrained in speech on that day, kindling only the āhavanīya.
He should offer the evening agnihotra with the milk of two [cows], as before.
If the sun rises upon one whose fire has not been taken out, he should carry ghee taken in four ladlings to the front;
following [him], a learned brāhmaṇa of ṛṣi-descent should take out the fire;
following [him], he should run forward with the agnihotra [milk].

sanskrit_iast: āyatane 'gniṃ pratiṣṭhāpyoṣāḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ yajñaṃ devebhiranvitam /
meaning: आयतने ऽग्निं प्रतिष्ठाप्योषाः केतुना जुषतां यज्ञं देवेभिरन्वितम् /
text_mt: Having established the fire in its place, [with the verse:] "May Dawn with her banner enjoy the sacrifice attended by the gods,
most sweet to the gods, svāhā!"—sitting down facing west, he should make an offering with ghee.
That same is the rite of offering the agnihotra.
The expiation for that is the one for [the agnihotra whose] time has elapsed in the morning.
he does not extinguish the āhavanīya here.
If the sun sets or rises upon one whose fire has not been taken out,

sanskrit_iast: mano jyotirjuṣatāṃ trayastriṃśattantava iti dve caturgṛhīte juhuyāt
meaning: मनो ज्योतिर्जुषतां त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तन्तव इति द्वे चतुर्गृहीते जुहुयात्
text_mt: he should offer two four-fold ladlings [of ghee] with "May the mind enjoy the light..." and "Thirty-three threads...".

sanskrit_iast: yasya viprakrāntamahutamagnihotraṃ sūryo 'bhyudiyādyathā vijaniṣyamāṇo na vijāyeta tādṛktat /
meaning: यस्य विप्रक्रान्तमहुतमग्निहोत्रं सूर्यो ऽभ्युदियाद्यथा विजनिष्यमाणो न विजायेत तादृक्तत् /
text_mt: If the sun rises upon one whose agnihotra has been carried out but not offered, it is like [a woman] about to give birth who does not give birth;

sanskrit_iast: ātmānaṃ vā ha yajamāno ruṇaddhi sarvajyāniṃ vā jīyate /
meaning: आत्मानं वा ह यजमानो रुणद्धि सर्वज्यानिं वा जीयते /
text_mt: either the sacrificer obstructs himself, or he suffers total loss.

sanskrit_iast: nityamagnihotramupasādyā tamitoraprāṇannāsitvā samanya hutvā bhūrbhuvaḥ suvarityupatiṣṭheta /
meaning: नित्यमग्निहोत्रमुपसाद्या तमितोरप्राणन्नासित्वा समन्य हुत्वा भूर्भुवः सुवरित्युपतिष्ठेत /
text_mt: Having set down the regular agnihotra, having sat without breathing until [he feels] suffocated, having breathed out and offered, he should worship [the sun] with: "Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ!"
Having offered, having extinguished it, the re-establishment [of the fires] is its expiation—so says Āśmarathya.
If it is at the end, having ladled out [the milk], he should run out towards the east.
Having set it down, he should sit until [he feels] suffocated.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadā tāmyedatha bhūḥ svāheti juhuyāt /
meaning: स यदा ताम्येदथ भूः स्वाहेति जुहुयात् /
text_mt: When he suffocates, then he should offer with: "Bhūḥ svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatirvai bhūtastamevopāsaretsa evainaṃ tata unnayati nārtimārchati yajamāna iti vijñāyate
meaning: प्रजापतिर्वै भूतस्तमेवोपासरेत्स एवैनं तत उन्नयति नार्तिमार्छति यजमान इति विज्ञायते
text_mt: "Prajāpati, indeed, is Bhūḥ; he approaches him; he raises him from that; the sacrificer suffers no affliction"—so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: yasyāgnihotraṃ vicchidyeta dvyahe tryahe caturahe vāgnaye tantumate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet
meaning: यस्याग्निहोत्रं विच्छिद्येत द्व्यहे त्र्यहे चतुरहे वाग्नये तन्तुमते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत्
text_mt: One whose agnihotra has been interrupted for two days, three days, or four days should offer [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni Tantumat.

sanskrit_iast: svayaṃ kṛṇvānaḥ sugamaprayāvaṃ tigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabhaḥ śośucānaḥ /
meaning: स्वयं कृण्वानः सुगमप्रयावं तिग्मशृङ्गो वृषभः शोशुचानः /
text_mt: "Making for himself an easy path, unhindered, / the sharp-horned bull gleaming bright,
beholding his ancient dwelling-place, / Agni has extended the divine thread."

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ nastanturuta seturagne tvaṃ panthā bhavasi devayānaḥ /
meaning: त्वं नस्तन्तुरुत सेतुरग्ने त्वं पन्था भवसि देवयानः /
text_mt: "Thou art our thread and our bridge, O Agni; / thou becomest the path leading to the gods.

sanskrit_iast: tvayāgne pṛṣṭhaṃ vayamāruhemāthā devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ mademeti yajyānuvākye
meaning: त्वयाग्ने पृष्ठं वयमारुहेमाथा देवैः सधमादं मदेमेति यज्यानुवाक्ये
text_mt: By thee, O Agni, may we mount to the ridge / and rejoice together with the gods"—these are the invitatory and consecratory verses.

sanskrit_iast: tantuṃ tanvannudbudhyasvāgna uduttamamudvayaṃ tamasasparyudu tyaṃ citramityupahomāḥ
meaning: तन्तुं तन्वन्नुद्बुध्यस्वाग्न उदुत्तममुद्वयं तमसस्पर्युदु त्यं चित्रमित्युपहोमाः
text_mt: "Extending the thread...", "Wake up, O Agni...", "The highest...", "Looking upon the higher light above the darkness...", "The bright face of the gods has arisen..."—these are the minor libations.
"Bearer of the oblation, vanquisher of foes, / slayer of demons, victorious in battles, / full of light, shining, wise— / we summon Agni Sviṣṭakṛt."
Luminous, shining, generous, / Agni Sviṣṭakṛt let us invoke.

sanskrit_iast: sviṣṭamagne abhi tatpṛṇāhi viśvā deva pṛtanā abhiṣya /
meaning: स्विष्टमग्ने अभि तत्पृणाहि विश्वा देव पृतना अभिष्य /
text_mt: "O Agni, fulfill that which is well offered; / overpower all hosts, O god!

sanskrit_iast: uruṃ naḥ panthāṃ pradiśanvibhāhi jyotiṣmaddhehyajaraṃ na āyuriti saṃyājye
meaning: उरुं नः पन्थां प्रदिशन्विभाहि ज्योतिष्मद्धेह्यजरं न आयुरिति संयाज्ये
text_mt: Shine forth, pointing out to us a wide path; / bestow on us an unaging life full of light!"—these are the two saṃyājyā verses.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāhavanīye 'nudvāte gārhapatya udvāyedāhavanīyamudvāpya gārhapatyaṃ mantheditaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe agnirityetayā /
meaning: यस्याहवनीये ऽनुद्वाते गार्हपत्य उद्वायेदाहवनीयमुद्वाप्य गार्हपत्यं मन्थेदितः प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निरित्येतया /
text_mt: If, while his āhavanīya is not extinguished, the gārhapatya should go out, having extinguished the āhavanīya, he should churn out the gārhapatya with this verse: "Agni was born first from here...".

sanskrit_iast: agne samrāḍiṣe rayyai ramasva sahase dyumnāyorjapatyāyetyabhimantrya samrāḍasi virāḍasi sārasvatu tvotsau samindhātāmannādaṃ tvānnapatyāyetyupasamidhyānvagniruṣasāmagramakhyadityanyaṃ praṇīyāgnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet
meaning: अग्ने सम्राडिषे रय्यै रमस्व सहसे द्युम्नायोर्जपत्यायेत्यभिमन्त्र्य सम्राडसि विराडसि सारस्वतु त्वोत्सौ समिन्धातामन्नादं त्वान्नपत्यायेत्युपसमिध्यान्वग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यदित्यन्यं प्रणीयाग्नये तपस्वते जनद्वते पावकवते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत्
text_mt: Having addressed [the fire] with "O Agni, sovereign, delight in food and wealth, in strength, splendor, and abundance of food!", having kindled it with "Thou art a sovereign, thou art an emperor; may the two Sarasvatī springs kindle thee; thee, the eater of food, for food-lordship!", and having brought forward another [fire] with "Agni has seen the front of the dawns...", he should offer [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni Tapasvat Janadvat Pāvakavat.
Some teach this sacrifice on extinction under all circumstances.
"Come with heat among men, O Agni, / purifying with your flame,

sanskrit_iast: ā no yāhi tapasā janeṣvagne pāvaka dīdyat /
meaning: आ नो याहि तपसा जनेष्वग्ने पावक दीद्यत् /
text_mt: "Come to us with heat among men, / O Agni, shining, purifying,
placing our oblations among the gods!"—these are the invitatory and consecratory verses.

meaning: आहवनीये ऽनुगते ऽग्नये ज्योतिष्मते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपति
text_mt: If the āhavanīya is extinguished, he offers [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni Jyotiṣmat,

sanskrit_iast: yadi sāyamahute 'gnihotre pūrvo 'gniranugacchedadhiśrityāgnihotramunnīya vāgninā ca sahāgnihotreṇa cānuddravet /
meaning: यदि सायमहुते ऽग्निहोत्रे पूर्वो ऽग्निरनुगच्छेदधिश्रित्याग्निहोत्रमुन्नीय वाग्निना च सहाग्निहोत्रेण चानुद्द्रवेत् /
text_mt: If, in the evening before the agnihotra is offered, the eastern fire should go out, having put the agnihotra [milk] on the fire or having ladled it out, he should run forward together with the fire and the agnihotra [milk];
a learned brāhmaṇa should take it out;
whatever wealth he would not previously have given, that he should give.
"He removes him by means of that which is unshaken"—so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: yadi prātarahute 'gnihotre 'paro 'gniranugacchedanugamayitvā pūrvaṃ pūrvavanmathitvāparaṃ pūrvavaduddhṛtya jhuyāt
meaning: यदि प्रातरहुते ऽग्निहोत्रे ऽपरो ऽग्निरनुगच्छेदनुगमयित्वा पूर्वं पूर्ववन्मथित्वापरं पूर्ववदुद्धृत्य झुयात्
text_mt: If, in the morning before the agnihotra is offered, the western fire should go out, having extinguished the eastern one, having churned out the western one as before, and having taken out [the eastern one] as before, he should offer.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tvareta pūrvamanvavasāya tataḥ prāṅuddhṛtya juhuyāt
meaning: यदि त्वरेत पूर्वमन्ववसाय ततः प्राङुद्धृत्य जुहुयात्
text_mt: If he should be in a hurry, having transferred the eastern [fire to the gārhapatya] and having taken it out towards the east from there, he should offer.

meaning: जमि तु तद्यो ऽस्य पूर्वस्तमपरं करोति /
text_mt: It is, however, an excess when one turns what is his eastern fire into the western fire;
having transferred it elsewhere, having churned out the western one as before, and having taken out [the eastern one] as before, he should offer.

meaning: श्वोभुते ऽग्नये तपस्वते जनद्वत इति समानम्
text_mt: on the next day, [the rite] to Agni Tapasvat Janadvat is the same.
If someone's fire should go out, he should not pay heed to the time;
having extinguished the eastern one, having churned out the western one as before, and having taken out [the eastern one] as before, he should offer.
He should prepare a twelve-pot-sherd cake for Agni Vaiśvānara [and] a barley pap for Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yadi gārhaptaya āhavanīyo vānugacchettebhya evāvakṣāṇebhyo 'dhi manthitavyaḥ /
meaning: यदि गार्हप्तय आहवनीयो वानुगच्छेत्तेभ्य एवावक्षाणेभ्यो ऽधि मन्थितव्यः /
text_mt: If the gārhapatya or the āhavanīya should go out, it should be churned out from those very embers.

sanskrit_iast: yadi na tādṛśānīvāvakṣāṇāni syurbhasmanāraṇī saṃsparśya manthitavyaḥ /
meaning: यदि न तादृशानीवावक्षाणानि स्युर्भस्मनारणी संस्पर्श्य मन्थितव्यः /
text_mt: If there should not be such embers, it should be churned after touching the two churning sticks with ashes.
"He produces it from its own womb," so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].
Likewise when ignited with dung or ignited with grass.
[The rule] "For Agni possessing heat, accompanied by people" is the same.

sanskrit_iast: anugateṣṭervā sthāna etā āhutīrjuhuyānmitrāya svāhā varuṇā svāhāgnaye svāhāgnaye vratapataye svāhāgnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate svāhāgnaye śucaye svāhāgnaye jyotiṣmate svāhā sūryāya svāheti vyāhṛtībhirvihṛtābhiḥ samastābhiśca juhuyāt
meaning: अनुगतेष्टेर्वा स्थान एता आहुतीर्जुहुयान्मित्राय स्वाहा वरुणा स्वाहाग्नये स्वाहाग्नये व्रतपतये स्वाहाग्नये तपस्वते जनद्वते पावकवते स्वाहाग्नये शुचये स्वाहाग्नये ज्योतिष्मते स्वाहा सूर्याय स्वाहेति व्याहृतीभिर्विहृताभिः समस्ताभिश्च जुहुयात्
text_mt: Or, in place of the sacrifice for the extinguished fire, he should offer these oblations: "To Mitra hail! To Varuṇa hail! To Agni hail! To Agni, lord of vows, hail! To Agni possessing heat, accompanied by people, possessing purifying power, hail! To Agni the pure hail! To Agni the luminous hail! To Sūrya hail!"—[and] he should offer with the sacred utterances separately and together.
If the āhavanīya should go out before the time of offering, he should bring forth another from the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: yadi homakale praṇa udānamapayagāditi gārhapatye juhuyāt
meaning: यदि होमकले प्रण उदानमपयगादिति गार्हपत्ये जुहुयात्
text_mt: If at the time of offering, he should offer into the gārhapatya with: "The out-breath has merged into the up-breath."
If the gārhapatya [goes out], into the āhavanīya with: "The up-breath has merged into the out-breath."
If the southern fire [goes out], into the gārhapatya with: "The cross-breath has merged into the up-breath."

sanskrit_iast: yadi sarve 'nugaccheyuragniṃ mathitvā yāṃ diśaṃ vāto vāyāttāṃ diśamuddhṛtya vāyave svāheti juhuyāt
meaning: यदि सर्वे ऽनुगच्छेयुरग्निं मथित्वा यां दिशं वातो वायात्तां दिशमुद्धृत्य वायवे स्वाहेति जुहुयात्
text_mt: If all should go out, having churned fire, taking it out in whichever direction the wind blows, he should offer with: "To Vāyu hail!"

sanskrit_iast: yadyu vai nivāte mathitvā vihāraṃ sādhayitvāpareṇāhavanīyaṃ yajamāna upaviśya svayamagnihotraṃ pibet /
meaning: यद्यु वै निवाते मथित्वा विहारं साधयित्वापरेणाहवनीयं यजमान उपविश्य स्वयमग्निहोत्रं पिबेत् /
text_mt: If, however, in a windless place, having churned, having arranged the sacrificial layout, the sacrificer, sitting to the west of the āhavanīya, should himself drink the agnihotra;
"It becomes a substitution for the agnihotra," so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: yadi prāgastamayājjuhuyātpunarevāstamite hutvā bhavataṃ naḥ samanasāvityupatiṣṭheta
meaning: यदि प्रागस्तमयाज्जुहुयात्पुनरेवास्तमिते हुत्वा भवतं नः समनसावित्युपतिष्ठेत
text_mt: If he should offer before sunset, having offered again once it has set, he should attend upon [the fire] with: "Be of one mind with us..."
If in the dead of night, having offered again at dawn, he should attend upon [the fire] with this very [formula].
If, while sprinkling the oblation, he should sprinkle upon the fire, he should sacrifice with a sacrifice of clarified butter.
He should rekindle the fire with: "May the Ādityas, the Rudras, the Vasus rekindle you..."
Thus in all damages to the fires.
He on whose fire they bring forth another fire should offer an eight-pot-sherd cake to Agni possessed of fire.
"In whatever manner they bring it forth, there is expiation," says Āśmarathya.

sanskrit_iast: yadyasaṃnyupte spāśayeyuranugamayeyurenaṃ na prāyaścittam ity ālekhanaḥ
meaning: यद्यसंन्युप्ते स्पाशयेयुरनुगमयेयुरेनं न प्रायश्चित्तम् इत्य् आलेखनः
text_mt: "If, before [the oblation] is poured together, they perceive it [and] extinguish it, there is no expiation," says Ālekhana.
"An eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni the luminous" has been stated.
Then he should offer an oblation with: "The thirty-three threads..."

sanskrit_iast: yasya sāṃnāyye 'dhiśrite haviṣi vā nirupte puruṣāḥ śvāno ratho vāntarāgnī vīyāddurvarāhaiḍako vā tadatrāpo 'nvatiṣicya gāmanvatyāvartayedvardhatāṃ bhūtirdadhnā ghṛtena muñcatu yajño yajñapatimaṃhasaḥ svāheti
meaning: यस्य सांनाय्ये ऽधिश्रिते हविषि वा निरुप्ते पुरुषाः श्वानो रथो वान्तराग्नी वीयाद्दुर्वराहैडको वा तदत्रापो ऽन्वतिषिच्य गामन्वत्यावर्तयेद्वर्धतां भूतिर्दध्ना घृतेन मुञ्चतु यज्ञो यज्ञपतिमंहसः स्वाहेति
text_mt: If, when the milk oblation has been set on the fire or the oblation has been poured out, men, dogs, or a chariot, or a wild boar or a ram should cross between the fires, having poured water along there, he should make a cow walk along it with: "May prosperity increase with curd and ghee; may the sacrifice release the lord of the sacrifice from distress, hail!"

sanskrit_iast: devāñjanamaganyajñastato mā yajñasyāśīrāgacchatu pitṝnpañcajanāndiśa āpa oṣadhīrvanaspatīñjanamaganyajñastato mā yajñasyāśrīrāgacchatviti ṣaḍāhutīrhutvedaṃ viṣṇurvicakrama iti vartma samūhe /
meaning: देवाञ्जनमगन्यज्ञस्ततो मा यज्ञस्याशीरागच्छतु पितॄन्पञ्चजनान्दिश आप ओषधीर्वनस्पतीञ्जनमगन्यज्ञस्ततो मा यज्ञस्याश्रीरागच्छत्विति षडाहुतीर्हुत्वेदं विष्णुर्विचक्रम इति वर्त्म समूहे /
text_mt: Having offered six oblations with: "The sacrifice has gone to the divine people; thence may the blessing of the sacrifice come to me! To the ancestors, to the five classes of men, to the quarters, to the waters, to the plants and trees, the sacrifice has gone to the people; thence may the prosperity of the sacrifice come to me!", he sweeps together the tracks with: "This Viṣṇu strode..."

sanskrit_iast: yasyāno vā ratho vāntarāgnī yatyāhavanīyamudvāpya gārhapatyāduddharedyadagne pūrvaṃ prabhṛtaṃ padaṃ hi te sūryasya raśmīnanvātatāna /
meaning: यस्यानो वा रथो वान्तराग्नी यत्याहवनीयमुद्वाप्य गार्हपत्यादुद्धरेद्यदग्ने पूर्वं प्रभृतं पदं हि ते सूर्यस्य रश्मीनन्वाततान /
text_mt: For him between whose fires a cart or a chariot passes, having extinguished the āhavanīya, he should take it out from the gārhapatya with: "Since, O Agni, your former brought-forward step stretched along the rays of the sun,

sanskrit_iast: tatra rayiṣṭhāmanusaṃbharaitaṃ saṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyā //
meaning: तत्र रयिष्ठामनुसंभरैतं सं नः सृज सुमत्या वाजवत्या //
text_mt: there bring together this resting upon wealth; unite us with good, prize-bearing favor."
[and] with these two: "You, O Agni, are wide-reaching..."
Then he should offer a cake to Agni Pathikṛt as before.
or for him whose fires they cross with fires, or who crosses [them himself];
or for him between whose fires they distribute fires;
With the milk of a cow whose calf is fostered by another, he should offer the agnihotra for him until the contact of the body with the fires.

sanskrit_iast: ye purodañco darbhāstāndakṣiṇāgrānkṛtvā dakṣiṇārdhe gārhapatyasya śīte bhasmanyadhiśritya dakṣiṇodvāsya sakṛdeva sarvaṃ tūṣṇīmunnīyādhastātsamidhaṃ dhārayandakṣiṇena vihāramuddravati
meaning: ये पुरोदञ्चो दर्भास्तान्दक्षिणाग्रान्कृत्वा दक्षिणार्धे गार्हपत्यस्य शीते भस्मन्यधिश्रित्य दक्षिणोद्वास्य सकृदेव सर्वं तूष्णीमुन्नीयाधस्तात्समिधं धारयन्दक्षिणेन विहारमुद्द्रवति
text_mt: Having turned the darbha grasses that point east so that their tips point south, having placed [the milk] on cold ashes on the southern half of the gārhapatya, having taken it down towards the south, having drawn it all up silently just once, holding a kindling stick underneath, he runs forth south of the sacrificial layout.
"For he holds it above for the gods," so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: sa upaṣadya samidhamādhāya sakṛdeva sarvaṃ tūṣṇīṃ juhuyāt
meaning: स उपषद्य समिधमाधाय सकृदेव सर्वं तूष्णीं जुहुयात्
text_mt: Having approached, having laid the kindling stick on [the fire], he should offer everything silently just once.
Or he should mentally refer to Soma accompanied by the ancestors at the first oblation,
and to Agni the carrier of kavya at the second.
The consuming, the pouring out, and the sprinkling around do not take place.
He gives the sacrificial utensils to Brahmins.
They throw the earthenware ones into water at home.
If they should hear that one who has not died is dead, he should prepare an eight-pot-sherd cake for Agni the fragrant.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pūrvasyāmāhutyāṃ hutāyāṃ yajamāno mriyeta dakṣiṇataḥ śīte bhasmanyuttarāmāhutiṃ ninayet
meaning: यदि पूर्वस्यामाहुत्यां हुतायां यजमानो म्रियेत दक्षिणतः शीते भस्मन्युत्तरामाहुतिं निनयेत्
text_mt: If, when the first oblation has been offered, the sacrificer should die, he should pour the second oblation to the south into cold ashes.
Or he should take it to the heap of ashes.
"He should make here that which is the first oblation in the Pitṛmedha," say some.

sanskrit_iast: yadi visaṃsthitāyāmiṣṭyāṃ yajamāno mriyeta sarvataḥ samavadāya sarvā devatā anudrutya svāhākāreṇa juhuyāt
meaning: यदि विसंस्थितायामिष्ट्यां यजमानो म्रियेत सर्वतः समवदाय सर्वा देवता अनुद्रुत्य स्वाहाकारेण जुहुयात्
text_mt: If the sacrificer should die while a sacrifice is uncompleted, having cut off [portions] from all sides, having recited all the deities in succession, he should offer with the word 'svāhā'.

sanskrit_iast: yadyāhitāgniḥ proṣitaḥ pramīto na prajñāyeta yāṃ diśamabhiprasthitaḥ syāttāmasyāgnibhiḥ kakṣaṃ daheyuḥ
meaning: यद्याहिताग्निः प्रोषितः प्रमीतो न प्रज्ञायेत यां दिशमभिप्रस्थितः स्यात्तामस्याग्निभिः कक्षं दहेयुः
text_mt: If an āhitāgni who has died abroad cannot be found, they should burn dry grass with his fires in whichever direction he had set out.
Or else three hundred and sixty palāśa stalks.
With them, they make the form of a man on a black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: palāśavalkaiḥ kuśair vā saṃdhiṣu saṃveṣṭya catvāriṃśatā śiraḥ prakalpayate /
meaning: पलाशवल्कैः कुशैर् वा संधिषु संवेष्ट्य चत्वारिंशता शिरः प्रकल्पयते /
text_mt: Having bound [them] at the joints with palāśa bark or kuśa grass, he forms the head with forty;
the neck with ten; the chest with twenty; the belly with thirty; each arm with fifty apiece;
from those two [lots of fifty] he forms the fingers with five apiece;
With seventy [stalks] each, each leg;
From these very [stalks], with five each, he prepares the toes;
With eight the penis, with twelve the testicles.

sanskrit_iast: taiḥ kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā snāpayitvālaṃkṛtyānarvedi kṛṣṇājinaṃ dakṣiṇāgrīvamadharalomāstīrya tasminnenamuttānaṃ nipātya pattodaśenāhatena vāsasā pracchādya bāndhavāḥ paryupaviśanti /
meaning: तैः कृष्णाजिने पुरुषाकृतिं कृत्वा स्नापयित्वालंकृत्यानर्वेदि कृष्णाजिनं दक्षिणाग्रीवमधरलोमास्तीर्य तस्मिन्नेनमुत्तानं निपात्य पत्तोदशेनाहतेन वाससा प्रच्छाद्य बान्धवाः पर्युपविशन्ति /
text_mt: Having fashioned an effigy of a man with them upon a black-antelope skin, having bathed and adorned it, having spread out a black-antelope skin inside the altar ground with the neck pointing to the south and the hair turned downward, having laid it down supine upon that [skin], and having covered it with an unwashed garment that has fringes on its feet-side, the kinsmen sit round it.

sanskrit_iast: abhimṛśantyayamasyāsau yasya ta ime agnaya iti prete 'mātyāḥ /
meaning: अभिमृशन्त्ययमस्यासौ यस्य त इमे अग्नय इति प्रेते ऽमात्याः /
text_mt: The relatives touch the deceased, [saying]: 'This one is his... so-and-so, whose these fires are.'
Beginning with this rite, one proceeds.
'Having made [the effigy], they should burn it with his fires,' so says the Vājasaneyaka.

sanskrit_iast: yadi havīṃṣyāsannāni kṛṣṇaśakuniruparyuparyatipatetpakṣābhyāmādhūnvāna ivābhiniṣīdedvedaṃ viṣṇurvicakrama ity āhutiṃ juhuyāt
meaning: यदि हवींष्यासन्नानि कृष्णशकुनिरुपर्युपर्यतिपतेत्पक्षाभ्यामाधून्वान इवाभिनिषीदेद्वेदं विष्णुर्विचक्रम इत्य् आहुतिं जुहुयात्
text_mt: If, when the oblations have been placed [near], a black bird should fly over them or alight flapping its wings as it were, he should offer an oblation with: 'Vishnu strode out through this...'
If it flies high, he should not pay heed to that.

sanskrit_iast: yadyucchriyamāṇo yūpaścaṣālaṃ vā padyeta brahma pratiṣṭhā manasa ityāhutiṃ juhuyāt
meaning: यद्युच्छ्रियमाणो यूपश्चषालं वा पद्येत ब्रह्म प्रतिष्ठा मनस इत्याहुतिं जुहुयात्
text_mt: If the sacrificial post while being erected, or the wooden ring, should fall, he should offer an oblation with: 'The brahman is the firm support of the mind...'

sanskrit_iast: yadi haviḥśeṣānanudvāsitānanūyājair abhyāśrāvayedyadvā devā atipādayānītyāhutiṃ juhuyāt (āśrāvayadyadvo?)
meaning: यदि हविःशेषाननुद्वासिताननूयाजैर् अभ्याश्रावयेद्यद्वा देवा अतिपादयानीत्याहुतिं जुहुयात् (आश्रावयद्यद्वो?)
text_mt: If one should cause the call to be given for the after-offerings while the remnants of the oblation have not been removed, he should offer an oblation with: 'Or whatever, O gods, I might omit...'

sanskrit_iast: yadi praṇītā skandeyurupadasyeyurvāpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ punargṛhītvā tataṃ ma āpa ityāhutiṃ juhuyāt
meaning: यदि प्रणीता स्कन्देयुरुपदस्येयुर्वापो हि ष्ठा मयोभुव इति तिसृभिः पुनर्गृहीत्वा ततं म आप इत्याहुतिं जुहुयात्
text_mt: If the praṇītā-waters should spill or dry up, having drawn them again with the three [verses]: 'Waters indeed are you, bestowal of bliss...', he should offer an oblation with: 'The waters have stretched out for me...'

sanskrit_iast: yadyagnyādheye sūryo 'nāviḥ syādudvayaṃ tamasasparyudu tyaṃ citramityāhutīrjuhuyāt
meaning: यद्यग्न्याधेये सूर्यो ऽनाविः स्यादुद्वयं तमसस्पर्युदु त्यं चित्रमित्याहुतीर्जुहुयात्
text_mt: If at the setting up of the fires the sun should not be visible, he should offer oblations with: 'Up from darkness...', 'Up that [banner]...', and 'The bright [face of the gods]...'

sanskrit_iast: yadyenamupadhāveyurgomāyavo 'vādiṣurekasṛko 'vādī dabhimṛtāḥ smaḥ paridhiṃ naḥ kurviti pālāśamidhmamupasamādhāyemaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne tvamagne ayāsi prajāpata iti ṣaḍāhutīrhutvemaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi maiṣāṃ nu gādayaro ardhametam /
meaning: यद्येनमुपधावेयुर्गोमायवो ऽवादिषुरेकसृको ऽवादी दभिमृताः स्मः परिधिं नः कुर्विति पालाशमिध्ममुपसमाधायेमं मे वरुण तत्त्वा यामि त्वं नो अग्ने स त्वं नो अग्ने त्वमग्ने अयासि प्रजापत इति षडाहुतीर्हुत्वेमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि मैषां नु गादयरो अर्धमेतम् /
text_mt: If [the people] should run up to him, [saying:] 'Jackals have howled, a solitary wolf has howled, we are afflicted by death; make an enclosing stick for us,' having put fuel of palāśa wood onto the fire and having offered six oblations with: 'This my prayer, O Varuṇa...', 'To you I go with prayer...', 'Do you, O Agni, to us...', 'So do you, O Agni, to us...', 'You, O Agni, are the goer...', [and] 'O Prajāpati...', [he lays an enclosing stick, saying:] 'This enclosing stick I place for the living, that no other of them may now go to this destination;'

sanskrit_iast: śataṃ jivantu śaradaḥ purūcīstiro mṛtyuṃ dadhatāṃ parvateneti dakṣiṇato 'śmānaṃ paridhiṃ dadhāti
meaning: शतं जिवन्तु शरदः पुरूचीस्तिरो मृत्युं दधतां पर्वतेनेति दक्षिणतो ऽश्मानं परिधिं दधाति
text_mt: 'May they live a hundred full autumns; may they keep death away through the mountain,' with this verse he places a stone as an enclosing stick to the south.
The firewood is of nyagrodha wood for a kṣatriya, at the boundary of his realm;
Of aśvattha wood for a vaiśya, at the boundary of his field.
The eight oblations [beginning with]: 'To the sacrifices, svāhā' may alternate with all the expiations belonging to the New and Full Moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: yadi dauḥṣvapnyamanyadvā bhayaṃ paśyedyata indra bhayāmaha ityāhutī juhuyāt /
meaning: यदि दौःष्वप्न्यमन्यद्वा भयं पश्येद्यत इन्द्र भयामह इत्याहुती जुहुयात् /
text_mt: If he should see bad dreams or other danger, he should offer oblations with: 'From where, O Indra, we are afraid...'
'The hot oblation indeed shines with the brilliance of all,' [so says the brāhmaṇa].
Therefore, having performed the rite with the Pravargya, or having heard [the sound] of it being set up, he should offer an oblation with: 'With these songs...'

sanskrit_iast: yadi homāyopasamiddheṣvahuteṣvagniṣu yajamāno 'śnīyādyatte vayaṃ yathā ha tadity āhutī juhuyāt /
meaning: यदि होमायोपसमिद्धेष्वहुतेष्वग्निषु यजमानो ऽश्नीयाद्यत्ते वयं यथा ह तदित्य् आहुती जुहुयात् /
text_mt: If, when the fires have been kindled for the offering but the oblations have not yet been made, the sacrificer should eat, he should offer oblations with: 'What of you we...', [and] 'Even as that...'

One over whom the sun has set, over whom the sun has risen, a paryāhita, a parīṣṭa, a parivitta, a parivinna, or a parivividāna should offer with these two [verses]: 'Whatever defect has arisen in my self...', and 'Agni has given back sight...'
In the case of what is unknown, he should offer with the three [verses beginning with]: 'What is unknown...'
If someone's unpurified clarified butter should spill, he should give a living creature that bites.
If it is purified, a speckled [animal] is to be given;

sanskrit_iast: yadi sruggataṃ yadasya gṛhe puṣkalaṃ syāttaddadyāt /
meaning: यदि स्रुग्गतं यदस्य गृहे पुष्कलं स्यात्तद्दद्यात् /
text_mt: If it was in the ladle, he should give whatever abundant [thing] may be in his house.

sanskrit_iast: saṃ tvā siñcāmīti tatsaṃsiñcedabhi vā mantrayeta
meaning: सं त्वा सिञ्चामीति तत्संसिञ्चेदभि वा मन्त्रयेत
text_mt: He should pour [more butter] into it, with: 'I pour you together...', or he should consecrate it [with the mantra].
'The sacrifice has gone to the divine folk,' according to some, he pronounces immediately after the clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: yajñasya tvā pramayābhimayā pratimayonmayā parigṛhṇāmīti tatparigṛhya bhūpataye svāheti prāñcaṃ prādeśaṃ mimīte /
meaning: यज्ञस्य त्वा प्रमयाभिमया प्रतिमयोन्मया परिगृह्णामीति तत्परिगृह्य भूपतये स्वाहेति प्राञ्चं प्रादेशं मिमीते /
text_mt: Having encircled that [spilled butter] with: 'With the measure, the counter-measure, the matching measure, the upward measure of the sacrifice I encircle you,' he measures a span to the east, with: 'To the lord of the earth, svāhā;'
To the south, with: 'To the lord of the world, svāhā;'
To the west, with: 'To the lord of beings, svāhā;'
To the north, with: 'To prosperity, svāhā;'
Upward, with: 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ.'

sanskrit_iast: bhūpataye svāhā bhuvanapataye svāhā bhūtānāṃ pataye svāheti skannamanumantrayeteti sarvahaviṣāmanavayavena śrūyate
meaning: भूपतये स्वाहा भुवनपतये स्वाहा भूतानां पतये स्वाहेति स्कन्नमनुमन्त्रयेतेति सर्वहविषामनवयवेन श्रूयते
text_mt: 'One should follow what has spilled with the mantra: 'To the lord of the earth, svāhā; to the lord of the world, svāhā; to the lord of beings, svāhā,'—thus it is taught in the sacred scripture without exception for all oblations.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kapālaṃ bhidyeta gāyatryā tvā śatākṣarayā saṃdadhāmīti tatsaṃdhāyopari gārhapatye dhāryamāṇamabhijuhuyānmano jyotirjuṣatāmiti
meaning: यदि कपालं भिद्येत गायत्र्या त्वा शताक्षरया संदधामीति तत्संधायोपरि गार्हपत्ये धार्यमाणमभिजुहुयान्मनो ज्योतिर्जुषतामिति
text_mt: If a potsherd should break, having joined it together with: 'With the hundred-syllabled Gāyatrī I join you together,' he should make an oblation over it while it is held above the gārhapatya fire, with: 'May the mind enjoy the light...'
Then he should carry it down to the waters with: 'Unbroken is the hot vessel, granting swiftness...'
Then, having consecrated another, he should insert it among the potsherds with: 'Thirty-three threads...', if it should break before being set down.
Now, if it breaks among those already set down, he should set down another with this very mantra;
Or [with the mantra] in place of which it broke.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prayuktānāṃ prāgarthakarmaṇaḥ kapālaṃ naśyedāśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ nirvapeddyāvāpṛthivyamekakapālam
meaning: यदि प्रयुक्तानां प्रागर्थकर्मणः कपालं नश्येदाश्विनं द्विकपालं निर्वपेद्द्यावापृथिव्यमेककपालम्
text_mt: If, of those arranged, a potsherd should be lost before the meaningful action, he should offer a cake on two potsherds to the Aśvins, and a cake on one potsherd to Dyāvāpṛthivī.

sanskrit_iast: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na iti dyāvāpṛthivyayarcā sruvāhutimatra vājasaneyinaḥ samāmananti
meaning: मही द्यौः पृथिवी च न इति द्यावापृथिव्ययर्चा स्रुवाहुतिमत्र वाजसनेयिनः समामनन्ति
text_mt: Here the followers of the Vājasaneyi recension prescribe an offering with the dipping-ladle accompanied by the verse to Dyāvāpṛthivī: 'Great heaven and earth to us...'

sanskrit_iast: yadyekakapālaḥ skandetpari vāvarteta prajāpatervartanimanuvartasvānu vīrairanurādhyāma gobhiḥ /
meaning: यद्येककपालः स्कन्देत्परि वावर्तेत प्रजापतेर्वर्तनिमनुवर्तस्वानु वीरैरनुराध्याम गोभिः /
text_mt: If a single potsherd should spill or overturn, with: 'Follow the track of Prajāpati; may we prosper along with heroes, along with cattle;

sanskrit_iast: anvaśvairanu sarvairupuṣṭairanu prajayānvindriyeṇa devā no yajñamṛjudhā nayantviti yathāsthānaṃ kalpayati
meaning: अन्वश्वैरनु सर्वैरुपुष्टैरनु प्रजयान्विन्द्रियेण देवा नो यज्ञमृजुधा नयन्त्विति यथास्थानं कल्पयति
text_mt: Along with horses, along with all nourished ones, along with offspring, along with sensory power; may the gods lead our sacrifice straight,' he sets it into its proper place.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ yajamāno 'bhimantrayate prati kṣatre pratitiṣṭhāmi rāṣṭre pratyaśveṣu pratitiṣṭhāmi goṣu /
meaning: तं यजमानो ऽभिमन्त्रयते प्रति क्षत्रे प्रतितिष्ठामि राष्ट्रे प्रत्यश्वेषु प्रतितिष्ठामि गोषु /
text_mt: The sacrificer addresses it with: 'I establish myself in dominion, in the realm; I establish myself in horses, in cattle;
I establish myself in offspring, in prosperity.
One of the two has magnified the all; upon the other that is supported.

sanskrit_iast: dive ca viśvakarmaṇe pṛthivyai cākaraṃ nama iti /
meaning: दिवे च विश्वकर्मणे पृथिव्यै चाकरं नम इति /
text_mt: To heaven and to Viśvakarman, and to earth I have paid homage.'
Then he should offer oblations with: 'The heaven has spilled, the earth...'
He should offer a cake on twelve potsherds to Vaiśvānara if he should pour an oblation upon a potsherd while performing the offerings to the wives.
'He should offer this very [cake], who performs the New and Full Moon sacrifices,' thus it has been stated.
He should offer this very [sacrifice] if, without having performed the Āgrayaṇa, he should eat of the new [harvest].

sanskrit_iast: ānīto vā eṣa devānāṃ ya āhitāgniradantyasya devā annam /
meaning: आनीतो वा एष देवानां य आहिताग्निरदन्त्यस्य देवा अन्नम् /
text_mt: Brought near indeed to the gods is he who has established the fires; the gods eat his food.
If, without having performed the Āgrayaṇa, he should eat of the new [harvest], he would eat the portion apportioned to the gods; he would incur misfortune.

sanskrit_iast: mārutaṃ trayodaśakapālaṃ nirvapedyasya yamau jāyeyātāṃ gāvau vā puruṣau vā
meaning: मारुतं त्रयोदशकपालं निर्वपेद्यस्य यमौ जायेयातां गावौ वा पुरुषौ वा
text_mt: He should offer a [cake] on thirteen potsherds to the Maruts, to whom twins are born, whether cattle or human beings.
For a man brings about loss of virility,
The invitatory verse is in the Gāyatrī metre;
He should offer an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Agni and Viṣṇu, whom they sacrifice for upon the fires of another, or upon whose fires another sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: raudraṃ vāstumayaṃ caruṃ nirvapedyasya rudraḥ paśūñchamāyeta
meaning: रौद्रं वास्तुमयं चरुं निर्वपेद्यस्य रुद्रः पशूञ्छमायेत
text_mt: He should offer an oblation of wild rice to Rudra, whose cattle Rudra afflicts.
According to this very rite he should sacrifice for a chieftain of the Niṣādas.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinaṃ dakṣiṇā kūṭaṃ vā karṇo vā gardabho hariṇo vā hariṇapṛṇākā vā śyāmākapātro vā śaphako veti vijñāyate
meaning: कृष्णाजिनं दक्षिणा कूटं वा कर्णो वा गर्दभो हरिणो वा हरिणपृणाका वा श्यामाकपात्रो वा शफको वेति विज्ञायते
text_mt: A black-antelope skin is the sacrificial gift, or a hornless beast, or an animal with large ears, or a donkey, or a deer, or a deer-skin, or a bowl of wild rice, or a hoofed animal—so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].
A student of the Veda who has approached a woman should sacrifice a donkey as a victim.
He should bake a sacrificial cake without potsherds on the bare ground.
They should perform the rite with portions [cast] into water.
It should have the Rakṣases as its deity, or have Nirṛti as its deity.
He should sacrifice to Nirṛti with a cooked offering.

sanskrit_iast: yasya haviḥ kṣāyati taṃ yajñaṃ nirṛtirgṛhṇāti /
meaning: यस्य हविः क्षायति तं यज्ञं निरृतिर्गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Whose oblation burns, his sacrifice Nirṛti seizes.
Having concluded that, he should offer another oblation to that deity.

sanskrit_iast: yasya puroḍāśaḥ kṣāyati taṃ yajñaṃ nirṛtirgṛhṇāti /
meaning: यस्य पुरोडाशः क्षायति तं यज्ञं निरृतिर्गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Whose sacrificial cake burns, his sacrifice Nirṛti seizes.

sanskrit_iast: yaducchiṣṭaṃ syāttena pracareddveṣyāya tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ havirucchiṣṭaṃ ca dadyāt /
meaning: यदुच्छिष्टं स्यात्तेन प्रचरेद्द्वेष्याय तां दक्षिणां हविरुच्छिष्टं च दद्यात् /
text_mt: With what remains of it he should proceed; he should give that sacrificial gift and the remainder of the oblation to a hated enemy;
thereby he causes Nirṛti to seize him alone—so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].
[This is] the expiation when it burns completely,
or if it does not suffice for the portions.
If an oblation fails before its deity has been assigned, he should offer another oblation to that deity.
There the mantras beginning with the taking of the ladle should be repeated,
or as far as the end [of the rite where] it failed.
If its deity had been assigned, he should conclude the remainder with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: yasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi naśyeyur duṣyeyur apahareyur vājyenaitā devatāḥ pratisaṃkhyāya yajeta
meaning: यस्य सर्वाणि हवींषि नश्येयुर् दुष्येयुर् अपहरेयुर् वाज्येनैता देवताः प्रतिसंख्याय यजेत
text_mt: Whose oblations are all lost, spoiled, or carried away, should sacrifice with clarified butter, reciting mentally these deities.
Then he should perform another sacrifice without fault;
for sacrifice is the expiation of sacrifice.
He takes down the ruined oblation to the waters—so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].
What is unfit to be eaten by Āryas, he should not sacrifice with that.

sanskrit_iast: yasya puroḍāśo duḥśṛtastaddhaviryamadaivatyaṃ yamameva tadgacchatīti vijñāyate /
meaning: यस्य पुरोडाशो दुःशृतस्तद्धविर्यमदैवत्यं यममेव तद्गच्छतीति विज्ञायते /
text_mt: Whose sacrificial cake is badly cooked, that oblation has Yama as its deity; it goes to Yama alone—so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: saṃsthāpya tadanvāhāryapacane catuḥśarāvamodanaṃ paktvā caturo brāhmaṇānbhojayet
meaning: संस्थाप्य तदन्वाहार्यपचने चतुःशरावमोदनं पक्त्वा चतुरो ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्
text_mt: Having concluded it, he should cook a mess of boiled rice measuring four platters on the anvāhāryapacana and feed four brāhmaṇas.
Of them, one among the partakers should be a Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast: yo 'dakṣiṇena yajñena yajeta sa yajñaḥ prakṣāmo 'nāyuḥ /
meaning: यो ऽदक्षिणेन यज्ञेन यजेत स यज्ञः प्रक्षामो ऽनायुः /
text_mt: He who sacrifices with a sacrifice without a sacrificial gift—that sacrifice is burnt out, without longevity.
If he should omit the prescribed sacrificial gift, a firmly established fertile field is to be given;
If he should invoke a portionless deity, he should sacrifice to it with clarified butter according as it was invoked,
or before the [offering to Agni] Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: yadi bhaginīṃ nāvāhayedyatra smarettadupotthāya manasāvāhya yadvo devā atipādayānītyāhutiṃ juhuyāt
meaning: यदि भगिनीं नावाहयेद्यत्र स्मरेत्तदुपोत्थाय मनसावाह्य यद्वो देवा अतिपादयानीत्याहुतिं जुहुयात्
text_mt: If he should not invoke an entitled deity, wherever he remembers it, having risen near there, having invoked it mentally, he should offer an oblation with: 'Whatever of you, O gods, I may omit…'

sanskrit_iast: yadi purā prayājebhyo bahiḥparidhyāhutiḥ skandedāgnīdhraṃ brūyādetāṃ saṃkṛsya juhudhīti /
meaning: यदि पुरा प्रयाजेभ्यो बहिःपरिध्याहुतिः स्कन्देदाग्नीध्रं ब्रूयादेतां संकृस्य जुहुधीति /
text_mt: If before the fore-offerings an oblation should spill outside the enclosing sticks, he should say to the agnīdh: 'Scraping this together, offer [it]!'
To him a full vessel should be given.

meaning: यत्किंच यज्ञे मृन्मयं भिद्येत तदपो ऽभ्यवहरेद्भुमिर्भूमिमगादिति
text_mt: Whatever earthenware should break in the sacrifice, he should consign that to the waters with: 'Earth has gone to earth.'

sanskrit_iast: yadyṛkto yajñaṃ bhreṣa āgacchedbhuriti gārhapatye juhuyāt /
meaning: यद्यृक्तो यज्ञं भ्रेष आगच्छेद्भुरिति गार्हपत्ये जुहुयात् /
text_mt: If an error should come to the sacrifice through an ṛc, he should offer in the gārhapatya with: 'Bhūḥ!'
If through a yajus, in the dakṣiṇāgni with: 'Bhuvaḥ!'
If through a sāman, in the āhavanīya with: 'Suvaḥ!'
If from every [quarter], he should offer them all.
'This universal expiation should be performed everywhere,' says Āśmarathya.
'It should be performed where none is handed down,' says Ālekhana.
Another [view is]: there should be a combination everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: yadyenaṃ vihāre barhirvā bhayaṃ vindetprajāpatirviśvakarmā tasya mano devaṃ yajñena rādhyāsam /
meaning: यद्येनं विहारे बर्हिर्वा भयं विन्देत्प्रजापतिर्विश्वकर्मा तस्य मनो देवं यज्ञेन राध्यासम् /
text_mt: If in the ritual area grass [in the eye] or fear should afflict him, [with the verse:] "Prajāpati Viśvakarman, through the sacrifice may I succeed in the divine mind of him; /"

sanskrit_iast: arthegā asya jahito 'vasānapate 'vasānaṃ me vindetyāhutiṃ juhuyāt
meaning: अर्थेगा अस्य जहितो ऽवसानपते ऽवसानं मे विन्देत्याहुतिं जुहुयात्
text_mt: "You are one who goes to the goal of it; O lord of the resting place, do not abandon [us], find a resting place for me," he should offer an oblation.
If the oblation scooped out for someone should spill, he should give a living being that can bite.
If it was purified [by winnowing], a variegated [animal/object] is to be given.

sanskrit_iast: yasya devate avadāne havīṃṣi yājyānuvākye vā viparihareyuryasya vā devatāyai bṛhītamahutaṃ skandeddevatāntaraye vā yadasya gṛhe puṣkalaṃ syāttaddadyāt
meaning: यस्य देवते अवदाने हवींषि याज्यानुवाक्ये वा विपरिहरेयुर्यस्य वा देवतायै बृहीतमहुतं स्कन्देद्देवतान्तरये वा यदस्य गृहे पुष्कलं स्यात्तद्दद्यात्
text_mt: For whom the deities, portions, oblations, or the invitatory and consecratory verses are interchanged, or for whose deity [the oblation] taken should spill unoffered, or upon omission of a deity, he should give whatever is abundant in his house.

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agna iti sarvatrāntaraye viparyāse caite āhutī juhotīty eke
meaning: त्वं नो अग्ने स त्वं नो अग्न इति सर्वत्रान्तरये विपर्यासे चैते आहुती जुहोतीत्य् एके
text_mt: Some [say that] with 'You, O Agni, to us' [and] 'So, you, O Agni, to us,' he offers these two oblations everywhere upon omission and upon interchange.

sanskrit_iast: yasya puroḍāśa udvā patetsaṃ vā vijeta tamudvāsya barhiṣadaṃ kṛtvā kimutpatasi kimutproṣṭhāḥ śāntaḥ śānterihāgahi /
meaning: यस्य पुरोडाश उद्वा पतेत्सं वा विजेत तमुद्वास्य बर्हिषदं कृत्वा किमुत्पतसि किमुत्प्रोष्ठाः शान्तः शान्तेरिहागहि /
text_mt: If someone's sacrificial cake should fly up or shake violently, having removed it [from the fire] and placed it on the barhis, [with the verses:] "Why do you fly up, why did you leap up? Calmed, come here through calm; /"

sanskrit_iast: aghoro yajñiyo bhūtvāsīda sadanaṃ svamāsīda sadanaṃ svam //
meaning: अघोरो यज्ञियो भूत्वासीद सदनं स्वमासीद सदनं स्वम् //
text_mt: "Becoming non-terrible and worthy of sacrifice, sit on your own seat, sit on your own seat! //"

sanskrit_iast: mā hiṃsīrdeva preṣita ājyena tejasājyasva mā naḥ kiṃcana rīriṣaḥ /
meaning: मा हिंसीर्देव प्रेषित आज्येन तेजसाज्यस्व मा नः किंचन रीरिषः /
text_mt: "Do not injure, sent forth by the god! Anoint yourself with brilliance, with clarified butter; do not harm anything of ours! /"

sanskrit_iast: yogakṣemasya śantyā asminnāsīda barhiṣītyetābhyāmabhimantrayetābhi ca ghārayet
meaning: योगक्षेमस्य शन्त्या अस्मिन्नासीद बर्हिषीत्येताभ्यामभिमन्त्रयेताभि च घारयेत्
text_mt: "For the peace of security, sit on this barhis," he should address it with these two [verses] and sprinkle clarified butter over [it].

sanskrit_iast: bhūtvā prabhavati yajamāno yasyaitāṃ yajñe prāyaścittiṃ kurvanti
meaning: भूत्वा प्रभवति यजमानो यस्यैतां यज्ञे प्रायश्चित्तिं कुर्वन्ति
text_mt: Having become [strong], the sacrificer prospers for whom they perform this expiation in the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: skannā dyauḥ skannā pṛthivī skannaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagat skannādo viśvā bhūtāni pra skannājjāyatāṃ haviḥ //
meaning: स्कन्ना द्यौः स्कन्ना पृथिवी स्कन्नं विश्वमिदं जगत् स्कन्नादो विश्वा भूतानि प्र स्कन्नाज्जायतां हविः //
text_mt: "Spilled is heaven, spilled is the earth, spilled is all this moving world; / of the spilled one all beings [partake]; may the oblation be born from the spilled! //"
"Here be born, O cows! Here, horses! Here, men! /"
"And here may prosperity of wealth with a thousand sacrificial gifts settle down! //"

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ yajño vardhatāṃ gobhiraśvairiyaṃ vediḥ svapatyā suvīrā /
meaning: अयं यज्ञो वर्धतां गोभिरश्वैरियं वेदिः स्वपत्या सुवीरा /
text_mt: "May this sacrifice increase with cattle, with horses; [may] this altar ground [abound] in good offspring, in good heroes; /"

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ barhirati barhīṃṣyanyemaṃ yajñaṃ viśve avantu devāḥ //
meaning: इदं बर्हिरति बर्हींष्यन्येमं यज्ञं विश्वे अवन्तु देवाः //
text_mt: "May this barhis surpass other barhis grasses; may all the gods favor this sacrifice! //"

sanskrit_iast: payasvatīroṣadhaya ityetābhiścatasṛbhiḥ pṛṣadājyaṃ skannamabhimantryāpo 'bhyavahṛtya nirṇijya srucaṃ śatamānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ srucyavadhāyedaṃ viṣṇurvicakrama ityanyatpṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhītvāśvenāvaghrāpyāyatane sādayet
meaning: पयस्वतीरोषधय इत्येताभिश्चतसृभिः पृषदाज्यं स्कन्नमभिमन्त्र्यापो ऽभ्यवहृत्य निर्णिज्य स्रुचं शतमानं हिरण्यं स्रुच्यवधायेदं विष्णुर्विचक्रम इत्यन्यत्पृषदाज्यं गृहीत्वाश्वेनावघ्राप्यायतने सादयेत्
text_mt: [With the four verses beginning with] 'The plants full of milk...', having addressed the spilled clotted butter with these four [verses], having thrown [it] into water, having cleansed the ladle, having placed gold weighing a hundred mānas into the ladle, having taken another [portion of] clotted butter with 'Through this Viṣṇu strode...', and having caused a horse to smell it, he should set it down in its place.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣadājye skanne pṛṣadājye pṛṣadājyamabhigṛhya mano jyotirjuṣatāmityāhutiṃ juhuyāt
meaning: पृषदाज्ये स्कन्ने पृषदाज्ये पृषदाज्यमभिगृह्य मनो ज्योतिर्जुषतामित्याहुतिं जुहुयात्
text_mt: When the clotted butter has spilled, having scooped clotted butter over clotted butter, he should offer an oblation with 'May the mind enjoy the light...'

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ some skanne some somamabhigṛhya juhuyāt
meaning: एवं सोमे स्कन्ने सोमे सोममभिगृह्य जुहुयात्
text_mt: Similarly, when soma has spilled, having scooped soma over soma, he should offer.
"What the bird has touched with its beak, [as an omen] of your destruction, /"

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭatsarvaṃ śundhatu havyavāḍ ghṛtasūdana iti kṛṣṇaśakunyavamṛṣṭamabhimantrayate /
meaning: अग्निष्टत्सर्वं शुन्धतु हव्यवाड् घृतसूदन इति कृष्णशकुन्यवमृष्टमभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: "May Agni, conveying the oblation, purifying the ghee, cleanse all that!" With this verse he addresses [an oblation] touched by a black bird.
Throwing into water and the rest are as before.
Here the vessel is scraped clean.
"What the beast of prey has licked with its mouth, [as an omen] of your destruction, /"

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭatsarvaṃ śundhatu havyavāḍ ghṛtasūdana iti śvāpadāvamṛṣṭamabhimantrayate /
meaning: अग्निष्टत्सर्वं शुन्धतु हव्यवाड् घृतसूदन इति श्वापदावमृष्टमभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: "May Agni, conveying the oblation, purifying the ghee, cleanse all that!" With this verse he addresses [an oblation] touched by a beast of prey.
Throwing into water and the rest are as before.
Here the vessel is not used again.

sanskrit_iast: yadi paśurupākṛto vāśyeta yadasya pāre rajasa ity āhutiṃ juhuyāt /
meaning: यदि पशुरुपाकृतो वाश्येत यदस्य पारे रजस इत्य् आहुतिं जुहुयात् /
text_mt: If the animal, having been brought near, should bellow, he should offer an oblation with 'What at the end of the realm of space...';
Or, [with the verse:] "Through fear of what you bellowed, make us fearless from that; /"

sanskrit_iast: prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo mṛḍa namo rudrāya mīḍhuṣa iti juhuyād abhi vā mantrayeta
meaning: प्रजाभ्यः सर्वाभ्यो मृड नमो रुद्राय मीढुष इति जुहुयाद् अभि वा मन्त्रयेत
text_mt: "Be gracious to all creatures; homage to bounteous Rudra!" he should offer or address [it].

sanskrit_iast: yadyu vai niṣīdedetayaiva yasmādbhīṣā nyaṣada iti dvitīyām
meaning: यद्यु वै निषीदेदेतयैव यस्माद्भीषा न्यषद इति द्वितीयाम्
text_mt: If it should sit down, [he recites] the second [verse] with this very [formula, adapted as:] 'through fear of what you sat down...';
When it has sat down, he should raise it with the staff of the maitrāvaruṇa.

sanskrit_iast: udusra tiṣṭha pratitiṣṭha mā riṣo memaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca rīriṣaḥ /
meaning: उदुस्र तिष्ठ प्रतितिष्ठ मा रिषो मेमं यज्ञं यजमानं च रीरिषः /
text_mt: "Rise up, O bull, stand firm! Do not be harmed; do not harm this sacrifice and the sacrificer! /"

sanskrit_iast: suvarge loke yajamānaṃ hi dhehi śaṃ na edhi dvipade śaṃ catuṣpada iti
meaning: सुवर्गे लोके यजमानं हि धेहि शं न एधि द्विपदे शं चतुष्पद इति
text_mt: "For place the sacrificer in the heavenly world; be auspicious to our two-footed, auspicious to our four-footed!"—
With 'Through fear of what you trembled...' as the second [verse] when it is trembling;
With 'Through fear of what you ran away...' as the second [verse] when it has run away;
If it does not return, having brought near another [animal] of that appearance, color, and age, dedicated to that deity, he should sacrifice.
With 'Through fear of what you consented...' as the second [verse] if it is suffocated against its will;

sanskrit_iast: ya idamakastasmai namastasmai svāheti sarvatra tṛtīyām
meaning: य इदमकस्तस्मै नमस्तस्मै स्वाहेति सर्वत्र तृतीयाम्
text_mt: Everywhere [he recites] as the third [verse:] 'Homage to him who did this; svāhā to him!'

sanskrit_iast: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva ityetābhiścatasṛbhirapo 'bhyavahṛtyānyaṃ tadrūpavarṇavayasaṃ taddaivatamupākṛtya yajeta
meaning: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुव इत्येताभिश्चतसृभिरपो ऽभ्यवहृत्यान्यं तद्रूपवर्णवयसं तद्दैवतमुपाकृत्य यजेत
text_mt: Having thrown [the dead body] into water with these four [verses beginning with] 'For waters are refreshing...', having brought near another [animal] of that appearance, color, and age, dedicated to that deity, he should sacrifice.
With 'Through fear of what you urinate...' as the second [verse] when it urinates;
With 'Through fear of what you dung...' as the second [verse] when it dungs.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaya ityucchrayantamabhimantrayate
meaning: ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतय इत्युच्छ्रयन्तमभिमन्त्रयते
text_mt: With 'Upright indeed for our protection...' he addresses it when it stands up.

sanskrit_iast: yadyupapāyyamāno na pibenna vā uvetanmriyasa ityupapāyayet
meaning: यद्युपपाय्यमानो न पिबेन्न वा उवेतन्म्रियस इत्युपपाययेत्
text_mt: If, while being made to drink, it should not drink, he should make it drink with 'Indeed, you do not die in this way...'

sanskrit_iast: garbhaṃ sravantīmagadāmakarmāgnirhotā pṛthivyantarikṣaṃ dyauryaścyutadagnāveva tanna tatprāpnoti nirṛtiṃ parācairiti paśūkhāṃ sravantīmabhimantrayate
meaning: गर्भं स्रवन्तीमगदामकर्माग्निर्होता पृथिव्यन्तरिक्षं द्यौर्यश्च्युतदग्नावेव तन्न तत्प्राप्नोति निरृतिं पराचैरिति पशूखां स्रवन्तीमभिमन्त्रयते
text_mt: With 'We have made healthy the one dripping a fetus; Agni is the hotṛ, the earth, the atmosphere, the sky; whatever trickled, it is in Agni alone; it does not reach destruction turning away,' he addresses the animal-cooking pot when it is leaking.
When they lead the animal northward after it is appeased by the Āprī verses, it has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: ye paśuṃ vimathnīranyastānkāmayetārtimārcheyuriti kuvidaṅgeti namovṛktivatyarcāgnīdhre juhuyāt /
meaning: ये पशुं विमथ्नीरन्यस्तान्कामयेतार्तिमार्छेयुरिति कुविदङ्गेति नमोवृक्तिवत्यर्चाग्नीध्रे जुहुयात् /
text_mt: If he should wish that those who tear apart the animal should suffer misfortune, he should offer in the āgnīdhra [fire] with the verse containing 'surely' and containing 'reverence' [namovṛkti];
In the āhavanīya or the śāmitra fire in the case of the independent animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yadi vapā haviravadānaṃ vā skandedā tvā dade yaśase vīryāya cāsmāsvaghniyā yūyaṃ dadhāthendriyaṃ paya ityādāya yaste drapso yasta udarṣo daivyaḥ keturviśvaṃ bhuvanamāviveśa /
meaning: यदि वपा हविरवदानं वा स्कन्देदा त्वा ददे यशसे वीर्याय चास्मास्वघ्निया यूयं दधाथेन्द्रियं पय इत्यादाय यस्ते द्रप्सो यस्त उदर्षो दैव्यः केतुर्विश्वं भुवनमाविवेश /
text_mt: If the omentum or a cut portion of the oblation should spill, having picked it up with 'I take you for glory and for strength; do you, inviolable ones, place in us vigorous milk,' [and reciting:] 'Whatever drop of yours, whatever divine banner of yours has flown up, [and] has entered the whole world, /'
'May that protect us from injury, svāhā!' he should offer the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: yadyaṣṭāpadītyanubudhyeta dhātā rātiḥ sūryo devo diviṣadbhya ity āhutī hutvāṣṭāprūḍḍhiraṇyamuṣṇīṣeṇāveṣṭya
meaning: यद्यष्टापदीत्यनुबुध्येत धाता रातिः सूर्यो देवो दिविषद्भ्य इत्य् आहुती हुत्वाष्टाप्रूड्ढिरण्यमुष्णीषेणावेष्ट्य
text_mt: If he should realize [that the animal was] eight-footed [pregnant], having offered the oblations with 'Dhātṛ, the gift, the divine Sun, for those dwelling in heaven...', having wrapped a piece of gold of eight prūṭas with a turban...

meaning: कोशे ऽवधाय द्वितीये ऽवधाय तृतीये ऽवदधाति
text_mt: Having placed [the fetus] in a basket, having placed it in a second, he places it in a third.
Having made the baskets as if rimless, the adhvaryu addresses it with a mantra.

sanskrit_iast: ā vartana vartayeti pradakṣiṇaṃ garbhamāvṛtya vi te bhinadmi takarīmityulbamādhyati
meaning: आ वर्तन वर्तयेति प्रदक्षिणं गर्भमावृत्य वि ते भिनद्मि तकरीमित्युल्बमाध्यति
text_mt: With: 'Turn toward, roll!', turning the fetus around to the right, he pierces the fetal membrane with: 'I tear open your covering.'

sanskrit_iast: bahiste astu bālityantarā sakthinī garbhaṃ nirasya śūle praṇīkṣya śāmitre nihatya śrapayati
meaning: बहिस्ते अस्तु बालित्यन्तरा सक्थिनी गर्भं निरस्य शूले प्रणीक्ष्य शामित्रे निहत्य श्रपयति
text_mt: With: 'Out with you, babe!', having expelled the fetus between the thighs, having pierced it on a spit, and having driven it down in the śāmitra fire, he cooks it.
With [the verse], 'A broad drop, of every form, the sparkling drop,' he pushes a vessel underneath for the juice of the foetus.
Having apportioned the sacrificial cake for the animal, he apportions the sacrificial cake for the foetus, baked on one potsherd, dedicated to Heaven and Earth according to apportioning.

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśena pracarya garbhapuroḍāśena pracarati bhaktīdyāvā pṛthivyeneti
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशेन प्रचर्य गर्भपुरोडाशेन प्रचरति भक्तीद्यावा पृथिव्येनेति
text_mt: Having proceeded with the sacrificial cake for the animal, he proceeds with the sacrificial cake for the foetus, dedicated to Heaven and Earth according to apportioning.
Cutting off the portions for the deity from the animal, having cut off another portion from in front of the navel of the foetus, he deposits it among the portions for the deity;
and another from above [the navel] among the portions for Sviṣṭakṛt.
He divides the juice of the foetus into three parts and pours it out among the portions for the deity, for Sviṣṭakṛt, and for the iḍā.
With [the formula], 'One-footed, two-footed,' he makes an offering before the Sviṣṭakṛt [offering].
Gold weighing eight prūṭis is the dakṣiṇā.

sanskrit_iast: garbhasya dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvapādaṃ pracchidya viṣṇuṃ śipiviṣṭaṃ yajati pra tatte adya śipiviṣṭa nāmeti /
meaning: गर्भस्य दक्षिणं पूर्वपादं प्रच्छिद्य विष्णुं शिपिविष्टं यजति प्र तत्ते अद्य शिपिविष्ट नामेति /
text_mt: Having cut off the right forefoot of the foetus, he sacrifices to Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa with [the verse], 'May I proclaim today, O Śipiviṣṭa, your name,'

sanskrit_iast: maruto yasya hi kṣaya iti garbhaṃ garbhapuroḍāśaṃ cottareṇa gārhapatyasya śāmitrasya vā śīte bhasmanyupopya mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na iti śītena bhasmanābhisamūhyaitaṃ yuvānamiti pañcabhirupatiṣṭhate
meaning: मरुतो यस्य हि क्षय इति गर्भं गर्भपुरोडाशं चोत्तरेण गार्हपत्यस्य शामित्रस्य वा शीते भस्मन्युपोप्य मही द्यौः पृथिवी च न इति शीतेन भस्मनाभिसमूह्यैतं युवानमिति पञ्चभिरुपतिष्ठते
text_mt: With [the verse], 'The Maruts, to whose house,' having buried the foetus and the sacrificial cake of the foetus in cold ashes north of the gārhapatya or of the śāmitra fire, having heaped cold ashes over them with [the verse], 'Great Heaven and Earth for us,' he attends [the spot] with the five [verses beginning], 'This young man.'
Āśmarathya holds: 'This expiation for a pregnant [victim] should be performed everywhere.'
Ālekhana holds: 'It should be performed where it is not specifically enjoined [otherwise].'

sanskrit_iast: yadyanapavṛktārtho yūpo virohettasmiṃstvāṣṭraṃ sāṇḍaṃ lomaśaṃ piṅgalaṃ bahurūpaṃ savanīyasyopālambhyaṃ kuryāt
meaning: यद्यनपवृक्तार्थो यूपो विरोहेत्तस्मिंस्त्वाष्ट्रं साण्डं लोमशं पिङ्गलं बहुरूपं सवनीयस्योपालम्भ्यं कुर्यात्
text_mt: If the sacrificial post, before its purpose is fulfilled, should sprout, he should tie to it, as an additional offering alongside the savanīya victim, an uncastrated, hairy, reddish-brown, variegated animal dedicated to Tvaṣṭṛ.
Here the Vājasaneyins prescribe a caru dedicated to Tvaṣṭṛ.
Some say: 'Here he merely offers spoon-oblations dedicated to Tvaṣṭṛ.'

sanskrit_iast: yadi yupaḥ suṣiraḥ syādatīsāreṇa yajamāno mriyeta /
meaning: यदि युपः सुषिरः स्यादतीसारेण यजमानो म्रियेत /
text_mt: If the sacrificial post should be hollow, the sacrificer would die of dysentery;

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṇavyā vyāhṛtibhiḥ prājāpatyayā ca hutvā taṃ saṃvṛścyāgnau pravṛjyāthānyaṃ sādhayet
meaning: वैष्णव्या व्याहृतिभिः प्राजापत्यया च हुत्वा तं संवृश्च्याग्नौ प्रवृज्याथान्यं साधयेत्
text_mt: having offered [an oblation] to Viṣṇu, with the vyāhṛtis, and [one] to Prajāpati, having chopped it down and cast it into the fire, he should then prepare another.
If worms should eat it because it is worm-eaten,
the expiation is as before.
If it should fall into the felling-trench, one should know: 'The wife will transgress against him';
the subsequent [procedure] beginning with the vyāhṛtis is the same.

sanskrit_iast: yadi dakṣiṇā patetpratyaṅvā saṃ vā śīryeta śākhāsu vā sajyeta yajamāno mriyeta /
meaning: यदि दक्षिणा पतेत्प्रत्यङ्वा सं वा शीर्येत शाखासु वा सज्येत यजमानो म्रियेत /
text_mt: If it should fall southward or westward, or shatter, or become entangled in branches, the sacrificer would die;
in place of the [oblation] to Viṣṇu, there is one to Yama;
If it should fall into water, he would die in water;
in place of the [oblation] to Viṣṇu, there is one to Varuṇa;
If robbers should carry it off by force, he would be deprived of all his property;
in place of the [oblation] to Viṣṇu, there is one to Indra;

sanskrit_iast: yadi mūla upaśuṣkaḥ syānna pitṛbhyo yathāpuraṃ kariṣyatīti vidyāt /
meaning: यदि मूल उपशुष्कः स्यान्न पितृभ्यो यथापुरं करिष्यतीति विद्यात् /
text_mt: If it should dry up at the base, one should know: 'He will not perform [offerings] for the ancestors as formerly';
if in the middle: 'He will die of hunger';
if at the top: 'He will not go to the heavenly world.'
If the [corner] facing the fire should split, the sacrificer would die;
if the southern one, the son of the chief queen;
if the northern one, the son born after the eldest;
if the south-eastern one, the brahman;
if the north-western one, the adhvaryu;
if the north-eastern one, the agnīdh.
In all [cases of] drying up and the like, the subsequent [procedure] beginning with [the oblation to] Yama is the same.

sanskrit_iast: yadi lohinyo lekhāḥ prasavyaṃ yūpaṃ parihareyurna sāhasraṃ kratumāhariṣyatīti vidyāt /
meaning: यदि लोहिन्यो लेखाः प्रसव्यं यूपं परिहरेयुर्न साहस्रं क्रतुमाहरिष्यतीति विद्यात् /
text_mt: If red lines should encircle the sacrificial post counter-clockwise, one should know: 'He will not perform a sacrifice with a thousand [cows as dakṣiṇā]';
if white ones [encircle it] clockwise, [one should know]: 'He will soon perform a sacrifice with a thousand [cows as dakṣiṇā].'

sanskrit_iast: yadyāhutau hutāyāṃ kṛṣṇo dhūmo dakṣiṇāṃ diśamabhinihanyādvāto vā prasavyaṃ dhumamāveṣṭayedyajamāno mriyeta /
meaning: यद्याहुतौ हुतायां कृष्णो धूमो दक्षिणां दिशमभिनिहन्याद्वातो वा प्रसव्यं धुममावेष्टयेद्यजमानो म्रियेत /
text_mt: If, when the oblation is offered, black smoke should strike toward the south, or the wind should wrap the smoke counter-clockwise, the sacrificer would die;
he should offer the all-expiation oblation—he should offer it.

sanskrit_iast: somena yakṣyamāṇo brāhmaṇānārṣeyānṛtvijo vṛṇīte yūnaḥ sthavirānvānūcānānūrdhvavāco 'naṅgahīnān
meaning: सोमेन यक्ष्यमाणो ब्राह्मणानार्षेयानृत्विजो वृणीते यूनः स्थविरान्वानूचानानूर्ध्ववाचो ऽनङ्गहीनान्
text_mt: Intending to sacrifice with soma, he chooses the officiating priests: Brāhmaṇas descended from ṛṣis, young or elderly, learned in the Veda, loud-voiced, and free from bodily defects.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ pṛcchati ka ṛtvijaḥ ke yājayanti kaccinnāhīnaḥ kaccinna nyastamārtvijyaṃ kaccitkalyāṇyo dakṣiṇā iti chandogabrāhmaṇaṃ bhavati
meaning: तं पृच्छति क ऋत्विजः के याजयन्ति कच्चिन्नाहीनः कच्चिन्न न्यस्तमार्त्विज्यं कच्चित्कल्याण्यो दक्षिणा इति छन्दोगब्राह्मणं भवति
text_mt: 'He asks him: "Who are the officiating priests? Who conduct the sacrifice? Is it not an ahīna? Is the office of officiating priest not cast away? Are the dakṣiṇās auspicious?"'—thus says a Chāndoga-Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: atha japati mahanme 'voco bhargo me 'voco yaśo me vocaḥ stomaṃ me 'vocaḥ kḷptiṃ me 'voco bhuktiṃ me 'vocaḥ sarvaṃ me 'vocastanmāvatu tanmāviśatu tena bhukṣiṣīyeti
meaning: अथ जपति महन्मे ऽवोचो भर्गो मे ऽवोचो यशो मे वोचः स्तोमं मे ऽवोचः कॢप्तिं मे ऽवोचो भुक्तिं मे ऽवोचः सर्वं मे ऽवोचस्तन्मावतु तन्माविशतु तेन भुक्षिषीयेति
text_mt: Then he mutters: 'Greatness you have spoken to me, splendor you have spoken to me, glory you have spoken to me, praise you have spoken to me, fitness you have spoken to me, enjoyment you have spoken to me, everything you have spoken to me; may that protect me, may that enter me, may I enjoy through that.'

sanskrit_iast: padvā nāmāsi srutiḥ somasaraṇī somaṃ gameyamiti panthānamātiṣṭhate
meaning: पद्वा नामासि स्रुतिः सोमसरणी सोमं गमेयमिति पन्थानमातिष्ठते
text_mt: With [the formula], 'Footpath by name are you, the trail leading to Soma; may I go to Soma,' he sets out upon the road.

sanskrit_iast: devo devametu somaḥ somametvṛtasya pathā vihāya dauṣkṛtyamityabhipravrajati
meaning: देवो देवमेतु सोमः सोममेत्वृतस्य पथा विहाय दौष्कृत्यमित्यभिप्रव्रजति
text_mt: With [the formula], 'May god go to god, may soma go to soma along the path of truth, leaving behind evil deeds,' he proceeds towards [the sacrificial enclosure].
Having turned toward the south, he attends the ancestors with [the formula], 'Ancestors! Bhūḥ!'
He chooses them, either four [at a time] or all one by one:

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuṃ pratiprasthātāraṃ neṣṭāram unnetāram ity adhvaryūn /
meaning: अध्वर्युं प्रतिप्रस्थातारं नेष्टारम् उन्नेतारम् इत्य् अध्वर्यून् /
text_mt: the adhvaryu, the pratiprasthātṛ, the neṣṭṛ, and the unnetṛ, as the adhvaryu priests;
the brahman, the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, the āgnīdhra, and the potṛ, as the brahman priests;

sanskrit_iast: hotāraṃ maitrāvaruṇam acchāvākaṃ grāvastutam iti hotṝn /
meaning: होतारं मैत्रावरुणम् अच्छावाकं ग्रावस्तुतम् इति होतॄन् /
text_mt: the hotṛ, the maitrāvaruṇa, the acchāvāka, and the grāvastut, as the hotṛ priests;

sanskrit_iast: udgātāraṃ prastotāraṃ pratihartāraṃ subrahmaṇyam ity udgātṝn
meaning: उद्गातारं प्रस्तोतारं प्रतिहर्तारं सुब्रह्मण्यम् इत्य् उद्गातॄन्
text_mt: the udgātṛ, the prastotṛ, the pratihartṛ, and the subrahmaṇya, as the udgātṛ priests.
The Kauṣītakins teach a seventeenth [priest], the sadasya.
He is the overseer of the ritual acts.

sanskrit_iast: agnirme hotādityo me 'dhvaryuścandramā me brahmā parjanyo ma udgātākāśo me sadasya āpo me hotrāśaṃsino raśmayo me camasādhvaryava ityupāṃśu devatādeśanam /
meaning: अग्निर्मे होतादित्यो मे ऽध्वर्युश्चन्द्रमा मे ब्रह्मा पर्जन्यो म उद्गाताकाशो मे सदस्य आपो मे होत्राशंसिनो रश्मयो मे चमसाध्वर्यव इत्युपांशु देवतादेशनम् /
text_mt: “Agni is my hotṛ; Āditya is my adhvaryu; Candramas is my brahman; Parjanya is my udgātṛ; the space is my sadasya; the waters are my hotrā-reciters; the rays are my camasādhvaryus”—this designation of deities is [uttered] in a low voice.
One who desires heaven should sacrifice with the Jyotiṣṭoma.
He may desire [them] simultaneously or at separate performances.
In spring one should sacrifice with the Jyotiṣṭoma.
The Agniṣṭoma is the first sacrifice.
Some teach the Atirātra first.
Every spring one should sacrifice with the Jyotiṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast: tasya tisro dakṣiṇā iti chandogabrāhmaṇaṃ bhavati
meaning: तस्य तिस्रो दक्षिणा इति छन्दोगब्राह्मणं भवति
text_mt: “Its sacrificial gifts are three [cows],” says a Chāndoga Brāhmaṇa.
One should sacrifice for the first time with the Rathaṃtara-sāman, with the Bṛhat-sāman, or with both sāmans.
Some say that without having performed [the sacrifice] with the Rathaṃtara-sāman, one should not undertake the one with the Bṛhat-sāman.

sanskrit_iast: yadīṣṭyā yadi paśunā yad somena yajetāmāvāsyāyāṃ vaiva paurṇamāsyāṃ vā yajeta
meaning: यदीष्ट्या यदि पशुना यद् सोमेन यजेतामावास्यायां वैव पौर्णमास्यां वा यजेत
text_mt: Whether he sacrifices with an iṣṭi, with an animal [sacrifice], or with soma, he should sacrifice only on the new moon or on the full moon.

sanskrit_iast: deva varuṇa devayajanaṃ me dehīti yajamāno rājānaṃ devayajanaṃ yācet
meaning: देव वरुण देवयजनं मे देहीति यजमानो राजानं देवयजनं याचेत्
text_mt: The sacrificer should request the place of sacrifice from the king [of the land], saying: “O divine Varuṇa, give me the place of sacrifice!”

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi dadāti devayajanavān bhūyā ityenamāha /
meaning: स यदि ददाति देवयजनवान् भूया इत्येनमाह /
text_mt: If he grants it, he says to him: “May you possess a place of sacrifice.”

sanskrit_iast: yadi na dadāti yadahaṃ devayajanaṃ veda tasmiṃstvā devayajana ā kṣiṇomīti
meaning: यदि न ददाति यदहं देवयजनं वेद तस्मिंस्त्वा देवयजन आ क्षिणोमीति
text_mt: If he does not grant it, [he says]: “In that place of sacrifice which I know, I destroy you upon that place of sacrifice!”
Then they curse him:
“You have struck at the mind; the mind shall abandon you!”—says the brahman.
“You have struck at speech; speech shall abandon you!”—says the hotṛ.
“You have struck at the breath; the breath shall abandon you!”—says the adhvaryu.
“You have struck at sight; sight shall abandon you!”—says the udgātṛ.
“You have struck at the self; the self shall abandon you!”—says the sadasya.
“You have struck at procreation; offspring shall abandon you!”—says the sacrificer.
“You have struck at the limbs; the limbs shall abandon you!”—say the hotrakas.
“You have struck at all beings; all beings shall abandon you!”—say all the officiating priests.
The king [sacrificer] requests the place of sacrifice:

sanskrit_iast: agnirhotā sa me hotā hotardevayajanaṃ me dehīti hotāram /
meaning: अग्निर्होता स मे होता होतर्देवयजनं मे देहीति होतारम् /
text_mt: “Agni is the hotṛ, he is my hotṛ; O hotṛ, give me the place of sacrifice!”—[he says] to the hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: ādityo 'dhvaryuḥ sa me 'dhvaryuradhvaryo devayajanaṃ me dehītyadhvaryum /
meaning: आदित्यो ऽध्वर्युः स मे ऽध्वर्युरध्वर्यो देवयजनं मे देहीत्यध्वर्युम् /
text_mt: “Āditya is the adhvaryu, he is my adhvaryu; O adhvaryu, give me the place of sacrifice!”—[he says] to the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: candramā brahmā sa me brahmā brahmandevayajanaṃ me dehīti brahmāṇam /
meaning: चन्द्रमा ब्रह्मा स मे ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मन्देवयजनं मे देहीति ब्रह्माणम् /
text_mt: “Candramas is the brahman, he is my brahman; O brahman, give me the place of sacrifice!”—[he says] to the brahman.

sanskrit_iast: prajanya udgātā sa ma udgātodgātardevayajanaṃ me dehītyudgātāram /
meaning: प्रजन्य उद्गाता स म उद्गातोद्गातर्देवयजनं मे देहीत्युद्गातारम् /
text_mt: “Parjanya is the udgātṛ, he is my udgātṛ; O udgātṛ, give me the place of sacrifice!”—[he says] to the udgātṛ.

sanskrit_iast: ākāśaḥ sadasyaḥ sa me sadasyaḥ sadasya devayajanaṃ me dehīti sadasyam /
meaning: आकाशः सदस्यः स मे सदस्यः सदस्य देवयजनं मे देहीति सदस्यम् /
text_mt: “The space is the sadasya, it is my sadasya; O sadasya, give me the place of sacrifice!”—[he says] to the sadasya.

sanskrit_iast: āpo hotrāśaṃsinaste me hotrāśaṃsino hotrāśaṃsino devayajanaṃ me datteti hotrakān /
meaning: आपो होत्राशंसिनस्ते मे होत्राशंसिनो होत्राशंसिनो देवयजनं मे दत्तेति होत्रकान् /
text_mt: “The waters are the hotrā-reciters, they are my hotrā-reciters; O hotrā-reciters, give me the place of sacrifice!”—[he says] to the hotrakas.

sanskrit_iast: raśmayaścamasādhvaryuvaste me camasādhvaryavaścamasā dhvaryavo devayajanaṃ me datteti camasādhvaryūn
meaning: रश्मयश्चमसाध्वर्युवस्ते मे चमसाध्वर्यवश्चमसा ध्वर्यवो देवयजनं मे दत्तेति चमसाध्वर्यून्
text_mt: “The rays are the camasādhvaryus, they are my camasādhvaryus; O camasādhvaryus, give me the place of sacrifice!”—[he says] to the camasādhvaryus.
Or rather, he should not request the place of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: devatā evopatiṣṭheta sakṣedaṃ paśya vidhartaridaṃ paśya nākedaṃ paśya /
meaning: देवता एवोपतिष्ठेत सक्षेदं पश्य विधर्तरिदं पश्य नाकेदं पश्य /
text_mt: He should just revere the deities: “O conqueror, see this! O sustainer, see this! O vault of heaven, see this!

sanskrit_iast: ramatiḥ paniṣṭhartaṃ varṣiṣṭhamamṛtā yānyāhuḥ sūryo variṣṭho akṣabhirvibhātyanu dyāvāpṛthivī devaputre iti
meaning: रमतिः पनिष्ठर्तं वर्षिष्ठममृता यान्याहुः सूर्यो वरिष्ठो अक्षभिर्विभात्यनु द्यावापृथिवी देवपुत्रे इति
