text_mt: Rest is the most praiseworthy, truth is the highest, which they call immortal; the sun, greatest, shines with his eyes along heaven and earth, the mothers of the gods.”

sanskrit_iast: edamaganma devayajanaṃ pṛthivyā iti devayajanam adhyavasyati
meaning: एदमगन्म देवयजनं पृथिव्या इति देवयजनम् अध्यवस्यति
text_mt: With the formula, “Here we have come to the place of sacrifice on earth,” he occupies the place of sacrifice.
Having grasped the middle main post of the east-facing hall, he mutters—according to the Vājasaneyaka.
Then he offers the collection-yajuses.
This anuvāka, beginning “Agni with the yajuses, Savitṛ with the stomas,” is recited.
At this point, having brought king [Soma], they serve him with milk-rice until the purchase.

sanskrit_iast: sve dakṣe dakṣapiteha sīda devānāṃ sumno mahate raṇāya /
meaning: स्वे दक्षे दक्षपितेह सीद देवानां सुम्नो महते रणाय /
text_mt: “In your own skill, O father of skill, sit here, a favour of the gods for the great battle!

sanskrit_iast: svāsasthastanuvā saṃviśasva pitevaidhi sūnava ā suśevaḥ /
meaning: स्वासस्थस्तनुवा संविशस्व पितेवैधि सूनव आ सुशेवः /
text_mt: Well-seated, enter together with your body; be like a father to a son, most gracious!

sanskrit_iast: śivo mā śivamāviśa satyaṃ ma ātmā śraddhā me 'kṣitistapo me pratiṣṭhā /
meaning: शिवो मा शिवमाविश सत्यं म आत्मा श्रद्धा मे ऽक्षितिस्तपो मे प्रतिष्ठा /
text_mt: Auspicious, enter me who am auspicious; truth is my self, faith my imperishability, ascetic heat my support!

sanskrit_iast: savitṛprasūtā mā diśo dīkṣayantu satyamasmīti purastāddīkṣaṇīyāyā āhavanīyaṃ yajamāna upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: सवितृप्रसूता मा दिशो दीक्षयन्तु सत्यमस्मीति पुरस्ताद्दीक्षणीयाया आहवनीयं यजमान उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: Impelled by Savitṛ, let the directions consecrate me; I am truth”—with these formulas the sacrificer reveres the āhavanīya prior to the consecration sacrifice.
Having run through the saptahotṛ formula mentally and having offered it into the āhavanīya with the draught portion,
he sets in motion the procedure of the consecration sacrifice.
He measures out [the grains] for a cake on eleven potsherds to Agni and Viṣṇu.
Or a mess of cooked grain in ghee to Agni and Viṣṇu.
The cake is for one who desires spiritual lustre;
the mess of cooked grain in ghee is for one who desires offspring or for one who desires cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ādityaṃ ghṛte caruṃ dvitīyaṃ prajākāmapaśukāmasyaike samāmananti
meaning: आदित्यं घृते चरुं द्वितीयं प्रजाकामपशुकामस्यैके समामनन्ति
text_mt: Some teach a second mess of cooked grain in ghee to Āditi for one who desires offspring or cattle.
There are fifteen or seventeen kindling verses.
Some teach [erecting] the east-facing hall first;
The consecration sacrifice concludes with the patnīsaṃyāja offerings.
He keeps the clarified butter of the dhruvā ladel.
With that he proceeds in a low voice up to the Agnīṣomīya [animal sacrifice].
With as much voice as he has, so much he recites at the consecration offering (Dīkṣaṇīyā);
lower than that at the introductory offering (Prāyaṇīyā);
still lower at the hospitality offering (Ātithyā);
In a low tone at the Dīkṣaṇīyā;
in a lower tone at the Prāyaṇīyā;
in a still lower tone at the Ātithyā;
Or, in a whisper at the Dīkṣaṇīyā;
in a lower whisper at the Prāyaṇīyā;
in a still lower whisper at the Ātithyā;

sanskrit_iast: darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtīnāṃ some 'gnyanvādhānaṃ vratopāyanamāraṇyāśanaṃ jāgaraṇamanvāhāryasya ca dānaṃ patnyāḥ saṃnahanaṃ vimocanamiti na vidyante
meaning: दर्शपूर्णमासप्रकृतीनां सोमे ऽग्न्यन्वाधानं व्रतोपायनमारण्याशनं जागरणमन्वाहार्यस्य च दानं पत्न्याः संनहनं विमोचनमिति न विद्यन्ते
text_mt: In the Soma sacrifice, for the rituals having the New and Full Moon sacrifices as their archetype, the following are not present: adding fuel to the fires, undertaking the vow, eating wild food, keeping awake, giving the anvāhārya cooked rice, and the tying and untying of the wife's girdle.

sanskrit_iast: agnyanvādhānaṃ tu dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ kriyeta patnyāśca saṃnahanam
meaning: अग्न्यन्वाधानं तु दीक्षणीयायां क्रियेत पत्न्याश्च संनहनम्
text_mt: However, adding fuel to the fires and the tying of the wife's girdle should be performed at the Dīkṣaṇīyā.
During the consecration days (dīkṣās), he has the sacrificial post made;
or when the King [Soma] has been purchased, or during the Upasads.

sanskrit_iast: prācīnavaṃśaṃ karoti purastādunnataṃ paścānninataṃ sarvataḥ pariśritam
meaning: प्राचीनवंशं करोति पुरस्तादुन्नतं पश्चान्निनतं सर्वतः परिश्रितम्
text_mt: He constructs the hall with the roof-beam pointing eastward, elevated in front, lower at the back, [and] enclosed on all sides.
The corners are in the intermediate directions.
He makes openings in the corners.
One desiring heaven [should make] a door to the east;
he who desires, 'May I thrive in the world of the fathers,' to the south;
one desiring the world of men, to the west;
he who desires, 'May I thrive in the world of the gods,' to the north;
he who desires, 'May I thrive in both worlds,' to the north-east;
he who desires, 'May I thrive in all quarters,' on all sides.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa bahiḥ prāgvaṃśaṃ pariśrite yajamānaḥ keśaśmaśru vāpayate
meaning: उत्तरेण बहिः प्राग्वंशं परिश्रिते यजमानः केशश्मश्रु वापयते
text_mt: In an enclosed space to the north outside the east-beamed hall, the sacrificer has his hair and beard shaved.
First the armpits, then the beard, then the hair;
or rather: the beard, the armpits, then the hair.
With 'May the waters moisten [thee],' he moistens the right side of the head.

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhe trāyasvainamiti prāgagraṃ darbhamantardhāya svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīriti svadhitinābhinidhāya devaśrūriti pravapati
meaning: ओषधे त्रायस्वैनमिति प्रागग्रं दर्भमन्तर्धाय स्वधिते मैनं हिंसीरिति स्वधितिनाभिनिधाय देवश्रूरिति प्रवपति
text_mt: Interposing a blade of darbha grass with its tip pointing eastward with 'O plant, protect him,' placing the razor upon it with 'O razor, harm him not,' he shaves with 'Listening to the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhe trāyasva mā svadhite mā mā hiṃsīḥ svastryuttarāṇyaśīyeti yajamāno japati
meaning: ओषधे त्रायस्व मा स्वधिते मा मा हिंसीः स्वस्त्र्युत्तराण्यशीयेति यजमानो जपति
text_mt: The sacrificer whispers: 'O plant, protect me; O razor, harm me not; may I attain auspicious subsequent [rites].'
He has his nails pared toward the interior.
First of the left hand, beginning from the little finger.
First those of the hands, then those of the feet.
He cleans his teeth with an udumbara twig, not causing bleeding.
He bathes in standing water containing shells, overgrown with avakā plants, at a grassy ford.
'Having placed gold in a jar, he bathes in it,' thus says the Vājasaneyaka.
With 'May the waters, our mothers, purify us,'
'Golden in color, pure, purifying, the waters have flowed forth leaving behind imperfection,'

sanskrit_iast: śataṃ pavitrā vitatā hyāsu tābhirno devaḥ savitā punātviti /
meaning: शतं पवित्रा वितता ह्यासु ताभिर्नो देवः सविता पुनात्विति /
text_mt: 'A hundred strainers are spread out in them; with these may the divine Savitṛ purify us,'
and with these two verses: 'Golden in color, pure, purifying...' [he bathes].
Emerging from the water, he mutters: 'Pure and cleansed, I come up from these.'
Then he gives him a new, unwashed linen garment.

sanskrit_iast: tatpratigṛhṇāti dīkṣāsi tapaso yonistapo 'si brahmaṇo yonirbrahmāsi kṣatrasya yoniḥ kṣatramasyṛtasya yonirṛtamasi bhūrārabhe śraddhāṃ manasā dīkṣāṃ tapasā viśvasya bhuvanasyādhipatnīṃ sarve kāmā yajamānasya santviti
meaning: तत्प्रतिगृह्णाति दीक्षासि तपसो योनिस्तपो ऽसि ब्रह्मणो योनिर्ब्रह्मासि क्षत्रस्य योनिः क्षत्रमस्यृतस्य योनिरृतमसि भूरारभे श्रद्धां मनसा दीक्षां तपसा विश्वस्य भुवनस्याधिपत्नीं सर्वे कामा यजमानस्य सन्त्विति
text_mt: He accepts it with: 'Thou art consecration, the womb of ascetic heat; thou art ascetic heat, the womb of sacred knowledge; thou art sacred knowledge, the womb of the warrior; thou art the warrior, the womb of cosmic order; thou art cosmic order, the earth. I undertake faith with the mind, consecration with ascetic heat, the ruler of the whole universe; may all desires belong to the sacrificer.'

sanskrit_iast: somasya tanūrasi tanuvaṃ me pāhi dīkṣāsi tanūrasi tāṃ tvāṃ śivāṃ syonāṃ paridhiṣīyeti tatparidhāya somasya nīvirasīti nīvimanuparikalpayate
meaning: सोमस्य तनूरसि तनुवं मे पाहि दीक्षासि तनूरसि तां त्वां शिवां स्योनां परिधिषीयेति तत्परिधाय सोमस्य नीविरसीति नीविमनुपरिकल्पयते
text_mt: Having put it on with: 'Thou art the body of Soma, protect my body; thou art consecration, thou art the body; as such, auspicious and comfortable, may I put thee on,' he arranges the tucked fold with: 'Thou art the tuck of Soma.'
With 'For strength, thee,' he eats food mixed with clarified butter, pouring sour milk over it.
He eats whatever is pleasing to his heart.
'Just that becomes his in yonder world,' it is known [from scripture].

sanskrit_iast: tathā śitaḥ syādyathā tato dīkṣāsu kanīyaḥkanīyo vratamupeyāt
meaning: तथा शितः स्याद्यथा ततो दीक्षासु कनीयःकनीयो व्रतमुपेयात्
text_mt: He should be sated in such a way that from then on, during the consecration days, he may take less and less food.
Some teachers recite that the eating takes place before the shaving of the hair or before the putting on of the garment.
With [the formula], “You are the milk of the great ones,” he stirs the fresh butter with two darbha tufts.
With [the formula], “You are the bestower of brilliance,” [the sacrificer] anoints himself three times away from [the hair's root] (or from head to foot):
With [the formula], “You are the pupil of Vṛtra's eye,” he anoints [his eyes] with salve from Mount Trikakud.

sanskrit_iast: yadi traikakudaṃ nādhigacchedyenaiva kena cāñjanenāñjīteti vājasaneyakam
meaning: यदि त्रैककुदं नाधिगच्छेद्येनैव केन चाञ्जनेनाञ्जीतेति वाजसनेयकम्
text_mt: “If he should not obtain salve from Mount Trikakud, he may anoint with whatever salve [is available],” so [says] the Vājasaneyaka.

sanskrit_iast: satūlayā darbheṣīkayā śareṣīkayā darbhapuñjīlena vābhyantaraṃ dvirdakṣiṇamanidhāvamānaḥ /
meaning: सतूलया दर्भेषीकया शरेषीकया दर्भपुञ्जीलेन वाभ्यन्तरं द्विर्दक्षिणमनिधावमानः /
text_mt: With a darbha stalk with its tuft, or a reed stalk, or a darbha tuft, inwards twice the right [eye], not running over;
Or else twice the right, three times the left;
Then, to the north outside the prāgvaṃśa hall, he purifies him with darbha tufts.
“He purifies with two, he purifies with three,” it has been said.
With twenty-one divided threefold, with seven each, twice he wipes upward from the navel;
Some say he purifies downward along [the body].
Whomever he hates, him he should purify crosswise or diagonally.
With these [formulas], “May Citpati purify you,” and so forth, mantra by mantra.
He attaches everywhere, “With an unbroken strainer.”

sanskrit_iast: citpatirmā punātu vākpatirmā punātu devo mā savitā punātviti pāvyamāno japati
meaning: चित्पतिर्मा पुनातु वाक्पतिर्मा पुनातु देवो मा सविता पुनात्विति पाव्यमानो जपति
text_mt: While being purified, he mutters: “May Citpati purify me, may Vākpati purify me, may the god Savitṛ purify me,”
And “Of that you, O lord of the strainer...”
“May the purifying one, who belongs to heaven, sagacious with the strainer,
The golden strainer, belonging to Prajāpati, of a hundred stretches,

sanskrit_iast: tena brahmavido vayaṃ pūtaṃ brahma punīmaha iti ca
meaning: तेन ब्रह्मविदो वयं पूतं ब्रह्म पुनीमह इति च
text_mt: With that, we who know sacred lore purify the purified sacred lore;” and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: yaddevā devaheḍanaṃ tvamagne ayāsīti ca pūtaḥ
meaning: यद्देवा देवहेडनं त्वमग्ने अयासीति च पूतः
text_mt: When purified, [he mutters]: “Whatever offense against the gods, O gods...” and “You, O Agni, are unyielding...”
Or he should offer before the consecratory offering.

sanskrit_iast: ā vo devāsa īmaha iti pūrvayā dvārā prāgvaṃśaṃ praviśyendrāgnī dyāvāpṛthivī ityapareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇātikramya tvaṃ dikṣāṇāmadhipatirasītyāhavanīyamupopaviśati
meaning: आ वो देवास ईमह इति पूर्वया द्वारा प्राग्वंशं प्रविश्येन्द्राग्नी द्यावापृथिवी इत्यपरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य त्वं दिक्षाणामधिपतिरसीत्याहवनीयमुपोपविशति
text_mt: With [the formula], “We approach you, O gods,” having entered the prāgvaṃśa hall by the eastern door, and having crossed south to the west of the āhavanīya with “Indra-and-Agni, Heaven-and-Earth,” he sits down near the āhavanīya with “You are the overlord of consecrations.”

sanskrit_iast: eṣa evāta ūrdhvaṃ yajamānasya saṃcaro bhavati
meaning: एष एवात ऊर्ध्वं यजमानस्य संचरो भवति
text_mt: This alone, from now on, is the passage-way of the sacrificer.
Here some teach the consecratory offering.
Some [teach] the equipment-formulas before the consecration libations.

sanskrit_iast: yaddīkṣaṇīyāyā dhrauvamājyaṃ tato dīkṣāhutīḥ sruveṇa catasro juhoti /
meaning: यद्दीक्षणीयाया ध्रौवमाज्यं ततो दीक्षाहुतीः स्रुवेण चतस्रो जुहोति /
text_mt: From what is the dhruvā-ghee of the consecratory offering, from that he offers four consecration libations with the sruva spoon,
With these [formulas], “To the intention, to the impulse, to Agni, svāhā,” mantra by mantra.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśagṛhītena srucaṃ pūrayitvā viśve devasya neturiti pūrṇāhutiṃ ṣaṣṭhīm
meaning: द्वादशगृहीतेन स्रुचं पूरयित्वा विश्वे देवस्य नेतुरिति पूर्णाहुतिं षष्ठीम्
text_mt: Having filled the sruc ladle with twelve portions of ghee, [he offers] the full libation as the sixth, with “All [men] of the divine leader...”

sanskrit_iast: yatrādhvaryuraudgrahaṇāni juhoti tadyajamāno 'dhvaryumanvārabhya pañca juhoti vācā me vāgdīkṣatāṃ svāhā /
meaning: यत्राध्वर्युरौद्ग्रहणानि जुहोति तद्यजमानो ऽध्वर्युमन्वारभ्य पञ्च जुहोति वाचा मे वाग्दीक्षतां स्वाहा /
text_mt: Where the adhvaryu offers the audgrahaṇa libations, there the sacrificer, keeping hold of the adhvaryu from behind, offers five: “Through speech may my speech be consecrated, svāhā;
Through breath may my breath be consecrated, svāhā;
Through sight may my sight be consecrated, svāhā;
Through hearing may my hearing be consecrated, svāhā;
Through mind may my mind be consecrated, svāhā.”
Or he recites over the adhvaryu while he is offering.

sanskrit_iast: vātaṃ prāṇaṃ manasānvārabhāmahe prajāpatiṃ yo bhuvanasya gopāḥ /
meaning: वातं प्राणं मनसान्वारभामहे प्रजापतिं यो भुवनस्य गोपाः /
text_mt: “We take hold with the mind of the wind, the breath, of Prajāpati who is the guardian of the world;

sanskrit_iast: sa no mṛtyostrāyatāṃ pātvaṃhaso jyogjīvā jarāmaśīmahīti pūrṇāhutiṃ hūyamānāmanumantrayate
meaning: स नो मृत्योस्त्रायतां पात्वंहसो ज्योग्जीवा जरामशीमहीति पूर्णाहुतिं हूयमानामनुमन्त्रयते
text_mt: May he protect us from death, protect from distress; long-living, may we attain old age,” with this he recites over the full libation while it is being offered.
Here some [prescribe] the equipment-formulas.
He consecrates the sacrificer with a black antelope skin.
He should be consecrated with two joined together, flesh sides inwards, hairy sides outwards.
If there should be one, he should stitch the right fore-foot;

sanskrit_iast: dve viṣūcī pratimuñceta pādaṃ vā pratiṣīvyedityeke
meaning: द्वे विषूची प्रतिमुञ्चेत पादं वा प्रतिषीव्येदित्येके
text_mt: He should fasten on two facing apart, or stitch a foot, say some.
Inside the altar ground, he spreads out the black antelope skin, with its neck to the east, hairy side up.

sanskrit_iast: ṛksāmayoḥ śilpe stha iti śuklakṛṣṇe rājī ālabhate /
meaning: ऋक्सामयोः शिल्पे स्थ इति शुक्लकृष्णे राजी आलभते /
text_mt: With [the formula], “You two are the works of art of the Ṛgveda and Sāmaveda,” he touches the white and black stripes;

sanskrit_iast: indra śākvara gāyatrīṃ prapadye tāṃ te yunajmīndra śākvara triṣṭubhaṃ prapadye tāṃ te yunajmīndra śākvara jagatīṃ prapadye tāṃ te yunajmīndra śākvarānuṣṭubhaṃ prapadye tāṃ te yunajmīndra śākvara paṅktiṃ prapadye tāṃ te yunajmītyetaiḥ pratimantraṃ pratidiśaṃ kṛṣṇājinamabhimṛśati /
meaning: इन्द्र शाक्वर गायत्रीं प्रपद्ये तां ते युनज्मीन्द्र शाक्वर त्रिष्टुभं प्रपद्ये तां ते युनज्मीन्द्र शाक्वर जगतीं प्रपद्ये तां ते युनज्मीन्द्र शाक्वरानुष्टुभं प्रपद्ये तां ते युनज्मीन्द्र शाक्वर पङ्क्तिं प्रपद्ये तां ते युनज्मीत्येतैः प्रतिमन्त्रं प्रतिदिशं कृष्णाजिनमभिमृशति /
text_mt: With these [formulas], “O mighty Indra, I take refuge in the gāyatrī; that I yoke for you,” “O mighty Indra, I take refuge in the triṣṭubh; that I yoke for you,” “O mighty Indra, I take refuge in the jagatī; that I yoke for you,” “O mighty Indra, I take refuge in the anuṣṭubh; that I yoke for you,” “O mighty Indra, I take refuge in the paṅkti; that I yoke for you,” mantra by mantra, he touches the black antelope skin in each direction,
Then, facing east, bending his knees, he creeps towards it.

sanskrit_iast: imāṃ dhiyaṃ śikṣamāṇasyeti kṛṣṇājinaṃ bhasatta ārohati
meaning: इमां धियं शिक्षमाणस्येति कृष्णाजिनं भसत्त आरोहति
text_mt: With [the formula], “[Desiring the favor] of him who seeks to learn this thought,” he mounts the black antelope skin from the rump side.
While mounting, he mutters: “The good protector...”;
Having mounted, “This good ship have I mounted...”

sanskrit_iast: āhaṃ dīkṣāmaruhamṛtasya patnīṃ gāyatreṇa chandasā brahmaṇā cartaṃ satye 'dhāyi satyamṛte 'dhāyyṛtaṃ ca me satyaṃ cābhūtāṃ jyotirabhūvaṃ suvaragamaṃ suvargaṃ lokaṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhaṃ bradhnasya viṣṭapamagamamiti ca
meaning: आहं दीक्षामरुहमृतस्य पत्नीं गायत्रेण छन्दसा ब्रह्मणा चर्तं सत्ये ऽधायि सत्यमृते ऽधाय्यृतं च मे सत्यं चाभूतां ज्योतिरभूवं सुवरगमं सुवर्गं लोकं नाकस्य पृष्ठं ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपमगममिति च
text_mt: And: “I have mounted the consecration, the spouse of truth, through the gāyatrī metre, through sacred lore. Truth has been placed in truth, truth has been placed in order. Both order and truth have become mine. I have become light, I have gone to heaven, I have gone to the heavenly world, the back of the firmament, the highest station of the sun.”
At this point, the wife puts a head-net and hair-ornament on her head.
"Black, made of living sheep's wool," says the Vājasaneyaka.
They explain kumbakurīra as a hair-net.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ śarmāsītyahatena vāsasā dakṣiṇamaṃsaṃ yajamānaḥ prorṇute /
meaning: विष्णोः शर्मासीत्यहतेन वाससा दक्षिणमंसं यजमानः प्रोर्णुते /
text_mt: With the formula, "You are Viṣṇu's shelter," the sacrificer covers his right shoulder with an unwashed garment.
With "Protect me from the shining through of the stars," [he covers] his head.

sanskrit_iast: uṣṇīṣeṇa pradakṣiṇaṃ śiro veṣṭayata iti vājasaneyakam
meaning: उष्णीषेण प्रदक्षिणं शिरो वेष्टयत इति वाजसनेयकम्
text_mt: "He wraps his head sunwise with a turban," says the Vājasaneyaka.
It is stated: "He should not uncover himself before the buying of soma."
He consecrates the wife with a garment having its fringes to the east.
A girdle made of reed grass or of muñja grass, threefold, broad, having a loop at one end.
With it he consecrates the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: ūrgasīti nābhiṃ prati parivyayati dveṣyaṃ manasā dhyāyan
meaning: ऊर्गसीति नाभिं प्रति परिव्ययति द्वेष्यं मनसा ध्यायन्
text_mt: With the formula, "You are sap," he ties it around opposite the navel, contemplating in his mind someone he hates.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa nābhiṃ niṣṭarkyaṃ granthiṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ paryūhya dakṣiṇena nābhimavasthāpayati
meaning: उत्तरेण नाभिं निष्टर्क्यं ग्रन्थिं कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं पर्यूह्य दक्षिणेन नाभिमवस्थापयति
text_mt: Having made a slipknot north of the navel, and having wound it round sunwise, he lets it rest south of the navel.
At this point, he girds the wife as in the New and Full Moon sacrifices.
"I gird you" is the modification.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya yonirasi māmā hiṃsīriti kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ yajamānāya prayacchati
meaning: इन्द्रस्य योनिरसि मामा हिंसीरिति कृष्णविषाणां यजमानाय प्रयच्छति
text_mt: With "You are Indra's womb; do not harm me," he gives a black-buck horn to the sacrificer.
It has three folds or five folds, turned to the right.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣyai tvā susasyāyā iti tayā vederloṣṭamuddhanti
meaning: कृष्यै त्वा सुसस्याया इति तया वेदेर्लोष्टमुद्धन्ति
text_mt: With "For plowing thee, rich in good crops," he digs up a clod from the altar ground with it.
With "For the plants rich in good fruit," when an occasion arises, he scratches his head.

sanskrit_iast: viṣāṇe viṣyaitaṃ granthiṃ yadasya gulphitaṃ hṛdi mano yadasya gulphitam ity aṅgāni
meaning: विषाणे विष्यैतं ग्रन्थिं यदस्य गुल्फितं हृदि मनो यदस्य गुल्फितम् इत्य् अङ्गानि
text_mt: With "O horn, untie this knot, whatever in his heart is tangled, whatever mind in him is tangled," [he scratches] his limbs.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvasadasi vānaspatyaḥ sudyumno dyumnaṃ yajamānāya dhehītyaudumbaraṃ dīkṣitadaṇḍaṃ yajamānāya prayacchati /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वसदसि वानस्पत्यः सुद्युम्नो द्युम्नं यजमानाय धेहीत्यौदुम्बरं दीक्षितदण्डं यजमानाय प्रयच्छति /
text_mt: With "You who sit upright, belonging to the tree, of good renown, bestow renown upon the sacrificer," he hands a staff of udumbara wood for the consecrated one to the sacrificer.
Or whatever sacrificial tree is fruit-bearing.
It reaches up to the mouth or reaches up to the chin.

sanskrit_iast: sūpasthā devo vanaspatiriti taṃ yajamānaḥ pratigṛhyoruvyacā asi janadhāḥ svabhakṣo mā pāhīti camasaṃ vratapradānamabhimantrya keśinīṃ dīkṣāṃ japatyagnirdīkṣitaḥ pṛthivī dīkṣā sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe /
meaning: सूपस्था देवो वनस्पतिरिति तं यजमानः प्रतिगृह्योरुव्यचा असि जनधाः स्वभक्षो मा पाहीति चमसं व्रतप्रदानमभिमन्त्र्य केशिनीं दीक्षां जपत्यग्निर्दीक्षितः पृथिवी दीक्षा सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे /
text_mt: Having received it with "A tree is a deity easy to approach," and having addressed the goblet that provides the fast-milk with "You are wide-extending, people-sustaining; partaking of yourself, protect me," the sacrificer whispers the Keśinī-consecration: "Agni is consecrated; the earth is the consecration. May that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: vāyur dīkṣito 'ntariksāṃ dīkṣā sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe /
meaning: वायुर् दीक्षितो ऽन्तरिक्सां दीक्षा सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे /
text_mt: Vāyu is consecrated; the atmosphere is the consecration. May that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: ādityo dīkṣito dyaur dīkṣā sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe /
meaning: आदित्यो दीक्षितो द्यौर् दीक्षा सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे /
text_mt: Āditya is consecrated; the sky is the consecration. May that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: candramā dīkṣitaḥ śrotraṃ dīkṣā sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe /
meaning: चन्द्रमा दीक्षितः श्रोत्रं दीक्षा सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे /
text_mt: The moon is consecrated; the hearing is the consecration. May that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir dīkṣito mano dīkṣā sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe /
meaning: प्रजापतिर् दीक्षितो मनो दीक्षा सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे /
text_mt: Prajāpati is consecrated; the mind is the consecration. May that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: vācā me vāg dīkṣatāmagnaye samaṣṭavā u /
meaning: वाचा मे वाग् दीक्षतामग्नये समष्टवा उ /
text_mt: Through speech may my speech be consecrated, so as to attain Agni!

sanskrit_iast: prāṇena me prāṇo dīkṣatāṃ vāyave samaṣṭavā u /
meaning: प्राणेन मे प्राणो दीक्षतां वायवे समष्टवा उ /
text_mt: Through breath may my breath be consecrated, so as to attain Vāyu!

sanskrit_iast: cakṣuṣā me cakṣur dīkṣatāṃ sūryāya samaṣṭavā u /
meaning: चक्षुषा मे चक्षुर् दीक्षतां सूर्याय समष्टवा उ /
text_mt: Through sight may my sight be consecrated, so as to attain Sūrya!

sanskrit_iast: śrotreṇa me śrotraṃ dīkṣatāṃ candramase samaṣṭavā u /
meaning: श्रोत्रेण मे श्रोत्रं दीक्षतां चन्द्रमसे समष्टवा उ /
text_mt: Through hearing may my hearing be consecrated, so as to attain the moon!

sanskrit_iast: manasā me mano dīkṣatāṃ prajāpataye samaṣṭavā u /
meaning: मनसा मे मनो दीक्षतां प्रजापतये समष्टवा उ /
text_mt: Through mind may my mind be consecrated, so as to attain Prajāpati!

sanskrit_iast: bhūr bhuvaḥ suvastapo me dīkṣā satyaṃ gṛhapatiriti
meaning: भूर् भुवः सुवस्तपो मे दीक्षा सत्यं गृहपतिरिति
text_mt: Bhūr, bhuvaḥ, suvaḥ! Ascetic heat is my consecration; truth is the master of the house."

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivī dīkṣā tayāgnirdīkṣayā dīkṣito yayāgnirdīkṣayā dīkṣitastayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi /
meaning: पृथिवी दीक्षा तयाग्निर्दीक्षया दीक्षितो ययाग्निर्दीक्षया दीक्षितस्तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि /
text_mt: [The adhvaryu says:] "The earth is the consecration; with that consecration Agni was consecrated. With which consecration Agni was consecrated, with that consecration I consecrate you.

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣaṃ dīkṣā tayā vāyur dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā vāyur dīkṣayā dīkṣitastayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi /
meaning: अन्तरिक्षं दीक्षा तया वायुर् दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया वायुर् दीक्षया दीक्षितस्तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि /
text_mt: The atmosphere is the consecration; with that consecration Vāyu was consecrated. With which consecration Vāyu was consecrated, with that consecration I consecrate you.

sanskrit_iast: dyaur dīkṣā tayādityo dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayādityo dīkṣayā dīkṣitastayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi /
meaning: द्यौर् दीक्षा तयादित्यो दीक्षया दीक्षितो ययादित्यो दीक्षया दीक्षितस्तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि /
text_mt: The sky is the consecration; with that consecration Āditya was consecrated. With which consecration Āditya was consecrated, with that consecration I consecrate you.

sanskrit_iast: diśo dīkṣā tayā candramā dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā candramā dīkṣayā dīkṣitastayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi /
meaning: दिशो दीक्षा तया चन्द्रमा दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया चन्द्रमा दीक्षया दीक्षितस्तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि /
text_mt: The quarters are the consecration; with that consecration the moon was consecrated. With which consecration the moon was consecrated, with that consecration I consecrate you.

sanskrit_iast: āpo dīkṣā tayā varuṇo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā varuṇo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣitastayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi /
meaning: आपो दीक्षा तया वरुणो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया वरुणो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितस्तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि /
text_mt: The waters are the consecration; with that consecration King Varuṇa was consecrated. With which consecration King Varuṇa was consecrated, with that consecration I consecrate you.

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhayo dīkṣā tayā somo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā somo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣitastayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi /
meaning: ओषधयो दीक्षा तया सोमो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया सोमो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितस्तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि /
text_mt: The plants are the consecration; with that consecration King Soma was consecrated. With which consecration King Soma was consecrated, with that consecration I consecrate you.

sanskrit_iast: vāg dīkṣā tayā prāṇo dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā prāṇo dīkṣayā dīkṣitastayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi /
meaning: वाग् दीक्षा तया प्राणो दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया प्राणो दीक्षया दीक्षितस्तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि /
text_mt: Speech is the consecration; with that consecration breath was consecrated. With which consecration breath was consecrated, with that consecration I consecrate you.
May the earth follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated!
May the atmosphere follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated!
May the sky follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated!
May the quarters follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated!
May the waters follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated!
May the plants follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated!
May speech follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated!
May the Ṛg-verses follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated!
May the Sāman-chants follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated!
May the Yajus-formulas follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated!

sanskrit_iast: ahaś ca rātriś ca kṛṣiś ca vṛṣṭiś ca tviṣiścāpacitiścāpaścauṣadhayaścork ca sūnṛtā ca tās tvā dīkṣamāṇam anudīkṣantām iti
meaning: अहश् च रात्रिश् च कृषिश् च वृष्टिश् च त्विषिश्चापचितिश्चापश्चौषधयश्चोर्क् च सूनृता च तास् त्वा दीक्षमाणम् अनुदीक्षन्ताम् इति
text_mt: Day and night, agriculture and rain, splendor and reverence, waters and plants, strength and gracious speech—may they follow in consecration after you as you are being consecrated."
And the adhvaryu makes him recite the Saṃbhāra-yajus formulas.
With "Svāhā to the sacrifice through mind," two [fingers].
With "Svāhā from the broad atmosphere!" [he makes] two [oblations].

sanskrit_iast: svāhā yajñaṃ vātādārabha iti muṣṭīkaroti vācaṃ ca yacchati
meaning: स्वाहा यज्ञं वातादारभ इति मुष्टीकरोति वाचं च यच्छति
text_mt: With "Svāhā! I seize the sacrifice from the wind!" he clenches his fists and restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: athainaṃ trirupāṃśvāvedayati triruccairadīkṣiṣṭāyaṃ brāhmaṇo 'sāvamuṣya putro 'muṣya pautro 'muṣya naptāmuṣyāḥ putro 'muṣyāḥ pautro 'muṣyā napteti
meaning: अथैनं त्रिरुपांश्वावेदयति त्रिरुच्चैरदीक्षिष्टायं ब्राह्मणो ऽसावमुष्य पुत्रो ऽमुष्य पौत्रो ऽमुष्य नप्तामुष्याः पुत्रो ऽमुष्याः पौत्रो ऽमुष्या नप्तेति
text_mt: Then [the adhvaryu] announces him three times silently and three times aloud: "This brahmin has undergone consecration: so-and-so, son of so-and-so, grandson of so-and-so, great-grandson of so-and-so; son of such-and-such a woman, grandson of such-and-such a woman, great-grandson of such-and-such a woman!"

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇo vā eṣa jāyate yo dīkṣate /
meaning: ब्रह्मणो वा एष जायते यो दीक्षते /
text_mt: He who undergoes consecration is indeed born from the brahman.
Therefore, even in the case of a rājanya or a vaiśya, he announces him merely as: "A brahmin!"

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta tapasvī syād iti taṃ pūrvāhṇe
meaning: यं कामयेत तपस्वी स्याद् इति तं पूर्वाह्णे
text_mt: One whom he desires to become ascetic, him [he should consecrate] in the forenoon.
Restraining his speech and practicing ascetic fervor, he sits until the stars rise.

sanskrit_iast: vatsasyaikaṃ stanamavaśiṣyetarānvrataṃ dohayitvā yāḥ paśūnāmṛṣabhe vācastāḥ sūryo agre śukro agre tāḥ prahiṇvo yathābhagaṃ vo atra śivā nastāḥ punarāyantu vāca iti japitvā vrataṃ kṛṇuteti vācaṃ visṛjate
meaning: वत्सस्यैकं स्तनमवशिष्येतरान्व्रतं दोहयित्वा याः पशूनामृषभे वाचस्ताः सूर्यो अग्रे शुक्रो अग्रे ताः प्रहिण्वो यथाभगं वो अत्र शिवा नस्ताः पुनरायन्तु वाच इति जपित्वा व्रतं कृणुतेति वाचं विसृजते
text_mt: Having left one teat for the calf and milked the other [teats] for the fast-milk, he recites softly: "The voices of the animals in the bull, which were at the forefront of the sun, at the forefront of the bright [soma], I send them forth according to your share here; may those auspicious voices return to us!" and releases his speech with: "Prepare the fast-food!"
With "You are seekers," he releases four fingers:
two on one [hand], two on the other.
He adds "Canasita" or "Vicakṣaṇa" at the end of the names.
"Vicakṣaṇa" for a rājanya and a vaiśya.
He speaks human speech indirectly.
He should not converse with a woman, nor with a śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: yadyenaṃ śūdreṇa saṃvāda upapadyeta brāhmaṇarājanyavaiśyānāmekaṃ brūyādimamitthaṃ brūhīti vājasaneyakam
meaning: यद्येनं शूद्रेण संवाद उपपद्येत ब्राह्मणराजन्यवैश्यानामेकं ब्रूयादिममित्थं ब्रूहीति वाजसनेयकम्
text_mt: If a conversation with a śūdra occurs, he should tell one among the brahmins, rājanyas, or vaiśyas: "Tell this man in this manner"—this is the Vājasaneyaka view.

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ śūdreṇa saṃbhāṣeta yaḥ pāpena karmaṇānabhilakṣitaḥ syāditi śaṭyāyanakam
meaning: कामं शूद्रेण संभाषेत यः पापेन कर्मणानभिलक्षितः स्यादिति शट्यायनकम्
text_mt: At will, he may converse with a śūdra who is not marked by an evil deed—this is the Śāṭyāyanaka view.

sanskrit_iast: abhivadati nābhivādayate 'pyācāryaṃ śvaśuraṃ rājānam iti śāṭyāyanakam
meaning: अभिवदति नाभिवादयते ऽप्याचार्यं श्वशुरं राजानम् इति शाट्यायनकम्
text_mt: He salutes, but does not allow himself to be saluted, even by a teacher, a father-in-law, or a king—this is the Śāṭyāyanaka view.

sanskrit_iast: agnir vai dīkṣitas tasmād enaṃ nopaspṛśet
meaning: अग्निर् वै दीक्षितस् तस्माद् एनं नोपस्पृशेत्
text_mt: The consecrated one is indeed Agni; therefore one should not touch him.
He should not untie the black-antelope horn before the sacrificial gifts are led away.
Covering [his mouth] with his hand, he smiles.

sanskrit_iast: madhu māṃsaṃ striyamanṛtamupariśayyāṃ ṣṭhīvanaṃ vikāle niṣkramaṇaṃ dīkṣitavimitātpravāsamiti varjayet
meaning: मधु मांसं स्त्रियमनृतमुपरिशय्यां ष्ठीवनं विकाले निष्क्रमणं दीक्षितविमितात्प्रवासमिति वर्जयेत्
text_mt: He should avoid honey, meat, women, falsehood, sleeping on an elevated bed, spitting, going outside at an improper time, and being absent from the enclosure of the consecrated.
He should not pass urine or feces by day.

sanskrit_iast: mūtraṃ cikīrṣanniyaṃ te yajñiyā tanūriti tṛṇaṃ loṣṭaṃ vāpādāyāpo muñcāmi na prajāmaṃhomucaḥ svāhākṛtāḥ pṛthivīmāviśateti mūtraṃ visṛjyācamya pṛthivyā saṃbhavetyapāttaṃ pratinidadhāti
meaning: मूत्रं चिकीर्षन्नियं ते यज्ञिया तनूरिति तृणं लोष्टं वापादायापो मुञ्चामि न प्रजामंहोमुचः स्वाहाकृताः पृथिवीमाविशतेति मूत्रं विसृज्याचम्य पृथिव्या संभवेत्यपात्तं प्रतिनिदधाति
text_mt: Intending to urinate, having taken up a blade of grass or a clod of earth with "This is your sacrificial body," having discharged urine with "I release the waters, not offspring; releasers from distress, consecrated by svāhā, enter the earth!" and having sipped water, he replaces the taken [grass or clod] with "Be united with the earth!"
"Whatever of my milk went from the fullness there, that you have caused to settle;

sanskrit_iast: agnihotramiva somena tadahaṃ punarādada iti retaḥ saknnamanumantrayate
meaning: अग्निहोत्रमिव सोमेन तदहं पुनरादद इति रेतः सक्न्नमनुमन्त्रयते
text_mt: like the agnihotra with soma, that I take back to myself"—with this he recites over semen that has been discharged.
"Whatever sap of mine has been spat out here unremembered,

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭatsomahā pṛthivī punarātmandadhātu ma iti charditvā ṣṭhutvā vā //
meaning: अग्निष्टत्सोमहा पृथिवी पुनरात्मन्दधातु म इति छर्दित्वा ष्ठुत्वा वा //
text_mt: may Agni, the slayer of Soma, may the earth place that back into myself"—[he recites this] having vomited or spat.

sanskrit_iast: yadannamadya te naktaṃ na tatprātaḥ kṣudho 'vati /
meaning: यदन्नमद्य ते नक्तं न तत्प्रातः क्षुधो ऽवति /
text_mt: "Whatever food is eaten by you tonight, that does not ward off hunger in the morning;

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ tadasmānmā hiṃsīrnahi taddadṛśe diveti svapne 'nnaṃ bhuktvā //
meaning: सर्वं तदस्मान्मा हिंसीर्नहि तद्ददृशे दिवेति स्वप्ने ऽन्नं भुक्त्वा //
text_mt: do not injure us from all that, for that was not seen by day"—[he recites this] having eaten food in a dream.
With "Svāhā to the Rudrian waters!" [he recites] having seen blood gushing out.

sanskrit_iast: bībhatsā nāma sthāpaḥ svāhākṛtāḥ pṛthivīmāviśateti snūhānam /
meaning: बीभत्सा नाम स्थापः स्वाहाकृताः पृथिवीमाविशतेति स्नूहानम् /
text_mt: With "You are waters named Disgusting; consecrated by svāhā, enter the earth!" [he addresses] nasal mucus.
With "You are waters named Compassion; consecrated by svāhā, enter the earth!" [he addresses] a tear.

sanskrit_iast: tapasyā nāma sthāpaḥ svāhākṛtāḥ pṛthivīmāviśateti svedam
meaning: तपस्या नाम स्थापः स्वाहाकृताः पृथिवीमाविशतेति स्वेदम्
text_mt: With "You are waters named Austere; consecrated by svāhā, enter the earth!" [he addresses] sweat.
He does not go out by the western door.
He does not make an oblation that is unconnected with the sacrificial rite.
He does not sacrifice with the New and Full Moon sacrifices.
He remains consecrated for twelve days at least.

sanskrit_iast: māsaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yadā vā kṛśaḥ syād ity aparam
meaning: मासं संवत्सरं यदा वा कृशः स्याद् इत्य् अपरम्
text_mt: For a month, for a year, or "whenever he becomes lean"—this is another [view].

sanskrit_iast: yadā vai dīkṣitaḥ kṛśo bhavatyatha medhyo bhavati /
meaning: यदा वै दीक्षितः कृशो भवत्यथ मेध्यो भवति /
text_mt: "Indeed, when the consecrated one becomes lean, then he becomes fit for sacrifice.
When there is nothing inside him, then he becomes fit for sacrifice.

meaning: यदास्य त्वचास्थि संधीयते ऽथ मेध्यो भवति /
text_mt: When his skin and bones are joined together, then he becomes fit for sacrifice.
When the black of his eyes disappears, then he becomes fit for sacrifice.
Whatever of his limbs diminishes, he just offers that as oblation"—so it is known [from scripture].

sanskrit_iast: ekā dīkṣā tisra upasadaḥ pañcamīṃ prasutaḥ /
meaning: एका दीक्षा तिस्र उपसदः पञ्चमीं प्रसुतः /
text_mt: One consecration [day], three upasad [days], pressed on the fifth [day].

sanskrit_iast: tisro vā dīkṣāstisra upasadaḥ saptamīṃ prasutaḥ /
meaning: तिस्रो वा दीक्षास्तिस्र उपसदः सप्तमीं प्रसुतः /
text_mt: Or three consecration [days], three upasad [days], pressed on the seventh [day].

meaning: चतस्रो वा दीक्षास्तिस्र उपसदो ऽष्टमीं प्रसुतः
text_mt: Or there are four consecration days and three Upasads; on the eighth day the pressing takes place.
The consecration takes place on the new moon day or on the day of sacrifice.
The pressing day falls on the full moon day or on the day of sacrifice.
The consecration takes place on the new moon day or on the day of sacrifice;
the pressing day falls on the new moon day or on the day of sacrifice.
The consecration takes place on the full moon day or on the day of sacrifice;
the pressing day falls on the full moon day or on the day of sacrifice.
The sun should not set or rise upon him anywhere else than inside the consecrated person's hut.
If set upon by the sun, he should whisper verses addressed to Varuṇa;
Having seen something impure, he whispers: 'My mind is unfettered...'
Rained upon, he whispers: 'O wetting waters, bestow strength...'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇenāhavanīyaṃ prāṅ śete na nyaṅnottāno nāgnerapaparyāvarteta
meaning: दक्षिणेनाहवनीयं प्राङ् शेते न न्यङ्नोत्तानो नाग्नेरपपर्यावर्तेत
text_mt: To the south of the āhavanīya fire, he lies facing east, neither face down nor on his back, and he must not turn away from the fire.

sanskrit_iast: yadyapaparyāvarteta viśve devā abhi māmāvavṛtrānniti japet
meaning: यद्यपपर्यावर्तेत विश्वे देवा अभि मामाववृत्रान्निति जपेत्
text_mt: If he should turn away, he should whisper: 'May all the gods turn toward me...'
He should not sit anywhere other than on the black antelope skin.
If he should sit elsewhere, he should whisper: 'The sacrifice has gone to the divine folk...'
He must not become separated from the staff or from the black antelope skin.
Having put down both, he may pass urine and feces.
The insignia of the consecrated person belong to the wife only to the extent stated.
[Another] should not put on the garment of the consecrated person.
Or, once the portion for the sacrifice has been set aside, they may eat from the remainder;
or when the animal sacrifice to Agni-Soma has been completed;
He should not release his speech before the stars [appear].

sanskrit_iast: yadi visṛjedidaṃ viṣṇustvamagne vratapā asīti japitvā vācaṃ yacchet
meaning: यदि विसृजेदिदं विष्णुस्त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असीति जपित्वा वाचं यच्छेत्
text_mt: If he should release it, he should restrain his speech after having whispered: 'Through this, Viṣṇu...' [and] 'You, O Agni, are the guardian of vows...'
speech is to be restrained after reciting a verse to Viṣṇu, one to Agni-Viṣṇu, one to Sarasvatī, and lastly one to Bṛhaspati.
Ālekhana says: He should release speech only over the milked [vow-drink].
It has been stated: 'Barley gruel is for a rājanya.'
Some teach without reference to caste that one should take as vow-drink either barley gruel or pure milk.
Some indeed take milk as that vow-drink.
Having cooked barley gruel in the milk itself, he should consume it as the vow-drink.
If the cow that yields the vow-drink yields little, one should milk another.
If there is no other, he should cook it mixed with water.

sanskrit_iast: yadi payo na syādapsveva yavāgūṃ śrapayitvā vratayet
meaning: यदि पयो न स्यादप्स्वेव यवागूं श्रपयित्वा व्रतयेत्
text_mt: If there is no milk, having cooked barley gruel in water alone, he should consume it as the vow-drink.
He should certainly not abstain from consuming the vow-drink, so that the agnihotra is not interrupted.
If he desires curds, they should prepare just curds for him.

sanskrit_iast: yadyannīyāddhānā asmā anvāvapeyuḥ saktūnasmā anvāvapeyurghṛtamasmā anvānayeyuḥ
meaning: यद्यन्नीयाद्धाना अस्मा अन्वावपेयुः सक्तूनस्मा अन्वावपेयुर्घृतमस्मा अन्वानयेयुः
text_mt: If he desires food, they should throw parched grains into it for him, throw groats into it for him, or pour clarified butter into it for him.
He may even consume as the vow-drink any one among the agnihotra oblations, with the exception of meat.

meaning: सो ऽयं दैक्षो वादो भवतीति खल्वाहुः /
text_mt: Indeed they say: 'This is the rule regarding the consecration.'
In the case of all [sacrifices], the procedure for taking the vow-drink during the Upasads has been handed down without specific initiation.

meaning: अपराह्णे ऽधिवृक्षसूर्ये वा व्रतप्रदो वाचं यमयति /
text_mt: In the afternoon, or when the sun is at the level of the tree tops, the one who brings the vow-drink causes [the sacrificer] to restrain his speech.

sanskrit_iast: agnīñjyotiṣmataḥ kuruta dīkṣita vācaṃ yaccha patni vācaṃ yaccheti saṃpreṣyati
meaning: अग्नीञ्ज्योतिष्मतः कुरुत दीक्षित वाचं यच्छ पत्नि वाचं यच्छेति संप्रेष्यति
text_mt: He gives the ritual call: 'Make the fires luminous! Consecrated one, restrain your speech! Wife, restrain your speech!'
When the stars have risen, speech is released as before.
In this manner he restrains [speech] towards sunrise;
He consumes the vow-drink at midday and at midnight;
or after having passed the human mealtime.
Some say: [he consumes] the evening milk in the latter part of the night, and the morning milk in the afternoon.
He boils the vrata [milk] of the consecrated [sacrificer] on the gārhapatya;
Whatever is the expiation for spilled agnihotra, that is [the expiation] for the vrata.

sanskrit_iast: agnihotravattūṣṇīmunnīyāpareṇāhavanīyaṃ vratamatyāhṛtya prayacchannāha vratya vrataya vratamupehīti
meaning: अग्निहोत्रवत्तूष्णीमुन्नीयापरेणाहवनीयं व्रतमत्याहृत्य प्रयच्छन्नाह व्रत्य व्रतय व्रतमुपेहीति
text_mt: Having scooped it out silently, just as [for] the agnihotra, and having brought the vrata around to the west of the āhavanġya, handing it over, he says: 'O consecrated one, partake of the vrata; approach the vrata.'

sanskrit_iast: daivīṃ dhiyaṃ manāmaha iti hastāvavanijya ye devā manojātā manoyuja iti dakṣiṇenāhavanīyaṃ pariśrite vratayati
meaning: दैवीं धियं मनामह इति हस्ताववनिज्य ये देवा मनोजाता मनोयुज इति दक्षिणेनाहवनीयं परिश्रिते व्रतयति
text_mt: Having washed his hands with: 'We contemplate divine thought...', he partakes of the vrata south of the āhavanġya, in an enclosed space, with: 'Which gods are mind-born, mind-yoked...'
Unconsecrated persons do not see him partaking of the vrata.

sanskrit_iast: śivāḥ pītā bhavatha yūyamāpo 'smākaṃ yonāvudare suśevāḥ /
meaning: शिवाः पीता भवथ यूयमापो ऽस्माकं योनावुदरे सुशेवाः /
text_mt: 'Favorable when drunk may you waters become, very kindly in our womb, the belly;

sanskrit_iast: irāvatīranamīvā anāgasaḥ śivā no bhavatha jīvasa iti vratayitvā nābhideśamabhimṛśate
meaning: इरावतीरनमीवा अनागसः शिवा नो भवथ जीवस इति व्रतयित्वा नाभिदेशमभिमृशते
text_mt: rich in nourishment, free from disease, sinless, favorable may you become to us for living' — having partaken of the vrata with this [mantra], he touches the region of his navel,
The wife partakes of the vrata silently in her own place.
When about to sleep, he addresses the āhavanġya with: 'O Agni, watch well!'

sanskrit_iast: tvamagne vratapā asīti prabudhya muṣṭī vācaṃ vā visṛjyādīkṣitavādaṃ voditvā
meaning: त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असीति प्रबुध्य मुष्टी वाचं वा विसृज्यादीक्षितवादं वोदित्वा
text_mt: Having awakened, if he has opened his fists or speech, or has spoken words improper for the consecrated, [he addresses it] with: 'O Agni, you are the guardian of vows.'

sanskrit_iast: viśve devā abhi māmāvavṛtranniti prabudhya japati /
meaning: विश्वे देवा अभि मामाववृत्रन्निति प्रबुध्य जपति /
text_mt: Having awakened, he murmurs: 'May all the gods turn toward me;
Mind has come again, life-span has come again, breath has come again, purpose has come again;

meaning: वैश्वानरो ऽदब्धस्तनूपा अवबाधतां दुरितानि विश्वेति च
text_mt: and may unbeguiled Vaiśvānara, protector of the body, ward off all distress.'
Therefore, the consecrated [sacrificer] should beg for maintenance for twelve days.
'He thereby indeed gathers the sacrifice together,' so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].
He instructs the bringers of gifts with: 'Pūṣan is with the gift...'
He receives [them] according to their characteristics with: 'You are Candramas...'
[He receives] others with: 'The divine Savitṛ, giver of wealth from wealth...'
Among them, he assigns one that is lost with: 'To Vāyu thee!'
one that has died in the waters with: 'To Varuṇa thee!'
one that has collapsed or is shattered with: 'To Nirṛti thee!'
one struck by lightning, struck by a sheep-slayer, or drowned in water with: 'To the Maruts thee!'
one killed by Mahādeva with: 'To Rudra thee!'

sanskrit_iast: indrāya tvā prashvana iti yāṃ senābhītvarī vindeta
meaning: इन्द्राय त्वा प्रस्ह्वन इति यां सेनाभीत्वरी विन्देत
text_mt: one which an attacking army has seized with: 'To Indra the conqueror thee!'
one that died of an unknown illness with: 'To Yama thee!'
He should not pasture among cattle [any animal] obtained from those assigned away.
Having mounted the fires into separate churning sticks, he sets forth in a chariot.
In its absence, taking a chariot-part.
The departure is made with: 'From the auspicious unto the better...'
He wades across water with: 'O divine waters...'

sanskrit_iast: acchinnaṃ tantuṃ pṛthivyā anugeṣamiti hastena loṣṭaṃ vimṛdnātyā pārāt
meaning: अच्छिन्नं तन्तुं पृथिव्या अनुगेषमिति हस्तेन लोष्टं विमृद्नात्या पारात्
text_mt: He crushes a clod of earth with his hand until the other shore, with: 'May I follow the unbroken thread of the earth.'

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyā saṃbhaveti sikatā loṣṭaṃ vā madhye pāre ca nyasyati
meaning: पृथिव्या संभवेति सिकता लोष्टं वा मध्ये पारे च न्यस्यति
text_mt: With: 'Be united with the earth,' he throws sand or a clod of earth into the middle and on the farther shore.
With two churning sticks [or] with churning sticks, according to some.
He should not be separated from the chariot or from the chariot-part.
Here, some prescribe settling upon the sacrificial ground.
Whoever would settle here should set out;
Elevated to the south, sloped down to the north, sloping toward the east, or sloping toward the northeast is the sacrificial ground.
Or where many brāhmaṇas would agree.
'The fires indeed are the sacrificial ground;

sanskrit_iast: yatra kvacāgnīnādhāya yajate devayajana eva yajata iti vijñāyate
meaning: यत्र क्वचाग्नीनाधाय यजते देवयजन एव यजत इति विज्ञायते
text_mt: wherever having established the fires he sacrifices, he sacrifices on the sacrificial ground indeed,' so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].
'The sacrificial gifts indeed are the sacrificial ground;

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāścetkalyāṇīrdadāti devayajana eva yajata ity eke
meaning: दक्षिणाश्चेत्कल्याणीर्ददाति देवयजन एव यजत इत्य् एके
text_mt: if he gives fine sacrificial gifts, he sacrifices on the sacrificial ground indeed,' so say some.
Practicing sorcery, he should sacrifice on a clearing [in the forest].
From which tree [or] ant-hills they would remove [material], and also dig up [earth].
He should cause one who is accused of sin to sacrifice secretly, in a hiding-place, in a forest.
They should undertake the pṛṣṭha chants out of sight;

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayetobhayeṣāṃ devamanuṣyāṇāṃ prakāśaṃ gaccheyamiti na prācīnaṃ devayajanāddevayajanamātramucchiṃṣet
meaning: यः कामयेतोभयेषां देवमनुष्याणां प्रकाशं गच्छेयमिति न प्राचीनं देवयजनाद्देवयजनमात्रमुच्छिंषेत्
text_mt: One who desires: 'May I become manifest to both gods and men,' should not leave behind [ground] the size of a sacrificial ground to the east of the sacrificial ground.

sanskrit_iast: yatrāpo devayajanaṃ cāntareṇa panthā abhividhāvettasminyājayedyaṃ kāmayeta nainamuttaro yajña upanamediti
meaning: यत्रापो देवयजनं चान्तरेण पन्था अभिविधावेत्तस्मिन्याजयेद्यं कामयेत नैनमुत्तरो यज्ञ उपनमेदिति
text_mt: Where a path runs across between the water and the sacrificial ground, upon that he should cause him to sacrifice whom he would wish: 'May a further sacrifice not fall to his lot.'
Having said: 'He should purchase the king [Soma] from a descendant of Kutsa or from another brāhmaṇa,' he says: 'even from a non-brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: uttaravedideśa uparavadeśe vā lohitaṃ carmānaḍuhaṃ prācīnagrīvamuttaralomāstīrya dkṣiṇe carmapakṣe rājānaṃ nivapati /
meaning: उत्तरवेदिदेश उपरवदेशे वा लोहितं चर्मानडुहं प्राचीनग्रीवमुत्तरलोमास्तीर्य द्क्षिणे चर्मपक्षे राजानं निवपति /
text_mt: Having spread a red ox-hide, with its neck pointing east and the hair upward, in the place of the uttaravedi or in the place of the uparavas, he pours out the king [Soma] upon the southern half of the hide;
the soma-seller sits down on the northern [half].

sanskrit_iast: udakumbhaṃ rājānaṃ somavikrayiṇamiti sarvataḥ pariśrityottareṇa dvāraṃ kṛtvā vicityaḥ somā3 ityuktam
meaning: उदकुम्भं राजानं सोमविक्रयिणमिति सर्वतः परिश्रित्योत्तरेण द्वारं कृत्वा विचित्यः सोमा3 इत्युक्तम्
text_mt: Having enclosed all around the water-jar, the king [Soma], and the soma-seller, and having made an entrance to the north, it is said: 'Is the Soma to be inspected?'
Having said: 'O soma seller, cleanse the soma,' he turns away.
The sacrificer should not sort out the soma.
Neither his man, nor the adhvaryu, nor the adhvaryu's man.
They should be onlookers while the King [Soma] is being picked out.
With the two [verses], "I am from you...", "Being summoned...", the sacrificer attends upon the āhavanīya.
He sets in motion the procedure of the introductory offering (prāyaṇīyā).
Having made the broom and strewn [grass] around the fires, he proceeds to the rites beginning with the washing of hands.
He arranges the vessels according to need,
a pot in place of the potsherds.
At the time of pouring out [the oblation-materials], the introductory offering is a boiled rice oblation for Aditi in milk.
Having performed [the rites] up to the ritual call, he issues the ritual call omitting the [sacrificer's] wife.

sanskrit_iast: yāḥ kṛtāyāṃ vedyāṃ codyante saiva tāsāṃ vediḥ /
meaning: याः कृतायां वेद्यां चोद्यन्ते सैव तासां वेदिः /
text_mt: For those [rites] that are prescribed [to be performed] on a prepared altar ground, that very altar ground serves for them;

sanskrit_iast: yāḥ stīrṇe barhiṣi tadeva tāsāṃ barhiḥ
meaning: याः स्तीर्णे बर्हिषि तदेव तासां बर्हिः
text_mt: for those [prescribed to be performed] on strewn sacrificial grass, that very sacrificial grass serves for them.
At the time of taking the clarified butter, in the introductory offering, which has no after-offerings, he takes four [ladlefuls] in the juhū
and four in the upabhṛt, for the sake of combining them.
In the concluding offering (udayanīyā), which has no fore-offerings, he does not take [any] in the juhū,
[but takes] four in the upabhṛt for the sake of the after-offerings.
With the six-hotṛ formula, he sets down the introductory offering.
It has already been stated: "having fore-offerings, [but] without after-offerings".
He offers four butter portions facing each direction:

sanskrit_iast: pathyāṃ svastiṃ purastādagniṃ dakṣiṇataḥ somaṃ paścātsavitāramuttarataḥ /
meaning: पथ्यां स्वस्तिं पुरस्तादग्निं दक्षिणतः सोमं पश्चात्सवितारमुत्तरतः /
text_mt: to Pathyā Svasti in the east, to Agni in the south, to Soma in the west, to Savitṛ in the north,
Having offered to Aditi and recited the verse addressed to the Maruts, he fills the pot with clarified butter and offers to these deities,
Or [the rite] may be concluded ending with the śaṃyu [formula].
However, he should not perform the offerings to the wives of the gods.
He should perform them at the concluding offering.
He preserves the clarified butter of the dhruvā ladle.
In the hall with eastward-pointing rafters, he puts down the sacrificial grass, the unscraped cooking pot, and the stirring stick for the sake of the concluding offering.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyāyā dhrauvādaṣṭau juhvāṃ caturo vā gṛhītvā tasmindarbheṇa hiraṇyaṃ niṣṭarkyaṃ baddhvāvadadhātīyaṃ te śukra tanūriti
meaning: प्रायणीयाया ध्रौवादष्टौ जुह्वां चतुरो वा गृहीत्वा तस्मिन्दर्भेण हिरण्यं निष्टर्क्यं बद्ध्वावदधातीयं ते शुक्र तनूरिति
text_mt: Having taken eight or four [ladlefuls] into the juhū from the dhruvā of the introductory offering, having tied a piece of gold in a knot that can be loosened with darbha grass, he puts it in [the juhū with the formula]: "This is your bright body..."

sanskrit_iast: purastāt pratīcī somakrayaṇyavasthitā bhavatyekahāyanī dvihāyanī varṣīyasī vā
meaning: पुरस्तात् प्रतीची सोमक्रयण्यवस्थिता भवत्येकहायनी द्विहायनी वर्षीयसी वा
text_mt: The Soma-purchasing cow stands in the east facing west, either one year old, two years old, or older.
Its marks are: [it is described] with "not hornless, not cropped-eared..."

sanskrit_iast: yā rohiṇī babhrulomnī pṛśnavālā pṛśniśaphā śucyakṣī śvitropakāśā tayā krīṇīyād ity eke
meaning: या रोहिणी बभ्रुलोम्नी पृश्नवाला पृश्निशफा शुच्यक्षी श्वित्रोपकाशा तया क्रीणीयाद् इत्य् एके
text_mt: Some say: "One should buy with one that is reddish, brown-haired, with a speckled tail, speckled hooves, clear eyes, and white-spotted."
for the Ṣoḍaśin, with a tailless one whose ears are pierced.
Looking at the Soma-purchasing cow, he offers that clarified butter with the formula: "You are swift..."

sanskrit_iast: aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā śukramasīti hiraṇyaṃ paścāduddhṛtya vaiśvadevaṃ havirityājyamavekṣya sūryasya cakṣurāruhamityādityamupasthāya cidasi manāsīti somakrayaṇīmabhimantrayate
meaning: अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा शुक्रमसीति हिरण्यं पश्चादुद्धृत्य वैश्वदेवं हविरित्याज्यमवेक्ष्य सूर्यस्य चक्षुरारुहमित्यादित्यमुपस्थाय चिदसि मनासीति सोमक्रयणीमभिमन्त्रयते
text_mt: Having taken another four ladlefuls, having lifted out the gold behind [the fire] with the formula "You are bright...", having looked at the clarified butter with the formula "The oblation belonging to All-gods...", having attended upon the sun with the formula "I have mounted the eye of the sun...", he addresses the Soma-purchasing cow with the formula: "You are thought, you are mind..."
She is not seized by the ear and her foot is not bound.

sanskrit_iast: mitrastvā padi badhnātviti dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvapādaṃ prekṣate /
meaning: मित्रस्त्वा पदि बध्नात्विति दक्षिणं पूर्वपादं प्रेक्षते /
text_mt: With the formula "May Mitra bind you by the foot", he looks at her right forefoot;
with the formula "May Pūṣan protect the paths", he recites after her as she walks eastward.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṭ padānyanunikrāmati dakṣiṇena padā dakṣiṇāni vasvyasi rudrāsītyetaiḥ pratimantram
meaning: षट् पदान्यनुनिक्रामति दक्षिणेन पदा दक्षिणानि वस्व्यसि रुद्रासीत्येतैः प्रतिमन्त्रम्
text_mt: He steps along six footprints with his right foot along the right [footprints], each with its formula: "You are Vasvī", "You are Rudrā"...

sanskrit_iast: ekamiṣe viṣṇustvānvetu dve ūrje viṣṇustvānvetu trīṇi vratāya viṣṇustvānvetu catvāri mayobhavāya viṣṇustvānvetu pañca paśubhyo viṣṇustvānvetu ṣaḍrāyaspoṣāya viṣṇustvānvetu sapta saptabhyo hotrābhyo viṣṇustvānvetv iti nikramyamāṇeṣu yajamāno 'nuvartayitvā
meaning: एकमिषे विष्णुस्त्वान्वेतु द्वे ऊर्जे विष्णुस्त्वान्वेतु त्रीणि व्रताय विष्णुस्त्वान्वेतु चत्वारि मयोभवाय विष्णुस्त्वान्वेतु पञ्च पशुभ्यो विष्णुस्त्वान्वेतु षड्रायस्पोषाय विष्णुस्त्वान्वेतु सप्त सप्तभ्यो होत्राभ्यो विष्णुस्त्वान्वेत्व् इति निक्रम्यमाणेषु यजमानो ऽनुवर्तयित्वा
text_mt: While they are being stepped along with the formulas, "One for sap, may Viṣṇu follow you; two for strength, may Viṣṇu follow you; three for the vow, may Viṣṇu follow you; four for happiness, may Viṣṇu follow you; five for cattle, may Viṣṇu follow you; six for increase of wealth, may Viṣṇu follow you; seven for the seven hotrās, may Viṣṇu follow you", the sacrificer, having followed after,

sanskrit_iast: sakhāya saptapadā abhūma sakhyaṃ te gameyaṃ sakhyātte mā yoṣaṃ sakhyān me mā yoṣṭhā iti saptame pade japati
meaning: सखाय सप्तपदा अभूम सख्यं ते गमेयं सख्यात्ते मा योषं सख्यान् मे मा योष्ठा इति सप्तमे पदे जपति
text_mt: mutters at the seventh footprint: "Friends having walked seven steps have we become; may I attain your friendship; may I not fall away from your friendship; may you not fall away from my friendship."

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatistvā sumne raṇvatviti sapatamaṃ padamadhvaryurañjalinābhigṛhya pade hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya pṛthivyāstvā mūrdhannājigharmīti hiraṇye hutvāpādāya hiraṇyaṃ devasya tvā savituḥ prasava iti sphyamādāya parilikhitaṃ rakṣaḥ parilikhitā arātaya iti triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ padaṃ parilikhati yāvadghṛtamanuvisṛtaṃ bhavati
meaning: बृहस्पतिस्त्वा सुम्ने रण्वत्विति सपतमं पदमध्वर्युरञ्जलिनाभिगृह्य पदे हिरण्यं निधाय पृथिव्यास्त्वा मूर्धन्नाजिघर्मीति हिरण्ये हुत्वापादाय हिरण्यं देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इति स्फ्यमादाय परिलिखितं रक्षः परिलिखिता अरातय इति त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं पदं परिलिखति यावद्घृतमनुविसृतं भवति
text_mt: The adhvaryu, having grasped around the seventh footprint with folded hands with the formula "May Bṛhaspati delight you in comfort", having placed the piece of gold in the footprint, having offered on the piece of gold with the formula "I sprinkle you on the head of the earth", having picked up the piece of gold, having taken the wooden sword with the formula "At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ...", traces around the footprint three times from left to right as far as the clarified butter has spread, with the formula: "Traced around is the demon; traced around are the enemies."

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇaviṣāṇyā cānuparilikhyāsme rāya iti sthālyāṃ yāvattmūtaṃ samopya tve rāya iti yajamānāya prayacchati
meaning: कृष्णविषाण्या चानुपरिलिख्यास्मे राय इति स्थाल्यां यावत्त्मूतं समोप्य त्वे राय इति यजमानाय प्रयच्छति
text_mt: And having traced around it with the black antelope horn, having gathered as much [dust] as fits into a bowl with the formula "In us is wealth", he gives it to the sacrificer with the formula: "In you is wealth."

sanskrit_iast: māhaṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa viyoṣamiti patnī padaṃ pradīyamānamanumantrayate
meaning: माहं रायस्पोषेण वियोषमिति पत्नी पदं प्रदीयमानमनुमन्त्रयते
text_mt: The wife recites after [the dust of] the footprint being handed over: "May I not be separated from the increase of wealth."

sanskrit_iast: saṃ devi devyorvaśyā paśyasveti somakrayaṇyā patnīṃ saṃkhyāpayati
meaning: सं देवि देव्योर्वश्या पश्यस्वेति सोमक्रयण्या पत्नीं संख्यापयति
text_mt: He causes the wife to look at the Soma-purchasing cow with the formula: "Look together, O goddess, with the divine Urvaśī."

sanskrit_iast: tvaṣṭīmatī te sapeyeti patnī somakrayaṇīm abhimantrayate
meaning: त्वष्टीमती ते सपेयेति पत्नी सोमक्रयणीम् अभिमन्त्रयते
text_mt: The wife addresses the Soma-purchasing cow with the formula: "Accompanied by Tvaṣṭṛ, may I serve you."
The sacrificer [addresses it] with: "Accompanied by Tvaṣṭṛ, may we serve you."

sanskrit_iast: yataḥ padamapāttaṃ tasminsahiraṇyau pāṇī prakṣālyonnambhaya pṛthivīmaityadbhirupaninīya padaṃ traidhaṃ vibhajya tṛtīyamuttarto gārhapatyasya śīte bhasmanyupavapati /
meaning: यतः पदमपात्तं तस्मिन्सहिरण्यौ पाणी प्रक्षाल्योन्नम्भय पृथिवीमैत्यद्भिरुपनिनीय पदं त्रैधं विभज्य तृतीयमुत्तर्तो गार्हपत्यस्य शीते भस्मन्युपवपति /
text_mt: At the place from where the [dust of the] footprint was taken, having washed his hands together with the gold, having poured water on it with the formula "Moisten the earth...", having divided the [dust of the] footprint into three parts, he scatters a third in the cool ashes north of the gārhapatya,
and hands a third to the wife.
She deposits it in the house.
Here, some prescribe the attendance on the sun and the rites of pouring out and so on of the King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: api panthāmagasmahītyuddhṛtapūrvaphalakenānasā pariśritena chadiṣmatā prāñcaḥ somamaccha yānti
meaning: अपि पन्थामगस्महीत्युद्धृतपूर्वफलकेनानसा परिश्रितेन छदिष्मता प्राञ्चः सोममच्छ यान्ति
text_mt: With the formula "We have reached the path...", they go facing east toward the Soma, with a cart that has its front plank removed, is enclosed on all sides, and is roofed.
They carry on the head what was purchased on the mountain.

sanskrit_iast: apareṇottareṇa vā rājānaṃ prāgīṣamudagīsaṃ vā naddhayugaṃ śakaṭaṃ cubukapratiṣṭhitam
meaning: अपरेणोत्तरेण वा राजानं प्रागीषमुदगीसं वा नद्धयुगं शकटं चुबुकप्रतिष्ठितम्
text_mt: Behind or to the north of the King [Soma], the cart has its yoke tied, its pole pointing eastward or northward, resting upon its support.

sanskrit_iast: aṃśunā te aṃśuḥ pṛcyatāmiti yajamāno rājānamabhimantrayate
meaning: अंशुना ते अंशुः पृच्यतामिति यजमानो राजानमभिमन्त्रयते
text_mt: The sacrificer addresses the King [Soma] with the formula: "May your stalk be united with stalk..."
It has already been stated: "For him whom he might wish, 'May he be without cattle', [he should take] from a withered [plant]..."

sanskrit_iast: kṣaumaṃ vāso dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vā prāgdaśamuttaradaśaṃ carmaṇyāstṛṇāti /
meaning: क्षौमं वासो द्विगुणं त्रिगुणं वा प्राग्दशमुत्तरदशं चर्मण्यास्तृणाति /
text_mt: He spreads a linen cloth, two-layered or three-layered, with its fringes pointing eastward or northward, upon the skin.

sanskrit_iast: tasminharaṇyapāṇiraṅguṣṭhena kaniṣṭhikayā cāṅgulyāṃśūnsaṃgṛhyānyacannabhi tyaṃ devaṃ savitāramityaticchandasarcā mimīte
meaning: तस्मिन्हरण्यपाणिरङ्गुष्ठेन कनिष्ठिकया चाङ्गुल्यांशून्संगृह्यान्यचन्नभि त्यं देवं सवितारमित्यतिच्छन्दसर्चा मिमीते
text_mt: Holding gold in his hand, seizing the soma shoots with the thumb and little finger [while leaving] the other [fingers] bent, he measures [them] out on it with the over-metered verse: 'Towards that divine Savitṛ...'
In this way, [he measures] each [time] releasing [one finger].
He presses the thumb against each of them.

sanskrit_iast: yayā prathamaṃ na tayā pañcamaṃ tayaivottamam
meaning: यया प्रथमं न तया पञ्चमं तयैवोत्तमम्
text_mt: With whichever [finger] he measures first, not with that does he measure the fifth; with that very [finger] he measures the last.
He measures five times with a yajus formula,
Thus [he repeats] twice, thrice, or an unmeasured number of times.

sanskrit_iast: prajābhyastvetyavaśiṣṭānaṃśūnupasamūhya kṣaumeṇa vāsasopasaṃgṛhya prāṇāya tveti dviguṇenoṣṇīṣeṇopanahya vyānāya tveti visrasyāvekṣate prajāstvamanuprāṇihi prajāstvāmanuprāṇantviti
meaning: प्रजाभ्यस्त्वेत्यवशिष्टानंशूनुपसमूह्य क्षौमेण वाससोपसंगृह्य प्राणाय त्वेति द्विगुणेनोष्णीषेणोपनह्य व्यानाय त्वेति विस्रस्यावेक्षते प्रजास्त्वमनुप्राणिहि प्रजास्त्वामनुप्राणन्त्विति
text_mt: Gathering together the remaining shoots with 'For offspring thee,' gathering [them] up with the linen cloth, tying [them] up with 'For out-breathing thee' with a double turban, and loosening [it] with 'For diffusive breathing thee,' he looks [at them] with: 'Breathe along with the offspring; may the offspring breathe along with thee.'

sanskrit_iast: eṣa te gāyatro bhāga ity etair yajamāno rājanamupatiṣṭhate
meaning: एष ते गायत्रो भाग इत्य् एतैर् यजमानो राजनमुपतिष्ठते
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning]: 'This is thy Gāyatra portion...', the sacrificer waits upon the king (Soma).

sanskrit_iast: deva sūrya somaṃ kreṣyāmastaṃ te prabrūmastsaṃ tvaṃ viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ kratūnkalpaya dakṣiṇāḥ kalpaya yathartu yathādevatamityādityam upasthāya somavikrayiṇe rājānaṃ pradāya paṇate
meaning: देव सूर्य सोमं क्रेष्यामस्तं ते प्रब्रूमस्त्सं त्वं विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः क्रतून्कल्पय दक्षिणाः कल्पय यथर्तु यथादेवतमित्यादित्यम् उपस्थाय सोमविक्रयिणे राजानं प्रदाय पणते
text_mt: Having waited upon the sun with: 'O divine Sūrya, we are about to purchase Soma; we announce him to thee; arrange the rites for the All-gods, arrange the sacrificial gifts, according to the season, according to the deity,' [and] having handed the king (Soma) to the soma-seller, he bargains:
'O soma-seller, is thy soma for sale?'
'It is for sale,' the other replies.

sanskrit_iast: somaṃ te krīṇāmyūrjasvantaṃ payasvantamityuktvā kalayā te krīṇānīty enam āha
meaning: सोमं ते क्रीणाम्यूर्जस्वन्तं पयस्वन्तमित्युक्त्वा कलया ते क्रीणानीत्य् एनम् आह
text_mt: Having said: 'I purchase thy soma, rich in food, rich in sap,' he says to him: 'Let me purchase it for a sixteenth part (kalā).'

sanskrit_iast: bhūyo vā ataḥ somo rājārhatīti sarveṣu paṇaneṣu somavikrayī pratyāhā saṃpadaḥ
meaning: भूयो वा अतः सोमो राजार्हतीति सर्वेषु पणनेषु सोमविक्रयी प्रत्याहा संपदः
text_mt: 'King Soma is worth more than that,' the soma-seller replies at every bargaining, up to the completion.
'Let me purchase it for an eighth part (kuṣṭhā),' [he says] a second time.
'Let me purchase it for a quarter (śapha),' [he says] a third time.
'Let me purchase it for a half (pad),' [he says] a fourth time.
'Let me purchase it for a cow,' [he says] finally.

sanskrit_iast: eṣeti nirdiśya japati tasyā ātmā tasyā ātmā tasyā rūpaṃ tasyāḥ prajā tasyāḥ payastasyā bandhuriti
meaning: एषेति निर्दिश्य जपति तस्या आत्मा तस्या आत्मा तस्या रूपं तस्याः प्रजा तस्याः पयस्तस्या बन्धुरिति
text_mt: Pointing to it, he murmurs: 'She is its self, she is its self, she is its form, she is its offspring, she is its milk, she is its kin.'

sanskrit_iast: śukraṃ te śukreṇa krīṇāmīti japitvā hiraṇyena krīṇāti
meaning: शुक्रं ते शुक्रेण क्रीणामीति जपित्वा हिरण्येन क्रीणाति
text_mt: Having murmured: 'Bright with bright I purchase thee,' he purchases with gold.
Having murmured: 'Thou art the body of austerity,' he purchases with a she-goat.
If he should purchase with a bull, he would purchase with Prajāpati.
In its place is an uncastrated young bull.
[With the formula]: 'With a pair,' [it means] a young bull and a heifer.
Having purchased with those two together, he completes [the purchase] finally with a cloth.
[The purchase is made] with ten [articles] for a sacrifice with a sacrificial gift of one hundred and twelve [cows];
or with four: with a cow, with gold, with cloth, [and] with a she-goat, according to some.
With one [article] for [a sacrifice] with a sacrificial gift of twenty-one [cows];
with three for [a sacrifice] with a sacrificial gift of sixty [cows];
with an unmeasured number for [a sacrifice] with an unmeasured sacrificial gift;
with twenty-four for a thousand [cows] or for an all-property sacrifice;
or with thirty for [a sacrifice] with a thousand sacrificial gift:

sanskrit_iast: saptaviṃśatirgā hiraṇyaṃ chāgā vāsa iti triṃśat
meaning: सप्तविंशतिर्गा हिरण्यं छागा वास इति त्रिंशत्
text_mt: twenty-seven cows, gold, a she-goat, [and] a cloth—thus thirty;
with a thousand for an Aśvamedha.
With 'To us radiant things,' he takes back the gold from the soma-seller.
With 'To us light,' he hands a tuft of white wool to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ sa kāle daśāpavitrasya nābhiṃ kurute
meaning: तां स काले दशापवित्रस्य नाभिं कुरुते
text_mt: At the proper time, he makes that into the navel of the fringed filter.
The filter is of white [wool] from a white sheep, unwoven.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dviṣyāttasya kṛṣṇāṃ lohinīṃ ca pavitre kuryāt
meaning: यं द्विष्यात्तस्य कृष्णां लोहिनीं च पवित्रे कुर्यात्
text_mt: For him whom he hates, he should make a black and a reddish [wool tuft] in the filter.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇāmūrṇāstukāmadbhiḥ kledayitvedamahaṃ sarpāṇaṃ dandaśūkānāṃ grīvā upagrathnāmītyupagrathya tayā somavikriyiṇaṃ vidhyati somavikrayiṇi tama iti
meaning: कृष्णामूर्णास्तुकामद्भिः क्लेदयित्वेदमहं सर्पाणं दन्दशूकानां ग्रीवा उपग्रथ्नामीत्युपग्रथ्य तया सोमविक्रियिणं विध्यति सोमविक्रयिणि तम इति
text_mt: Having moistened a tuft of black wool with water and tied it up with: 'Here do I tie up the necks of the biting snakes,' he strikes the soma-seller with it, [saying]: 'Darkness in the soma-seller!'

sanskrit_iast: svāna bhrājeti somakrayaṇānanudiśya svajā asi svabhūrasyasmai karmaṇe jāta ṛtena tvā gṛhṇāmyṛtena mā pāhīti somavikrayiṇo rājānamapādatte
meaning: स्वान भ्राजेति सोमक्रयणाननुदिश्य स्वजा असि स्वभूरस्यस्मै कर्मणे जात ऋतेन त्वा गृह्णाम्यृतेन मा पाहीति सोमविक्रयिणो राजानमपादत्ते
text_mt: Having addressed the articles used for purchasing soma with 'O Svāna, Bhrāja...', he takes the king (Soma) away from the soma-seller with: 'Thou art self-born, thou art self-existent, born for this rite; by truth I take thee, by truth protect me.'
If he should make difficulties, he should simply take it away.

sanskrit_iast: sīkṣitadaṇḍaṃ ca maitrāvaruṇāya prayacchati mitrāvaruṇayostvā praśāstroḥ praśiṣā prayacchāmyavakro 'vidhuro bhūyāsamiti
meaning: सीक्षितदण्डं च मैत्रावरुणाय प्रयच्छति मित्रावरुणयोस्त्वा प्रशास्त्रोः प्रशिषा प्रयच्छाम्यवक्रो ऽविधुरो भूयासमिति
text_mt: And he hands the staff of the consecrated one to the maitrāvaruṇa with: 'By the command of Mitra and Varuṇa, the two directors, I hand thee over; may I be upright and unbroken.'

sanskrit_iast: mitro na ehīti yajamāno rājānamādāyendrasyorumāviśeti dakṣiṇa ūrāvāsādya hastābhyāṃ nigṛhyāste
meaning: मित्रो न एहीति यजमानो राजानमादायेन्द्रस्योरुमाविशेति दक्षिण ऊरावासाद्य हस्ताभ्यां निगृह्यास्ते
text_mt: With 'Come as a friend to us,' the sacrificer, taking the king (Soma) and placing him on his right thigh with 'Enter Indra's thigh,' sits holding [him] with both hands.
Some teach here the waiting upon the sun, the handing over of the staff, and the addressing of the articles used for purchasing soma.

sanskrit_iast: rudrastvāvartayatviti pradakṣiṇaṃsomakrayaṇīmāvartyānyayā gavā niṣkrīya yajamānasya goṣṭhe visṛjati
meaning: रुद्रस्त्वावर्तयत्विति प्रदक्षिणंसोमक्रयणीमावर्त्यान्यया गवा निष्क्रीय यजमानस्य गोष्ठे विसृजति
text_mt: Having turned the cow used for purchasing soma around clockwise with 'May Rudra turn thee back,' and redeemed her with another cow, he releases [her] into the sacrificer's cow-pen.

sanskrit_iast: yadi somavikrayī prativivadeta pṛṣatainaṃ vratrākāṇḍenāvakṣāyaṃ nāśayeyuḥ
meaning: यदि सोमविक्रयी प्रतिविवदेत पृषतैनं व्रत्राकाण्डेनावक्षायं नाशयेयुः
text_mt: If the soma-seller should dispute, they should drive him away, blinding [him] with a spotted piece of cane.
'They beat him with clubs,' say some.
Some teach the beating as an obligatory rule.
Taking the king (Soma) and rising with 'Up with life, with good life,' the sacrificer walks towards the cart with: 'Traverse the wide mid-space.'

sanskrit_iast: adityāḥ sado 'sītyadhvaryuḥ śakaṭanīḍe kṛṣṇājinaṃ prācīnagrīvamuttaralomāstīryādityāḥ sada āsīdeti tasminrājānamāsādya vaneṣu vyantarikṣaṃ tatāneti vāsasā paryānahyodu tyaṃ jātavedasamiti sauryarcā kṛṣṇājinaṃ purastātpratyānahyatyūrdhvagrīvaṃ bahiṣṭādviśasanam
meaning: अदित्याः सदो ऽसीत्यध्वर्युः शकटनीडे कृष्णाजिनं प्राचीनग्रीवमुत्तरलोमास्तीर्यादित्याः सद आसीदेति तस्मिन्राजानमासाद्य वनेषु व्यन्तरिक्षं ततानेति वाससा पर्यानह्योदु त्यं जातवेदसमिति सौर्यर्चा कृष्णाजिनं पुरस्तात्प्रत्यानह्यत्यूर्ध्वग्रीवं बहिष्टाद्विशसनम्
text_mt: With the formula 'You are the seat of Aditi,' the adhvaryu, having spread a black antelope skin with the neck to the east and the hair side up in the seat of the cart, having set the King [Soma] upon it with 'Sit upon the seat of Aditi,' having wrapped him around with a cloth with 'He stretched the atmosphere across the trees,' ties up the black antelope skin in front with the solar verse, 'Upward the knowledgeable one…' with its neck turned upward and the cut side facing out.

sanskrit_iast: atra darśapūrṇamāsavaddhurāvabhimṛśya vāruṇamasīti śakaṭamākhidya varuṇastvottabhnātvityupastabhya varuṇasya skambhanamasīti śamyāṃ pratimucyosrāvetaṃ dhūrṣāhāvityanaḍvāhāvupājya vāruṇamasīti yoktrapāśaṃ parihṛtya pratyasto varuṇasya pāśa ityabhidhānīṃ pratyasyati
meaning: अत्र दर्शपूर्णमासवद्धुरावभिमृश्य वारुणमसीति शकटमाखिद्य वरुणस्त्वोत्तभ्नात्वित्युपस्तभ्य वरुणस्य स्कम्भनमसीति शम्यां प्रतिमुच्योस्रावेतं धूर्षाहावित्यनड्वाहावुपाज्य वारुणमसीति योक्त्रपाशं परिहृत्य प्रत्यस्तो वरुणस्य पाश इत्यभिधानीं प्रत्यस्यति
text_mt: Here, having touched the two yoke-pins as in the New and Full Moon sacrifices, having pulled down the cart with 'You belong to Varuṇa,' having propped it up with 'May Varuṇa prop you up,' having fastened the yoke-peg with 'You are the prop of Varuṇa,' having driven up the two draft oxen with 'Come, you two bulls bearing the yoke,' having slipped around the yoke-strap loop with 'You belong to Varuṇa,' he fastens the halter with 'Cast away is the halter of Varuṇa.'
In the same manner, he yokes the northern ox.
Holding two green branches, the subrahmaṇya crawls between the two shafts,
or two palāśa branches, or two śamī branches.

sanskrit_iast: athādhvaryuḥ śakaṭamanvārabhya saṃpreṣyati somāya rājñe krītāya prohyamāṇāyānubrūhi subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyāmāhvayeti
meaning: अथाध्वर्युः शकटमन्वारभ्य संप्रेष्यति सोमाय राज्ञे क्रीताय प्रोह्यमाणायानुब्रूहि सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्यामाह्वयेति
text_mt: Then the adhvaryu, holding onto the cart, issues the ritual call: 'Recite for King Soma, who has been purchased and is being conveyed forward; subrahmaṇya, call the subrahmaṇyā [litany]!'

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsu subrahmaṇyāsu subrahmaṇyamanvārabhya yajamāno japati sāsi subrahmaṇye tasyāste pṛthivī pādaḥ /
meaning: सर्वासु सुब्रह्मण्यासु सुब्रह्मण्यमन्वारभ्य यजमानो जपति सासि सुब्रह्मण्ये तस्यास्ते पृथिवी पादः /
text_mt:
Holding onto the subrahmaṇya at all subrahmaṇyā [recitations], the sacrificer mutters: 'Such are you, O subrahmaṇyā; of you, the earth is a foot.

Such are you, O subrahmaṇyā; of you, the atmosphere is a foot.
Such are you, O subrahmaṇyā; of you, the sky is a foot.
Such are you, O subrahmaṇyā; of you, the directions are a foot.
Beyond the realm of space is your fifth foot.

sanskrit_iast: sā na iṣamūrjaṃ dhukṣva teja indriyaṃ brahmavarcasamannādyam iti
meaning: सा न इषमूर्जं धुक्ष्व तेज इन्द्रियं ब्रह्मवर्चसमन्नाद्यम् इति
text_mt: As such, milk out for us food and sap, fiery vigor, sensory faculty, spiritual luster, and consumable food.'
In this way, [he recites this] each time she is called three times.
When the first [litany] has been recited thrice,

meaning: प्रच्यवस्व भुवस्पत इति प्राञ्चो ऽभिप्रयाय प्रदक्षिणमावर्तन्ते
text_mt: having stepped forward toward the east with 'Advance, O Lord of the world,' they turn around sunwise.

sanskrit_iast: śyeno bhūtvā parāpatety adhvaryū rājānam abhimantrayate
meaning: श्येनो भूत्वा परापतेत्य् अध्वर्यू राजानम् अभिमन्त्रयते
text_mt: With 'Becoming a falcon, fly away,' the two adhvaryus address the King [Soma].
With 'We have reached the path,' the adhvaryu and the sacrificer walk across past the King [Soma] on the south or on the north.

sanskrit_iast: ajenāgnīṣomīyeṇa karṇagṛhītena yajamāno rājānamohyamānaṃ pratīkṣate namo mitrasyeti
meaning: अजेनाग्नीषोमीयेण कर्णगृहीतेन यजमानो राजानमोह्यमानं प्रतीक्षते नमो मित्रस्येति
text_mt: With the goat meant for Agni and Soma held by its ear, the sacrificer looks at the King being conveyed, with 'Homage to the eye of Mitra…'
stout, fat, and bearded.
There is a chair made of udumbara wood, with headpieces and side-rails of a cubit's length, legs reaching up to the navel, woven with muñja grass;

meaning: तां सर्वे ऽध्वर्यवो ऽग्रेण प्राग्वंशं राजन्योह्यमान उद्गृह्णन्ति
text_mt: all the adhvaryus lift it up in front of the prāgvaṃśa hall while the King is being conveyed.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa prāgvaṃśaṃ prāgīṣamudagīṣaṃ vā śakaṭamavasthāpya pūrvvadākhidyopastabhya varuṇasya skambhanamasīti śamyāmudvṛhya vicṛtto varuṇasya pāśa iti yoktrapāśaṃ vicṛtyonmukto varuṇasya pāśa ityabhidhānīmunmuñcati
meaning: अग्रेण प्राग्वंशं प्रागीषमुदगीषं वा शकटमवस्थाप्य पूर्व्वदाखिद्योपस्तभ्य वरुणस्य स्कम्भनमसीति शम्यामुद्वृह्य विचृत्तो वरुणस्य पाश इति योक्त्रपाशं विचृत्योन्मुक्तो वरुणस्य पाश इत्यभिधानीमुन्मुञ्चति
text_mt: Having halted the cart in front of the prāgvaṃśa hall, with its shafts facing east or facing north, having pulled it down and propped it up as before, having taken off the yoke-peg with 'You are the prop of Varuṇa,' having untied the yoke-strap loop with 'Untied is the bond of Varuṇa,' he removes the halter with 'Loosed is the bond of Varuṇa.'
In the same manner, he unyokes the northern ox.
The left [ox] is either unyoked or not unyoked.
Then he undertakes the procedure of the guest-offering (ātithyā).
The firewood consists of twenty-two sticks.
the enclosing sticks are made of kārṣmarya wood.
Having made the grass broom (veda) and strewn around the fires, he undertakes the ritual acts beginning with the washing of the hands.
The placement of the utensils is according to requirement.
At the time of portioning out the oblation, having made the sacrificer's wife hold onto the cart, he portions out the guest-offering;
Portioning out from the hand, he should mutter all the cart mantras over the hand,
formula by formula, beginning with 'You are the hospitality for Agni...'
There is a substitute mention of the deity.
In the case of the five [portions], he appends the formula dedicated to Savitṛ and 'agreeable to...'
The sacrificial cake is dedicated to Viṣṇu, on nine potsherds.
From here onwards, the preparatory rites are just as for Viṣṇu.
Having released speech with the invocation of the preparer of the oblation (haviṣkṛt), and having unyoked the northern ox,

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇamasīti vāso 'pādāya varuṇo 'si dhṛtavrata iti rājānamādāyācchidrapatraḥ prajā upāvarohośannuśatīḥ syonaḥ syonāḥ soma rānviśvastvaṃ prajā upāvaroha viśvāstvāṃ prajā upāvarohantvityupāvahṛtyorvantarikṣamanvihīty abhipravrajati
meaning: वारुणमसीति वासो ऽपादाय वरुणो ऽसि धृतव्रत इति राजानमादायाच्छिद्रपत्रः प्रजा उपावरोहोशन्नुशतीः स्योनः स्योनाः सोम रान्विश्वस्त्वं प्रजा उपावरोह विश्वास्त्वां प्रजा उपावरोहन्त्वित्युपावहृत्योर्वन्तरिक्षमन्विहीत्य् अभिप्रव्रजति
text_mt: having taken off the cloth with 'You belong to Varuṇa,' having taken the King with 'You are Varuṇa whose vows are steadfast,' having taken him down with 'With unperforated leaf, descend to the offspring; desiring [them who are] desiring, kind [to them who are] kind; O King Soma, descend to all offspring, may all offspring descend to you,' he steps forward with 'Traverse the wide atmosphere.'
Taking the chair, the pratiprasthātṛ proceeds in front.

sanskrit_iast: yā te dhāmānīti pūrvayā dvārā prāgvaṃśaṃ praviśyāpareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇātihṛtya varuṇasyartasadanyasīti dakṣiṇenāhavanīyaṃ rājāsandīṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: या ते धामानीति पूर्वया द्वारा प्राग्वंशं प्रविश्यापरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणातिहृत्य वरुणस्यर्तसदन्यसीति दक्षिणेनाहवनीयं राजासन्दीं प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: Having entered the prāgvaṃśa hall through the eastern door with 'Whatever your abodes...', having carried it past southwards to the west of the āhavanīya, he sets down the King's chair south of the āhavanīya with 'You are the seat of the cosmic order belonging to Varuṇa.'
Upon it, the spreading of the black antelope skin and the placing of the King take place as on the cart.

meaning: वरुणो ऽसि धृतव्रत इति राजानम् अभिमन्त्रयते
text_mt: He addresses the King with 'You are Varuṇa whose vows are steadfast.'
With 'You belong to Varuṇa,' he wraps him around with a cloth.

sanskrit_iast: evāvandasva varuṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ namasyā dhīramamṛtasya gopām /
meaning: एवावन्दस्व वरुणं बृहन्तं नमस्या धीरममृतस्य गोपाम् /
text_mt: He should seat the King in all cases with this verse: 'Thus praise great Varuṇa; pay homage to the wise guardian of immortality;

sanskrit_iast: sa naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ viyaṃsatpātaṃ mā dyāvāpṛthivī upastha ity etayā sarvatra rājānamāsīdet
meaning: स नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वियंसत्पातं मा द्यावापृथिवी उपस्थ इत्य् एतया सर्वत्र राजानमासीदेत्
text_mt: may he extend three-layered protection to us; do you protect me in your lap, O Heaven and Earth.'

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ rājānaṃ cāntareṇa mā saṃcāriṣṭeti saṃpreṣyati
meaning: अग्निं राजानं चान्तरेण मा संचारिष्टेति संप्रेष्यति
text_mt: He issues the call: 'Do not pass between the fire and the king!'
He undertakes the rites beginning with pounding [the grains].
Having deposited the ātithya [offering] with the Caturhotṛ formula, he recites the saṃbhārayajus formulas.
Some [authorities] say that he makes the sacrificer recite [them].
