sanskrit_iast: upanahyā pratyāropyaikagrahāyāptaṃ rājānamupare nyupya hotṛcamase 'ṃśūnavadhāya tasmingrāvāṇamupāṃśusavanamupari dhārayaṃstriḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pariplāvayannigrābhampaiti prāgapāgudagadharāgiti
meaning: उपनह्या प्रत्यारोप्यैकग्रहायाप्तं राजानमुपरे न्युप्य होतृचमसे ऽंशूनवधाय तस्मिन्ग्रावाणमुपांशुसवनमुपरि धारयंस्त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं परिप्लावयन्निग्राभम्पैति प्रागपागुदगधरागिति
text_mt: Having tied it up, placed it back, scattered on the lower pressing-board king [Soma] sufficient for one draught, put the stalks in the hotṛ's goblet, and holding the upāṃśusavana pressing-stone above it, he approaches the nigrābha, swirling [the water] three times sunwise, with: ‘Eastward, westward, northward, downward.’

sanskrit_iast: yāṃ bhāryāṃ kāmayeta tāṃ manasā dhyāyedamba niṣvareti /
meaning: यां भार्यां कामयेत तां मनसा ध्यायेदम्ब निष्वरेति /
text_mt: Whichever wife he might desire, he should meditate on her in his mind with: ‘O mother, do not cry out.’

sanskrit_iast: śvātrā stha vṛtratura iti tāsāmekadeśenopasṛjyopaspṛṣṭasya rājñaḥ ṣaḍaṃśūnārdrānsaṃśliṣṭānādāya carmaṇi nidhāya yatte soma divi jyotiriti rājānamabhimantrayate
meaning: श्वात्रा स्थ वृत्रतुर इति तासामेकदेशेनोपसृज्योपस्पृष्टस्य राज्ञः षडंशूनार्द्रान्संश्लिष्टानादाय चर्मणि निधाय यत्ते सोम दिवि ज्योतिरिति राजानमभिमन्त्रयते
text_mt: Having poured [water] over it with a portion of those [waters] with: ‘You are invigorating, overcoming the foe,’ and having taken six moist, clinging stalks from the touched king [Soma] and placed them on the skin, he addresses king [Soma] with: ‘O Soma, that light of yours which is in heaven.’
[He addresses] the two pressing-boards with: ‘O two firm dhiṣaṇās.’

sanskrit_iast: avīvṛdhaṃ vo manasā sujātā iti rājānamevābhimantrya mā bhermā saṃvikthā iti grāvāṇamudyamyānāgasastvā vayamindreṇa preṣitā upa vāyuṣṭe astvaṃśabhūrmitraste astvaṃśabhūrvaruṇaste astvaṃśabhūrahataḥ somo rājeti tṛṇamantardhāyābhiṣuṇoti
meaning: अवीवृधं वो मनसा सुजाता इति राजानमेवाभिमन्त्र्य मा भेर्मा संविक्था इति ग्रावाणमुद्यम्यानागसस्त्वा वयमिन्द्रेण प्रेषिता उप वायुष्टे अस्त्वंशभूर्मित्रस्ते अस्त्वंशभूर्वरुणस्ते अस्त्वंशभूरहतः सोमो राजेति तृणमन्तर्धायाभिषुणोति
text_mt: Having addressed king [Soma] himself with: ‘With the mind I have magnified you, O well-born ones,’ and raised the pressing-stone with: ‘Do not fear, do not tremble,’ he places a blade of grass in between and presses with: ‘Sinless, we, sent by Indra, approach; may Vāyu be your stalk-protector, may Mitra be your stalk-protector, may Varuṇa be your stalk-protector, uninjured king Soma.’

sanskrit_iast: yadi vā purā tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ mūlaṃ vā syāttasminpraharet
meaning: यदि वा पुरा तृणं काष्ठं मूलं वा स्यात्तस्मिन्प्रहरेत्
text_mt: Or, if previously there should be a blade of grass, a piece of wood, or a root, he should strike upon that.
He presses eight times at first.
Then the pratiprasthātṛ, holding the upāṃśu vessel, inserts two stalks above those that have been taken.
In it the adhvaryu catches the pressed [juice] with his cupped hands, with: ‘Purify yourself for the Lord of Speech, O swift one.’
There is no strainer, no under-cup, and no setting down.
This is the first round.
The second and the third [rounds] are prescribed in the same way.
Or, he presses eleven times in the second [round],
twelve times in the third.
The approaching for nigrābha water and the pouring of water [take place] twice, either at the beginning or at the end.
He presses the shoots meant for the hotṛ's goblet in the last round.
The pratiprasthātṛ places two shoots each from the remainder in between.
Taking the draught with [the formula], 'You are self-consecrated,' [and reciting], 'Along the wide atmosphere…,' the adhvaryu steps past to the south of the hotṛ,
or by whichever [path] the hotṛ may direct [him].
Standing to the south with [the formula], 'May the mind accept you,' having lowered [it] along the southern junction of the enclosing sticks,

sanskrit_iast: svāhā tvā subhavaḥ sūryāyeti dakṣiṇataḥ prāñcamṛjuṃ saṃtataṃ dīrghaṃ hutvā devebhyastvā marīcipebhya iti madhyame paridhau lepaṃ nimārṣṭi
meaning: स्वाहा त्वा सुभवः सूर्यायेति दक्षिणतः प्राञ्चमृजुं संततं दीर्घं हुत्वा देवेभ्यस्त्वा मरीचिपेभ्य इति मध्यमे परिधौ लेपं निमार्ष्टि
text_mt: having offered [it] continuously and in a long line toward the east from the south with [the formula], 'Hail to you, the well-arising Sūrya,' he wipes the residue onto the middle enclosing stick with [the formula], 'To the deities who drink the rays of light.'
For someone whom he hates, he should make the offering bending forward.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ prajanyaḥ syādityabhyantaraṃ pātrasyāvamṛjyābhyantaraṃ paridhernīcā hastena nimṛjyāt
meaning: यदि कामयेत वर्षुकः प्रजन्यः स्यादित्यभ्यन्तरं पात्रस्यावमृज्याभ्यन्तरं परिधेर्नीचा हस्तेन निमृज्यात्
text_mt: If he should desire, 'May Parjanya be rainy,' having wiped the inside of the cup downwards, he should wipe downwards on the inside of the enclosing stick with his hand turned downward.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayetāvarṣukaḥ syāditi bāhyataḥ pātrasyordhvamunmṛjya bāhyataḥ paridheruttānena hastenordhvamunmṛjyāt
meaning: यदि कामयेतावर्षुकः स्यादिति बाह्यतः पात्रस्योर्ध्वमुन्मृज्य बाह्यतः परिधेरुत्तानेन हस्तेनोर्ध्वमुन्मृज्यात्
text_mt: If he should desire, 'May he not be rainy,' having wiped upwards on the outside of the cup, he should wipe upwards on the outside of the enclosing stick with his hand turned upward.

sanskrit_iast: sarvamāgrayaṇasthālyāṃ saṃpātamavanīyaiṣa te yoniḥ prāṇāya tveti riktaṃ pātramāyatane sādayitvā tasminnaṃśumavāsya taṃtṛtīyasavane 'pisṛjyābhiṣuṇuyāt
meaning: सर्वमाग्रयणस्थाल्यां संपातमवनीयैष ते योनिः प्राणाय त्वेति रिक्तं पात्रमायतने सादयित्वा तस्मिन्नंशुमवास्य तंतृतीयसवने ऽपिसृज्याभिषुणुयात्
text_mt: Having poured the entire residue into the āgrayaṇa vessel, having set the empty cup down in its proper place with [the formula], 'This is your womb; for the in-breath to you,' having placed a shoot into it, he should press it at the third pressing having added [it].
Now, these [acts are performed] for one who is practicing sorcery:

sanskrit_iast: upāṃśuṃ gṛhītvāmuṣya tvā prāṇe sādayāmīti sādayitvā devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ityādāyāmuṣya tvā prāṇamapidadhāmīti hastenāpidhāyāmuṃ jahyatha tvā hoṣyāmīti brūyāt
meaning: उपांशुं गृहीत्वामुष्य त्वा प्राणे सादयामीति सादयित्वा देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इत्यादायामुष्य त्वा प्राणमपिदधामीति हस्तेनापिधायामुं जह्यथ त्वा होष्यामीति ब्रूयात्
text_mt: Having drawn the upāṃśu draught, having set it down with [the formula], 'I set you down in the breath of so-and-so,' having taken it up with [the formula], 'At the instigation of divine Savitṛ…,' having covered it with his hand with [the formula], 'I cover the breath of so-and-so,' he should say, 'Slay so-and-so, then I will offer you.'
If [the enemy] should be far away, he should remain standing until he loses breath.

sanskrit_iast: praharṣiṇo madirasya made mṛṣāsāvastviti jihmastiṣṭhanhutvāmuṣya tvā prāṇe sādayāmīti sādayet
meaning: प्रहर्षिणो मदिरस्य मदे मृषासावस्त्विति जिह्मस्तिष्ठन्हुत्वामुष्य त्वा प्राणे सादयामीति सादयेत्
text_mt: Having offered while standing crosswise with [the formula], 'In the exhilaration of the exhilarating, intoxicating [soma], let so-and-so perish,' he should set [the cup] down with [the formula], 'I set you down in the breath of so-and-so.'

sanskrit_iast: yo vastre bāhāvurasi vāṃśurāśliṣṭastamabhicarato juhotītyeke devāṃśo yasmai tveḍe tatsatyamapariplutā bhaṅgyena hato 'sau phaḍiti
meaning: यो वस्त्रे बाहावुरसि वांशुराश्लिष्टस्तमभिचरतो जुहोतीत्येके देवांशो यस्मै त्वेडे तत्सत्यमपरिप्लुता भङ्ग्येन हतो ऽसौ फडिति
text_mt: Some [teachers say] that he offers the shoot that clung to the garment, the arm, or the chest of the one practicing sorcery, with [the formula], 'O divine shoot, that truth for which I praise you is not overturned; by [this] crushing, so-and-so is struck down, phaṭ!'

sanskrit_iast: yatte somādābhyaṃ nāma jāgṛvītyupāṃśupāvanānāmanusavanaṃ dvaudvāvaṃśū mahābhiṣaveṣvapisṛjati
meaning: यत्ते सोमादाभ्यं नाम जागृवीत्युपांशुपावनानामनुसवनं द्वौद्वावंशू महाभिषवेष्वपिसृजति
text_mt: With [the formula], 'What inviolable name of yours, O Soma, is watchful…,' he adds two shoots each of the upāṃśupāvana shoots at each pressing during the great pressings.

meaning: अदाभ्यांशुमुपांशुपावनौ चापिसृज्य सर्वे ऽध्वर्यवो दिग्भ्यो महाभिषवमभिषुण्वन्ति
text_mt: Having added the adābhya shoot and the two upāṃśupāvana [shoots], all the adhvaryus perform the great pressing from the cardinal directions.
The adhvaryu is to the east, the pratiprasthātṛ to the south, the neṣṭṛ to the west, and the unnetṛ to the north.
Some [teachers say] that the adhvaryu is to the west and the neṣṭṛ to the east.

Having poured the king [Soma] onto the lower pressing stone, having placed the shoots in the hotṛ's goblet, [the rite proceeds] with these [mantras] up to the pouring of water, except for the upāṃśusavana [stone].
They press silently with the other pressing stones.
In this way, having poured water a second and a third time, they press.
The adhvaryu sprinkles the pressed [soma] with his folded hands.
The unnetṛ, having scooped it up between the shafts, pours it into the ādhavanīya trough to the north.
This indeed is the path of the waters and of the soma.
This is the first round.
The second and the third [rounds] are prescribed in the same way.

sanskrit_iast: saṃbhṛtya rājānamupare grāvṇaḥ saṃmukhānkṛtvā prapīḍyarjīṣaṃ mukheṣūpohati /
meaning: संभृत्य राजानमुपरे ग्राव्णः संमुखान्कृत्वा प्रपीड्यर्जीषं मुखेषूपोहति /
text_mt: Having collected the king [Soma] on the lower pressing stone, having brought the pressing stones face to face, having squeezed out the pressed soma pulp, he inserts it into their mouths.
It is known [from a Brāhmaṇa]: 'He gives fodder to them.'

sanskrit_iast: teṣudgātāro droṇakalaśaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tasminnudīcīnadaśaṃ pavitraṃ vitanvanti
meaning: तेषुद्गातारो द्रोणकलशं प्रतिष्ठाप्य तस्मिन्नुदीचीनदशं पवित्रं वितन्वन्ति
text_mt: Setting down the droṇakalaśa trough upon them, the udgātṛs spread out upon it the strainer with its fringes pointing north.

sanskrit_iast: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate prabhurgātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ /
meaning: पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः /
text_mt: 'Your strainer is spread out, O Brahmaṇaspati; as sovereign, you encompass the limbs on all sides;

sanskrit_iast: ataptatanūrna tadāmo aśnute śṛtāsa idvahantastatsamāśateti vitatamānamabhimantrayate yajamānaḥ
meaning: अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते शृतास इद्वहन्तस्तत्समाशतेति विततमानमभिमन्त्रयते यजमानः
text_mt: The unbaked body does not attain that raw [soma]; only the cooked, bearing it, have fully reached it' — with this [verse] the sacrificer addresses [the strainer] while it is being spread out.

sanskrit_iast: pavitrasya yajamāno nābhiṃ kṛtvā tasminhotṛcamasena dhārāṃ srāvayati
meaning: पवित्रस्य यजमानो नाभिं कृत्वा तस्मिन्होतृचमसेन धारां स्रावयति
text_mt: The sacrificer, having made the navel of the strainer, causes a stream [of soma] to flow through it with the hotṛ's goblet.
The unnetṛ brings [soma] with the dipping-ladle from the ādhavanīya trough into the hotṛ's goblet.
A continuous stream should be made to flow.
It is known [from a Brāhmaṇa]: 'His desire indeed becomes fulfilled.'
For someone whom he hates, he should interrupt it.
From the stream, they draw the antaryāma draught,
and all the draughts from this point up to the dhruva draught.
The upāṃśu and antaryāma [draughts] have the same Brāhmaṇa; both relate to sorcery.
Having drawn [it] with [the formula], 'You are taken with a support; restrain inward,' he steps past to the north of the hotṛ,

sanskrit_iast: yena vā hotā pratipādayeduttarato 'vasthāyottaraṃ paridhisaṃdhimanvavahṛtyottarārdhe juhoti
meaning: येन वा होता प्रतिपादयेदुत्तरतो ऽवस्थायोत्तरं परिधिसंधिमन्ववहृत्योत्तरार्धे जुहोति
text_mt: or by whichever [path] the hotṛ may direct [him]; standing to the north, having lowered [it] along the northern junction of the enclosing sticks, he offers in the northern half [of the fire].
Some [teachers] mention the places as reversed.

sanskrit_iast: asarvamāgrayaṇasthālyāṃ saṃpātamvanīyaiṣa te yonirapānāya tvetyariktaṃ pātramāyatane sādayitvā vyānāya tveti te antareṇa grāvāṇamupāṃśusavanaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaṃ saṃspṛṣṭaṃ pātrābhyām
meaning: असर्वमाग्रयणस्थाल्यां संपातम्वनीयैष ते योनिरपानाय त्वेत्यरिक्तं पात्रमायतने सादयित्वा व्यानाय त्वेति ते अन्तरेण ग्रावाणमुपांशुसवनं दक्षिणामुखं संस्पृष्टं पात्राभ्याम्
text_mt: Having poured not all of the residue into the āgrayaṇa vessel, having set down the non-empty cup in its proper place with [the formula], 'This is your womb; for the out-breath to you,' [he places] the upāṃśusavana pressing stone between the two cups facing south, touching both cups, with [the formula], 'For the diffused breath to you.'
It is said [in the Brāhmaṇa] that for one whom he desires, 'May he perish quickly,' the two [cups] should not touch [the stone].
He should offer the upāṃśu draught when the sun has not risen, and the antaryāma draught when it has risen.
Some [teachers say] both should be offered before sunrise.
If the soma sacrifice has the Rathaṃtara as its sāman, he should draw [the draughts] beginning with the Aindravāyava draught;
if it has the Bṛhat as its sāman, beginning with the Śukra draught;
if it has the Jagat as its sāman, beginning with the Āgrayaṇa draught.
If it has both sāmans, it is according to his pleasure;
or indeed, only beginning with the Aindravāyava draught.
He should draw [the draughts] beginning with the Aindravāyava if he desires: ‘May offspring be arranged according to seniority.’
It has been said: ‘those [grahas] before the Āgrayaṇa.’
Whichever optional [draught] he draws before the Aindravāyava, he should not set it down.
[It] is set down following the setting down of the Aindravāyava draught.
He draws the Aindravāyava draught.

sanskrit_iast: ā vāyo bhūṣa śucipā ityanudrutyopayāmagṛhīto 'si vāyave tveti gṛhītvāpayamyendravāyū ime sutā ityanudrutyopayāmagṛhīto 'sīndravāyubhyāṃ tveti gṛhītvā pavitradaśābhiḥ parimṛjyaiṣa te yoniḥ sajoṣābhyāṃ tveti sādayati
meaning: आ वायो भूष शुचिपा इत्यनुद्रुत्योपयामगृहीतो ऽसि वायवे त्वेति गृहीत्वापयम्येन्द्रवायू इमे सुता इत्यनुद्रुत्योपयामगृहीतो ऽसीन्द्रवायुभ्यां त्वेति गृहीत्वा पवित्रदशाभिः परिमृज्यैष ते योनिः सजोषाभ्यां त्वेति सादयति
text_mt: Having recited, “Come, O Vāyu, appropriate [the soma], O drinker of the pure,” having drawn [a portion] with, “You are taken with a base; for Vāyu, you,” having restrained [the flow], having recited, “O Indra and Vāyu, these are pressed,” having drawn [a portion] with, “You are taken with a base; for Indra and Vāyu, you,” and having wiped around [the cup] with the fringes of the strainer, he sets [it] down with, “This is your womb; for the two who rejoice together, you.”

sanskrit_iast: sarvāngrahānpavitradaśābhiḥ parimṛjyaiṣa te yoniriti yathādevaṃ yathāyatanaṃ sādayati
meaning: सर्वान्ग्रहान्पवित्रदशाभिः परिमृज्यैष ते योनिरिति यथादेवं यथायतनं सादयति
text_mt: Having wiped around all the draughts with the fringes of the strainer, he sets [each] down according to its deity [and] according to its place, with: “This is your womb…”
Or, for this purpose, a second strainer should have fringes.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇeti maitrāvaruṇaṃ gṛhītvā rāyā vayaṃ sasavāṃso madema havyena devā yavasena gāvaḥ /
meaning: अयं वां मित्रावरुणेति मैत्रावरुणं गृहीत्वा राया वयं ससवांसो मदेम हव्येन देवा यवसेन गावः /
text_mt: Having drawn the Maitrāvaruṇa draught with, “This [soma] of you two, O Mitra and Varuṇa…”; [with:] “Possessing wealth, may we rejoice in abundance; the gods with the oblation, the cows with grass;

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ dhenuṃ mitrāvaruṇā yuvaṃ no viśvāhā dhattamanapasphurantīmiti śṛtaśītena payasā śrītvaiṣa te yonirṛtāyubhyāṃ tveti sādayati
meaning: तां धेनुं मित्रावरुणा युवं नो विश्वाहा धत्तमनपस्फुरन्तीमिति शृतशीतेन पयसा श्रीत्वैष ते योनिरृतायुभ्यां त्वेति सादयति
text_mt: That milch-cow, O Mitra and Varuṇa, do you grant to us every day, unbalking,” having mixed [it] with boiled-and-cooled milk, he sets [it] down with, “This is your womb; for the two lovers of Ṛta, you.”

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ venaścodayaditi śukraṃ gṛhītvā hiraṇyena śrītvaiṣa te yonirvīratāṃ pāhīti sādayati
meaning: अयं वेनश्चोदयदिति शुक्रं गृहीत्वा हिरण्येन श्रीत्वैष ते योनिर्वीरतां पाहीति सादयति
text_mt: Having drawn the Śukra draught with, “This yearning one impelled…,” and having mixed [it] with gold, he sets [it] down with, “This is your womb; protect heroism.”
In the case of a hated [sacrificer, he adds]: “For Śaṇḍa, you.”

sanskrit_iast: taṃ pratnatheti manthinaṃ gṛhītvā mano na yeṣu havaneṣu juhvadvipaḥ śacyā vanutho dravantā /
meaning: तं प्रत्नथेति मन्थिनं गृहीत्वा मनो न येषु हवनेषु जुह्वद्विपः शच्या वनुथो द्रवन्ता /
text_mt: Having drawn the Manthin draught with, “Him, as of old…,” [with:] “Sacrificing at which invocations like the mind, you two swift runners win the waters with power;

sanskrit_iast: ā yaḥ śaryābhistuvinṛmṇo asyāśrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastāviti saktubhiḥ śrīṇātyanabhidhvaṃsayannātmānam /
meaning: आ यः शर्याभिस्तुविनृम्णो अस्याश्रीणीतादिशं गभस्ताविति सक्तुभिः श्रीणात्यनभिध्वंसयन्नात्मानम् /
text_mt: He who, of abundant prowess, shot with reeds, mixed the portion in his hand,” he mixes [it] with groats, without sprinkling upon himself,

sanskrit_iast: eṣa te yoniḥ prajāḥ pāhīti sādayati
meaning: एष ते योनिः प्रजाः पाहीति सादयति
text_mt: He sets [it] down with, “This is your womb; protect progeny.”
In the case of a hated [sacrificer, he adds]: “For Marka, you.”

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta yo grāme taṃ grāmānnirūheyaṃ yo bahirgrāmāttaṃ grāme kuryāmitīdamahamamumāmuṣyāyaṇamamuṣya putramamuṣyā viśa udūhāmīti śukramudūhyedamahamamumāmuṣyāyaṇamamuṣya putramamuṣyāṃ viśi sādayāmīti tasminmanthinaṃ sādayet
meaning: यदि कामयेत यो ग्रामे तं ग्रामान्निरूहेयं यो बहिर्ग्रामात्तं ग्रामे कुर्यामितीदमहममुमामुष्यायणममुष्य पुत्रममुष्या विश उदूहामीति शुक्रमुदूह्येदमहममुमामुष्यायणममुष्य पुत्रममुष्यां विशि सादयामीति तस्मिन्मन्थिनं सादयेत्
text_mt: If he should wish, “May I drive out of the clan the one who is in the clan; may I put into the clan the one who is outside the clan,” having displaced the Śukra draught with, “Here I drive out so-and-so, son of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so, from so-and-so's clan,” he should set the Manthin draught down in that [place] with, “Here I establish so-and-so, son of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so, in so-and-so's clan.”

sanskrit_iast: ye devā divītyupariṣṭādupayāmayā purastādupayāmena vā yajuṣā dvābhyāṃ dhārābhyāṃ sthālyāgrayaṇaṃ gṛhṇāti
meaning: ये देवा दिवीत्युपरिष्टादुपयामया पुरस्तादुपयामेन वा यजुषा द्वाभ्यां धाराभ्यां स्थाल्याग्रयणं गृह्णाति
text_mt: With “The gods who are in heaven…,” with a formula having the upayāma at the end or with one having the upayāma at the beginning, he draws the Āgrayaṇa draught in two streams using a pot.

sanskrit_iast: ya āgrayaṇasthālyāṃ somastamanyasminpātra ānīya tāṃ dvitīyāṃ dhārāṃ karoti
meaning: य आग्रयणस्थाल्यां सोमस्तमन्यस्मिन्पात्र आनीय तां द्वितीयां धारां करोति
text_mt: Having poured the soma that is in the Āgrayaṇa pot into another vessel, he makes that into the second stream.

meaning: त्रिंशत्त्रयश्चेति रुग्णवत्यर्चा भ्रातृव्यवतो ऽभिचरतो वा गृह्णीयात्
text_mt: For one who has a rival, or for one practicing sorcery, he should draw [it] with the verse containing [the word] rugṇa: “Thirty and three…”;

sanskrit_iast: vidadyatī saramā rugṇamadrermahi pāthaḥ pūrvyaṃ sadhriyakkaḥ /
meaning: विदद्यती सरमा रुग्णमद्रेर्महि पाथः पूर्व्यं सध्रियक्कः /
text_mt: or, for one practicing sorcery, with: “Saramā, finding the cleft of the rock, made the ancient, great sustenance unified;

sanskrit_iast: agraṃ nayatsupadyakṣarāṇāmacchā ravaṃ prathamā jānatī gāditi vābhicarataḥ
meaning: अग्रं नयत्सुपद्यक्षराणामच्छा रवं प्रथमा जानती गादिति वाभिचरतः
text_mt: Leading the vanguard of the fleet-footed syllables, knowing [the path], she first went towards the roar.”
Having drawn the Āgrayaṇa draught and having made the hiṅ-sound three times, he releases speech.

sanskrit_iast: somaḥ pavate somaḥ pavate somaḥ pavate subhūtāya pavate brahmavarcasāya pavate 'smai brahmaṇe pavate 'smai kṣatrāya pavate 'syai viśe pavate 'dbhyaḥ pavata oṣadhībhyaḥ pavate vanaspatibhyaḥ pavate dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pavate 'smai sunvate yajamānāya pavate mahyaṃ jyaiṣṭhyāya pavate yaṭ devebhyo 'pavathā evaṃ mahyaṃ pavasveti trirudvadati śanairuccairatha sūccaiḥ
meaning: सोमः पवते सोमः पवते सोमः पवते सुभूताय पवते ब्रह्मवर्चसाय पवते ऽस्मै ब्रह्मणे पवते ऽस्मै क्षत्राय पवते ऽस्यै विशे पवते ऽद्भ्यः पवत ओषधीभ्यः पवते वनस्पतिभ्यः पवते द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां पवते ऽस्मै सुन्वते यजमानाय पवते मह्यं ज्यैष्ठ्याय पवते यट् देवेभ्यो ऽपवथा एवं मह्यं पवस्वेति त्रिरुद्वदति शनैरुच्चैरथ सूच्चैः
text_mt: He proclaims aloud three times—slowly, loudly, and then very loudly: “Soma purifies itself, Soma purifies itself, Soma purifies itself; it purifies itself for prosperity, it purifies itself for spiritual lustre; it purifies itself for this priesthood, it purifies itself for this nobility, it purifies itself for this clan; it purifies itself for the waters, it purifies itself for the plants, it purifies itself for the trees, it purifies itself for heaven and earth, it purifies itself for this pressing sacrificer, it purifies itself for my supremacy. As you purified yourself for the gods, so purify yourself for me!”

sanskrit_iast: eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhya iti sādayitvā trīnagniṣṭome 'tigrāhyāngṛhṇāti /
meaning: एष ते योनिर्विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्य इति सादयित्वा त्रीनग्निष्टोमे ऽतिग्राह्यान्गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Having set [it] down with, “This is your womb; for the All-gods, you,” in the Agniṣṭoma he draws the three Atigrāhya draughts:
the one for Agni, the one for Indra, and the one for Sūrya.
“O Agni, life-spans…,” “Arising…,” and “The crossing over…” are the [formulas for] drawing and setting down.
He draws the Ukthya draught using a pot.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'sīndrāya tvā bṛhadvate vayasvata iti grahaṇasādanau
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसीन्द्राय त्वा बृहद्वते वयस्वत इति ग्रहणसादनौ
text_mt: “You are taken with a base; for Indra, the mighty, the vigorous” are the [formulas for] drawing and setting down.

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā iti sthālyā dhruvaṃ pūrṇaṃ gṛhṇāti
meaning: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या इति स्थाल्या ध्रुवं पूर्णं गृह्णाति
text_mt: With “Head of heaven, chariot-spoke of the earth…,” he draws the Dhruva draught full using a pot.
He should draw a small amount for one of whom he should wish, “May he be prone to die”;
more than half for one of whom he should wish, “May he attain an advanced life-span.”

sanskrit_iast: eṣa te yoniragnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyetyāyatane hiraṇye sādayedāyuṣkāmasya
meaning: एष ते योनिरग्नये त्वा वैश्वानरायेत्यायतने हिरण्ये सादयेदायुष्कामस्य
text_mt: With “This is your womb; for Agni Vaiśvānara, you,” he should set it down in its place upon gold for one desiring a full life-span.
A king's son should guard it until the pouring out.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayetāvagatamaparundhyuraparuddho 'vagaccheditīdamahamamumāmuṣyāyaṇamamuṣya putramamuṣyā viśa utkhidāmīti dhruvamutkhidyedamahamamumāmuṣyāyaṇamamuṣya putramamuṣyāṃ viśi sādayāmīti tatraiva punaḥ sādayet
meaning: यदि कामयेतावगतमपरुन्ध्युरपरुद्धो ऽवगच्छेदितीदमहममुमामुष्यायणममुष्य पुत्रममुष्या विश उत्खिदामीति ध्रुवमुत्खिद्येदमहममुमामुष्यायणममुष्य पुत्रममुष्यां विशि सादयामीति तत्रैव पुनः सादयेत्
text_mt: If he should wish, “May they banish an accepted [clan member], or may an expelled one return,” having lifted out the Dhruva draught with, “Here I tear away so-and-so, son of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so, from so-and-so's clan,” he should set it down again in that very same place with, “Here I establish so-and-so, son of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so, in so-and-so's clan.”
Because if he should do so, he would derange the life-span of the offspring;
he should [instead] carry a blade of grass past it above, with this formula.
If he should practice sorcery, he should move the Dhruva draught with, “Here I roll away the life of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so.”

sanskrit_iast: dhruvaṃ tvā dhruvakṣitimamumā sthānāccyāvayāmīti vā vyaṅgayet
meaning: ध्रुवं त्वा ध्रुवक्षितिममुमा स्थानाच्च्यावयामीति वा व्यङ्गयेत्
text_mt: Or he should tilt it, [saying:] “O firm one, having a firm abode, I shake so-and-so from his place.”
Having squeezed out the strainer, he sets [it] down.

sanskrit_iast: ekadhanānāṃ yathārthaṃ sarvāśca maitrāvaruṇacamasīyā ādhavanīye 'vanīya pūtabhṛto bila udīcīnadaśaṃ pavitraṃ vitatya ya ādhavanīye rājā tamasarvaṃ pūtabhṛtyavanīyopayāmagṛhīto 'si prajāpataye tveti droṇakalaśamabhimṛśet /
meaning: एकधनानां यथार्थं सर्वाश्च मैत्रावरुणचमसीया आधवनीये ऽवनीय पूतभृतो बिल उदीचीनदशं पवित्रं वितत्य य आधवनीये राजा तमसर्वं पूतभृत्यवनीयोपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजापतये त्वेति द्रोणकलशमभिमृशेत् /
text_mt: Having poured the Ekadhana waters according to purpose and all the waters for the Maitrāvaruṇa's goblet into the ādhavanīya trough, having spread out over the mouth of the pūtabhṛt trough the strainer with its fringes pointing northward, and having poured that king [Soma] which was in the ādhavanīya entirely into the pūtabhṛt trough, he should touch the droṇakalaśa with, “You are taken with a base; for Prajāpati, you”;
the ādhavanīya with, “For Indra, you”;
and the pūtabhṛt with, “For the All-gods, you.”
They all have the upayāma formula at the beginning.
The sacrificer touches all the draughts with the Pañcahotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: drapsaścaskanda yaste drapso yo drapso yaste drapsa ityetaiḥ pratimtraṃ vaipruṣānhomāñjuhoti
meaning: द्रप्सश्चस्कन्द यस्ते द्रप्सो यो द्रप्सो यस्ते द्रप्स इत्येतैः प्रतिम्त्रं वैप्रुषान्होमाञ्जुहोति
text_mt: With “The drop leaped…,” “That drop which of you…,” “The drop which…,” and “That drop which of you…,” he offers the vaipruṣa oblations, one for each formula.
Some teach that the first [formula] is attached everywhere, and the next three are distributed across each pressing.

sanskrit_iast: saptahotāraṃ manasānudrutyāhavanīye sagrahaṃ hutvodañcaḥ prahvā bahiṣpavamānāya pañcartvijaḥ samanvārabdhāḥ sarpanti
meaning: सप्तहोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्याहवनीये सग्रहं हुत्वोदञ्चः प्रह्वा बहिष्पवमानाय पञ्चर्त्विजः समन्वारब्धाः सर्पन्ति
text_mt: Having recited the Saptahotṛ formula mentally and having offered it into the āhavanīya with a draught, the five priests, holding on to one another from behind, stooping and turned northward, glide forward for the Bahiṣpavamāna chant.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuṃ prastotānvārabhate prastotāraṃ pratihartā pratihartāramudgātodgātāraṃ brahmā brahmāṇaṃ yajamānaḥ
meaning: अध्वर्युं प्रस्तोतान्वारभते प्रस्तोतारं प्रतिहर्ता प्रतिहर्तारमुद्गातोद्गातारं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माणं यजमानः
text_mt: The prastotṛ grasps the adhvaryu from behind, the pratihartṛ the prastotṛ, the udgātṛ the pratihartṛ, the brahman the udgātṛ, and the sacrificer the brahman.

sanskrit_iast: yadyu vai svayaṃ hotā yajamānaḥ syātsarpedeva /
meaning: यद्यु वै स्वयं होता यजमानः स्यात्सर्पेदेव /
text_mt: Even if the sacrificer himself is the hotṛ, he must glide forward;
for “his [function] is that of a chorister,” so states a Rigvedic Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: tsaranta iva rehāṇā iva nyaṅṅiva śīrṣāṇi kṛtvā sarpanti
meaning: त्सरन्त इव रेहाणा इव न्यङ्ङिव शीर्षाणि कृत्वा सर्पन्ति
text_mt: They glide forward as if creeping, as if licking, keeping their heads bent low;

sanskrit_iast: pūrvo 'dhvaryurbarhirmuṣṭiṃ dhūnvansarpati vāgagregā agra etviti gāyatraḥ panthā vasavo devatāvṛkeṇāparipareṇa pathā svasti vasūnaśīyeti
meaning: पूर्वो ऽध्वर्युर्बर्हिर्मुष्टिं धून्वन्सर्पति वागग्रेगा अग्र एत्विति गायत्रः पन्था वसवो देवतावृकेणापरिपरेण पथा स्वस्ति वसूनशीयेति
text_mt: The adhvaryu, being the foremost, glides forward shaking a handful of sacrificial grass, with: “May Speech, going in the forefront, go in front; the path is of Gāyatrī meter, the Vasus are the deity; along the wolf-free, unobstructed path may I safely attain the Vasus.”
Looking towards the cātvāla pit, they chant;
Then the adhvaryu brings near the chant.
He hands the handful of sacrificial grass to the prastotṛ with, “Vāyu is the one who makes the hiṅ-sound.”
In all Pavamāna chants, the bringing on [of the chant] is performed in this way.

sanskrit_iast: asarjyasarji vāgasarjyaindraṃ saho 'sarjyupāvartadhvamiti barhirbhyāmanyāni pavamānebhyaḥ stotrāṇyupākaroti
meaning: असर्ज्यसर्जि वागसर्ज्यैन्द्रं सहो ऽसर्ज्युपावर्तध्वमिति बर्हिर्भ्यामन्यानि पवमानेभ्यः स्तोत्राण्युपाकरोति
text_mt: With “Speech has been released, released has been Indra's might, released; turn yourselves towards [it],” he brings on the chants other than the Pavamāna chants with two blades of sacrificial grass.
Therefore, the Bahiṣpavamāna chant is to be approached [reverently] by a brahmin.
"Whomever he hates, he should exclude him from the bahiṣpavamāna [chant]," so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].
While [the chant] is being sung, the sacrificer joins in singing.
There are at least four accompanying singers.

sanskrit_iast: vasvyai hiṅkuru tasyai prastuhi tasyai stuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyā iti purastādbahiṣpavamānādyajamāno japati
meaning: वस्व्यै हिङ्कुरु तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै स्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्या इति पुरस्ताद्बहिष्पवमानाद्यजमानो जपति
text_mt: Before the bahiṣpavamāna [chant], the sacrificer mutters: "Utter the hiṅ-sound for the wealthy one; begin the prelude for her; sing the chant for her; for my obtainment of her."
And he recites the daśahotṛ formula.
And while [the chant] is being sung, he mutters the daśahotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: śyeno 'si gāyatracchandā iti madhyamāyāṃ ca stotrīyāyāmanvāroham
meaning: श्येनो ऽसि गायत्रच्छन्दा इति मध्यमायां च स्तोत्रीयायामन्वारोहम्
text_mt: And at the middle strophic verse, [he mutters] the ascending formula: "You are a falcon, with the gāyatrī metre."
At the second pavamāna [chant], with the second formula.
He follows the chant with the recitation: "Of that which is praised, you are the praise."
The recitation with: "Of that which is recited, you are the recitation."
In both cases he appends: "Possessed of vigour, we win."

sanskrit_iast: stute 'dhvaryuḥ sampreṣyatyagnīdagnīnvihara barhi stṛṇāhi puroḍāśām̐ alaṃkurviti
meaning: स्तुते ऽध्वर्युः सम्प्रेष्यत्यग्नीदग्नीन्विहर बर्हि स्तृणाहि पुरोडाशाम्̐ अलंकुर्विति
text_mt: When it has been chanted, the adhvaryu calls out: "Agnīdh, distribute the fires, strew the barhis, adorn the sacrificial cakes!"

sanskrit_iast: stuta uttiṣṭhannāhāgnīdagnīnvihara barhi stṛṇihi puroḍāśām̐ alaṃkuru pratiprasthātaḥ paśunehīti
meaning: स्तुत उत्तिष्ठन्नाहाग्नीदग्नीन्विहर बर्हि स्तृणिहि पुरोडाशाम्̐ अलंकुरु प्रतिप्रस्थातः पशुनेहीति
text_mt: When it has been chanted, rising up, he says: "Agnīdh, distribute the fires, strew the barhis, adorn the sacrificial cakes; pratiprasthātṛ, come with the animal!"
They act according to the ritual call.
He distributes the dhiṣṇya hearths from the āgnīdhra fire.
He scatters [them] on the earthen dhiṣṇya hearths.
In that order according as they have been thrown up.

sanskrit_iast: pracaraṇyāṃ pañcagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā droṇakalaśācca pariplavayā rājānaṃ purastātpratyaṅṅāsīno dhiṣṇiyānvyāghārayati taireva mantraiḥ /
meaning: प्रचरण्यां पञ्चगृहीतं गृहीत्वा द्रोणकलशाच्च परिप्लवया राजानं पुरस्तात्प्रत्यङ्ङासीनो धिष्णियान्व्याघारयति तैरेव मन्त्रैः /
text_mt: Having taken five ladlings [of clarified butter] in the pracaraṇī ladle, and King [Soma] from the droṇakalaśa trough with the dipping spoon, sitting in front facing west, he consecrates the dhiṣṇya hearths with those very formulas;
The āhavanīya, the āgnīdhrīya, the hotrīya, and the mārjālīya with soma;

sanskrit_iast: yajñasya saṃtatirasi yajñasya tvā saṃtatyai stṛṇāmi saṃtatyai tvā yajñasyeti gārhapatyātprakramya saṃtatamanupṛṣṭhyaṃ barhiḥ stṛṇātyāhavanīyāt
meaning: यज्ञस्य संततिरसि यज्ञस्य त्वा संतत्यै स्तृणामि संतत्यै त्वा यज्ञस्येति गार्हपत्यात्प्रक्रम्य संततमनुपृष्ठ्यं बर्हिः स्तृणात्याहवनीयात्
text_mt: Starting from the gārhapatya up to the āhavanīya, he strews the barhis uninterruptedly along the spinal line [of the altar], with: "You are the continuity of the sacrifice; I strew you for the continuity of the sacrifice, for the continuity of the sacrifice of you."

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṇavyarcā punaretya yajamāno rājānamupatiṣṭhate viṣṇo tvaṃ no antama iti
meaning: वैष्णव्यर्चा पुनरेत्य यजमानो राजानमुपतिष्ठते विष्णो त्वं नो अन्तम इति
text_mt: Having returned, the sacrificer attends upon King [Soma] with a verse addressed to Viṣṇu: "O Viṣṇu, you are nearest to us."
The adhvaryu, touching the vessels with this very [verse], draws the āśvina draught.
"What whip of yours..." are the two [formulas] for drawing and depositing.
The draughts drawn without a stream are taken from the droṇakalaśa trough with the dipping spoon;
Having wrapped the sacrificial post with a threefold cord, he brings near the savanīya victim for Agni.
Some teach [these] as cumulative:
He seizes the one for Agni at the agniṣṭoma;
a second, for Indra and Agni, at the ukthya;
a third, a ram for Indra, at the ṣoḍaśin;
a fourth, an ewe for Sarasvatī, at the atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: ā vapāyāḥ kṛtvā hutāyāṃ vapāyāṃ mārjayitvā prātaḥsavanāya saṃprasarpanti
meaning: आ वपायाः कृत्वा हुतायां वपायां मार्जयित्वा प्रातःसवनाय संप्रसर्पन्ति
text_mt: Having proceeded up to the omentum, when the omentum has been offered, having cleansed themselves, they creep together for the morning pressing.
As they are about to creep, they look at the draughts:
at the pūtabhṛt and ādhavanīya vats with: "Two oceans...";
at the droṇakalaśa trough with: "Two wide sheets...";
at the entire King [Soma] with: "Surrounding the fire...";
at the antaryāma draught with: "For my in-breath...";
at the upāṃśusavana stone with: "For my cross-breath...";
at the aindravāyava draught with: "For my speech...";
at the maitrāvaruṇa draught with: "For my capacity and resolve...";
at the śukra and manthin draughts with: "For our two eyes...";
at the āśvina draught with: "For my hearing...";
at the āgrayaṇa draught with: "For my self...";
at the ukthya draught with: "For my limbs...";
at the clarified butter portions with: "For my splendour, O giver of splendour, clarify yourself for splendour!";

sanskrit_iast: paśubhyo me varcodā varcase pavasveti pṛṣadājyam /
meaning: पशुभ्यो मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्वेति पृषदाज्यम् /
text_mt: at the clotted butter with: "For my cattle, O giver of splendour, clarify yourself for splendour!"
[He looks at] all the draughts with: “Bestowing splendor, purify yourselves for my thriving!”

sanskrit_iast: stanābhyāṃ me varcodau varcase me pavethāmityṛtupātre /
meaning: स्तनाभ्यां मे वर्चोदौ वर्चसे मे पवेथामित्यृतुपात्रे /
text_mt: [He looks at] the two season-cups with: “Bestowing splendor, may you two purify yourselves for my two breasts, for my splendor!”

sanskrit_iast: tejase ma ojase me varcase me vīryāya me varcodā varcase pavasvetyetaiḥ pratimantramatigrāhyānṣoḍaśinamiti /
meaning: तेजसे म ओजसे मे वर्चसे मे वीर्याय मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्वेत्येतैः प्रतिमन्त्रमतिग्राह्यान्षोडशिनमिति /
text_mt: With these [formulas], formula by formula: “Bestowing splendor, purify yourself for my energy, for my splendor!”—[he looks at] the atigrāhya [draughts]; “...for my force... for my splendor... for my prowess...” [and at] the Ṣoḍaśin.
[He looks at] the droṇakalaśa with: “You are Viṣṇu's belly.”
[He looks at] the ādhavanīya with: “...of Indra.”
[He looks at] the pūtabhṛt with: “...of the All-gods.”
[He looks at] the āhavanīya with: “Who are you? What is your name?”

sanskrit_iast: soma tvāṃ vṛṇīmaha udgātāraṃ nṛcakṣasaṃ pārayā ṇa svastaye /
meaning: सोम त्वां वृणीमह उद्गातारं नृचक्षसं पारया ण स्वस्तये /
text_mt: “O Soma, we choose you as udgātṛ, who watch over men; carry us across to well-being!”

sanskrit_iast: viśvebhyo me rūpebhya iti sarvaṃ rājānam
meaning: विश्वेभ्यो मे रूपेभ्य इति सर्वं राजानम्
text_mt: “...for all my forms!”—with these [formulas he looks at] the whole king [Soma],
One who desires spiritual luster, or is diseased, or is performing a sorcery rite,
the sacrificer attends upon all the draughts with the Śṛtaṃkāra formulas.
[He attends upon] the upāṃśu and antaryāma [draughts] with: “You two are boiled; mature my out-breath and in-breath!”
[He attends upon] the upāṃśusavana [stone] with: “You are boiled; mature my diffused breath!”
[He attends upon] the cup for Indra and Vāyu with: “You are boiled; mature my speech!”

meaning: शृतो ऽसि दक्षक्रतू मे श्रीणाहीति मैत्रावरुणम् /
text_mt: [He attends upon] the cup for Mitra and Varuṇa with: “You are boiled; mature my skill and purpose!”
[He attends upon] the śukra and manthin [draughts] with: “You two are boiled; mature my two eyes!”
[He attends upon] the cup for the Aśvins with: “You are boiled; mature my hearing!”
[He attends upon] the āgrayaṇa with: “You are boiled; mature my self!”
[He attends upon] the ukthya with: “You are boiled; mature my limbs!”
[He attends upon] the dhruva with: “You are boiled; mature my life!”
[He attends upon] the clarified butters with: “You are boiled; mature my fiery energy!”
[He attends upon] the speckled butter with: “You are boiled; mature my cattle!”

sanskrit_iast: śṛtā stha puṣṭiṃ me śrīṇīyeti sarvāngrahān /
meaning: शृता स्थ पुष्टिं मे श्रीणीयेति सर्वान्ग्रहान् /
text_mt: [He attends upon] all the draughts with: “You are boiled; mature my thriving!”

sanskrit_iast: prajāpaterjaṭharamasi śṛto 'si sa mā śrīṇāhīti droṇakalaśam /
meaning: प्रजापतेर्जठरमसि शृतो ऽसि स मा श्रीणाहीति द्रोणकलशम् /
text_mt: [He attends upon] the droṇakalaśa with: “You are Prajāpati's belly; you are boiled; as such, mature me!”

sanskrit_iast: indrasya jaṭharamasi śṛto 'si sa mā śrīṇāhītyādhavanīyam /
meaning: इन्द्रस्य जठरमसि शृतो ऽसि स मा श्रीणाहीत्याधवनीयम् /
text_mt: [He attends upon] the ādhavanīya with: “You are Indra's belly; you are boiled; as such, mature me!”

sanskrit_iast: viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ jaṭharamasi śṛto 'si sa mā śrīṇāhīti pūtabhṛtam /
meaning: विश्वेषां देवानां जठरमसि शृतो ऽसि स मा श्रीणाहीति पूतभृतम् /
text_mt: [He attends upon] the pūtabhṛt with: “You are the All-gods' belly; you are boiled; as such, mature me!”

sanskrit_iast: śṛtastvaṃ śṛto 'haṃ śṛto me prāṇaḥ śṛto me 'pānaḥ śṛto me vyānaḥ śṛtaṃ me cakṣuḥ śṛtaṃ me śrotraṃ śṛtā me vāk śṛto ma ātmā śṛtaṃ me haviḥ śṛto me somaḥ śṛtā me grahāḥ //
meaning: शृतस्त्वं शृतो ऽहं शृतो मे प्राणः शृतो मे ऽपानः शृतो मे व्यानः शृतं मे चक्षुः शृतं मे श्रोत्रं शृता मे वाक् शृतो म आत्मा शृतं मे हविः शृतो मे सोमः शृता मे ग्रहाः //
text_mt: “Boiled are you; boiled am I; boiled is my out-breath; boiled is my in-breath; boiled is my diffused breath; boiled is my sight; boiled is my hearing; boiled is my speech; boiled is my self; boiled is my oblation; boiled is my soma; boiled are my draughts.”
“Drink this pressed [soma], O Indra, the supreme, immortal exhilaration!
The streams of the bright [soma] flow towards you in the seat of truth.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣā soma dyumām̐ asi vṛṣā deva vṛṣavrataḥ /
meaning: वृषा सोम द्युमाम्̐ असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः /
text_mt: A bull, O Soma, radiant are you; a bull, O god, whose vow is bullish;

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṇaste vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo vṛṣā vane vṛṣā made /
meaning: वृष्णस्ते वृष्ण्यं शवो वृषा वने वृषा मदे /
text_mt: Bullish is your mighty force; a bull in the wood, a bull in exhilaration;

sanskrit_iast: aśvo na cakrado vṛṣā saṃ gā indo samarvataḥ /
meaning: अश्वो न चक्रदो वृषा सं गा इन्दो समर्वतः /
text_mt: Like a horse you have neighed, a bull; assemble cattle, O Drop, assemble horses!

sanskrit_iast: vi no rāye duro vṛdhīti sarvaṃ rājānam
meaning: वि नो राये दुरो वृधीति सर्वं राजानम्
text_mt: Open wide the doors to wealth for us!”—with this [he attends upon] the whole king [Soma].
“Agni is a purifier; may he purify me.
Soma is a purifier; may he purify me.
Sūrya is a purifier; may he purify me.”

sanskrit_iast: upahūtā gāva upahūto 'haṃ gavāmityetairyathāliṅgamupasthāya sphyaḥ svastirityutkare vedikaraṇāni parāsyopatiṣṭhate
meaning: उपहूता गाव उपहूतो ऽहं गवामित्येतैर्यथालिङ्गमुपस्थाय स्फ्यः स्वस्तिरित्युत्करे वेदिकरणानि परास्योपतिष्ठते
text_mt: Having attended upon [the various entities] according to their characteristic marks with these formulas and with: “Invoked are the cows, invoked am I among cows,” and having cast away the tools for making the altar ground onto the rubbish heap with: “The wooden sword is well-being,” he attends upon [the others].
[He attends upon] Heaven and Earth with: “May Heaven and Earth [call] me!”
[He attends upon] the place for chanting the bahiṣpavamāna with: “May the place of chanting...”
[He attends upon] the hotṛ's assistants with: “May the priestly offices [call] me!”
He attaches everywhere [the verbal form] “may the two call,” “may he/she call,” or “may they call,” according to the characteristic mark.
[He attends upon] the āhavanīya with: “Homage to Agni, slayer of Makha!”
[He attends upon] the āgnīdhra fire with: “Homage to Rudra, slayer of Makha!”
[He attends upon] the hotṛ's hearth with: “Homage to Indra, slayer of Makha!”

sanskrit_iast: dṛḍhe sthaḥ śithire samīcī iti dyāvāpṛthivī upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: दृढे स्थः शिथिरे समीची इति द्यावापृथिवी उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: He attends upon Heaven and Earth with: “You two are firm, loose, turned towards each other.”

sanskrit_iast: sūryaṃ vāyumagniṃ yamaṃ sarasvatīṃ sadaso dvārāviti
meaning: सूर्यं वायुमग्निं यमं सरस्वतीं सदसो द्वाराविति
text_mt: [He attends upon] Sūrya, Vāyu, Agni, Yama, Sarasvatī, and the two doors of the sadas with:
“protect [me]!” or “may the two protect [me]!” which he attaches everywhere according to the grammatical mark.
About to crawl forth, he mutters: "Homage to the beholder!"
Having crawled forth: "Homage to the overseer!"
The seat of the sacrificer is to the west of the seat of the brahman,

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ sadasa iti sado namaḥ sadasaspataya iti brahmāṇaṃ namaḥ sakhīnāṃ purogāṇāmityṛtvijo namo dive namaḥ pṛthivyā iti dyāvāpṛthivī upasthāyāhe daidhiṣavyetyāyatanāttṛṇaṃ nirasyonnivata ududvataśca geṣamityupaviśati
meaning: नमः सदस इति सदो नमः सदसस्पतय इति ब्रह्माणं नमः सखीनां पुरोगाणामित्यृत्विजो नमो दिवे नमः पृथिव्या इति द्यावापृथिवी उपस्थायाहे दैधिषव्येत्यायतनात्तृणं निरस्योन्निवत उदुद्वतश्च गेषमित्युपविशति
text_mt: Having attended upon the sadas with: "Homage to the sadas!", upon the brahman with: "Homage to the lord of the sadas!", upon the officiating priests with: "Homage to the friends who lead!", [and] upon heaven and earth with: "Homage to heaven! Homage to earth!", he casts away a blade of grass from his seat with: "O son of Didhiṣu!", and sits down with: "May I go forth up from the lowlands and the heights!"

sanskrit_iast: pātaṃ mā dyāvāpṛthivī adyāhna ity upaviśya japati
meaning: पातं मा द्यावापृथिवी अद्याह्न इत्य् उपविश्य जपति
text_mt: Having sat down, he mutters: "Protect me, O heaven and earth, on this day!"
With: "The fathers have come, he is possessed of fathers," he looks around at the southern half.
Both mutter these [mantras], the adhvaryu and the sacrificer,
At this point, the pratiprasthātṛ sets down the savanīya [offerings].
With them the adhvaryu proceeds.
From all the sacrificial cakes he cuts off portions for the deities into the juhū spoon,
[and] the portions for the Sviṣṭakṛt into the upabhṛt spoon.

sanskrit_iast: prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyendrāya puroḍāśānāmanubrūhi prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyendrāya puroḍāśānāṃ preṣyeti saṃpraiṣau /
meaning: प्रातः प्रातःसावस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशानामनुब्रूहि प्रातः प्रातःसावस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशानां प्रेष्येति संप्रैषौ /
text_mt: "Recite for Indra the invitatory verse for the sacrificial cakes of the morning pressing at dawn!" [and] "Prompt for Indra the consecratory verse for the sacrificial cakes of the morning pressing at dawn!"—these are the two ritual calls;

sanskrit_iast: prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyendrāya puroḍāśānāmavadīyamānānāmanubrūhi prātaḥ prātahsāvasyendrāya puroḍāśānprasthitānpreṣyeti vā
meaning: प्रातः प्रातःसावस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशानामवदीयमानानामनुब्रूहि प्रातः प्रातह्सावस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशान्प्रस्थितान्प्रेष्येति वा
text_mt: or: "Recite for Indra the invitatory verse for the sacrificial cakes being cut of the morning pressing at dawn! Prompt for Indra the consecratory verse for the sacrificial cakes set forward of the morning pressing at dawn!"
The ritual calls for the Sviṣṭakṛt are: "Recite for Agni!" [and] "Prompt for Agni!"
Having cut off the prāśitra portion [and] the iḍā, but not the sacrificer’s portion,

sanskrit_iast: hotra iḍāṃ hṛtvā havirdhānaṃ gacchansaṃpreṣyati vāyava indravāyubhyāmanubrūhīti
meaning: होत्र इडां हृत्वा हविर्धानं गच्छन्संप्रेष्यति वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्यामनुब्रूहीति
text_mt: [and] having taken the iḍā to the hotṛ, he issues the ritual call as he goes to the havirdhāna shed: "Recite for Vāyu, for Indra and Vāyu!"

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si vākṣasadasītyādityapātreṇa pratiprasthātā droṇakalaśādaindravāyavasya pratinigrāhyaṃ gṛhītvā na sādayati
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि वाक्षसदसीत्यादित्यपात्रेण प्रतिप्रस्थाता द्रोणकलशादैन्द्रवायवस्य प्रतिनिग्राह्यं गृहीत्वा न सादयति
text_mt: With: "You are taken with a support; you are the two axle-seats," the pratiprasthātṛ takes the counter-draught of the Aindravāyava draught from the droṇakalaśa with the vessel of the Āditya draught, but does not set it down.

sanskrit_iast: aindravāyavamādāyādhvaryurdroṇakalaśācca pariplavayā rājānamubhau niṣkramya dakṣiṇato 'vasthāya dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhimanvavahṛtyādhvaro yajño 'yamastu devā iti pariplavayāghāramāghārayati yathopāṃśurhuto bhavati
meaning: ऐन्द्रवायवमादायाध्वर्युर्द्रोणकलशाच्च परिप्लवया राजानमुभौ निष्क्रम्य दक्षिणतो ऽवस्थाय दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिमन्ववहृत्याध्वरो यज्ञो ऽयमस्तु देवा इति परिप्लवयाघारमाघारयति यथोपांशुर्हुतो भवति
text_mt: Taking the Aindravāyava draught, and the adhvaryu taking the king [Soma] from the droṇakalaśa with the pariplavā ladle, both step out, take their stand to the south, reach along the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, and he pours out a continuous stream with the pariplavā with: "May this sacrifice be non-violent, O gods!", so that it is offered silently.
At this place he offers all the soma oblations.

sanskrit_iast: yato manyetānabhikramya hoṣyāmīti tattiṣṭhansrucaṃ vāyavyaṃ camasaṃ vānvārabhyāśrāvayet /
meaning: यतो मन्येतानभिक्रम्य होष्यामीति तत्तिष्ठन्स्रुचं वायव्यं चमसं वान्वारभ्याश्रावयेत् /
text_mt: Standing where he thinks, "Without stepping forward I shall offer," he should take hold of the ladle, the vāyavya vessel, or the goblet, and cause [the agnīdh] to call for the response;

sanskrit_iast: grahaṃ vā gṛhītvā camasaṃ vonnīya stotramupākuryād ity atyantapradeśaḥ
meaning: ग्रहं वा गृहीत्वा चमसं वोन्नीय स्तोत्रमुपाकुर्याद् इत्य् अत्यन्तप्रदेशः
text_mt: or having drawn a draught or drawn [soma into] a goblet, he should introduce the chant: this is an universal rule.

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya pratyāśrāvite saṃpreṣyati vāyava indravāyubhyāṃ preṣyeti
meaning: आश्राव्य प्रत्याश्राविते संप्रेष्यति वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्यां प्रेष्येति
text_mt: Having made the call and when the response is given, he issues the ritual call: "Prompt [the hotṛ] for Vāyu, for Indra and Vāyu!"
At the second vaṣaṭ-call both of them make the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: yadi manyeta yajamānaḥ pūrvo mātikrānto bhrātṛvya iti
meaning: यदि मन्येत यजमानः पूर्वो मातिक्रान्तो भ्रातृव्य इति
text_mt: If the sacrificer should think, "My rival has surpassed me beforehand,"
he should, prior to the oblation, press down the finger with his thumb with: "He who acts maliciously toward us, O Indra and Vāyu!";
or if [the rival is] posterior, [he should press down] the thumb with his finger.

sanskrit_iast: hute cādityamupatiṣṭhate bhūrasi śreṣṭho raśmīnāṃ prāṇapāḥ prāṇaṃ me pāhīti
meaning: हुते चादित्यमुपतिष्ठते भूरसि श्रेष्ठो रश्मीनां प्राणपाः प्राणं मे पाहीति
text_mt: And when the offering is made, he attends upon the sun with: "You are being, the best of the rays, protector of the out-breath; protect my out-breath!"
Then the pratiprasthātṛ pours the residue into the vessel of the adhvaryu,
[or] the adhvaryu into that of the pratiprasthātṛ,
With: "For the gods, thee!", the pratiprasthātṛ pours the residue into the Āditya tub with the Āditya vessel.

sanskrit_iast: grahamadhvaryurādāya kṣipraṃ hotāramabhidrutya mayi vasuriti grahaṃ hotre prayacchati
meaning: ग्रहमध्वर्युरादाय क्षिप्रं होतारमभिद्रुत्य मयि वसुरिति ग्रहं होत्रे प्रयच्छति
text_mt: The adhvaryu, taking the draught, runs swiftly toward the hotṛ and hands over the draught to the hotṛ with: "In me is wealth."

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva hotā pratigṛhya dakṣiṇa ūrāvāsādya hastābhyāṃ nigṛhyāste
meaning: एतेनैव होता प्रतिगृह्य दक्षिण ऊरावासाद्य हस्ताभ्यां निगृह्यास्ते
text_mt: Accepting it with this very [formula], placing it upon his right thigh, and holding it firmly with both hands, the hotṛ remains seated.
In this way the two proceed with the two subsequent draughts.
The continuous stream and the second vaṣaṭ-call do not take place.
The ritual calls are according to the deity.

The drawing of the counter-draughts, the pressing down [of finger or thumb], the attendance upon the sun, the pouring [of the residue], and the handings-over are performed with the respective subsequent mantras.

sanskrit_iast: vibhūrasi śreṣṭho raśmīnāṃ vyānapā vyānaṃ me pāhīti tṛtīya ādityopasthānaḥ
meaning: विभूरसि श्रेष्ठो रश्मीनां व्यानपा व्यानं मे पाहीति तृतीय आदित्योपस्थानः
text_mt: "You are manifold being, the best of the rays, protector of the diffused breath; protect my diffused breath!"—this is the third attendance upon the sun.
With: "O Viṣṇu of wide strides, this is your soma; protect it!" the pratiprasthātṛ covers the Āditya tub with the Āditya vessel.

meaning: आश्विनं होत्रे प्रदाय हविर्धानं गच्छन्संप्रेष्यत्युन्नीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहीति
text_mt: Having handed over the Āśvina draught to the hotṛ, as he goes to the havirdhāna shed he issues the ritual call: "Recite for those being drawn [into goblets]!"
He draws [soma into] nine goblets headed by the goblet of the hotṛ.
Having made an underlayer from the droṇakalaśa and having drawn [soma] from the pūtabhṛt, he sprinkles over it from the droṇakalaśa.
This is the rule for all the goblets.
At the time of drawing the stream, there are optional rules for the draughts for twin deities.

sanskrit_iast: yadi manyeta yajamānaḥ pūrvo mātikrānto bhrātṛvya iti pratiprasthānena pūrvo gṛhītvā pūrvo hutvā pūrvaḥ sādayeti
meaning: यदि मन्येत यजमानः पूर्वो मातिक्रान्तो भ्रातृव्य इति प्रतिप्रस्थानेन पूर्वो गृहीत्वा पूर्वो हुत्वा पूर्वः सादयेति
text_mt: If the sacrificer should think, "My rival has surpassed me beforehand," [he should instruct]: "Drawing first with the pratiprasthātṛ's vessel, offering first, set it down first!"

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta samāvadvīryamenaṃ bhrātṛvyeṇa kuryāmiti prabāhuggṛhītvā prabāhuktiṣṭhadbhyāṃ hotavyam /
meaning: यदि कामयेत समावद्वीर्यमेनं भ्रातृव्येण कुर्यामिति प्रबाहुग्गृहीत्वा प्रबाहुक्तिष्ठद्भ्यां होतव्यम् /
text_mt: If he should desire, "May I make him of equal power with his rival," drawing simultaneously, they should offer while standing side by side.
Having offered simultaneously, they should set them down simultaneously.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayetāvagatamaparundhyuraparuddho 'vagaccheditīdamahamamumāmuṣyāyaṇamamuṣya putramamuṣyā viśa udūhāmītyadhvaryupātramudūhyedamahamamumāmuṣyāyaṇamamuṣya putramamuṣyāṃ viśi sādayāmīti tasminpratiprasthānaṃ sādayet
meaning: यदि कामयेतावगतमपरुन्ध्युरपरुद्धो ऽवगच्छेदितीदमहममुमामुष्यायणममुष्य पुत्रममुष्या विश उदूहामीत्यध्वर्युपात्रमुदूह्येदमहममुमामुष्यायणममुष्य पुत्रममुष्यां विशि सादयामीति तस्मिन्प्रतिप्रस्थानं सादयेत्
text_mt: If he should desire: "May they exclude one who has been accepted, or may one who has been excluded be accepted," having pushed aside the adhvaryu's vessel with: "Here I push aside so-and-so, belonging to such-and-such lineage, the son of so-and-so, from the clan of so-and-so," he should set down the pratiprasthātṛ's vessel in that place with: "Here I settle so-and-so, belonging to such-and-such lineage, the son of so-and-so, in the clan of so-and-so."
If they are for a wish, the counter-draughts should be drawn with separate vessels.
Then the two proceed with the Śukra and Manthin draughts.

sanskrit_iast: stuto 'si janadhā devāstvā śukrapāḥ praṇayantviti śukramadhvaryurādatte /
meaning: स्तुतो ऽसि जनधा देवास्त्वा शुक्रपाः प्रणयन्त्विति शुक्रमध्वर्युरादत्ते /
text_mt: With: "Puffed up are you, supporter of the folk; let the gods who drink the pure draught lead you forward!", the adhvaryu takes the Śukra draught.

sanskrit_iast: stuto 'si janadhā devāstvā manthipāḥ praṇayantviti manthinaṃ pratiprasthātā /
meaning: स्तुतो ऽसि जनधा देवास्त्वा मन्थिपाः प्रणयन्त्विति मन्थिनं प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: With: "Puffed up are you, supporter of the folk; let the gods who drink the mixed draught lead you forward!", the pratiprasthātṛ [takes] the Manthin draught,
and the camasādhvaryus the goblets.
Having covered the two [draughts] with two sprinkled chips [of wood], they brush off the dust beneath them with two unsprinkled chips, with: "Expelled are Śaṇḍa and Marka together with so-and-so!";

sanskrit_iast: apanuttaḥ śaṇḍa iti vādhvaryurdveṣyaṃ manasā dhyāyan /
meaning: अपनुत्तः शण्ड इति वाध्वर्युर्द्वेष्यं मनसा ध्यायन् /
text_mt: or the adhvaryu, meditating in his mind upon the enemy: "Expelled is Śaṇḍa!";
the pratiprasthātṛ: "Expelled is Marka!"
Covering the two [cups], both [priests] go out towards the east.
They advance forward with: “Traverse the wide intermediate space!”
“Allied with Indra, with wrath, repelling the attacking foe,

sanskrit_iast: ghnatā vṛtrāṇyapratīti śukraṃ yajamāno 'nvārabhata ā homāt
meaning: घ्नता वृत्राण्यप्रतीति शुक्रं यजमानो ऽन्वारभत आ होमात्
text_mt: slaying enemies, irresistible”—with this formula, the sacrificer touches the śukra [cup] from behind until the offering.

sanskrit_iast: apareṇottaravediṃ grahāvaratnī vā saṃdhatto brahma saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvataṃ kṣattraṃ saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvatamiṣaṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatamūrjaṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvataṃ rayiṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvataṃ puṣṭiṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvataṃ prajāṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvataṃ paśūnsaṃdhattaṃ tānme jinvatamiti
meaning: अपरेणोत्तरवेदिं ग्रहावरत्नी वा संधत्तो ब्रह्म संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतं क्षत्त्रं संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतमिषं संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतमूर्जं संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतं रयिं संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतं पुष्टिं संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतं प्रजां संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतं पशून्संधत्तं तान्मे जिन्वतमिति
text_mt: To the west of the high altar, they touch the two draughts or their elbows together, saying: “Unite spiritual power, gladden that for me! Unite lordly power, gladden that for me! Unite nourishment, gladden that for me! Unite vigor, gladden that for me! Unite wealth, gladden that for me! Unite thriving, gladden that for me! Unite offspring, gladden that for me! Unite cattle, gladden them for me!”
With [the words,] 'You are unassailable,' having seized the uttaravedi with their thumbs, they walk around the uttaravedi as if separating.

sanskrit_iast: suvīrāḥ prajāḥ prajanayanparīhi śukraḥ śukraśociṣeti dakṣiṇenādhvaryuḥ pratipadyate /
meaning: सुवीराः प्रजाः प्रजनयन्परीहि शुक्रः शुक्रशोचिषेति दक्षिणेनाध्वर्युः प्रतिपद्यते /
text_mt: The adhvaryu proceeds southwards with [the words,] 'Begetting offspring rich in heroes, go around, O Śukra, with bright luster.'

sanskrit_iast: suprajāḥ prajāḥ prajanayanparīhi manthī manthiśociṣetyuttareṇa pratiprasthātā /
meaning: सुप्रजाः प्रजाः प्रजनयन्परीहि मन्थी मन्थिशोचिषेत्युत्तरेण प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ [proceeds] northwards with [the words,] 'Begetting offspring rich in good offspring, go around, O Manthin, with stirring luster.'

sanskrit_iast: agreṇottaravediṃ grahāvaratnī vā saṃdhattaḥ saṃjagmānau diva ā pṛthivyā āyuḥ saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvataṃ prāṇaṃ samdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatamapānaṃ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvataṃ vyānaṃ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvataṃ cakṣuḥ saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvataṃ śrotraṃ saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvataṃ manaḥ saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvataṃ vācaṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatamiti
meaning: अग्रेणोत्तरवेदिं ग्रहावरत्नी वा संधत्तः संजग्मानौ दिव आ पृथिव्या आयुः संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतं प्राणं सम्धत्तं तं मे जिन्वतमपानं संधत्तं तं मे जिन्वतं व्यानं संधत्तं तं मे जिन्वतं चक्षुः संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतं श्रोत्रं संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतं मनः संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतं वाचं संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतमिति
text_mt: In front of the uttaravedi they join the two draughts or their elbows [with the words,] 'Coming together from heaven [and] from earth, join life, quicken that for me; join out-breath, quicken that for me; join in-breath, quicken that for me; join diffused breath, quicken that for me; join sight, quicken that for me; join hearing, quicken that for me; join mind, quicken that for me; join speech, quicken that for me.'

sanskrit_iast: athaināvadhvaryurabhimantrayata āyu stha āyurme dhattamāyuryajñāya dhattamāyuryajñapataye dhattaṃ prāṇa sthaḥ prāṇaṃ me dhattaṃ prāṇaṃ yajñāya dhattaṃ prāṇaṃ yajñapataye dhattaṃ cakṣu sthaścakṣurme dhattaṃ cakṣuryajñāya dhattaṃ cakṣuryajñapataye dhattaṃ śrotraṃ shtaḥ śrotraṃ me dhattaṃ śrotraṃ yajñāya dhattaṃ śrotraṃ yajñapataye dhattam
meaning: अथैनावध्वर्युरभिमन्त्रयत आयु स्थ आयुर्मे धत्तमायुर्यज्ञाय धत्तमायुर्यज्ञपतये धत्तं प्राण स्थः प्राणं मे धत्तं प्राणं यज्ञाय धत्तं प्राणं यज्ञपतये धत्तं चक्षु स्थश्चक्षुर्मे धत्तं चक्षुर्यज्ञाय धत्तं चक्षुर्यज्ञपतये धत्तं श्रोत्रं स्ह्तः श्रोत्रं मे धत्तं श्रोत्रं यज्ञाय धत्तं श्रोत्रं यज्ञपतये धत्तम्
text_mt: Then the adhvaryu addresses them: 'You two are life, bestow life on me, bestow life on the sacrifice, bestow life on the lord of the sacrifice; you two are out-breath, bestow out-breath on me, bestow out-breath on the sacrifice, bestow out-breath on the lord of the sacrifice; you two are sight, bestow sight on me, bestow sight on the sacrifice, bestow sight on the lord of the sacrifice; you two are hearing, bestow hearing on me, bestow hearing on the sacrifice, bestow hearing on the lord of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: tau devau śukrāmanthinau kalpayataṃ daivīrviśaḥ kalpayataṃ mānuṣīriṣamūrjamasmāsu dhattaṃ prāṇānpaśuṣu prajāṃ mayi ca yajamāne ceti
meaning: तौ देवौ शुक्रामन्थिनौ कल्पयतं दैवीर्विशः कल्पयतं मानुषीरिषमूर्जमस्मासु धत्तं प्राणान्पशुषु प्रजां मयि च यजमाने चेति
text_mt: 'Do you two gods, Śukra and Manthin, arrange the divine clans, arrange the human ones; bestow food and nourishment upon us, breath upon cattle, and offspring upon me and upon the sacrificer.'

sanskrit_iast: aprokṣitau śakalau bahirvedi nirasyato nirastau śaṇḍāmarkau sahāmuneti /
meaning: अप्रोक्षितौ शकलौ बहिर्वेदि निरस्यतो निरस्तौ शण्डामर्कौ सहामुनेति /
text_mt: They cast out outside the altar ground the two unbesprinkled chips [of wood] with [the formula,] 'Cast out are Śaṇḍa and Marka together with so-and-so.'

sanskrit_iast: nirastaḥ śaṇḍa iti vādhvaryurdveṣyaṃ manasā dhyāyan /
meaning: निरस्तः शण्ड इति वाध्वर्युर्द्वेष्यं मनसा ध्यायन् /
text_mt: Or the adhvaryu [casts out one] with 'Cast out is Śaṇḍa,' mentally meditating on the person to be hated;
the pratiprasthātṛ [casts out the other] with 'Cast out is Marka.'
The adhvaryu [puts his on] with 'You are the kindling stick of Śukra;'
the pratiprasthātṛ with 'You are the kindling stick of Manthin.'

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya pratyāśrāvite saṃpreṣyati prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasya śukravato manthivato madhuścuta indrāya somānprasthitānpreṣya madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasādhvaryavo vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛtāñjuhuta hotrakāṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ sakṛtsakṛddhutvā śukrasyābhyunnīyopāvartadhvamiti
meaning: आश्राव्य प्रत्याश्राविते संप्रेष्यति प्रातः प्रातःसावस्य शुक्रवतो मन्थिवतो मधुश्चुत इन्द्राय सोमान्प्रस्थितान्प्रेष्य मध्यतःकारिणां चमसाध्वर्यवो वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृताञ्जुहुत होत्रकाणां चमसाध्वर्यवः सकृत्सकृद्धुत्वा शुक्रस्याभ्युन्नीयोपावर्तध्वमिति
text_mt: Having called for response and the response having been given, he issues the ritual call: 'For the morning pressing, for Indra, accompanied by Śukra, accompanied by Manthin, dripping with sweetness, prompt the somas set forth; O camasādhvaryus of the principal officiants, sacrifice at the vaṣaṭ-call and at the secondary vaṣaṭ-call; O camasādhvaryus of the minor priests, having sacrificed once each, having poured in [soma] from the Śukra, turn back.'
They act according to the ritual call.
Facing west, in front, the two adhvaryus sacrifice.
Facing east, in the rear, the camasādhvaryus sacrifice with their goblets.
The offering of the Śukra and Manthin draughts is made with a distinctive recited formula:

sanskrit_iast: sa prathamaḥ saṃkṛtirviśvakarmā sa prathamo mitro varuṇo agniḥ /
meaning: स प्रथमः संकृतिर्विश्वकर्मा स प्रथमो मित्रो वरुणो अग्निः /
text_mt: 'He is the first creator, Viśvakarman; he is the first Mitra, Varuṇa, Agni;

sanskrit_iast: sa prathamo bṛhaspatiścikitvāṃstasmā indrāya sutamājuhomi svāhetyadhvaryurjuhoti /
meaning: स प्रथमो बृहस्पतिश्चिकित्वांस्तस्मा इन्द्राय सुतमाजुहोमि स्वाहेत्यध्वर्युर्जुहोति /
text_mt: he is the first Bṛhaspati, the wise; for that Indra I offer the pressed [juice], svāhā!'—with this the adhvaryu offers;
'For that Sūrya I offer the pressed [juice], svāhā!'—with this the pratiprasthātṛ.
Either with a secondary vaṣaṭ-call or without a secondary vaṣaṭ-call.

sanskrit_iast: api vā sūdavacchukrapātramāyatane sādayitvottarārdhātpratiprasthātā bahiḥparidhyaṅgāraṃ nirvartya tasminmanthinaḥ saṃsrāvaṃ juhotyeṣa te rudra bhāgo yaṃ nirayācathā iti
meaning: अपि वा सूदवच्छुक्रपात्रमायतने सादयित्वोत्तरार्धात्प्रतिप्रस्थाता बहिःपरिध्यङ्गारं निर्वर्त्य तस्मिन्मन्थिनः संस्रावं जुहोत्येष ते रुद्र भागो यं निरयाचथा इति
text_mt: Or having placed the Śukra vessel in its place with its residue, from the northern half the pratiprasthātṛ, having rolled out an ember outside the enclosing sticks, offers upon it the residue of the Manthin [with the formula,] 'This is your share, O Rudra, which you requested.'
This which is the Manthin vessel is an afflicted vessel.
Whichever of the officiating priests he hates, to him he should bring it.
'He meets with affliction right here,' so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ saṃpreṣyati praitu hotuścamasaḥ pra brahmaṇaḥ prodgātuḥ pra yajamānasya /
meaning: ततः संप्रेष्यति प्रैतु होतुश्चमसः प्र ब्रह्मणः प्रोद्गातुः प्र यजमानस्य /
text_mt: Then he issues the ritual call: 'Let the goblet of the hotṛ go forward, forward that of the brahman, forward that of the udgātṛ, forward that of the sacrificer;'
'Forward that of the udgātṛs,' some recite;
or 'Let those of the sadasyas go forward.'
Then the hotrakas perform their accompanying offerings.

sanskrit_iast: tasmai camasādhvaryavaḥ svaṃsvaṃ camasaṃ droṇakalaśādabhyunnīya haranti
meaning: तस्मै चमसाध्वर्यवः स्वंस्वं चमसं द्रोणकलशादभ्युन्नीय हरन्ति
text_mt: For him the camasādhvaryus bring each their own goblet, having filled it from the droṇakalaśa.

sanskrit_iast: maitrāvaruṇacamasamādāyāhavanīyaṃ gatvāśrāvya pratyāśrāvite saṃpreṣyati hotaryaja praśāstariti vā
meaning: मैत्रावरुणचमसमादायाहवनीयं गत्वाश्राव्य प्रत्याश्राविते संप्रेष्यति होतर्यज प्रशास्तरिति वा
text_mt: Having taken the goblet of the maitrāvaruṇa and gone to the āhavanīya, having called for response and the response having been given, he issues the ritual call: 'Hotṛ, recite the consecratory verse,' or 'Praśāstṛ [recite]!'
Having offered at the vaṣaṭ-call and at the secondary vaṣaṭ-call, he takes away the portion to be partaken of.
In this way he proceeds with the subsequent ones.
At the second he issues the ritual call: 'Brahman, recite the consecratory verse;'
at the fourth: 'Neṣṭṛ, recite the consecratory verse;'
Everywhere there is a secondary vaṣaṭ-call, with the exception of the draughts for two deities, the season draughts, the Āditya draught, the Sāvitra draught, and the Pātnīvata draught.
Having taken the goblet of the agnīdh and gone to the sadas, he announces: 'The agnīdh has sacrificed!'

sanskrit_iast: sa bhadramakaryo naḥ somaṃ pāyayiṣyatītītare pratyāhuḥ
meaning: स भद्रमकर्यो नः सोमं पाययिष्यतीतीतरे प्रत्याहुः
text_mt: 'He has done well, who will make us drink soma,' the others say in reply.

sanskrit_iast: yadi rājanyaṃ vaiśyaṃ vā yājayetsa yadi somaṃ bibhakṣayiṣennyagrodhastibhinīrāgṛtya saṃpiṣya dadhanyunmṛjya camaseṣu hūyamāneṣvantaḥparidhyaṅgāraṃ nirvartyaitasya camasasya darbhataruṇenopahatyāhaṃ tvadasmi madasi tvamityaṅgāre hutvā tamasmai bhakṣaṃ prayacchet
meaning: यदि राजन्यं वैश्यं वा याजयेत्स यदि सोमं बिभक्षयिषेन्न्यग्रोधस्तिभिनीरागृत्य संपिष्य दधन्युन्मृज्य चमसेषु हूयमानेष्वन्तःपरिध्यङ्गारं निर्वर्त्यैतस्य चमसस्य दर्भतरुणेनोपहत्याहं त्वदस्मि मदसि त्वमित्यङ्गारे हुत्वा तमस्मै भक्षं प्रयच्छेत्
text_mt: If he performs the sacrifice for a kṣatriya or a vaiśya, [and] if he wishes to partake of soma, having brought aerial sprouts of a banyan tree, crushed them, and wiped them in curds, while the goblets are being offered, having rolled out an ember inside the enclosing sticks, having taken up [a portion] of this goblet with a tender darbha blade, having made an offering on the ember with 'I am you, you are I,' he should hand over to him that portion for partaking.
Among those who are assembled at a vessel, the maker of the vaṣaṭ-call partakes first.

sanskrit_iast: bhakṣehīti bhakṣamāhriyamāṇaṃ pratīkṣyāśvinostvā bāhubhyāṃ saghyāsamiti pratigṛhya nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā deva sometyavekṣya mandrābhibhūtiriti prātaḥsavane sarvānaindrānbhakṣayati /
meaning: भक्षेहीति भक्षमाह्रियमाणं प्रतीक्ष्याश्विनोस्त्वा बाहुभ्यां सघ्यासमिति प्रतिगृह्य नृचक्षसं त्वा देव सोमेत्यवेक्ष्य मन्द्राभिभूतिरिति प्रातःसवने सर्वानैन्द्रान्भक्षयति /
text_mt: Looking at the portion being brought with 'Come, O portion to be partaken,' taking it with 'May I grasp you with the arms of the Aśvins,' gazing at it with 'You, O divine Soma, looking upon men,' he partakes of all the draughts belonging to Indra at the morning pressing with 'Joyful, overcoming;'
[he partakes of] the nārāśaṃsa goblets with '...of [the soma] drunk by Narāśaṃsa;'
at the midday pressing he partakes of all the draughts belonging to Indra with '...accompanied by the troop of Rudras;'
[he partakes of] the nārāśaṃsa goblets with '...of [the soma] drunk by Narāśaṃsa;'
at the third pressing he partakes of all the draughts belonging to Indra with '...accompanied by the troop of Ādityas;'
[he partakes of] the nārāśaṃsa goblets with '...of [the soma] drunk by Narāśaṃsa.'
Whatever precedes 'accompanied by the troop of Vasus' he attaches everywhere.
Even for those belonging to other deities, [he says,] '...of [the soma] drunk by Indra;'

sanskrit_iast: vāgjuṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatviti sarvasomānāṃ bhakṣaṇameke samāmananti
meaning: वाग्जुषाणा सोमस्य तृप्यत्विति सर्वसोमानां भक्षणमेके समामनन्ति
text_mt: Some recite the partaking formula for all somas as: 'May speech, taking pleasure, be satisfied with the soma;'
or 'May the goddess Speech be satisfied with the soma.'

sanskrit_iast: hinva me gātrā hariva iti bhakṣayitvā nābhideśānabhimṛśante
meaning: हिन्व मे गात्रा हरिव इति भक्षयित्वा नाभिदेशानभिमृशन्ते
text_mt: Having partaken, they touch their navel regions with 'Quicken my limbs, O lord of bay horses!'
Soma must not be drunk by one who has not been invited;
he surely becomes deprived of the drinking of soma.
He addresses [the other] by his ritual title: 'So-and-so, invite [me]!'
"Invited!" is the response.
He asks for an invitation from those who partake in the same course,
He partakes of the Aindravāyava draught from the eastern side, bringing it close to the vital breaths.
He partakes of the Maitrāvaruṇa draught from the eastern side, bringing it close to the two eyes.
Moving it all around, he partakes of the Āśvina draught, bringing it close to the two ears.

sanskrit_iast: avyutsṛjantau pātraṃ dviraindravāyavaṃ bhakṣayato bhakṣayanti bhakṣayati vā /
meaning: अव्युत्सृजन्तौ पात्रं द्विरैन्द्रवायवं भक्षयतो भक्षयन्ति भक्षयति वा /
text_mt: Without letting go of the vessel, the two partake twice of the Aindravāyava draught, or [all of them] partake, or [each] partakes.
With regard to those [texts where it says], "the two partake," the meaning is the adhvaryu and the hotṛ.
Where it says, "they partake," the meaning is the two adhvaryus and the hotṛ.
Where it says, "he partakes," the meaning is each one by himself.
Having partaken, they pour the residue into the hotṛ's goblet, whether the goblet has been partaken of or not partaken of.
Then they let go of the vessel.
He places a piece of the sacrificial cake into the vessel of the Aindravāyava draught;
curdled milk into that of the Maitrāvaruṇa draught;
He sets them down on the northern track of the southern cart for the soma-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: ā tṛtīyasavanātpariśere yajñasya saṃtatyā iti vijñāyate
meaning: आ तृतीयसवनात्परिशेरे यज्ञस्य संतत्या इति विज्ञायते
text_mt: "They remain until the third pressing for the continuity of the sacrifice," it is recognized in tradition.
At this point some teach the cutting off of the portions of the iḍā.
At this point the hotṛ invokes the iḍā.
The holders of the goblets lift up their goblets.
The hotṛ's goblet touches the iḍā.
Those who partake in the archetypal rite consume [the iḍā] once it is invoked.
He sets aside a piece of the sacrificial cake for the acchāvāka.
In the Āgnīdhra fire-shed they consume the remains of the sacrificial offerings.

sanskrit_iast: atra savanīyānāṃ śākhāpraharaṇaṃ vājinacaryāntarvedi yajamānasya vedābhimarśanaṃ piṣṭalepaphalīkaraṇahomau patnyā vedaprāsanaṃ praṇītāsu mārjanamupaveṣodasanaṃ kapālavimocanamiti kriyante
meaning: अत्र सवनीयानां शाखाप्रहरणं वाजिनचर्यान्तर्वेदि यजमानस्य वेदाभिमर्शनं पिष्टलेपफलीकरणहोमौ पत्न्या वेदप्रासनं प्रणीतासु मार्जनमुपवेषोदसनं कपालविमोचनमिति क्रियन्ते
text_mt: At this point the following rites belonging to the press-offerings are performed: throwing the branch into the fire, the performance with the whey, touching the grass bush inside the altar ground by the sacrificer, the two offerings of the flour-paste and the chaff, casting the grass bush by the wife, sprinkling with the consecrated waters, throwing away the wooden poker, and removing the potsherds.
For an incidental rule does not postpone a specific one belonging to these.
The hotṛ obtains his share of partaking by virtue of the vaṣaṭ-call;
the adhvaryu by virtue of offering and pressing [the soma];
They also obtain a share of partaking by virtue of the designation [of the goblet].
The hotṛ partakes once of all the goblets;
The subordinate hotṛ priests partake twice of their own respective goblets.
The adhvaryu partakes in return once of those that have been partaken of, in the original order.
They swell those [goblets] that have been partaken of with the verse: "Swell, let [strength] gather unto you..."
The first two pressings have two nārāśaṃsa rounds;
the third pressing has one nārāśaṃsa round.
They place those that have been partaken of and swelled underneath the southern cart for the soma-offerings, in the hanging frame.

meaning: उपविशत्यच्छावाको बहिः सदसो ऽग्रेण स्वं धिष्णियम्
text_mt: The acchāvāka sits down outside the sadas in front of his own dhiṣṇiya hearth.
Offering him the piece of sacrificial cake, [the adhvaryu] says: "O acchāvāka, speak what you have to say!"

sanskrit_iast: yadāsya vijānātyupo asmānbrāhmaṇānbrāhmaṇā hvayadhvamityathainaṃ hotra āvedayatyacchāvāko vā ayamupahavamicchate taṃ hotarupahvayasveti
meaning: यदास्य विजानात्युपो अस्मान्ब्राह्मणान्ब्राह्मणा ह्वयध्वमित्यथैनं होत्र आवेदयत्यच्छावाको वा अयमुपहवमिच्छते तं होतरुपह्वयस्वेति
text_mt: When he understands from him, "O brahmins, invite us brahmins!", then he reports him to the hotṛ: "This acchāvāka desires an invitation; invite him, O hotṛ!"

sanskrit_iast: uta no gāva upahūtā upahūteti hoturabhijñāyonnīyamānāyānubrūhyacchāvākasya camasādhvaryo unnayasvobhayataḥ śukraṃ kuruṣveti
meaning: उत नो गाव उपहूता उपहूतेति होतुरभिज्ञायोन्नीयमानायानुब्रूह्यच्छावाकस्य चमसाध्वर्यो उन्नयस्वोभयतः शुक्रं कुरुष्वेति
text_mt: Upon recognizing the hotṛ's [words], "And to us the cows are invited, invited!", [the adhvaryu calls]: "Recite for [the soma] being drawn up! Camasādhvaryu of the acchāvāka, draw it up; make it clear on both sides!"
Taking it and going to the āhavanīya, having called for the response and when the response has been given, he gives the ritual call: "Acchāvāka, recite the consecratory verse!"
Having offered at the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call, he brings the partaking share.
He does not ask for an invitation from him.
If he should ask for an invitation from him, he should say to him: "Partake!"

sanskrit_iast: bhakṣitāpyāyitamantarā neṣṭurāgnīdhrasya ca camasau sādyitvartugrahaiḥ pracarataḥ
meaning: भक्षिताप्यायितमन्तरा नेष्टुराग्नीध्रस्य च चमसौ साद्यित्वर्तुग्रहैः प्रचरतः
text_mt: Having set down the two goblets of the neṣṭṛ and the āgnīdh, which have been partaken of and swelled, between [the two fires], they proceed with the seasonal draughts.
They are drawn from the wooden trough;
Over the remnants of the earlier ones they draw the subsequent ones.

meaning: पूर्वो ऽध्वर्युर्गृह्णाति जघन्यः प्रतिप्रस्थातोपयामगृहीतो ऽसि मधुश्चेत्येतैः प्रतिमन्त्रम्
text_mt: The adhvaryu draws first, the pratiprasthātṛ last, with each respective mantra: "You are taken with a support; you are Madhu..."
"For Madhu you, for Mādhava you," some teach.
All [mantras] have the upayāma-formula at the beginning.
They should not cross behind one another.
The adhvaryu enters on the southern side in the well-known manner.
In the established manner, the pratiprasthātṛ [enters] by the north.
As the adhvaryu is entering, the pratiprasthātṛ passes around [him] holding the draught;
For the first three [draughts], the adhvaryu issues the ritual call: “Prompt [the hotṛ] with the season-formula!”
Having turned around the mouths of both vessels, the adhvaryu [issues the ritual call] for two [draughts]: “Prompt [the hotṛ] with the season-formulas!”
Having turned them back again, the adhvaryu once [issues the ritual call]: “Prompt [the hotṛ] with the season-formula!”
Twelve, thirteen, or fourteen [draughts] are drawn.
When there are twelve, the first two are drawn together;
When there are thirteen, drawing and offering of the last two are done together.
Likewise when there are fourteen, of the first two and of the last two.
With “Thou art Saṃsarpa, for Aṃhaspatya thee,” the thirteenth and fourteenth are drawn separately.

Having recognized [the calls]: “O two adhvaryus, recite the consecratory verse!” [and] “O master of the house, recite the consecratory verse!”, in both cases he issues the further ritual call: “O hotṛ, recite the consecratory verse for this!”
Likewise the master of the house at the end of his own ritual call.
Having poured the remnants of the offerings together as in the case of the two-deity [draughts], the adhvaryu draws the draught for Indra and Agni with the unemptied vessel.
“O Indra and Agni, come to the pressed [soma]” are the [verses for] drawing and settling.
The pratiprasthātṛ brings the portion for partaking.
Both adhvaryus partake according to the vaṣaṭ-call.
The cleansing of all soma-vessels that have been partaken of takes place at the mārjālīya [hearth].

sanskrit_iast: etatpātramādāyādhvaryuḥ sadobile prāṅmukha upaviśyeḍā devahūriti śastraṃ pratigariṣyañjapati
meaning: एतत्पात्रमादायाध्वर्युः सदोबिले प्राङ्मुख उपविश्येडा देवहूरिति शस्त्रं प्रतिगरिष्यञ्जपति
text_mt: Taking up this vessel and sitting down facing east at the opening of the sadas, the adhvaryu, about to make the response to the recitation, whispers: “Iḍā, the invoker of the gods...”

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryo śoṃsāvomiti hoturabhijñāya pradakṣiṇamāvartamānaḥ śoṃsā moda iveti pratyāhvayate /
meaning: अध्वर्यो शोंसावोमिति होतुरभिज्ञाय प्रदक्षिणमावर्तमानः शोंसा मोद इवेति प्रत्याह्वयते /
text_mt: Having recognized the hotṛ's [call], “Adhvaryu, let us two recite: om,” turning clockwise he calls in response: “Recite! May it delight [us]! May it be so!”
Holding the season-cup, standing facing west at the opening of the sadas, he makes the response;
“Othā moda iva” at the half-verses;
“Om othā moda iva” at the pauses.

sanskrit_iast: othā moda ivaṃ hotarmoda ivamothā moda ivomiti vikalpante
meaning: ओथा मोद इवं होतर्मोद इवमोथा मोद इवोमिति विकल्पन्ते
text_mt: “Othā moda ivaṃ,” “hotar moda iva,” and “om othā moda ivom” are options.

sanskrit_iast: śoṃsā moda ivauthā moda iveti vyāhāveṣūbhayaṃ karoti
meaning: शोंसा मोद इवौथा मोद इवेति व्याहावेषूभयं करोति
text_mt: At the calls to recite, he does both: “Śoṃsā moda iva” and “authā moda iva.”
Having responded to the recitation, the adhvaryu takes up the draught;
the camasādhvaryus the goblets.
Having called for attention and received the response, he issues the ritual call: “Reciter of the uktha, recite the consecratory verse for the soma!”
They shake the Nārāśaṃsa [goblets] following the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call.
The partaking of the draught has been explained;
likewise the partaking, swelling, and settling of the Nārāśaṃsas.
He draws the Vaiśvadeva [draught] with the Śukra vessel.
“O protectors, upholders of the people” are the [verses for] drawing and settling.
With “It has been released, it has been released,” he initiates the chant with two blades of sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: iḍāyai hiṅkuru tasyai prastuhi tasyai stuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyā iti purastādājyānāṃ yajamāno japati caturhotāraṃ ca vyācaṣṭe
meaning: इडायै हिङ्कुरु तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै स्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्या इति पुरस्तादाज्यानां यजमानो जपति चतुर्होतारं च व्याचष्टे
text_mt: “Make the hiṅ-sound for Iḍā! Chant the prelude for her! Sing praise to her! For my obtaining of her!”—before the Ājya [chants] the sacrificer whispers this and recites the Caturhotṛ formula.
And while praise is being chanted, he whispers the Caturhotṛ formula.
“Having recited the Caturhotṛs, he sings [the chant] with the Ājyas,” thus it is known from tradition.
When the chant has been sung, the response to the recitation, the draught, and the Nārāśaṃsa [goblets] are as in the case of the Indra-Agni [draught], except for the season-vessel.
The goblets are those of which all partake.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi devebhyo devā yuvamukthyebhya ukthyā yuvamityukthyapātreṇokthyatṛtīyaṃ gṛhītvaiṣa te yonirmitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tveti sādayitvā punarhavirasīti sthālīmabhimṛśati
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णामि देवेभ्यो देवा युवमुक्थ्येभ्य उक्थ्या युवमित्युक्थ्यपात्रेणोक्थ्यतृतीयं गृहीत्वैष ते योनिर्मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वेति सादयित्वा पुनर्हविरसीति स्थालीमभिमृशति
text_mt: Having drawn the third part of the Ukthya [draught] with the Ukthya vessel with: “Thou art taken with a support; I take thee pleasing to Mitra and Varuṇa; gods to gods, worthy of ukthas, ye two are worthy of ukthas,” and having settled it with: “This is thy womb; for Mitra and Varuṇa thee,” he touches the trough with: “Again art thou an oblation.”

sanskrit_iast: yanmukhyāścamasā bhavanti tasya pratigṛṇāti taṃ ca pratibhakṣayati
meaning: यन्मुख्याश्चमसा भवन्ति तस्य प्रतिगृणाति तं च प्रतिभक्षयति
text_mt: He responds for the one whose goblets are headed [by his own], and he partakes alongside him.
Having drawn the goblets headed by the Maitrāvaruṇa goblet, he initiates the chant as before.
When the chant has been sung, having responded to the recitation as before, the adhvaryu takes up the draught;
the camasādhvaryus the goblets.
Having called for attention and received the response, he issues the ritual call: “Reciter of the uktha, recite the consecratory verse for the somas!”
At the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call, they offer.
In this way, henceforth, is the procedure regarding the groups, with the exception of the Nārāśaṃsa [goblets].

sanskrit_iast: devebhyastvā devāyuvaṃ pṛṇajmi yajñasyāyuṣa iti mukhye saṃpātamavanayati
meaning: देवेभ्यस्त्वा देवायुवं पृणज्मि यज्ञस्यायुष इति मुख्ये संपातमवनयति
text_mt: With 'To the gods, longing for the gods, I unite thee for the life of the sacrifice', he pours the residue into the chief [goblet].
'If the adhvaryu desires: "May I endow myself with the glory of the sacrifice"'—[this] has [already] been stated.
In this way the two subsequent rounds are prescribed.
With these two the pratiprasthātṛ performs [the ritual actions].

sanskrit_iast: indrāya tveti dvitīye grahaṇasādanau saṃnamatyardhaṃ cokthyaśeṣasya gṛhṇāti /
meaning: इन्द्राय त्वेति द्वितीये ग्रहणसादनौ संनमत्यर्धं चोक्थ्यशेषस्य गृह्णाति /
