With “The female protector of Tvaṣṭṛ,” [he places that] of the ram to the south, turned northward.
With “Which fire among the fires,” [he places that] of the he-goat to the north, [turned] southward.
He attends upon them without interruption with the dismissal [formulas].
With “Do not harm this two-footed one,” [he attends upon the head] of the human.
With “Do not harm this single-hoofed one,” [that] of the horse.
With “This ocean,” [that] of the bull.
With “This woolly one,” [that] of the ram.
With “For the she-goat is Agni's,” [that] of the he-goat.

sanskrit_iast: yadi vāyavyasya syānmukhyasya sthāne sarveṣāmupadhānairupadhāya sarveṣāmutsargairupatiṣṭheta
meaning: यदि वायव्यस्य स्यान्मुख्यस्य स्थाने सर्वेषामुपधानैरुपधाय सर्वेषामुत्सर्गैरुपतिष्ठेत
text_mt: If [the animal sacrifice] belongs to Vāyu, having placed [the other heads] in the place of the chief one with the placing [formulas] of all, he should attend upon [them] with the dismissal [formulas] of all;

sanskrit_iast: api vā tasyatasya sthāna upadhāya tasyatasyotsargeṇopatiṣthate
meaning: अपि वा तस्यतस्य स्थान उपधाय तस्यतस्योत्सर्गेणोपतिष्थते
text_mt: or having placed each in its respective place, he attends upon it with its respective dismissal [formula].

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta kanīyo 'syānnaṃ syāditi saṃtarāṃ tasyetyuktam
meaning: यं कामयेत कनीयो ऽस्यान्नं स्यादिति संतरां तस्येत्युक्तम्
text_mt: “He whom he might wish, ‘May food be smaller for him,’ for him [placed] more closely together”—thus it has been declared.

sanskrit_iast: nomo astu sarpebhya iti dakṣiṇe 'ṃse sarpaśira upadadhyādviṣūcīnaṃ paśuśīrṣaiḥ
meaning: नोमो अस्तु सर्पेभ्य इति दक्षिणे ऽंसे सर्पशिर उपदध्याद्विषूचीनं पशुशीर्षैः
text_mt: With “Homage be to the snakes,” he should place a snake head in the southern corner, facing away from the animal heads.
Or he may only utter the yajus-formula and not place [it].

sanskrit_iast: mā chandastatpṛthivyagnirdevatā tenarṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayāṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda /
meaning: मा छन्दस्तत्पृथिव्यग्निर्देवता तेनर्षिणा तेन ब्रह्मणा तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद /
text_mt: “Mā is the metre; that is the earth; Agni is the deity; with that seer, with that sacred word, with that deity, sit firm like Aṅgiras.
Pramā is the metre; that is the atmosphere; Vāta is the deity.
Pratimā is the metre; that is the sky; Sūrya is the deity.
Asrīviṣ is the metre; that is the directions; Soma is the deity.
Virāj is the metre; that is speech; Varuṇa is the deity.
Gāyatrī is the metre; that is the she-goat; Bṛhaspati is the deity.
Triṣṭubh is the metre; that is gold; Indra is the deity.
Jagatī is the metre; that is the cow; Prajāpati is the deity.
Anuṣṭubh is the metre; that is the wind; Mitra is the deity.
Uṣṇih is the metre; that is the eye; Pūṣan is the deity.
Paṅkti is the metre; that is agriculture; Parjanya is the deity.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhatī chandastadaśvaḥ parameṣṭhī devatā tenarṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayāṅgirasvaddhruvā sīdetyetābhirdvādaśabhistrirabhyāsaṃ purastātpratīcīṃ puruṣātkṛtiṃ cinoti
meaning: बृहती छन्दस्तदश्वः परमेष्ठी देवता तेनर्षिणा तेन ब्रह्मणा तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीदेत्येताभिर्द्वादशभिस्त्रिरभ्यासं पुरस्तात्प्रतीचीं पुरुषात्कृतिं चिनोति
text_mt: Bṛhatī is the metre; that is the horse; Parameṣṭhin is the deity; with that seer, with that sacred word, with that deity, sit firm like Aṅgiras,”—with these twelve [formulas], recited three times, he piles a human-shaped [layer] from the east turned towards the west.
The human head becomes its head.

sanskrit_iast: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣa ityupahitāṃ puruṣeṇa nārāyaṇena yajamāna upatiṣṭhate
meaning: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुष इत्युपहितां पुरुषेण नारायणेन यजमान उपतिष्ठते
text_mt: The sacrificer reveres [the layer] when it is laid down with the Puruṣasūkta [beginning with] 'A thousand-headed is the Puruṣa'.
Five [pointing] from east to west with 'I settle you in the courses of waters';

sanskrit_iast: arṇave sadane sīdeti pañca dakṣiṇata udīcīḥ /
meaning: अर्णवे सदने सीदेति पञ्च दक्षिणत उदीचीः /
text_mt: Five [pointing] from south to north with 'Sit in the surge of the ocean';

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ tvā sadane sādayāmīti pañca paścātprācīḥ /
meaning: अपां त्वा सदने सादयामीति पञ्च पश्चात्प्राचीः /
text_mt: Five [pointing] from west to east with 'I settle you in the seat of waters';
Five [pointing] from north to south with 'The gāyatrī metre'.
"The gods who grasped the sacrifice from around the gods,

sanskrit_iast: tāngāyatrī nayatu prajānatī svarge loke amṛtaṃ duhānā //
meaning: तान्गायत्री नयतु प्रजानती स्वर्गे लोके अमृतं दुहाना //
text_mt: May the knowing gāyatrī lead them, milking immortality in the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: ye jyotīṃṣi saṃdadhati svarārohanto amṛtasya lokam /
meaning: ये ज्योतींषि संदधति स्वरारोहन्तो अमृतस्य लोकम् /
text_mt: Those who unite the lights, ascending to heaven, to the world of immortality,

sanskrit_iast: te yantu prajānanto yajñaṃ vidānāḥ sukṛtasya loke //
meaning: ते यन्तु प्रजानन्तो यज्ञं विदानाः सुकृतस्य लोके //
text_mt: May they go knowing, recognizing the sacrifice in the world of the well-done.
The animals fit for sacrifice who were produced toward the womb of the sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast: tāndadante kavayo vipaścito yajñaṃ vidānāḥ sukṛtasya loke //
meaning: तान्ददन्ते कवयो विपश्चितो यज्ञं विदानाः सुकृतस्य लोके //
text_mt: The wise, inspired poets offer them, recognizing the sacrifice in the world of the well-done.
The path that is stretched out, going to the gods, proceeds distributed by metres;
By that path he has reached heaven and the intermediate space, having seized the sacrifice, into the world of the well-done.
The sacrifice of a thousand streams, built up above heaven and earth,

sanskrit_iast: tenaitu yajamānaḥ svastyā divo 'dhi pṛṣṭhamasthāditi pañca hiraṇyeṣṭakāḥ pratidiśam /
meaning: तेनैतु यजमानः स्वस्त्या दिवो ऽधि पृष्ठमस्थादिति पञ्च हिरण्येष्टकाः प्रतिदिशम् /
text_mt: By that may the sacrificer go to well-being; he has stood upon the back of heaven" — [with these verses] five gold bricks [are laid down], one in each direction;

sanskrit_iast: āyave svāhāyoṣkṛte svāhāyoṣpatvane svāhā viṣṇave svāhā bṛhapsataye svāheti pañcopadhāyādbhyaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ pṛthivyai rasācca viśvakramaṇaḥ samavartatādhi /
meaning: आयवे स्वाहायोष्कृते स्वाहायोष्पत्वने स्वाहा विष्णवे स्वाहा बृहप्सतये स्वाहेति पञ्चोपधायाद्भ्यः संभूतः पृथिव्यै रसाच्च विश्वक्रमणः समवर्तताधि /
text_mt: Having laid down five with 'Svāhā to the quick one, svāhā to the fashioner of quickness, svāhā to the flier of quickness, svāhā to Viṣṇu, svāhā to Bṛhaspati', and having laid down this [brick] with 'Formed from the waters, the sap of earth, and Viśvakarman, he arose over [all]; / Fashioning his form, Tvaṣṭṛ approaches; that was the complete birth of the Puruṣa in the beginning', [he lays down bricks with:] 'You are the seat of truth, the seat of reality, the seat of brilliance, the seat of splendour, the seat of fame, you are praised.

sanskrit_iast: tasya tvaṣṭā vidadhadrūpameti tatpuruṣasya viśvamājānamagra ityetāmupadhāyartasadasi satyasadasi tejaḥsadasi varcaḥsadasi yaśaḥsadasi gṛṇānāsi /
meaning: तस्य त्वष्टा विदधद्रूपमेति तत्पुरुषस्य विश्वमाजानमग्र इत्येतामुपधायर्तसदसि सत्यसदसि तेजःसदसि वर्चःसदसि यशःसदसि गृणानासि /
text_mt: You are the abode; to the abode I [offer] you, to the abodes I [offer] you; sit in the abodes.

sanskrit_iast: dhāmāsi dhāmyai tvā dhāmabhyastvā dhāmasu sīda /
meaning: धामासि धाम्यै त्वा धामभ्यस्त्वा धामसु सीद /
text_mt: You are acquisition; to acquisition I [offer] you; may I acquire.
You are finding; to finding I [offer] you; may I find.
You are ability; to ability I [offer] you; may I be able.
You are prosperity; to prosperity I [offer] you; may I prosper.
You are ritual action; to ritual action I [offer] you; may I perform.
You are the jump; to the jump I [offer] you, to the jumps I [offer] you; sit in the jump.

sanskrit_iast: gūrdo 'si gūrdāya tvā gūrdebhyastvā gūrde sīda /
meaning: गूर्दो ऽसि गूर्दाय त्वा गूर्देभ्यस्त्वा गूर्दे सीद /
text_mt: Protect dominion, nourish dominion, animate dominion, bestow dominion, strengthen dominion. You are dominion; to dominion I [offer] you, to dominions I [offer] you; sit in dominion.

sanskrit_iast: kṣatraṃ pāhi kṣatraṃ pinva kṣatraṃ jinva kṣatraṃ yaccha kṣatraṃ dṛṃha kṣatramasi kṣatrāya tvā kṣatrebhyastvā kṣatre sīda /
meaning: क्षत्रं पाहि क्षत्रं पिन्व क्षत्रं जिन्व क्षत्रं यच्छ क्षत्रं दृंह क्षत्रमसि क्षत्राय त्वा क्षत्रेभ्यस्त्वा क्षत्रे सीद /
text_mt: I settle you in all earthly things.
I settle you in all intermediate things.
I settle you in all heavenly things.
I settle you in all gods.
I settle you in all waters.
I settle you in all plants.
I settle you in all trees.
I settle you in all quarters.
Sit in heaven.

sanskrit_iast: svarjidasi pṛtanājidasi bhūrijidasyabhijidasi viśvajidasi sarvajidasi satrājidasi dhanajidasi bhrāḍasi vibhrāḍasi prabhrāḍasi /
meaning: स्वर्जिदसि पृतनाजिदसि भूरिजिदस्यभिजिदसि विश्वजिदसि सर्वजिदसि सत्राजिदसि धनजिदसि भ्राडसि विभ्राडसि प्रभ्राडसि /
text_mt: I settle you, a thunderbolt striking rivals.
I settle you, a thunderbolt striking enemies.
I settle you, a thunderbolt striking ill-will.
I settle you, a thunderbolt striking sorcerers.
I settle you, a thunderbolt striking piśācas.
I settle you, a thunderbolt striking rakṣases.
I settle you, Indra's thunderbolt, striking foes, striking unfriendly ones, striking adversaries, striking asuras.

You are the high-speaker, you are rising, you are surging, you are approaching, you are advancing, you are conquest, you are stepping over, you are crossing, you are transition, you lead to heaven, you are heaven.

Sit in nourishment, sit in strength, sit in good fortune, sit in wealth, sit in well-being, sit in the sacrificial [seat] of earth, sit on the back of Viṣṇu, sit in the place of iḍā, sit in ghee, sit in abundance.

sanskrit_iast: iṣi sīdorji sīda bhage sīda draviṇe sīda subhūte sīda pṛthivyā yajñiye sīda viṣṇoḥ pṛṣṭhe sīdeḍāyāḥ pade sīda ghṛtavati sīda pinvamāne sīda
meaning: इषि सीदोर्जि सीद भगे सीद द्रविणे सीद सुभूते सीद पृथिव्या यज्ञिये सीद विष्णोः पृष्ठे सीदेडायाः पदे सीद घृतवति सीद पिन्वमाने सीद
text_mt: Sit in the saṃvatsara-year, sit in the parivatsara-year, sit in the idāvatsara-year, sit in the iduvatsara-year, sit in the idvatsara-year, sit in the vatsara-year.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsare sīda parivatsare sīdedāvatsare sīdeduvatsare sīdedvatsare sīda vatsare sīda /
meaning: संवत्सरे सीद परिवत्सरे सीदेदावत्सरे सीदेदुवत्सरे सीदेद्वत्सरे सीद वत्सरे सीद /
text_mt: Sit in one, sit in ten, sit in a hundred, sit in a thousand, sit in ten thousand, sit in a hundred thousand, sit in a million, sit in ten million, sit in a hundred million, sit in a billion, sit in the middle, sit in ten billion, sit at the end, sit in the highest number.

sanskrit_iast: ekasyāṃ sīda daśasu sīda śate sīda sahasre sīdāyute sīda niyute sīda prayute sīdārbude sīda nyarbude sīda samudre sīda madhye sīda padme sīdānte sīda parārdhe sīda /
meaning: एकस्यां सीद दशसु सीद शते सीद सहस्रे सीदायुते सीद नियुते सीद प्रयुते सीदार्बुदे सीद न्यर्बुदे सीद समुद्रे सीद मध्ये सीद पद्मे सीदान्ते सीद परार्धे सीद /
text_mt: You are swelling; to the swelling I [offer] you, to the swelling ones I [offer] you; sit in the swelling.

sanskrit_iast: pinvamānāsi pinvamānāya tvā pinvamānebhyastvā pinvamāne sīda /
meaning: पिन्वमानासि पिन्वमानाय त्वा पिन्वमानेभ्यस्त्वा पिन्वमाने सीद /
text_mt: You are truth; to truth I [offer] you, to the true I [offer] you; sit in truth.
You are reality; to reality I [offer] you, to the real I [offer] you; sit in reality.

sanskrit_iast: satyamasi satyāya tvā satyebhyastvā satye sīda /
meaning: सत्यमसि सत्याय त्वा सत्येभ्यस्त्वा सत्ये सीद /
text_mt: You are junction; to junction I [offer] you, to junctions I [offer] you; sit in junctions.

sanskrit_iast: saṃdhirasi saṃdhaye tvā saṃdhibhyastvā saṃdhiṣu sīda /
meaning: संधिरसि संधये त्वा संधिभ्यस्त्वा संधिषु सीद /
text_mt: You are close adherence; to close adherence I [offer] you, to the adhering ones I [offer] you; sit in adherence.

sanskrit_iast: saṃśliḍasi saṃśliṣe tvā saṃśliḍbhyastvā saṃśliṭsu sīda /
meaning: संश्लिडसि संश्लिषे त्वा संश्लिड्भ्यस्त्वा संश्लिट्सु सीद /
text_mt: You are attainment; to attainment I [offer] you, to attainments I [offer] you; sit in attainments' — with these two anuvākas, verse by verse, [he lays down] the seer-bricks [ṛṣīṣṭakāḥ] and with the rounds expressing settling.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpadasi saṃpade tvā saṃpadbhyastvā saṃpatsu sīdetyetābhyāmanuvākābhyāṃ pratimantramṛṣīṣṭakāḥ sādanapravādaiśca paryāyaiḥ
meaning: संपदसि संपदे त्वा संपद्भ्यस्त्वा संपत्सु सीदेत्येताभ्यामनुवाकाभ्यां प्रतिमन्त्रमृषीष्टकाः सादनप्रवादैश्च पर्यायैः
text_mt: [With] 'This one in front is being', [he lays down] fifty breath-holding bricks [prāṇabhṛtaḥ]:

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ puro bhuva iti pañcāśataṃ prāṇabhṛtaḥ /
meaning: अयं पुरो भुव इति पञ्चाशतं प्राणभृतः /
text_mt: Ten in each quarter, [and] diagonally ten;
Having laid down the inner one in the middle, [he lays down] each outer one.
[With] 'The eastern of the directions', [he lays down] fifty out-breath-holding bricks [apānabhṛtaḥ] in the same manner as the breath-holding bricks,
Having laid down the outer one, [then] each inner one.
"Unite the in-breath with lifetime;
"Extend the ear from the eye;"
"Extend the earth from the self;"
"Extend the intermediate region from the earth;"
"Extend heaven from the intermediate region;"
"Extend light from heaven"—[with these mantras he sets down] the twelve continuity bricks.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivī vaśāmāvāsyā garbho vanaspatayo jarāyvagnirvatso 'gnihotraṃ pīyuṣaḥ /
meaning: पृथिवी वशामावास्या गर्भो वनस्पतयो जराय्वग्निर्वत्सो ऽग्निहोत्रं पीयुषः /
text_mt: "The earth is the barren cow, the new moon day is the fetus, the trees are the placenta, Agni is the calf, the agnihotra is the colostrum;"

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣaṃ vaśā dhātā garbho rudro jarāyu vāyurvatso ghrmaḥ pīyūṣaḥ /
meaning: अन्तरिक्षं वशा धाता गर्भो रुद्रो जरायु वायुर्वत्सो घ्र्मः पीयूषः /
text_mt: "The intermediate region is the barren cow, Dhātṛ is the fetus, Rudra is the placenta, Vāyu is the calf, the summer heat is the colostrum;"

sanskrit_iast: dyaurvaśā stanayitnurgarbho nakṣatrāṇi jarāyu sūryo vatso vṛṣṭiḥ pīyūṣaḥ /
meaning: द्यौर्वशा स्तनयित्नुर्गर्भो नक्षत्राणि जरायु सूर्यो वत्सो वृष्टिः पीयूषः /
text_mt: "Heaven is the barren cow, the thunder is the fetus, the lunar mansions are the placenta, the sun is the calf, the rain is the colostrum;"

sanskrit_iast: ṛgvaśā bṛhadrathaṃtare garbhaḥ praiṣanivido jarāyu yajño vatso dakṣiṇāḥ pīyūṣaḥ /
meaning: ऋग्वशा बृहद्रथंतरे गर्भः प्रैषनिविदो जरायु यज्ञो वत्सो दक्षिणाः पीयूषः /
text_mt: "The Ṛgveda is the barren cow, the Bṛhat and Rathantara [sāmans] are the fetus, the ritual calls and nivids are the placenta, the sacrifice is the calf, the sacrificial gifts are the colostrum;"

sanskrit_iast: viḍvaśā rājanyo garbhaḥ paśavo jarāyu rājā vatso baliḥ pīyūṣa iti pañca vaśā
meaning: विड्वशा राजन्यो गर्भः पशवो जरायु राजा वत्सो बलिः पीयूष इति पञ्च वशा
text_mt: "The commonalty is the barren cow, the nobleman is the fetus, the animals are the placenta, the king is the calf, the tribute is the colostrum"—[these are] the five barren cow [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: artheta sthādhvagato 'gnirvastejiṣṭhena tejasā devatābhirgṛhṇāmīti kumbhaṃ kumbhīṃ cādbhiḥ pūrayitvā śarma ca stha varma ca stha devasya vaḥ savituḥ prasave madhumatīḥ sādayāmīti purastādanusītamupadhāya jyotiṣe vāmiti hiraṇyaśalkau pratyasyati
meaning: अर्थेत स्थाध्वगतो ऽग्निर्वस्तेजिष्ठेन तेजसा देवताभिर्गृह्णामीति कुम्भं कुम्भीं चाद्भिः पूरयित्वा शर्म च स्थ वर्म च स्थ देवस्य वः सवितुः प्रसवे मधुमतीः सादयामीति पुरस्तादनुसीतमुपधाय ज्योतिषे वामिति हिरण्यशल्कौ प्रत्यस्यति
text_mt: Having filled a jar and a small jar with water with "You are meant for a purpose, on the journey; with Agni's most brilliant radiance, through the deities I draw you," having placed them in the east along the furrow with "You are protection, you are armor; at the impulse of the god Savitṛ, sweet I seat you," he tosses into each a gold flake with "For luster to you both."
In this same way [he places] the subsequent ones with the subsequent mantras in each direction along the furrow;

sanskrit_iast: śukrā stha vīryāvatīrindrasya va indriyāvato devatābhirgṛhṇāmi
meaning: शुक्रा स्थ वीर्यावतीरिन्द्रस्य व इन्द्रियावतो देवताभिर्गृह्णामि
text_mt: "You are bright, full of virility; of Indra who possesses virility, through the deities I draw you;"

sanskrit_iast: ṛtaṃ ca stha satyaṃ ca stha devasya vaḥ savituḥ prasave madhumatīḥ sādayāmi /
meaning: ऋतं च स्थ सत्यं च स्थ देवस्य वः सवितुः प्रसवे मधुमतीः सादयामि /
text_mt: "You are order and you are truth; at the impulse of the god Savitṛ, sweet I seat you;"

sanskrit_iast: mandarā sthābhibhuvo viśveṣāṃ vo devānāṃ devatābhirgṛhṇāmi /
meaning: मन्दरा स्थाभिभुवो विश्वेषां वो देवानां देवताभिर्गृह्णामि /
text_mt: "You are gladdening, overpowering; through the deities of the All-gods I draw you;"

sanskrit_iast: sapatnaghnīśca sthābhimātighnīśca stha devasya vaḥ savituḥ prasave madhumatīḥ sādayāmi /
meaning: सपत्नघ्नीश्च स्थाभिमातिघ्नीश्च स्थ देवस्य वः सवितुः प्रसवे मधुमतीः सादयामि /
text_mt: "You are slayers of rivals and slayers of assailants; at the impulse of the god Savitṛ, sweet I seat you;"
"You are the sovereign, mighty; through the deities of the Ādityas I draw you;"

sanskrit_iast: rakṣoghnīśca sthārātighnīśca stha devasya vaḥ savituḥ prasave madhumatīḥ sādayāmi /
meaning: रक्षोघ्नीश्च स्थारातिघ्नीश्च स्थ देवस्य वः सवितुः प्रसवे मधुमतीः सादयामि /
text_mt: "You are slayers of demons and slayers of malicious foes; at the impulse of the god Savitṛ, sweet I seat you;"
"You are holders of dominion, mighty; with the sacred word of Mitra and Varuṇa, through the deities I draw you;"

sanskrit_iast: vasu ca stha vāmaṃ ca stha devasya vaḥ savituḥ prasave madhumatīḥ sādayāmi /
meaning: वसु च स्थ वामं च स्थ देवस्य वः सवितुः प्रसवे मधुमतीः सादयामि /
text_mt: "You are wealth and you are what is desirable; at the impulse of the god Savitṛ, sweet I seat you;"
"You are dwelling in the pen, looking upward; with the sacred word of Bṛhaspati, through the deities I draw you;"

sanskrit_iast: bhūtaṃ ca stha bhavyaṃ ca stha devasya vaḥ savituḥ prasave madhumatīḥ sādayāmi /
meaning: भूतं च स्थ भव्यं च स्थ देवस्य वः सवितुः प्रसवे मधुमतीः सादयामि /
text_mt: "You are what has been and you are what is to be; at the impulse of the god Savitṛ, sweet I seat you;"
"For radiance to you both"—these are the drawing, seating, and tossing mantras of the pot-bricks.
He addresses them once laid with "Golden of hue..."

sanskrit_iast: divi śrayasveti bārhaspatyaṃ naivāraṃ payasi caruṃ madhye kumbheṣṭakānāmupadadhāti
meaning: दिवि श्रयस्वेति बार्हस्पत्यं नैवारं पयसि चरुं मध्ये कुम्भेष्टकानामुपदधाति
text_mt: With "Rest in heaven," he sets down in the middle of the pot-bricks a wild rice caru cooked in milk for Bṛhaspati;

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyavarṇaḥ sa hiraṇyasaṃdṛgapāṃ patiḥ sedu hiraṇyavarṇaḥ /
meaning: हिरण्यवर्णः स हिरण्यसंदृगपां पतिः सेदु हिरण्यवर्णः /
text_mt: "Golden-colored is he, golden of aspect, the lord of waters; he indeed is golden-colored;

sanskrit_iast: hirṇyayātpari yonerniṣadyā hiraṇyadā dadatyannamasmā ityetābhyāṃ ca naivāram
meaning: हिर्ण्ययात्परि योनेर्निषद्या हिरण्यदा ददत्यन्नमस्मा इत्येताभ्यां च नैवारम्
text_mt: sitting down from the golden womb, the givers of gold give food to him"—and with these two [verses he sets down] the wild rice [caru].
"The threefold chant is your head, O Agni; that is my head, O Agni;"

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśau te agne bāhū tau me agne bāhū /
meaning: पञ्चदशौ ते अग्ने बाहू तौ मे अग्ने बाहू /
text_mt: "The fifteenfold chants are your two arms, O Agni; those are my two arms, O Agni;"

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśaste agna ātmā sa me agna ātmā /
meaning: सप्तदशस्ते अग्न आत्मा स मे अग्न आत्मा /
text_mt: "The seventeenfold chant is your body, O Agni; that is my body, O Agni;"

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśau te agne ūrū tau me agne ūrū /
meaning: एकविंशौ ते अग्ने ऊरू तौ मे अग्ने ऊरू /
text_mt: "The twenty-onefold chants are your two thighs, O Agni; those are my two thighs, O Agni;"

sanskrit_iast: triṇavau te agne aṣṭhīvantau tau me agne aṣṭhīvantau /
meaning: त्रिणवौ ते अग्ने अष्ठीवन्तौ तौ मे अग्ने अष्ठीवन्तौ /
text_mt: "The thrice-ninefold chants are your two knee-caps, O Agni; those are my two knee-caps, O Agni;"

sanskrit_iast: trayastriṃśaṃ te agne pratiṣṭhānaṃ tanme agne pratiṣṭhānamityetāḥ śirasi pakṣayormadhye pucche vopadadhāti
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिंशं ते अग्ने प्रतिष्ठानं तन्मे अग्ने प्रतिष्ठानमित्येताः शिरसि पक्षयोर्मध्ये पुच्छे वोपदधाति
text_mt: "The thirty-threefold chant is your foundation, O Agni; that is my foundation, O Agni"—these he places on the head, on the two wings, in the middle, and on the tail.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtte agne śirastena mā pāhīti saṃnamayaṃstāṃtāmupatiṣṭhate yajamānaḥ
meaning: त्रिवृत्ते अग्ने शिरस्तेन मा पाहीति संनमयंस्तांतामुपतिष्ठते यजमानः
text_mt: Modifying [the mantras] with "The threefold chant is your head, O Agni; protect me with it," the sacrificer reveres each of them.

sanskrit_iast: tvāmagne vṛṣabhamityṛṣabhamupadhāya lokaṃ pṛṇa tā asya sūdadohasa ityaviśiṣṭamaparimitābhirlokaṃpṛṇābhiḥ pracchādayati
meaning: त्वामग्ने वृषभमित्यृषभमुपधाय लोकं पृण ता अस्य सूददोहस इत्यविशिष्टमपरिमिताभिर्लोकंपृणाभिः प्रच्छादयति
text_mt: Having placed the bull-brick with "You, O Agni, the bull...," with "Fill the space...," and "Those milk-givers of his...," he covers the remainder [of the layer] with an unlimited number of space-filler bricks.
He should make the marks of the bricks of all varieties.
There is an authoritative instruction on the lines, and it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa]:
"Those that turn to the right he should place on the south;
those with straight lines, in the west and in the east;
Having placed gold upon the layer, he touches it with the layer-arrangement [mantra]: "The known and the unknown..."

sanskrit_iast: yatte 'citaṃ yadu citaṃ te agne yadūnaṃ yadvātrātiriktam /
meaning: यत्ते ऽचितं यदु चितं ते अग्ने यदूनं यद्वात्रातिरिक्तम् /
text_mt: "Whatever is unpiled of you, and whatever is piled of you, O Agni, whatever is deficient or whatever here is redundant,
may the All-gods and the Aṅgirases pile it, may the Ādityas fill up your layer.
"May we, O Agni, possess wealth, sufficient for the sacrifice and for the sacrificial gift;
may the pressing stone speak facing the stalk of Soma; may we serve Indra with the pressed juice."

sanskrit_iast: rāyaspoṣaṃ no dhehi jātaveda ūrjo bhāgaṃ madhumatsūnṛtāvat /
meaning: रायस्पोषं नो धेहि जातवेद ऊर्जो भागं मधुमत्सूनृतावत् /
text_mt: Bestow on us prosperity of wealth, O Jātavedas, a portion of vigour, sweet and pleasant;

sanskrit_iast: dadhāma yajñaṃ sunavāma somaṃ yajñena tvāmupaśikṣema śakra //
meaning: दधाम यज्ञं सुनवाम सोमं यज्ञेन त्वामुपशिक्षेम शक्र //
text_mt: May we establish the sacrifice, may we press soma; by the sacrifice may we serve you, O mighty one!

sanskrit_iast: īśānaṃ tvā śuśrumo vayaṃ dhanānāṃ dhanapate gomadagne /
meaning: ईशानं त्वा शुश्रुमो वयं धनानां धनपते गोमदग्ने /
text_mt: We have heard of you as the master of riches, O lord of wealth, rich in cattle, O Agni;
Bestow upon me abundant, rich nourishment with horses and with gold!

sanskrit_iast: duhāṃ te dyauḥ pṛthivī payo 'jagarastvā sodako visarpatu /
meaning: दुहां ते द्यौः पृथिवी पयो ऽजगरस्त्वा सोदको विसर्पतु /
text_mt: May heaven and earth yield milk for you; may the water-python glide away from you;
With Prajāpati I fill myself; empty is my self.

sanskrit_iast: yo rudro agnau yo apsu ya oṣadhīṣu yo rudro viśvā bhuvanāviveśa /
meaning: यो रुद्रो अग्नौ यो अप्सु य ओषधीषु यो रुद्रो विश्वा भुवनाविवेश /
text_mt: The Rudra who is in the fire, who is in the waters, who is in the plants, the Rudra who entered into all beings—

sanskrit_iast: tasmai rudrāya namo astu devā ityetābhiḥ svayaṃcityābhimṛśati
meaning: तस्मै रुद्राय नमो अस्तु देवा इत्येताभिः स्वयंचित्याभिमृशति
text_mt: To that Rudra be homage, O gods!"—with these [verses] he touches the self-built [layer].
To the north stands a black horse,

sanskrit_iast: tamālabhya cātvālātpurīṣmāhṛtya pṛṣṭo divīti vaiśvānaryarcā citāvanubyūhati
meaning: तमालभ्य चात्वालात्पुरीष्माहृत्य पृष्टो दिवीति वैश्वानर्यर्चा चितावनुब्यूहति
text_mt: Touching it, having brought loose earth from the cātvāla pit, he scatters it along the layer with the Vaiśvānara verse: "Set on the back of heaven..."

sanskrit_iast: yo apsvantaragniryo vṛtre yaḥ puruṣe yo aśmani /
meaning: यो अप्स्वन्तरग्निर्यो वृत्रे यः पुरुषे यो अश्मनि /
text_mt: "The fire which is within the waters, which is in Vṛtra, which is in man, which is in the rock,

sanskrit_iast: ya āviveśa bhuvanāni viśvā tebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat //
meaning: य आविवेश भुवनानि विश्वा तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत् //
text_mt: Which entered into all beings—to those fires be this offered!

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ some antaryo goṣvantarvayāṃsi ya āviveśa yo mṛgeṣu /
meaning: यः सोमे अन्तर्यो गोष्वन्तर्वयांसि य आविवेश यो मृगेषु /
text_mt: The one which is within soma, which is within cattle, which entered the birds, which is in beasts,

sanskrit_iast: ya āviveśa dvipado yaścatuṣpadastebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat //
meaning: य आविवेश द्विपदो यश्चतुष्पदस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत् //
text_mt: Which entered two-footed [creatures], which entered four-footed—to those fires be this offered!

sanskrit_iast: yenendrasya rathaṃ saṃbabhūvuryo vaiśvānara uta vaiśvadevyaḥ /
meaning: येनेन्द्रस्य रथं संबभूवुर्यो वैश्वानर उत वैश्वदेव्यः /
text_mt: With which they joined Indra's chariot, which is Vaiśvānara and also belonging to all the gods,

sanskrit_iast: dhīro yaḥ śakraḥ paribhūradābhyastebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat //
meaning: धीरो यः शक्रः परिभूरदाभ्यस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत् //
text_mt: Wise, powerful, surrounding, undecaying—to those fires be this offered!

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ hutādamagniṃ yamu kāmamāhuryaṃ dātāraṃ pratigrahītāramāhuḥ /
meaning: यं हुतादमग्निं यमु काममाहुर्यं दातारं प्रतिग्रहीतारमाहुः /
text_mt: [and] “Which Agni the consumer of the oblation, and which they call desire, whom they call the giver, the receiver,” [he attends upon it].
Who is the most divine of gods, born of heat—to those fires be this offered!"
With these six [verses], having placed layer upon layer, he makes an offering over each [with the verses beginning] "For the bull-eater, for the barren-cow-eater..."
With an Agni-verse, with a dhāmacchad verse: "Agni, many...", having placed layer upon layer, he makes an offering over [it].
It is stated: "He should touch the first layer with an Agni-verse in the gāyatrī metre."

sanskrit_iast: agne devām̐ ihā vaha jajñāno vṛktabarhiṣe /
meaning: अग्ने देवाम्̐ इहा वह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे /
text_mt: "O Agni, bring the gods hither, being born for him who has trimmed the sacrificial grass;

sanskrit_iast: aganma mahā manasā yaviṣṭhaṃ yo dīdāya samiddhaḥ sve duroṇe /
meaning: अगन्म महा मनसा यविष्ठं यो दीदाय समिद्धः स्वे दुरोणे /
text_mt: We have approached with great mind the youngest, who shines kindled in his own abode,

sanskrit_iast: citrabhānū rodasī antarurvī svāhutaṃ viśvataḥ pratyañcam //
meaning: चित्रभानू रोदसी अन्तरुर्वी स्वाहुतं विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चम् //
text_mt: Shining wonderfully between the two wide heaven and earth, well-sacrificed, facing all directions.

sanskrit_iast: medhākāraṃ vidathasya prasādhanamagniṃ hotāraṃ paribhūtamaṃ matim /
meaning: मेधाकारं विदथस्य प्रसाधनमग्निं होतारं परिभूतमं मतिम् /
text_mt: The creator of wisdom, the accomplisher of the sacred assembly, Agni the hotṛ, most comprehensive, the thought;

sanskrit_iast: tvāmarbhasya haviṣaḥ samānamittvā maho vṛṇate naro nānyaṃ tvat //
meaning: त्वामर्भस्य हविषः समानमित्त्वा महो वृणते नरो नान्यं त्वत् //
text_mt: You for a small offering, just the same for a great one, do men choose, none other than you.
Like Manu we set you down, like Manu we kindle you;
O Agni, like Manu, O Aṅgiras, sacrifice to the gods on behalf of him who seeks the gods!
For Agni, dwelling among all men, gives a steed to the clan;

sanskrit_iast: agnī rāye svābhuvaṃ sa prīto yāti vāryamiṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bharetyetā āmnātā bhavanti
meaning: अग्नी राये स्वाभुवं स प्रीतो याति वार्यमिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भरेत्येता आम्नाता भवन्ति
text_mt: Agni, pleasing to riches, approaches; may he, being pleased, bring desirable food to the praisers"—these are handed down by tradition.
For two days each, he offers with one Upasad mantra.
Following each Upasad, he piles the fire for two days.
There are three four-teat fast-milks;

sanskrit_iast: āparāhṇikībhyāṃ pracarya śvetamaśvaṃ pariṇīya vasanti vasanti
meaning: आपराह्णिकीभ्यां प्रचर्य श्वेतमश्वं परिणीय वसन्ति वसन्ति
text_mt: Having performed [the rites] with the two afternoon [offerings] and having led the white horse around, they dwell for each night.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte paurvāhṇikībhyāṃ pracarya dvitīyāṃ citiṃ cinoti
meaning: श्वो भूते पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां प्रचर्य द्वितीयां चितिं चिनोति
title: praśnaḥ 17
text_mt: On the next day, having performed [the rites] with the two morning [offerings], he piles the second layer.
With "Steadfast dwelling..." he places the five Āśvinī bricks.
With "United with the seasons..." having placed the five seasonal bricks following the Āśvinī bricks;

sanskrit_iast: prāṇaṃ me pāhīti pañca prāṇabhṛta ṛtavyā anūpadhāya
meaning: प्राणं मे पाहीति पञ्च प्राणभृत ऋतव्या अनूपधाय
text_mt: With "Protect my breath..." having placed the five vital-breath-supporting bricks following the seasonal bricks;
With "Swell the waters..." [he places] the five water-bricks, moving all around.
With "You are Vāyu's vehicle..." [he places] two Saṃyānī bricks.
With "Bright and clear..." [he places] two seasonal bricks having the same deity and placement.
With "The three-year-old steer is strength..." [he places] five [bricks] on the southern buttock;
With "The four-year-old ox is strength..." [he places] five on the northern;
With "The he-goat is strength..." [he places bricks] on the right shoulder;
With "The tiger is strength..." on the right wing;

sanskrit_iast: viṣṭambho vaya iti catasro vayasyāḥ purastātpratīcīḥ
meaning: विष्टम्भो वय इति चतस्रो वयस्याः पुरस्तात्प्रतीचीः
text_mt: With "Support is strength..." [he places] four Vayasyā bricks in the front, facing west.
“He whom he might wish, ‘May he be without cattle,’ for him the [bricks] belonging to various ages”—thus it has been declared.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte paurvāhṇikībhyāṃ pracarya tṛtīyāṃ citiṃ cinoti
meaning: श्वो भूते पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां प्रचर्य तृतीयां चितिं चिनोति
text_mt: On the next day, having performed the two morning rituals, he builds the third layer.

sanskrit_iast: indrāgnī avyathamānāmiti svayamātṛṇāmabhimṛśyāśvenopaghrāpya viśvakarmā tvā sādayatvantarikṣasya pṛṣṭha ityaviduṣā brāhmaṇena saha madhye 'gnerupadadhāti /
meaning: इन्द्राग्नी अव्यथमानामिति स्वयमातृणामभिमृश्याश्वेनोपघ्राप्य विश्वकर्मा त्वा सादयत्वन्तरिक्षस्य पृष्ठ इत्यविदुषा ब्राह्मणेन सह मध्ये ऽग्नेरुपदधाति /
text_mt: Having touched the naturally perforated [brick] with 'Indra and Agni, not trembling...', and having made a horse sniff it, he lays it down in the center of the Agni with 'May Viśvakarman seat you on the back of the intermediate space...', together with an unlearned brāhmaṇa;
and with this sacred utterance: 'Bhuvaḥ!'
Having offered into the naturally perforated [brick] with 'I offer insight...', he breathes out.
[He lays] a gold brick with 'You are light; give me light.'
A round brick with 'Sky above...'

sanskrit_iast: viśvakarmā tvā sādayatvantarikṣasya pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīmiti viśvajyotiṣam
meaning: विश्वकर्मा त्वा सादयत्वन्तरिक्षस्य पृष्ठे ज्योतिष्मतीमिति विश्वज्योतिषम्
text_mt: A Viśvajyotis brick with 'May Viśvakarman seat you on the back of the intermediate space, full of light.'
Two Saṃyānī bricks with 'You are that which goes to the intermediate space...'
Four seasonal bricks with 'Nabhas and Nabhasya...'
Two each, sharing the same deity-formula.

sanskrit_iast: rājñyasi prācī digiti pañca diśyāḥ pratidiśamekāṃ madhye
meaning: राज्ञ्यसि प्राची दिगिति पञ्च दिश्याः प्रतिदिशमेकां मध्ये
text_mt: Five directional bricks with 'You are the queen, the eastern direction...', one in each direction and one in the center.
Having laid down ten Prāṇabhṛt bricks in the east with 'Protect my life...',
twelve to the south with 'Mā meter...';
twelve to the west with 'Earth meter...';
twelve to the north with 'Agni is deity...'
Seven Vālakhilyā [bricks] facing west in the east with 'You are head, ruler...';
seven facing east in the west with 'Controller, ruler...'

sanskrit_iast: akṣṇayā dveṣyasya prasavāya tvopayāmāya tvā kāṭāya tvārṇavāya tvā dharṇasāya tvā draviṇāya tvā sindhave tvā samudrāya tvā sarasvate tvā viśvavyacase tvā subhūtāya tvāntarikṣāya tveti dvādaśa bhūteṣṭakāḥ
meaning: अक्ष्णया द्वेष्यस्य प्रसवाय त्वोपयामाय त्वा काटाय त्वार्णवाय त्वा धर्णसाय त्वा द्रविणाय त्वा सिन्धवे त्वा समुद्राय त्वा सरस्वते त्वा विश्वव्यचसे त्वा सुभूताय त्वान्तरिक्षाय त्वेति द्वादश भूतेष्टकाः
text_mt: Diagonally, for the enemy, twelve Bhūteṣṭakā bricks with 'To impulse you, to Upayāma you, to Kāṭa you, to the flood you, to Dharnas you, to wealth you, to the stream you, to the ocean you, to Sarasvat you, to the all-encompassing you, to well-being you, to the intermediate space you.'

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte paurvāhṇikībhyāṃ pracarya caturthīṃ citiṃ cinoti
meaning: श्वो भूते पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां प्रचर्य चतुर्थीं चितिं चिनोति
text_mt: On the next day, having performed the two morning rituals, he builds the fourth layer.

meaning: आशुस्त्रिवृदग्नेर्भागो ऽसीत्येताभ्यामनुवाकाभ्यां यथाब्राह्मणमुपधायान्तरिक्षमस्यन्तरिक्षाय त्वेति द्वे संयान्यौ
text_mt: Having laid [bricks] down according to the Brāhmaṇa with the two anuvākas 'Swift, threefold...' and 'You are the portion of Agni...', [he lays down] two Saṃyānī bricks with 'You are the intermediate space, to the intermediate space you.'
Two seasonal bricks with 'Sahas and Sahasya...', sharing the same deity-formula.
Seventeen Sṛṣṭi bricks with 'They praised with one...'

sanskrit_iast: iyameva sā yā prathamā vyaucchaditi ṣoḍaśa vyuṣṭīḥ
meaning: इयमेव सा या प्रथमा व्यौच्छदिति षोडश व्युष्टीः
text_mt: Sixteen Vyuṣṭi bricks with 'This indeed is she who shone forth first...'

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte paurvāhṇikībhyāṃ pracarya pañcamīṃ catiṃ cinoti
meaning: श्वो भूते पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां प्रचर्य पञ्चमीं चतिं चिनोति
text_mt: On the next day, having performed the two morning rituals, he builds the fifth layer.

sanskrit_iast: agne jātānpra ṇudā naḥ sapatnāniti purastādupadadhāti /
meaning: अग्ने जातान्प्र णुदा नः सपत्नानिति पुरस्तादुपदधाति /
text_mt: He lays [bricks] in the east with 'O Agni, dispel our enemies born...';
in the west with 'Those born with force...';
in the south with 'Forty-fourfold stoma...';
in the north with 'Sixteenfold stoma...'

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭakāyāṃ purīṣamadhyūhya pṛthivyāḥ purīṣamasīti madhye 'gneḥ purīṣavatīm
meaning: इष्टकायां पुरीषमध्यूह्य पृथिव्याः पुरीषमसीति मध्ये ऽग्नेः पुरीषवतीम्
text_mt: Having scattered loose earth over the brick, [he lays] the loose-earth brick in the center of the Agni with 'You are the loose earth of the earth.'

sanskrit_iast: evaśchando varivaśchanda iti catvāriṃśataṃ virājo daśadaśa pratidiśamakṣṇayā
meaning: एवश्छन्दो वरिवश्छन्द इति चत्वारिंशतं विराजो दशदश प्रतिदिशमक्ष्णया
text_mt: Forty Virāj [bricks] with 'Eva meter, Varivas meter...', ten in each direction, diagonally.

sanskrit_iast: raśmirasi kṣayāya tvā kṣayaṃ jinveti stomabhāgāḥ /
meaning: रश्मिरसि क्षयाय त्वा क्षयं जिन्वेति स्तोमभागाः /
text_mt: Stomabhāga bricks with 'You are a ray; for dwelling you, quicken the dwelling...':
seven in each direction;

sanskrit_iast: rājñyasi prācī digiti pañca nāksadaḥ pratidiśamekāṃ madhye
meaning: राज्ञ्यसि प्राची दिगिति पञ्च नाक्सदः प्रतिदिशमेकां मध्ये
text_mt: Five Nākasad bricks with 'You are the queen, the eastern direction...', one in each direction and one in the center.

sanskrit_iast: tāsu purīṣamadhyūhyāyaṃ puro harikeśa iti pañcacoḍā abhyupadadhāti /
meaning: तासु पुरीषमध्यूह्यायं पुरो हरिकेश इति पञ्चचोडा अभ्युपदधाति /
text_mt: Having scattered loose earth over them, he places five Cūḍā bricks upon them with 'This one in front, yellow-haired...';
meditating in mind on the enemy, [he places] the last one facing east in the west.

sanskrit_iast: āyostvā sadane sādayāmīti svayamātṛṇāmabhimṛśyāśvenopaghrāpya parameṣṭhī tvā sādayatu divaḥ pṛṣṭha ityaviduṣā brāhmaṇena saha madhye 'gnerupadadhāti /
meaning: आयोस्त्वा सदने सादयामीति स्वयमातृणामभिमृश्याश्वेनोपघ्राप्य परमेष्ठी त्वा सादयतु दिवः पृष्ठ इत्यविदुषा ब्राह्मणेन सह मध्ये ऽग्नेरुपदधाति /
text_mt: Having touched the naturally perforated [brick] with 'In the seat of Āyu I place you...', and having made a horse sniff it, he lays it down in the center of the Agni with 'May Parameṣṭhin seat you on the back of heaven...', together with an unlearned brāhmaṇa;
and with this sacred utterance: 'Suvar!'

sanskrit_iast: cittiṃ juhomīti svayamātṛṇāyāṃ hutvāpānya prothadaśva ityuttare 'ṃse vikarṇīm
meaning: चित्तिं जुहोमीति स्वयमातृणायां हुत्वापान्य प्रोथदश्व इत्युत्तरे ऽंसे विकर्णीम्
text_mt: Having offered into the naturally perforated [brick] with 'I offer insight...', having inhaled, [he lays] the Vikarṇī brick on the northern shoulder with 'Snorting, the horse...'
He places [them] over them with other bricks.
A gold brick with 'You are light; give me light.'
A round brick with 'Heaven is unconquered...'
Here [he places] one seed-pouring brick for an old man.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatistvā sādayatu divaḥ pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīmiti viśvajyotiṣam
meaning: प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु दिवः पृष्ठे ज्योतिष्मतीमिति विश्वज्योतिषम्
text_mt: A Viśvajyotis brick with 'May Prajāpati seat you on the back of heaven, full of light.'
Two seasonal bricks with 'Tapas and Tapasya...', sharing the same deity-formula.

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ yānyasi devānāṃ devayānyasīti dve saṃyānyau
meaning: देवानां यान्यसि देवानां देवयान्यसीति द्वे संयान्यौ
text_mt: Two Saṃyānī bricks with 'You are that which goes to the gods; you are that which goes on the path of the gods to the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: saṃyānyāvṛtavye viśvajyotiṣaṃ retaḥsicaṃ hiraṇyeṣṭakāṃ maṇḍaleṣṭakāṃ vikarṇīṃ svayamātṛṇāmityevamanupūrvā eke samāmananti
meaning: संयान्यावृतव्ये विश्वज्योतिषं रेतःसिचं हिरण्येष्टकां मण्डलेष्टकां विकर्णीं स्वयमातृणामित्येवमनुपूर्वा एके समामनन्ति
text_mt: Some teach them in this order: the two Saṃyānīs, the two seasonal, the Viśvajyotis, the seed-pouring, the gold brick, the round brick, the Vikarṇī, the naturally perforated.
Having performed the two afternoon rituals, he steeps udumbara kindling-sticks in ghee.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte paurvāhṇikībhyāṃ pracarya pañcamyāściteḥ śeṣaṃ yājñasenīṃ citiṃ cinoti
meaning: श्वो भूते पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां प्रचर्य पञ्चम्याश्चितेः शेषं याज्ञसेनीं चितिं चिनोति
text_mt: On the next day, having performed the two morning rituals, he builds the remainder of the fifth layer, the Yājñasenī layer.
He lays three Gāyatrī [bricks] in the east with 'Agni is the head...';
likewise the subsequent sets of three:
Bṛhatīs, Uṣṇihs, Paṅktis, and Akṣarapaṅktis, [namely] the various meters, in the available spaces;
Elsewhere than in the thousand-brick piling, for one who desires cattle he piles the cattle-layer (gociti).
A thousand foot-long bricks.
He should place them in the first layer, in the middle, or in the highest.

sanskrit_iast: agne gobhirna ā gahītyanuvākena pratimantraṃ punaḥ punarabhyāsam
meaning: अग्ने गोभिर्न आ गहीत्यनुवाकेन प्रतिमन्त्रं पुनः पुनरभ्यासम्
text_mt: Repeating again and again with each formula of the anuvāka: "Agni, come to us with cattle..."

sanskrit_iast: indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā sayujā yujā yunajmītyaṣṭau sayujaḥ
meaning: इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा सयुजा युजा युनज्मीत्यष्टौ सयुजः
text_mt: With "For Indra and Agni I yoke you, yoke-mate with yoke-mate...", eight yoke-mate bricks (sayuj).

sanskrit_iast: rohiteṣu tvā jīmūteṣu sādayāmyaruṇeṣu tvā kṛṣṇeṣu tvā nīleṣu tvā siteṣu tvā jīmūteṣu sādayāmīti pañca jīmūtāḥ
meaning: रोहितेषु त्वा जीमूतेषु सादयाम्यरुणेषु त्वा कृष्णेषु त्वा नीलेषु त्वा सितेषु त्वा जीमूतेषु सादयामीति पञ्च जीमूताः
text_mt: With "I place you in the red clouds; I place you in the ruddy clouds; I place you in the black clouds; I place you in the dark-blue clouds; I place you in the white clouds...", five cloud bricks (jīmūta).
With "Ambā by name are you...", seven Kṛttikā bricks.
With "You are the winner of the east wind...", five rain-winning bricks, placing them around continuously.
With "For the ocean, you...", eight Āditya bricks.

sanskrit_iast: ṛce tvā ruce tveti pañca ghṛteṣṭakā anuparihāram
meaning: ऋचे त्वा रुचे त्वेति पञ्च घृतेष्टका अनुपरिहारम्
text_mt: With "For the Ṛc, you; for splendour, you...", five ghee bricks, placing them around continuously.
"Balls of ghee should be placed interwoven with the Āditya bricks," says the Vājasaneyaka.
With "You that give glory...", five glory-giving bricks (yaśodā).
With "You are the increaser...", five increasing bricks (bhūyaskṛt).
With "You that sit in the waters...", five forms of Agni (agnirūpa).
With "I place you in the wealth of the earth...", five wealth-giving bricks (draviṇodā).
With "Protect my breath...", six life-prolonging bricks (āyuṣyā).
With "O Agni, what is your supreme name, the heart...", the heart of Agni (agner hṛdaya).
With "Yāvas, Ayāvas...", seven season bricks (ṛtavyā).
"What divine brick you are, life-giving, lying near,
lie by me, as a wife ever by her husband;

sanskrit_iast: yā devyasīṣṭake prāṇadā apānadā vyānadāścakṣurdā śrotradā vāgdā ātmadāḥ pṛthividā antarikṣadā dyaurdā svardāḥ kumārīdāḥ prapharvidāḥ prathamaupaśadā yuvatidā upaśīvarī /
meaning: या देव्यसीष्टके प्राणदा अपानदा व्यानदाश्चक्षुर्दा श्रोत्रदा वाग्दा आत्मदाः पृथिविदा अन्तरिक्षदा द्यौर्दा स्वर्दाः कुमारीदाः प्रफर्विदाः प्रथमौपशदा युवतिदा उपशीवरी /
text_mt: what divine bricks you are, giving out-breath, giving in-breath, giving diffused breath, giving sight, giving hearing, giving speech, giving self, giving earth, giving intermediate space, giving heaven, giving the sun-world, giving young maidens, giving lively women, giving the first head-ornament, giving youthful women, lying near,
lie by me, as a wife ever by her husband"—thus sixteen lying-near bricks (upaśīvarī).

sanskrit_iast: abhīṣāccābhiṣavī cābhivayāścordhvavayāśca bṛhadvayāśca savayāśca sahvāṃśca sahamānaśca sahasvāṃsca sahīyāṃśceti daśendranāmāni
meaning: अभीषाच्चाभिषवी चाभिवयाश्चोर्ध्ववयाश्च बृहद्वयाश्च सवयाश्च सह्वांश्च सहमानश्च सहस्वांस्च सहीयांश्चेति दशेन्द्रनामानि
text_mt: With "Abhīṣāh, and Abhiṣavī, and Abhivayas, and Ūrdhvavayas, and Bṛhadvayas, and Savayas, and Sahvan, and Sahamāna, and Sahasvan, and Sahīyas...", ten Indra names.
With "With Agni, the all-conquering...", twenty-two Indra bodies (indratanū).
With "Prajāpati with his mind reached out to the soma...", thirty-three sacrifice bodies (yajñatanū).
With "I place you, the luminous...", twelve luminous bricks (jyotiṣmatī).

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇā paścāditi paurṇamāsīṃ purastādupadhāya kṛttikā nakṣatramiti nakṣatreṣṭakāḥ purastātpratīcīrasaṃspṛṣṭāḥ
meaning: पूर्णा पश्चादिति पौर्णमासीं पुरस्तादुपधाय कृत्तिका नक्षत्रमिति नक्षत्रेष्टकाः पुरस्तात्प्रतीचीरसंस्पृष्टाः
text_mt: Having placed the full moon brick in front with "Full in the west...", he places the constellation bricks (nakṣatreṣṭakā) with "The Kṛttikās are the constellation...", running from east to west without touching [each other].
Having placed the previous one, [he places] the subsequent one and the subsequent one, up to the Viśākhās.
To the south of the naturally perforated brick (svayamātṛṇā), he carries forward the line.
Having placed the new moon brick in the west with "What the gods deposited...", of the remaining [constellations, he places] the previous and the previous one, up to the Apabharaṇīs.
To the north of the naturally perforated brick, he carries forward the line.

sanskrit_iast: ṛce tvā ruce tveti sarvāsu nakṣatreṣṭakāsvanuṣajati
meaning: ऋचे त्वा रुचे त्वेति सर्वासु नक्षत्रेष्टकास्वनुषजति
text_mt: With "For the Ṛc, you; for splendour, you...", he attaches [this mantra] to all the constellation bricks.
With "Hiranyagarbha came into being in the beginning...", eight river bricks (sarit).

sanskrit_iast: viśvakarmā diśāṃ patiriti pañca hiraṇyeṣṭakāḥ pratidiśamekāṃ madhye
meaning: विश्वकर्मा दिशां पतिरिति पञ्च हिरण्येष्टकाः प्रतिदिशमेकां मध्ये
text_mt: With "Viśvakarman, lord of the quarters...", five gold bricks (hiraṇyeṣṭakā): one in each direction and one in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāya tvā cakṣuṣe tveti catasraḥ svayamātṛṇāḥ pratidiśam
meaning: प्राणाय त्वा चक्षुषे त्वेति चतस्रः स्वयमातृणाः प्रतिदिशम्
text_mt: With "For breath, you; for sight, you...", four naturally perforated bricks (svayamātṛṇā), one in each direction.
By Agni is Agni kindled;
May Agni slay the foes;
Agni, we think on a hymn of praise, successful today, touching heaven,
desirous of the god's wealth"—thus five forms of the days (ahar-rūpa).
Then he places the vow brick (vrata).

sanskrit_iast: prācyā tvā diśā sādayāmīti pañcātmeṣṭakāḥ pratidiśamekāṃ madhye
meaning: प्राच्या त्वा दिशा सादयामीति पञ्चात्मेष्टकाः प्रतिदिशमेकां मध्ये
text_mt: With "With the eastern direction I place you...", five body bricks (ātmeṣṭakā): one in each direction and one in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: saṃyacca pracetāśceti pañca vaiśvadevīrātmani dveṣyaṃ manasā dhyāyan
meaning: संयच्च प्रचेताश्चेति पञ्च वैश्वदेवीरात्मनि द्वेष्यं मनसा ध्यायन्
text_mt: With "Saṃyac and Pracetas...", [he places] five all-god bricks (vaiśvadevī) on the body [of the altar], contemplating in mind the person he hates.

sanskrit_iast: kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā /
meaning: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा /
text_mt: "With what help will the wonderful one be present to us, the ever-increasing friend,
What true, most generous exhilaration of the drinks will gladden you with the draught,
Do protect us well, your friends, your praisers;
be present with a hundred aids"—thus the Vāmadevya [hymn].
"Indra, with the bones of Dadhīca, unresisted,
grew mighty, fierce, undefeated, slaying the obstacles"—thus the Atharvaśiras, ten [bricks] interlinked.
"In the eastern half there is the drawing out of the head;

sanskrit_iast: abhi tvā śūra nonumo 'dugdhā iva dhenavaḥ /
meaning: अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमो ऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः /
text_mt: "Unto you, O hero, we roar aloud like unmilked cows,
to the lord of this moving world, beholding the sun, the lord, O Indra, of what stands still,

sanskrit_iast: na tvāvām̐ anyo divyo na pārthivaḥ /
meaning: न त्वावाम्̐ अन्यो दिव्यो न पार्थिवः /
text_mt: None like you, neither celestial nor earthly,

sanskrit_iast: na jāto na janiṣyate aśvāyanto maghavannindra vājinaḥ /
meaning: न जातो न जनिष्यते अश्वायन्तो मघवन्निन्द्र वाजिनः /
text_mt: “None has been born, nor will be born, equal to you. Desiring horses, bountiful Indra, rich in spoils,

sanskrit_iast: gavyantastvā havāmaha iti rathaṃtaraṃ dakṣiṇe pakṣe 'dhyātmannapavargaḥ
meaning: गव्यन्तस्त्वा हवामह इति रथंतरं दक्षिणे पक्षे ऽध्यात्मन्नपवर्गः
text_mt: desiring cattle, we call upon you”—with these words [he places the bricks of] the Rathaṃtara on the southern wing; the conclusion is on the body [of the altar].
Having placed the first, then the second, [he places] the viśayā brick:
half on the body, half on the wing.
“You indeed we call upon, the poets, in the winning of booty;
you, Indra, true lord amidst the foes, men [call upon] you in the racecourses, swift horse;
So, wonderful one, bolt in hand, boldly,
scatter cow, horse, chariot-horse, O Indra;

sanskrit_iast: satrā vājaṃ na jigyuṣa iti bṛhaduttare pakṣe
meaning: सत्रा वाजं न जिग्युष इति बृहदुत्तरे पक्षे
text_mt: bestow booty at once upon the winner”—with these words [he places the bricks of] the Bṛhat on the northern wing.
Its procedure is like that of the Rathaṃtara.

sanskrit_iast: yajñāyajñā vo agnaye girāgirā ca dakṣase /
meaning: यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे /
text_mt: “At every sacrifice for your Agni, with song after song for the capable,

sanskrit_iast: prapra vayamamṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śamsiṣam /
meaning: प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शम्सिषम् /
text_mt:
forth we sing the immortal Jātavedas, like a dear friend;

like a dear friend.
He, the child of strength, being well disposed toward us,
May he be our helper in battles, may he be our increaser,
and the protector of our bodies”—with these words [he places the bricks of] the Yajñāyajñīya on the tail.
Its procedure is like that of the Rathaṃtara.
Having placed the bull brick with “You, Agni, the bull...”, [he places] the Prājāpatyā brick with “Image of the year...”.
With “For him who has a hundred weapons, a hundred strengths...”, [he places] five Ājyānī bricks, one in each quarter and one in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya vajro 'sīti catasro vajriṇīḥ pratidiśamaśmana iṣuhasta upadadhāti
meaning: इन्द्रस्य वज्रो ऽसीति चतस्रो वज्रिणीः प्रतिदिशमश्मन इषुहस्त उपदधाति
text_mt: With “You are Indra's bolt...”, holding an arrow in his hand, he places four Vajriṇī stones in each quarter.

meaning: इन्द्रस्य वज्रो ऽसि वार्त्रघ्नस्तनूपा नः प्रतिस्पशः /
text_mt: “You are Indra’s bolt, slayer of Vṛtra, protector of our bodies, confronting spies.

sanskrit_iast: yo na upariṣṭādaghāyurabhidāsatyetaṃ so 'śmānamṛcchatviti madhye pañcamīmeke samāmananti
meaning: यो न उपरिष्टादघायुरभिदासत्येतं सो ऽश्मानमृच्छत्विति मध्ये पञ्चमीमेके समामनन्ति
text_mt: Whoever attacks us from above with evil intent, may he meet this stone”—with these words some teach a fifth in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyai tvāntarikṣāya tvā dive tveti tisro lokeṣṭakāḥ
meaning: पृथिव्यै त्वान्तरिक्षाय त्वा दिवे त्वेति तिस्रो लोकेष्टकाः
text_mt: With “To the earth you, to the atmosphere you, to heaven you”, [he places] three Lokeṣṭakā bricks.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye tvā pavamānāyāgnaye tvā pāvakāyāgnaye tvā śucaya iti tisraḥ pāvamānīḥ
meaning: अग्नये त्वा पवमानायाग्नये त्वा पावकायाग्नये त्वा शुचय इति तिस्रः पावमानीः
text_mt: With “To Agni Pavamāna you, to Agni Pāvaka you, to Agni Śuci you”, [he places] three Pāvamānī bricks.

sanskrit_iast: ṛcā tvā chandasā sādayāmi vaṣaṭkāreṇa tvā chandasā sādayāmi hiṅkāreṇa tvā chandasā sādayāmi prastāvena tvā chandasā sādayāmi pratihāreṇa tvā chandasā sādayāmyudgīthena tvā chandasā sādayāmi nidhanena tvā chandasā sādayāmīti sapta cchandasyāḥ
meaning: ऋचा त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि वषट्कारेण त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि हिङ्कारेण त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि प्रस्तावेन त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि प्रतिहारेण त्वा छन्दसा सादयाम्युद्गीथेन त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि निधनेन त्वा छन्दसा सादयामीति सप्त च्छन्दस्याः
text_mt: “With the ṛc metre I settle you; with the vaṣaṭ-call metre I settle you; with the hiṅ-sound metre I settle you; with the prastāva metre I settle you; with the pratihāra metre I settle you; with the udgītha metre I settle you; with the nidhana metre I settle you”—thus [he places] the seven Chandasyā bricks.

sanskrit_iast: ange yaśasvinniti catasro rāṣṭrabhṛtaḥ purastādupadhāya hiraṇyeṣṭakābhiḥ sarvato mukhamupadadhāti
meaning: अन्गे यशस्विन्निति चतस्रो राष्ट्रभृतः पुरस्तादुपधाय हिरण्येष्टकाभिः सर्वतो मुखमुपदधाति
text_mt: Having placed the four Rāṣṭrabhṛt bricks in front with “O body, glorious...”, he places [the layer] facing in all directions with gold bricks.
It has been said: “He places the Gāyatrī in front”.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṃ purastādupadadhāti triṣṭubhaṃ dakṣiṇato jagatīṃ paścādanuṣṭubhamuttarataḥ paṅktiṃ madhye /
meaning: गायत्रीं पुरस्तादुपदधाति त्रिष्टुभं दक्षिणतो जगतीं पश्चादनुष्टुभमुत्तरतः पङ्क्तिं मध्ये /
text_mt: “He places the Gāyatrī in front, the Triṣṭubh in the south, the Jagatī in the west, the Anuṣṭubh in the north, the Paṅkti in the middle”—
with all of these he places [the layer] facing in all directions.
They begin with the Gāyatrī and end with the Paṅkti.
“Agni, that horse today...”—these [verses] are recited.

sanskrit_iast: agna ā yāhi vītaya iti caitābhiḥ sarvato mukhamupadadhāti
meaning: अग्न आ याहि वीतय इति चैताभिः सर्वतो मुखमुपदधाति
text_mt: And with these [verses beginning with] “Come, Agni, to the feast...”, he places [bricks] facing in all directions.
Or here he may place the Vikarṇī and the Svayamātṛṇā.
The end of the layer is with Lokaṃpṛṇā [bricks] and the like.

sanskrit_iast: yukṣvā hi devahūtamāniti dvābhyāṃ saṃcitamagnimabhimṛśya vasvastvā rudraiḥ purastātpāntvityetairyathāliṅgaṃ saṃcitamagnimājyena prokṣati /
meaning: युक्ष्वा हि देवहूतमानिति द्वाभ्यां संचितमग्निमभिमृश्य वस्वस्त्वा रुद्रैः पुरस्तात्पान्त्वित्येतैर्यथालिङ्गं संचितमग्निमाज्येन प्रोक्षति /
text_mt: with the two verses “Harness those who best invoke the gods...”, having touched the piled Agni, he sprinkles the piled Agni with clarified butter according to the characteristic marks with [the mantras beginning with] “May the Vasus with the Rudras protect you in the east...”.
Facing east, in the middle with the last [mantra].

sanskrit_iast: sahasrasya pramā asīti sahasreṇa hiraṇyaśalkairūrdhvastiṣṭhanpratidiśamagniṃ prokṣati dvābhyāṃdvābhyāṃ śatābhyām /
meaning: सहस्रस्य प्रमा असीति सहस्रेण हिरण्यशल्कैरूर्ध्वस्तिष्ठन्प्रतिदिशमग्निं प्रोक्षति द्वाभ्यांद्वाभ्यां शताभ्याम् /
text_mt: Standing upright, with “You are the measure of a thousand...”, he sprinkles the fire in each quarter with a thousand gold chips, two hundred [for each quarter].
Facing east, in the middle with the last two hundred.

sanskrit_iast: imā me agna iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santvitīṣṭakā debūryajamānaḥ kurute
meaning: इमा मे अग्न इष्टका धेनवः सन्त्वितीष्टका देबूर्यजमानः कुरुते
text_mt: With “May these bricks, O Agni, be milch-cows to me...”, the sacrificer renders the bricks yielding.

sanskrit_iast: aiḍikyā cityādhvaryuragnimabhimṛśya śatarudrīyaṃ juhoti jartilayavāgvā gavīdhukayavāgvā vā jartilairgavīdhukasaktubhiḥ kusayasarpiṣājākṣīreṇa mṛgīkṣīreṇa vārkaparṇenodaṅtiṣṭan /
meaning: ऐडिक्या चित्याध्वर्युरग्निमभिमृश्य शतरुद्रीयं जुहोति जर्तिलयवाग्वा गवीधुकयवाग्वा वा जर्तिलैर्गवीधुकसक्तुभिः कुसयसर्पिषाजाक्षीरेण मृगीक्षीरेण वार्कपर्णेनोदङ्तिष्टन् /
text_mt: The adhvaryu, having touched the fire with the Aiḍikī layer, standing facing north, offers the Śatarudrīya with gruel of wild sesame or with gruel of gavīdhukā grains, or with wild sesame, gavīdhukā groats, butter from a kusaya vessel, goat's milk, or the milk of a wild doe, using an arka leaf,

sanskrit_iast: uttarasya pakṣasyottarāparasyāṃ sraktyāṃ vikarṇyāṃ svayamātṛṇāyāmanuparicāraṃ vā
meaning: उत्तरस्य पक्षस्योत्तरापरस्यां स्रक्त्यां विकर्ण्यां स्वयमातृणायामनुपरिचारं वा
text_mt: on the north-western corner of the northern wing, on the Vikarṇī, on the Svayamātṛṇā, or moving all around.

sanskrit_iast: namaste rudra manyava ityetānanuvākāṃstraidhaṃ vibhajyāpi vā prathamādupakramya namastakṣabhya iti jānudaghne dhārayamāṇo rathakārebhyaśca va ityupakramya namaḥ svāyudhāyeti nābhidaghne śeṣeṇa prāgavatānebhya āsyadaghne hutvā sahasrāṇi sahasraśa iti daśāvatānānhutvānvārohāñjuhoti
meaning: नमस्ते रुद्र मन्यव इत्येताननुवाकांस्त्रैधं विभज्यापि वा प्रथमादुपक्रम्य नमस्तक्षभ्य इति जानुदघ्ने धारयमाणो रथकारेभ्यश्च व इत्युपक्रम्य नमः स्वायुधायेति नाभिदघ्ने शेषेण प्रागवतानेभ्य आस्यदघ्ने हुत्वा सहस्राणि सहस्रश इति दशावतानान्हुत्वान्वारोहाञ्जुहोति
text_mt: Having divided these anuvākas beginning with “Homage, Rudra, to your anger...” into three parts, or alternatively beginning from the first, holding [the ladle] at knee height up to “Homage to the carpenters...”, and beginning with “And to your chariot-makers...” at navel height up to “Homage to him of good weapons...”, and having offered the remainder up to the descending formulas at mouth height, and having offered the ten descending formulas beginning with “Thousands in thousands...”, he offers the ascending formulas.

sanskrit_iast: namo rudrebhyo ye pṛthivyāmiti jānudaghne dhārayamāṇo namo rudrebhyo ye 'ntarikṣa iti nābhidaghne namo rudrebhyo ye divītyāsyadaghne hutvaitāneva yajamānaṃ vācayitvaitāneva viparītānpratyavarohānhutvā saṃcare paśūnāmarkaparṇamudasyati
meaning: नमो रुद्रेभ्यो ये पृथिव्यामिति जानुदघ्ने धारयमाणो नमो रुद्रेभ्यो ये ऽन्तरिक्ष इति नाभिदघ्ने नमो रुद्रेभ्यो ये दिवीत्यास्यदघ्ने हुत्वैतानेव यजमानं वाचयित्वैतानेव विपरीतान्प्रत्यवरोहान्हुत्वा संचरे पशूनामर्कपर्णमुदस्यति
text_mt: Holding [the leaf] at knee height with “Homage to the Rudras who are on earth...”, at navel height with “Homage to the Rudras who are in the atmosphere...”, having offered at mouth height with “Homage to the Rudras who are in heaven...”, having made the sacrificer recite these very [formulas], and having offered these same formulas in reverse order as descending offerings, he throws up the arka leaf in the cattle path.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dviṣyāttasya saṃcare yasya rudraḥ prajāṃ paśūnvābhimanyetodaṅ paretya rudrāñjapaṃścaredityayajñasaṃyuktaḥ kalpaḥ
meaning: यं द्विष्यात्तस्य संचरे यस्य रुद्रः प्रजां पशून्वाभिमन्येतोदङ् परेत्य रुद्राञ्जपंश्चरेदित्ययज्ञसंयुक्तः कल्पः
text_mt: “In the path of him whom he hates; or, if Rudra should afflict someone's offspring or cattle, he should go away toward the north and wander reciting the Rudra hymns”—this is a procedure not connected with the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yo rudro agnāviti raudraṃ gāvīdhukaṃ carum
meaning: यो रुद्रो अग्नाविति रौद्रं गावीधुकं चरुम्
text_mt: With “The Rudra who is in the fire...”, [he takes] a caru of gavīdhukā grains dedicated to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast: etena yajuṣā yasyāmiṣṭakāyāṃ śatarudrīyaṃ juhoti tasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: एतेन यजुषा यस्यामिष्टकायां शतरुद्रीयं जुहोति तस्यां प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: With this yajus formula he establishes it on the brick upon which he offers the Śatarudrīya.

sanskrit_iast: tisṛdhanvamayācitaṃ yajamāno brāhmaṇāya dattvā yatte rudra puro dhanurityetairyathāliṅgamupatiṣṭhate
meaning: तिसृधन्वमयाचितं यजमानो ब्राह्मणाय दत्त्वा यत्ते रुद्र पुरो धनुरित्येतैर्यथालिङ्गमुपतिष्ठते
text_mt: Having given an unasked-for bow with three arrows to a brahmin, the sacrificer reverences [the fire] according to their characteristic marks with [the mantras beginning with] “The bow that is yours in the east, Rudra...”.
Taking a water jar, the adhvaryu circumambulates the fire three times from left to right, pouring water around with “Firmness, vigor...”.

sanskrit_iast: nidhāya kumbhamaśmāste kṣudamuṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣma iti trirapariṣiñcanpratiparyeti
meaning: निधाय कुम्भमश्मास्ते क्षुदमुं ते शुगृच्छतु यं द्विष्म इति त्रिरपरिषिञ्चन्प्रतिपर्येति
text_mt: Having set down the pot, he walks around counter-clockwise three times without pouring, with the mantra: 'The stone is your hunger; let that sorrow reach him whom we hate.'

sanskrit_iast: yadyabhicaredidamahamamuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasyāyuḥ prakṣiṇomīti dakṣiṇasyāmuttarasyāṃ vā sraktyāṃ kumbhaṃ prakṣiṇuyāt
meaning: यद्यभिचरेदिदमहममुष्यामुष्यायणस्यायुः प्रक्षिणोमीति दक्षिणस्यामुत्तरस्यां वा स्रक्त्यां कुम्भं प्रक्षिणुयात्
text_mt: If he would perform sorcery, he should shatter the pot on the southern or the northern corner, saying: 'Here I cut off the life of so-and-so, son of so-and-so.'

sanskrit_iast: avakā vetasaśākhāṃ maṇḍūkaṃ ca dīrghavaṃśe prabadhya samudrasya tvāvākayeti saptabhiraṣṭābhirvāgniṃ vikarṣati
meaning: अवका वेतसशाखां मण्डूकं च दीर्घवंशे प्रबध्य समुद्रस्य त्वावाकयेति सप्तभिरष्टाभिर्वाग्निं विकर्षति
text_mt: Having tied an avakā plant, a reed-branch, and a frog to a long bamboo, he drags [them] over the fire with seven or eight [mantras], beginning with: 'Thee, of the ocean, with the avakā...'
Having indeed extinguished [the burning parts] while dragging, having stopped all the vital breaths of the frog, he tosses [them] onto the rubbish heap.
Whomever he might hate, he should touch him with these.
The two wings, with the Bṛhat and the Rathaṃtara;
The tail, with the Ṛtusthā-Yajñāyajñīya;
On the right hip, with the Vāravantīya;
On the left hip, with the Vāmadevya.
Near the wing, he sings the verse-less Sāman of Prajāpati.
The hotṛ recites after [him] with the saṃcita-ukthya [hymn], beginning with: 'Father Mātariśvan...'
If the hotṛ is unwilling, the adhvaryu causes the sacrificer to recite the milkings of the chant and the recitation.
At the mantra: 'Thou art the praised of the praised,' he dismantles the Pravargya.

sanskrit_iast: juhvāṃ pañcagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā svayaṃ kṛṇvāna iti dve
meaning: जुह्वां पञ्चगृहीतं गृहीत्वा स्वयं कृण्वान इति द्वे
text_mt: Having taken five portions [of clarified butter] in the juhū spoon, [he offers] two [oblations] with the verse: 'Making oneself...'
'Granting dispensation to the descendant of Manu, beholding the straight path,

sanskrit_iast: ajuṣanta maruto yajñametaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ devānāmamṛtaṃ svarvidam //
meaning: अजुषन्त मरुतो यज्ञमेतं वृष्टिं देवानाममृतं स्वर्विदम् //
text_mt: The Maruts enjoyed this sacrifice, the rain of the gods, the immortal, sun-finding.'
'Turning round in the midst of the world, transforming the creatures, begetting various forms,

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraḥ parameṣṭhī dhṛtavrato yajñaṃ naḥ pātu rajasaḥ purastāt //
meaning: संवत्सरः परमेष्ठी धृतव्रतो यज्ञं नः पातु रजसः पुरस्तात् //
text_mt: May the Year, the supreme lord of steadfast observance, protect our sacrifice before the aerial space.'

sanskrit_iast: prajāṃ dadātu parivatasaro no dhātā dadātu sumanasyamānaḥ /
meaning: प्रजां ददातु परिवतसरो नो धाता ददातु सुमनस्यमानः /
text_mt: 'May the Parivatsara give us offspring; may the Creator, well-disposed, give [offspring]!

sanskrit_iast: bahvīḥ sākaṃ bahudhā viśvarūpā ekavratā māmabhisaṃviśantviti pañcānvārohānhutvāparaṃ pañcagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā kārṣṇī upānahāvupamuñcate /
meaning: बह्वीः साकं बहुधा विश्वरूपा एकव्रता मामभिसंविशन्त्विति पञ्चान्वारोहान्हुत्वापरं पञ्चगृहीतं गृहीत्वा कार्ष्णी उपानहावुपमुञ्चते /
text_mt: May many, manifold, all-formed [creatures] of one vow enter together into me'—having offered these five Anvāroha oblations and taken another five portions [of clarified butter], he puts on two shoes made of black-antelope skin,
With the two [verses]: 'Homage to thy heat, to thy flame...,' he mounts the fire-altar;
The sacrificer [mounts] with: 'I have stepped onto the earth...'

sanskrit_iast: nṛṣade vaḍiti pañcabhiruttaravedivadagniṃ svayamātṛṇāṃ vā vyāghārya ye devā devānāmiti dvābhyāmanuparicāraṃ dadhnā madhumiśreṇa darbhagrumuṣṭināgniṃ vyavokṣya kūrmapṛṣantaṃ kṛtvā prāṇadā apānadā iti pratyavaruhyāgnistigmeneti dvābhyāmagnaye 'nīkavata ekāmāhutiṃ hutvā
meaning: नृषदे वडिति पञ्चभिरुत्तरवेदिवदग्निं स्वयमातृणां वा व्याघार्य ये देवा देवानामिति द्वाभ्यामनुपरिचारं दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण दर्भग्रुमुष्टिनाग्निं व्यवोक्ष्य कूर्मपृषन्तं कृत्वा प्राणदा अपानदा इति प्रत्यवरुह्याग्निस्तिग्मेनेति द्वाभ्यामग्नये ऽनीकवत एकामाहुतिं हुत्वा
text_mt: Having sprinkled the fire-altar or the naturally perforated stone as in the case of the high altar with five [formulas] beginning with: 'To the dweller among men, vaṭ!,' having sprinkled the fire-altar with curds mixed with honey by means of a handful of darbha roots following the verses: 'Which gods of the gods...,' making it like a tortoise-back, having stepped down with: 'Givers of breath, givers of downward breath...,' and having offered one oblation to Agni Anīkavat with the two [verses] beginning with: 'Agni with sharp...'
Having filled the sruc ladle with sixteen portions [of clarified butter], he offers the Vaiśvakarmaṇa oblations:
'He who, offering all these worlds...';

sanskrit_iast: cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīra iti nānāsūktābhyāṃ dve āhutī
meaning: चक्षुषः पिता मनसा हि धीर इति नानासूक्ताभ्यां द्वे आहुती
text_mt: 'Father of the eye, for wise in mind...'—thus two oblations from the two different hymns.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta ciraṃ pāpmano nirmucyetetyekaikaṃ tasyetyuktam
meaning: यं कामयेत चिरं पाप्मनो निर्मुच्येतेत्येकैकं तस्येत्युक्तम्
text_mt: For whomever he desires that he should be freed from evil for a long time, [he should offer] each one singly for him—thus it is declared.

sanskrit_iast: yadyenamudake bhīrvidnedudakāñjalimādāya samudrāya vayunāyetyapsu juhuyādityayajñasaṃyuktaḥ kalpaḥ
meaning: यद्येनमुदके भीर्विद्नेदुदकाञ्जलिमादाय समुद्राय वयुनायेत्यप्सु जुहुयादित्ययज्ञसंयुक्तः कल्पः
text_mt: If fear of water should seize him, he should take a hollowed handful of water and offer it into water with: 'To the ocean, to the path...'—this is a procedure not connected with the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: udenamuttarāṃ nayetyaudumbarīḥ samidho ghṛtoṣitāstisṛbhistisra ādhāya paśubandhavadagniṃ praṇayati
meaning: उदेनमुत्तरां नयेत्यौदुम्बरीः समिधो घृतोषितास्तिसृभिस्तिस्र आधाय पशुबन्धवदग्निं प्रणयति
text_mt: With the three verses beginning with: 'Lead him higher...,' having placed three udumbara kindling-sticks soaked in ghee, he leads the fire forward as in the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: udu tvā viśve devā ityagnimudyamya pañca diśo daivīriti pañcabhirharatyāgnīdhrāt
meaning: उदु त्वा विश्वे देवा इत्यग्निमुद्यम्य पञ्च दिशो दैवीरिति पञ्चभिर्हरत्याग्नीध्रात्
text_mt: Having lifted up the fire with: 'Up, indeed, thee, all the gods...,' he carries it from the Āgnīdhra with five [verses], beginning with: 'Five divine quarters...'

sanskrit_iast: āśuḥ śiśāna iti dakṣiṇato brahmā daśarcenānveti /
meaning: आशुः शिशान इति दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा दशर्चेनान्वेति /
text_mt: The brahman follows along on the south with the ten-verse hymn: 'Swift, sharpening...';
Or the maitrāvaruṇa, or the pratiprasthātṛ.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta rāṣṭraṃ syāditi tametena saṃnahyānviyāt /
meaning: यं कामयेत राष्ट्रं स्यादिति तमेतेन संनह्यान्वियात् /
text_mt: Whomever he would desire that he should possess a kingdom, he should follow along having equipped him with this [hymn];
An oblation should be made when a battle is joined;
The firewood consists of reed or Madhuka wood—this is a procedure not connected with the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: vimāna eṣa divo madhya āsta iti dvābhyāmāgnīdhre 'śmānaṃ nidhāyendraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhanniti catasṛbhirāpucchādgatvā
meaning: विमान एष दिवो मध्य आस्त इति द्वाभ्यामाग्नीध्रे ऽश्मानं निधायेन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्निति चतसृभिरापुच्छाद्गत्वा
text_mt: Having placed a stone in the Āgnīdhra with the two [verses]: 'This measure sits in the middle of heaven...,' and having walked as far as the tail with the four [verses]: 'All have magnified Indra...'

sanskrit_iast: prācīmanu pradiśamiti pañcabhiragnimadhiruhya naktoṣāsāgne sahasarākṣeti dvābhyāṃ saṃhitābhyāṃ dadhnaḥ pūrṇāmaudumbarīṃ svayamātṛṇāyāṃ juhoti
meaning: प्राचीमनु प्रदिशमिति पञ्चभिरग्निमधिरुह्य नक्तोषासाग्ने सहसराक्षेति द्वाभ्यां संहिताभ्यां दध्नः पूर्णामौदुम्बरीं स्वयमातृणायां जुहोति
text_mt: Having mounted the fire-altar with the five [formulas]: 'Along the eastern direction...,' he offers an udumbara [ladle] full of curd onto the naturally perforated stone with the two connected [verses]: 'Night and Dawn...,' 'O Agni of a thousand eyes...'
With 'Night and Dawn...,' he offers with milk from a black cow with a white calf.
Some say he sprinkles it with milk.

sanskrit_iast: ūrṇāvantaṃ prathamaḥ sīda yonimiti hoturabhijñāya paśukānsaṃbhārānnyupya suparṇo 'si garutmāniti tisṛbhiḥ svayamātṛṇāyāmagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya preddho agne dīdihi puro na ityaudumbarīṃ samidhamādadhāti
meaning: ऊर्णावन्तं प्रथमः सीद योनिमिति होतुरभिज्ञाय पशुकान्संभारान्न्युप्य सुपर्णो ऽसि गरुत्मानिति तिसृभिः स्वयमातृणायामग्निं प्रतिष्ठाप्य प्रेद्धो अग्ने दीदिहि पुरो न इत्यौदुम्बरीं समिधमादधाति
text_mt: Recognizing the hotṛ's [verse]: 'Sit thou first in the wool-bearing womb...,' having scattered the materials for [obtaining] cattle, and having established the fire upon the naturally perforated stone with the three [verses]: 'Thou art the winged eagle...,' he places an udumbara kindling-stick with: 'Kindled, O Agni, shine before us...'

sanskrit_iast: vidhema te parame janmannagna iti vaikaṅkatīm
meaning: विधेम ते परमे जन्मन्नग्न इति वैकङ्कतीम्
text_mt: A vaikaṅkata [kindling-stick] with: 'Let us honor thee in the highest birth, O Agni...'
A śamī [kindling-stick] with: 'That wondrous [glory] of Savitṛ the desirable...'

sanskrit_iast: agne tamadyāśvamiti dve āhutī hutvā dvādaśagṛhītena srucaṃ pūrayitvā sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvā iti saptavatyā pūrṇāhutiṃ juhoti
meaning: अग्ने तमद्याश्वमिति द्वे आहुती हुत्वा द्वादशगृहीतेन स्रुचं पूरयित्वा सप्त ते अग्ने समिधः सप्त जिह्वा इति सप्तवत्या पूर्णाहुतिं जुहोति
text_mt: Having offered two oblations with: 'O Agni, this horse today...,' and having filled the sruc ladle with twelve portions [of clarified butter], he offers the full oblation with the verse containing 'seven': 'Seven are thy kindling-sticks, O Agni, seven thy tongues...'

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ juhvadiha so 'stviti digbhyo 'gniṃ manasā dhyāyati
meaning: तां जुह्वदिह सो ऽस्त्विति दिग्भ्यो ऽग्निं मनसा ध्यायति
text_mt: Offering it, he meditates mentally on the fire from the quarters with: 'May he be here!'
Having performed [the rites] up to the sprinkling of the altar ground, he commences the ritual procedure of the Vaiśvānara [sacrifice].

sanskrit_iast: vedaṃ kṛtvāgniṃ paristīrya pāṇiprakṣālanādi karma pratipadyate
meaning: वेदं कृत्वाग्निं परिस्तीर्य पाणिप्रक्षालनादि कर्म प्रतिपद्यते
text_mt: Having made the sacred broom and strewn around the fire, he proceeds to the action beginning with the washing of the hands.
The preparation of the utensils is according to requirement.

sanskrit_iast: nirvapaṇakāle vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirupya sapta mārutānsaptakapālānnirvapati
meaning: निर्वपणकाले वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालं निरुप्य सप्त मारुतान्सप्तकपालान्निर्वपति
text_mt: At the time of apportioning [the oblations], having apportioned [the oblation] on twelve potsherds for Vaiśvānara, he apportions seven [cakes] on seven potsherds for the Maruts.
They are attended to silently.
At the time of issuing calls, he issues the call omitting the wife.
At the time of taking the clarified butter, he takes [it] into the dhruvā spoon only.
He proceeds to the rite beginning with the consecration of the sprinkling-waters.

sanskrit_iast: staraṇakāle 'pareṇāgniṃ barhiḥ stīrtvā dhruvāṃ sruvaṃ ca sādayati
meaning: स्तरणकाले ऽपरेणाग्निं बर्हिः स्तीर्त्वा ध्रुवां स्रुवं च सादयति
text_mt: At the time of strewing [the sacrificial grass], having strewn the sacrificial grass to the west of the fire, he sets down the dhruvā-ladle and the sruva-spoon.
He adapts the formula: "May these two sit down..."
Having put down the grass broom, he proceeds to the sāmidhenī verses.

sanskrit_iast: na saṃpreṣyati na saṃmārṣṭi na prayājānyajati
meaning: न संप्रेष्यति न संमार्ष्टि न प्रयाजान्यजति
text_mt: He does not issue a ritual call, he does not wipe [the spoons], and he does not offer the fore-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya juhvāmupastīrya kṛtsnaṃ vaiśvānaramavadāya dvirabhighāryoccairvaiśvānarasyāśrāvayati
meaning: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य जुह्वामुपस्तीर्य कृत्स्नं वैश्वानरमवदाय द्विरभिघार्योच्चैर्वैश्वानरस्याश्रावयति
text_mt: Having performed the two butter-portion offerings, having spread [ghee] as an underlayer in the juhū-spoon, having cut off the whole Vaiśvānara [cake], and having basted it twice, he calls loudly for the Vaiśvānara [offering].
He offers silently the offerings to the Maruts as entirely offered.

sanskrit_iast: īdṛṅ cānyādṛṅ ceti saptabhirgaṇairāsīno hastena gaṇena gaṇamanudrutya mārutāñjuhoti
meaning: ईदृङ् चान्यादृङ् चेति सप्तभिर्गणैरासीनो हस्तेन गणेन गणमनुद्रुत्य मारुताञ्जुहोति
text_mt: Seated, reciting group by group [the formula beginning] "Such and otherwise-such..." with the seven groups, he offers the Marut offerings by hand.
Some say: he offers group by group with the forest-recitation in the middle.
Some say: he encloses the Vaiśvānara all around with the Marut offerings.

sanskrit_iast: svatavāṃśca praghāsī ca sāṃtapanaśca gṛhamedhī ca krīḍī ca sākī corjiṣī cetyeṣa ṣaṣṭha āmnātaḥ
meaning: स्वतवांश्च प्रघासी च सांतपनश्च गृहमेधी च क्रीडी च साकी चोर्जिषी चेत्येष षष्ठ आम्नातः
text_mt: "And the powerful one, and the consumer, and the scorcher, and the householder, and the playful one, and the mighty one, and the vigorous one"—this is taught as the sixth [group].
He attaches "and the measured, and the commensurate" everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta kṣatraṃ viśa ojīyaḥ syāditi grāme 'nuvākyasya trīṇi catvāri vā padānyanudrutyāraṇye'nuvākyamanudrutya grāme'nuvākyasya śeṣeṇa juhuyāt
meaning: यदि कामयेत क्षत्रं विश ओजीयः स्यादिति ग्रामे ऽनुवाक्यस्य त्रीणि चत्वारि वा पदान्यनुद्रुत्यारण्येऽनुवाक्यमनुद्रुत्य ग्रामेऽनुवाक्यस्य शेषेण जुहुयात्
text_mt: If he should desire: "May the nobility be stronger than the commonalty," he should, after reciting three or four words of the village-recitation, recite the forest-recitation, and offer with the remainder of the village-recitation.
Thus, having offered with three groups from the beginning, he should offer with the forest-recitation.
As with the former [groups], so with the three subsequent groups.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta viṭ kṣatrādojīyasī syāditi yathāsamāmnātamāditastribhirgaṇairhutvāraṇye'nuvākyasya ṣaṭsu padāntarāleṣu ṣaḍgaṇānopyāraṇye'nuvākyena juhuyāt
meaning: यदि कामयेत विट् क्षत्रादोजीयसी स्यादिति यथासमाम्नातमादितस्त्रिभिर्गणैर्हुत्वारण्येऽनुवाक्यस्य षट्सु पदान्तरालेषु षड्गणानोप्यारण्येऽनुवाक्येन जुहुयात्
text_mt: If he should desire: "May the commonalty be stronger than the nobility," having offered as handed down with three groups from the beginning, having inserted six groups into the intervals of the six words of the forest-recitation, he should offer with the forest-recitation.
As with the former [groups], so with the three subsequent groups.
He does not issue a ritual call, he does not wipe [the spoons], and he does not offer the after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta kṣatreṇāsya kṣatraṃ hanyātprasvādāyatanāccyaveteti tasyāraṇye'nuvākyenāgniṣṭhaṃ rathavāhanaṃ vā vyaṅgayedityayajñasaṃyuktaḥ kalpaḥ
meaning: यं कामयेत क्षत्रेणास्य क्षत्रं हन्यात्प्रस्वादायतनाच्च्यवेतेति तस्यारण्येऽनुवाक्येनाग्निष्ठं रथवाहनं वा व्यङ्गयेदित्ययज्ञसंयुक्तः कल्पः
text_mt: "If he should desire of someone: 'May he smite his nobility with nobility, may he fall from his own domain,' he should cripple his chariot-chassis standing at the fire with the forest-recitation"—this is a procedure unconnected with the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: agnāviṣṇū sajoṣaseti caturgṛhītaṃ hutvaudubarīṃ srucaṃ vyāyāmamātrīṃ mṛdā pradigdhāṃ paścādāsecanavatīṃ ghṛtasya pūrayitvā vājaśca me prasavaśca ma iti saṃtatāṃ vasordhārāṃ juhotyā mantrasamāpanāt
meaning: अग्नाविष्णू सजोषसेति चतुर्गृहीतं हुत्वौदुबरीं स्रुचं व्यायाममात्रीं मृदा प्रदिग्धां पश्चादासेचनवतीं घृतस्य पूरयित्वा वाजश्च मे प्रसवश्च म इति संततां वसोर्धारां जुहोत्या मन्त्रसमापनात्
text_mt: Having offered a fourfold portion of ghee with "O Agni and Viṣṇu, being in harmony...", having filled an udumbara ladle of a vyāyāma's length, smeared with clay, and having a pouring-lip at the back, with clarified butter, he offers the continuous Shower of Wealth with "And my food, and my production..." up to the conclusion of the formula.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta prāṇānasyānnādyaṃ vi chindyāmiti vigrāhaṃ tasyetyuktam
meaning: यं कामयेत प्राणानस्यान्नाद्यं वि छिन्द्यामिति विग्राहं तस्येत्युक्तम्
text_mt: It has been said: "If he should desire concerning someone: 'May I cut off his vital breaths and food,' [he should offer it] discontinuously for him."
In whatever ghee remains, having cooked the brahmaudana porridge, he should feed four brahmins.
Or, having cooked porridge measuring four śarāvas, he should feed [them] with that [ghee] as condiment.
To those who have eaten, he should give four milch cows.
[There are] three [verses beginning] "From the ocean the wave..."

sanskrit_iast: tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhirguhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtamanvavindan /
meaning: त्रिधा हितं पणिभिर्गुह्यमानं गवि देवासो घृतमन्वविन्दन् /
text_mt:
"Deposited threefold, hidden by the Paṇis, the gods discovered the clarified butter in the cow;
Indra generated one [part], Sūrya one, [and] from Vena they fashioned one by their own inherent power.

sanskrit_iast: indra ekaṃ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venādekaṃ svadhayā niṣṭatakṣuḥ //
meaning: इन्द्र एकं सूर्य एकं जजान वेनादेकं स्वधया निष्टतक्षुः //
text_mt:
These flow from the ocean of the heart, having a hundred enclosures, unseen by the deceiver;
I gaze upon the streams of clarified butter; in their midst is the golden reed.

Like rivers the streams flow well together, being purified within the heart by the mind;
These waves of clarified butter flow forth like fleeing deer escaping the hunter.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām //
meaning: घृतस्य धारा अभि चाकशीमि हिरण्ययो वेतसो मध्य आसाम् //
text_mt:
Swift as the wind, they fly along like rapid [currents] on the course of a river, the streaming [drops];
Like a red racehorse bursting through the course, the stream of clarified butter swells with waves.

sanskrit_iast: samyak sravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ /
meaning: सम्यक् स्रवन्ति सरितो न धेना अन्तर्हृदा मनसा पूयमानाः /
text_mt:
Like beautiful young women smiling as they go to an assembly, they flow towards the fire;
Streams of clarified butter reach the kindling-sticks; enjoying them, Jātavedas rejoices.

sanskrit_iast: ete arṣantyūrmayo ghṛtasya mṛgā iva kṣipaṇorīṣamāṇāḥ //
meaning: एते अर्षन्त्यूर्मयो घृतस्य मृगा इव क्षिपणोरीषमाणाः //
text_mt:
Like maidens adorning themselves to go to the wedding, I gaze upon [them];
Where soma is pressed, where the sacrifice is, thither flow the streams of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: sindhoriva prādhvane śūghanāso vātapramiyaḥ patayanti yajvāḥ /
meaning: सिन्धोरिव प्राध्वने शूघनासो वातप्रमियः पतयन्ति यज्वाः /
text_mt:
Flow toward the sweet praise, toward the race for cattle; place blessed treasures in us;
Lead this sacrifice of ours to the gods; the streams of clarified butter flow sweetly."

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtasya dhārā aruṣo na vājī kāṣṭhā bhindannūrmibhiḥ pinvamānaḥ //
meaning: घृतस्य धारा अरुषो न वाजी काष्ठा भिन्दन्नूर्मिभिः पिन्वमानः //
text_mt:
With "Thy whole realm rests upon the world, within the ocean, in the heart, within life;
Brought into being in the gathering of the host of waters, may we attain that sweet wave of thine," the sacrificer recites over [the offering] when it has been offered, or while it is being offered.

sanskrit_iast: abhi pravanta samaneva yoṣāḥ kalpāṇyaḥ smayamānāso agnim /
meaning: अभि प्रवन्त समनेव योषाः कल्पाण्यः स्मयमानासो अग्निम् /
text_mt: He offers the Vājaprasavīya offering.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtasya dhārāḥ samidho nasanta tā juṣāṇo haryati jātavedāḥ //
meaning: घृतस्य धाराः समिधो नसन्त ता जुषाणो हर्यति जातवेदाः //
text_mt: [There are] seven cultivated plants and seven wild plants.

sanskrit_iast: kanyā iva vahatumetavā u añjyañjānā abhi cākaśīmi /
meaning: कन्या इव वहतुमेतवा उ अञ्ज्यञ्जाना अभि चाकशीमि /
text_mt: Having liquefied the food substances separately, having offered the cultivated [grains] with the udumbara spoon with "The production of strength has produced this...", he offers the wild ones.

sanskrit_iast: yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajño ghṛtasya dhārā abhi tatpavante //
meaning: यत्र सोमः सूयते यत्र यज्ञो घृतस्य धारा अभि तत्पवन्ते //
text_mt: Having offered each time, he pours the residue into a vessel.

sanskrit_iast: abhyarṣata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta /
meaning: अभ्यर्षत सुष्टुतिं गव्यमाजिमस्मासु भद्रा द्रविणानि धत्त /
text_mt: Having set up an udumbara chair near the south side [of the fire], having spread on it a black antelope skin with its neck to the east and the hairy side turned up, he consecrates with the residues the sacrificer seated upon it and holding onto the fire from behind.

sanskrit_iast: imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumatpavante //
meaning: इमं यज्ञं नयत देवता नो घृतस्य धारा मधुमत्पवन्ते //
text_mt: A kṣatriya [is consecrated] on a tiger skin.

sanskrit_iast: dhāmante viśvaṃ bhuvanamadhi śritamantaḥ samudre hṛdyantarāyuṣi /
meaning: धामन्ते विश्वं भुवनमधि श्रितमन्तः समुद्रे हृद्यन्तरायुषि /
text_mt: A vaiśya on a goat skin.

sanskrit_iast: apāmanīke samithe ya ābhṛtastamaśyāma madhumantaṃ ta ūrmimiti hutāṃ hūyamānāṃ vā yajamāno 'numantrayate
meaning: अपामनीके समिथे य आभृतस्तमश्याम मधुमन्तं त ऊर्मिमिति हुतां हूयमानां वा यजमानो ऽनुमन्त्रयते
text_mt: One who desires spiritual luster [is consecrated] on a black antelope skin.
Some say: on a goat skin for one desiring prosperity.
